iḷavēṉiṟparuvam  (aṭi1-9),apparuvattil pālaivaḻi naṭantuvarum viṟaliyiṉ varuṇaṉai(10-33), ciṟiyayāḻai ēntiya ciṟupāṇaṉ vaṟumaiyāl kalaṅkiya nilaimai(34-40) cēranāṭṭuc ciṟappum ataṉ talainakarāṉa vañciyiṉ ciṟappum-(41-50), pāṇṭi nāṭṭuc ciṟappum ataṉtalainakarāṉa maturaiyiṉ ciṟappum(51-67), cōḻanāṭṭuc ciṟappum ataṉ kōnakarāṉa uṟaiyūrc ciṟappum (68-83), kaṭaieḻu vaḷḷalkaḷ ciṟappu(84-113), nalliyak kōṭaṉatu māvilaṅkai nakaracciṟappu, nalliyakkōṭaṉ ciṟappu(114-126), paricil peṟṟu mīṇṭa ciṟupāṇaṉatu muṉṉaiyavaṟiya nilai, atunīṅka vaḷḷal taṉakku poruḷīntamai(127-143), kiṭaṅkilukkuc cellumneṟi, neytal nilavaruṇaṉai, eyiṟpaṭṭiṉam, aṅkuḷḷavar upacarippu(144-163) eyiṟpaṭṭiṉattilirunta vēlūr cellum vaḻiyiluḷḷa mullai nilavaruṇaṉai (164-177),.....cellum vaḻiyiluḷsmarutaniyvaruṇad(178-195), kiṭaṅkišnakaracciṟapò(196-202). nalliyakkōṭaṉ iyalpukaḷ, avaṉ avaiyil iruttal (203-220), yāḻai icaittu avaṉ ciṟappiṉaip pāṭa, avaṉ ciṟupāṇaṉai  upacarittuk koṭai vaḻaṅkutal (221-269) ākiya ivaiyaṉaittum paricil peṟṟu mīṇṭa ciṟupāṇaṉ vaṟiya pāṇaṉukkuk kūṟiyavaiyākum.
perumpāṇāṟṟuppaṭai
inneṭumpāṭal, ainnūṟu aṭikaḷaiyuṭaiyatu. itaṉ kaṇ mutuvēṉil, pēriyāḻ varuṇaṉai, perumpāṇaṉatu vaṟiya nilai (1-22), paricil peṟṟa perum pāṇaṉuṭaiya muṉṉaiya vaṟiya nilai nīṅkip paricil peṟṟu varutal, iḷantiraiyaṉ ciṟappu (23-45), kāñcikkuc cellum vaḻiyil umaṇar vāṇikam, vaḻikaḷ, vaḻikaḷil kāvalar, miḷaku vāṇikam, ulkuṭaipperuvaḻikāvalar ,pāilayil eyiṉar vāḻvu, eyiṉar araṇkaḷ, mulilanilavaruṇaṉai, maruta nilavaruṇaiṉa, marutanilattil valaiyar, pāṇar vāḻkkai, maṟaiyavar uṟaipati, nīrpbpayaṟṟu, paṭṭivaḷam (46-351), paṭṭiṉattiliruntu kāñci cellum vaḻiyiln tāppukkuṭikaḷ, pērūrkaḷ, vaḷḷikkūttāṭum makkaḷ uḷḷa ciṟṟūrkaḷ, ivaṟṟukkappāl uḷḷatirubvaḵkah, aṅkuḷḷa aṭarnta cālaiyum, nīrvaḷamum, appāl uḷḷakaccimūtūr (352-392),kāñcivaruṇaṉai,(393-411), iḷantiraiyaṉvīram, araciyal, avaṉaip pahrāṭṭal, upacarippu, koṭaicciṟappu(411-500) eṉpaṉa iṭam peṟṟuḷḷaṉa. kūttāraṟṟuppaṭai 

(malaipaṭukaṭām)
innīṇṭa pāṭal ainnūṟṟeṇpattu mūṉṟu aṭikaḷaiyuṭaiyatu. `ceṅkaṇmā eṉpatu naṉṉaṉukkuriya talainakaram. annakaram naṉṉaṉuṭaiya malaikaḷukkut teṟku nilattil uḷḷatu. annakarattaiyaṭaittakum vaḻiyai ammalaikaḷiṉ vaḻiyē ceṉṟu paricil peṟṟu mīṇṭu cellum kūttaṉ, vaṟiya kūttaṉukkum avaṉ kūṭṭattārkkum kūṟiyuḷḷāṉ. eṉavē, avaṉ kūṟiyatil, mutalil aṭivāram nōkkic cellum vaḻi aṭivārap pakuti, malai vaḷam, malaikaḷiṉ mītuḷḷa kuṟiñci-pālai-mullai-marutanila amaippukaḷ, cēyāṟu, ataṉ oru karai vaḻiyē teṟku nōkkic ceṉṟu talaiyiluḷḷa ceṅkaṇmā nakarattai aṭaiyum vaḻi, araṇmaṉaic ciṟappu, naṉṉaṉ koṭaittiṟam eṉpaṉa muṟaiyē ippāṭalil amaintuḷḷaṉa. iṉi avaṉ kūṟiyuḷḷaṉa kāṇka:
mutalil kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷavai vaḷḷalai nāṭic cellum kūttar vaittirunta icaikkaruvikaḷ, yāḻiṉ varuṇaṉai, viṟaliyar varuṇaṉai, naṉṉaṉiṭam cellumāṟu kūṟutal, naṉṉaṉatu koṭaittaṉmai kūṟal, avaṉatu naviramalaiyil uḷḷa kāriyuṇṭik kaṭavuḷ, naṉṉaṉatu vīram ākiyavaṟṟaik kūṟal. piṉpu avaṉaik kāṇac cellattakam vaḻi kūṟutal (1-94).
aṭivāram nōkkic cellum vaḻiyil uḷḷa nilattiṉ taṉmaiyum viḷaiporuḷkaḷum, aṭivārattu ūrkaḷ (95-169), malaimītu vaḻi, uṇavu vakai, pōtaṟkariya vaḻi, naviramalai, kāriyuṇṭikkaṭavuḷ, vaḻittuṉpam, kuṉṟiṉkāvalar vaḻi kāṭṭal, pala vakai olikaḷ (170-348), ariya vaḻi, naṭukaṟkaḷ, mullai nilam, marutanilam, cēyāṟu, ataṉ orukaraiyaippaṟṟic cellavēṇṭuvatu (349-477), talainakaracciṟappu, araṇmaṉai muṟṟattil uḷḷa malaipaṭuporuḷkaḷ, naṉṉaṉaip pārāṭṭal, naṉṉaṉatu avai, naṉṉaṉatu upacarippu, koṭai (478-583).
nāṉkilum potuc ceytikaḷ
mēlē kūṟappaṭṭa nāṉku āṟṟuppaṭaikaḷilum potuvāy uḷḷa ceytikaḷ yāvai?
vaḷḷalai nāṭic cellum putiya vaṟiya porunaṉ, pāṇaṉ, kūttaṉ, uṭaṉ ceṉṟavar ākiyōratu vaṟiya icaikkaruvikaḷ paṟṟiya kuṟippu, paricil peṟṟa pāṇaṉ vaḷḷalaik kāṇumuṉ irunta taṉatu vaṟiya nilaiyaiyum vaḷḷalaik kaṇṭapiṉpu peṟṟa celvanilaiyaiyum paṟṟiya kuṟippu, vaḷḷaliṉ nalliyalpukaḷ, avaṉatu talainakarattukkuc cellattakka vaḻi, avaṉatu talainakarac ciṟappu, avaṉ varavēṟpu, avaṉatu vīram, upacarippu, paricuvaḻaṅkaḷ eṉpaṉa mēlē collappaṭṭa nāṉku āṟṟuppaṭaikaḷilum potuppaṭaiyāy iṭam peṟṟuḷḷavaiyākum.
enta nāṭṭilum perumpālum ` kuṟiñci, pālai, mullai, marutam, neytal ākiya aivakai nilaṅkaḷum irukkalām. āyiṉ, cōḻa nāṭṭil malaiyum malaicārnta kuṟiñcinilamum illai; iṅṅaṉamē naṉṉaṉatu malai nāṭṭil kaṭalum kaṭal cārnta neytal nilamum illai. malaināṭē kuṟiñciyāyiṉam, kūttarāṟṟuppaṭai pāṭiya āciriyar kuṟiñci nilamākiya malaikaḷiṉmītu mullai, pālai, marutanilaṅkaḷ iruppatākap pāṭiyuḷḷār;  malaiyil pulveḷiyuḷḷa pakuti mullai; kaṟkaḷum pāṟaikaḷum uḷḷa pakuti pālai; tiṉai mutaliyaṉa viḷaiyum pakuti kuṟiñci; karumpum nellum payirākum āṟṟup pakuti nilam marutam eṉa malaimītuḷḷa viḷaivaik koṇṭu nāṉilaṅkaḷaip pirittuk kūṟiyuḷḷār.
ovvōr āṟṟuppaṭaiyilum kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷa vaḻi cuṟṟu vaḻiyākavē kāṇappaṭukiṟatu. avvaḻi akkāla makkaḷ payaṇam ceyta vaḻiyāyirun tirukkalām; allatu aivakai nila varuṇaṉaiyai āṟṟuppaṭaiyiṟ pukuttik kūṟuvēṇṭum eṉṟu eṇṇi avaṟṟai uḷḷaṭakkiya cuṟṟu vaḻiyākavum irukkalām. uṇmai ippoḻutu aṟiyumāṟillai. porunarāṟṟup paṭaiyil porunaṉ enta ūraiyum kuṟippiṭāmal, marutam-mullai- neytal-kuṟiñci nilappakutikaḷai varuṇittuc celvatāl, avaṉ kūṟiyuḷḷa vaḻiyai mēṟpōkkākavum kūṟa iyalavillai. naṉṉaṉatu malaināṭum talainakarāṉa ceṅkaṇmāvum paṭattil kuṟikkap paṭṭuḷḷaṉa. kūttaṉ eṅkiruntu naṭantu ceṉṟu enta malaiyil mutalil ēṟiṉāṉ eṉpatu ataṟku cāṉṟillai. āyiṉ, naviramalaiyiliruntu cēyāṟu varaiyum, piṟaku aṅkiruntu ceṅkam varaiyum ceṉṟavaḻiyai oruvāṟu tuṇiyalām.
ciṟupāṇaṉ kūṟiya ōymāṉāṭṭu vaḻiyil perumpāṇaṉ kūṟiya toṇṭai nāṭṭu vaḻiyum oruvāṟu aṟiyalām. ivai mikka tolaivuḷḷa vaḻikaḷ. ivai muṉṉarc colliyavāṟu uṇmai vaḻikaḷā allatu aivakai nila varuṇaṉaikkākap pulavar kaṟpittavaiyā eṉpatait tuṇiyac cāṉṟillai. āyiṉ, ovvoru vaḻiyilum avvaḻiyaik kūṟiya pulavar, aivakai nila varuṇaṉaiyai viṭāmaṟkūṟiyiruppataik kāṇa, ivvaḻikaḷ pulavar kaṟpaṉai vaḻikaḷ ākalām eṉṟu karututal takum.
iṅṅaṉam karutuvatu poruttamākum eṉpataṟkuk kūttarāṟṟup paṭaiyil kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷa vaḻiyē ēṟṟa cāṉṟākum.
paricil peṟṟu mīṇṭu vanta kūttaṉ malaiyaṭivārattait tāṇṭic cellum vaḻiyil -malaippakutikkuc ciṟitu tolaivil uḷḷa nilappakutiyil - vaṟiya kūttaṉaic cantittu, nilappakutiyilē (malaiyilaṉṟu) uḷḷa naṉṉaṉatu ceṅkaṇmā eṉṉum talainakarattukku āṟṟuppaṭuttiṉāṉ eṉpataip pāṭalē kūṟukiṟatu. avaṉ āṟṟuppaṭuttiya pōtu avarkaḷ irunta iṭam nilam; malaiyaṉṟu. naṉṉaṉatu talai nakaramum nilattilētāṉ uḷḷatē tavira, malaiyilaṉṟu. annakarattiṟku malaiyēṟāmalē malaiyōramākavē teṟku nōkki variṉ, ceṅkaṇmāvai eḷitil aṭaiyalām. ivvaḷavu eḷiya vaḻi irukka, kūttaṉ malai vaḻiyaik kūṟiyatākap pulavar pāṭiyatēṉ?
pulavar ammalaikaḷai naṉku pārvaiyiṭṭavar; vaḻit tuṉpaṅkaḷai nukarntavar; malaimītu palavakai nilaṅkaḷaik kaṇṭu kaḷittavar; naviramalaiyil araṇum kāriyuṇṭik kaṭavuḷ kōyilum iruntaṉa; vēṟumalaikaḷil naṭukaṟkaḷ iruntaṉa; āṅkāṅku naṉṉaṉiṉ malaināṭṭuk. kuṭiyiruntu kāval kāttaṉar. malaivaḷam kaṇṇukkiṉiya kāṭciyait tantatu. malai vaḻiyaik kūṟiṉāltāṉ avvaḻiyil ivaiyaṉaittaiyum amaittuk kūṟu iyalum. naṉṉaṉatu nāṭṭil malaivaḷamē ciṟanta vaḷam. ivaṟṟaik kūṟi malaikaḷaic ciṟappippatāl naṉṉaṉ makiḻvāṉ eṉṟu eṇṇiyavar ātalāl, inta iṭakkāṉa malaivaḻiyaip paricil peṟṟa kūttaṉ putiya kūttaṟkuk kūṟiyatākap pulavar pāṭiṉār eṉṟu karutuvatē ēṟpuṭaiyatu.
tirumurukāṟṟuppaṭai amaippu
tolkāppiyar, kūttar, pāṇar, porunar, viṟaliyar ākiya nālvaraiyum poruḷutavi puriyum vaḷḷalpāl āṟṟuppaṭuttuvatu āṟṟuppaṭai eṉak kūṟiṉār. itaṉāl pulavarai āṟṟuppaṭuttutal avarkku muṉpum avar kālattilum vaḻakkil illai eṉpatu teḷivākiṟatu. innilaiyil, maṉitaṉait teyvattiṭam āṟṟuppaṭuttum vaḻakkam avar kalattil vaḻakkil illai eṉpatu teḷivākiṟatu. innilaiyil, maṉitaṉait btayvattiṭam āṟṟuppaṭuttum vaḻakkam avar kahlattil aṟavē illai eṉpatu taḷivu. āṟṟuppaṭaikaḷ āṟṟuppaṭuttappaṭum pāṇar, kūttar, porunar, viṟali eṉṉum peyarkaḷōṭu cārttip pāṇāṟṟuppaṭai, kūttarāṟṟuppaṭai, poru narāṟṟuppaṭai, viṟaliyāṟṟup paṭai eṉa vaḻaṅkappaṭum. āyiṉ, tirumurukāṟṟuppaṭai immuṟaiyil amaintataṉṟu. murukaṉ aruḷpeṟṟa pulavar oruvar putiya pulavar oruvarai murukaṉpāl āṟṟuppaṭuttuvatāka nakkīrar itaṉaip pāṭiyuḷḷār. ātaliṉ, itu pulavar āṟṟuppaṭai eṉṉum peyaraip peṟṟatu eṉṟu cilar kūṟuvar. āyiṉ, itu pulavarāṟṟuppaṭai eṉṉum peyaril vaḻakkup peṟāmal, tirumurukāṟṟuppaṭai eṉṟē peruvaḻakkup peṟṟuḷḷatu. mēlum, itu caṅkakālattiṟku (ki.pi. 300kku)p piṉpum, appar-campantarkku (ki.pi. 600kku) muṉpum pāṭappaṭṭirukkalām eṉpatu muṉpē kūṟappaṭṭatu. iṉi, itaṉ amaippaik kāṇpōm:
itu munnūṟṟuppatiṉēḻaṭikaḷaik koṇṭa nīṇṭa akavaṟpāvākum. murukaṉ kuṟiñci nilac ciṟappuk kaṭavuḷ ātalāl, potuppaṭa malaināṭṭukkuriya murukaṉ eṉpatai uṇartta vaḷam mikunta malai oṉṟaṉaic4  ciṟappittukkūṟi, ammalaikku urimai pūṇṭa murukaṉ, tirupparaṅkuṉṟam, tiruccīralaivāy, tiru āvi naṉkuṭi, tiru ērakam eṉṉum nāṉku ciṟappuṭait talaṅkaḷil eḻuntaruḷiyuḷḷāṉ eṉṟu kūṟi, apperumāṉ mēlum kuṉṟutōṟāṭal koṇṭavaṉ eṉṟum kuṟamakaḷ ceyyum murukavaḻipāṭum kūṟi, apperumāṉaip putiya pattaṉ eppaṭi vaḻipaṭa vēṇṭum eṉpataic cuṭṭi, murukaṉaruḷ puriyum tiṟattiṉaiyum kūṟi ippāṭal muṭivuṟukiṉṟatu.
piṟa āṟṟuppaṭaikaḷiṟ kāṇappaṭum āṟṟuppaṭuttap paṭuttuvōṉ taṉatu paḻaiya nilaiyai viḷakkutal, paricil peṟṟa muṟaiyaik kūṟutal eṉpaṉa immurukāṟṟup paṭaiyil teḷivākak kūṟappaṭavillai eṉpatu kavaṉikkattakkatu.
itaṉkaṇ mutaṟpakutiyil murukaṉ tiruvuruvac ciṟappu, avaṉ mālai vicēṭaṅkaḷ, cūraramakaḷir ceyalkaḷ, murukaṉ cūraṉai veṉṟamai, maturaiyiṉ ciṟappu, tirupparaṅkuṉṟattiṉ iyaṟkaivaḷam eṉpavai kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa (aṭi, 1-77); iraṇṭām pakutiyil murukaṉatu yāṉaiyiṉ iyalpu, apperumāṉuṭaiya āṟumukaṅkaḷiṉ ceyalkaḷ, tiruccīralai vāyil avaṉ iruttal eṉpavai iṭam peṟṟuḷḷaṉa (aṭi, 78-125); mūṉṟām pakutiyil murukaṉai vaḻipaṭum muṉivar oḻukkam, tēvamakaḷir iyalpukaḷ, tirumāl mutaliyavar paṟṟiya ceytikaḷ kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa (aṭi, 127-176); nāṉkām pakutiyil antaṇar iyalpum avarkaḷ tiruvērakattil murukaṉ vaḻipaṭum muṟaimaiyum kuṟikkappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa. (aṭi, 177-189); aintām pakutiyil kuṉṟakkuravai, murukaṉai vaḻipaṭum makaḷir, āṭumakaḷir, pāṭumakaḷir iyalpukaḷ, avartam aṇi āṭai ceyal mutaliyaṉa iṭam peṟṟuḷḷaṉa (aṭi, 190-217); āṟām pakutiyil murukaṉ eḻuntaruḷiyuḷḷa iṭaṅkaḷ, tēvarāṭṭi apperumāṉai āṟṟuppaṭuttum muṟai, avaṉait tutikkum muṟai, apperumāṉiṭam ceṉṟu aruḷ perum vaḻi, avaṉuṭaiya toṇṭartam iyalpukaḷ, murukaṉ aruḷ puriyum muṟai, paḻamutircōlai vaḷam ākiyavai kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.
inta muṟai vaippu, mēlē kūṟappaṭṭa porunar āṟṟuppaṭai mutaliyavaṟṟil illai.
4. āṟṟuppaṭai vaḻikaḷ
1. tirumurukāṟṟuppaṭai
murukaṉatu aruḷaip peṟṟa aṭiyavaṉ oruvaṉ, avvaruḷ peṟa virumpiya maṟṟoruvaṉai murukaṉiṭam āṟṟuppaṭuttum muṟaiyil muṟaiyē paraṅkuṉṟam, āvi naṉkuṭi, alaivāy, ērakam ākiya nāṉku iṭaṅkaḷait teḷivākak kūṟiyuḷḷāṉ; piṟa iṭaṅkaḷai (malai, āṟu mutaliyavaṟṟai)p potuppaṭaccuṭṭic ceṉṟuḷḷāṉ. ippāṭalaip pāṭiyavar nakkīrar. avarāl mutaliṟcuṭṭap paṭṭatu maturaiyai aṭuttuḷḷa paraṅkuṉṟam. ātalāl, avarāl pāṭappaṭṭa murukaṉaṭiyāṉ maturaiyiliruntu putiya aṭiyavaṉai āṟṟuppaṭuttiṉāṉ eṉṟu koḷvatu poruttamākum.
tirumurukāṟṟuppaṭaiyil kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷa mutal iṭam paraṅkuṉṟam. atu maturai māvaṭṭattil caṅka kāla maturaikku aṇmaiyil nēr mēṟkil iruntatu; iṉṟuḷḷa maturaikkut teṉmēṟkil-ēṟattāḻa aintu kal tolaivil- uḷḷatu.
iraṇṭāvatākak kūṟappaṭum iṭam alaivāy. inta alaivāyē puṟanāṉūṟu mutaliya nūlkaḷil kūṟappaṭum `centil eṉṟum, iṉṟaiya `tiruccentūr eṉṟum aṟiñar karutukiṉṟaṉar. ivviṭam tirunelvēli māvaṭṭattuk kaṭaṟkaraiyil amaintuḷḷatu. iṅkuḷḷa murukaṉ kōvil perumpukaḻ peṟṟatu.
mūṉṟāvatākak kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷa iṭam, āvi naṉkuṭi eṉpatu. iḵtu iṉṟuḷḷa paḻaṉi eṉṉum ūrākum. ivvūril malaiyaṭivārattil uḷḷa kōvilē tirumurukāṟṟuppaṭaiyil kuṟikkappeṟṟatākum.
nāṉkāvatākak kūṟappaṭṭatu ērakam eṉṉum iṭamākum. `itu malai nāṭṭakattatu, eṉṟu nacciṉārkkiṉiyar kūṟiyuḷḷār. malai nāṭu eṉpatu mēṟkut toṭarcci malaiyaic cārnta nilappakuti ākum. ērakam eṉpatu nākarkōvilukku aṇmaiyiluḷḷa vēḷmalai (vēḻi malai) eṉṟu cilar kūṟuvar. tirumurukāṟṟup paṭaiyiluḷḷa ērakam paṟṟiya vivaraṅkaḷaik kāṇa, ērakam eṉpatu, teṉ kaṉṉaṭa māvaṭṭattup puttūr vaṭṭattuk kiḻakkuk kōṭiyil mēṟku malaittoṭariṉ mēṟkup pakkattil uḷḷa `kumāra kṣēttiram eṉṉum iṭamāy irukkalām. `murukaṉukkuriya iṭaṅkaḷ eṉṉum pakutiyil itu paṟṟi viḷakkappaṭum.
tirumurukāṟṟuppaṭaiyil murukaṉ kōvil koṇṭuḷḷaṉavākac ciṟappittuk kūṟappaṭum iṭaṅkaḷ inta nāṉkēyākum. murukaṉ aruḷ peṟṟa aṭiyavaṉ, apperumāṉ aruḷaippeṟa virumpum aṭiyavaṉukku innāṉkaiyum kūṟiya piṉpu, ``murukaṉ kuṉṟutōṟum āṭal purikiṉṟāṉ. ūrmaṉṟaṅkaḷilum nīrttuṟaiyilum palvēṟu iṭaṅkaḷilum avaṉ tōṉṟuvāṉ, eṉṟu kūṟi muṭittuḷḷāṉ.
ivvivaraṅkaḷai nōkka, āṟṟuppaṭuttiya aṭiyavaṉ murukaṉ eṅkum iruppavaṉ eṉpataip putiyavaṉukku aṟivuṟutti, akkālattil ciṟappuṟṟirunta murukaṉukkuriya iṭaṅkaḷ nāṉkai maṭṭum viḷakkamākakkūṟi āṟṟuppaṭuttiṉāṉ eṉṟu koḷvatē poruttamākum.
avaṉ kūṟiya iṭaṅkaḷuḷ paraṅkuṉṟamum āvi naṉkuṭiyum maturai māvaṭṭattil uḷḷavai; alaivāy maturaikkut teṉkiḻakkil ēṟattāḻa nūṟu kal tolaivil uḷḷatu. ērakam maturaikku neṭuntolaivu vaṭamēṟkil mēṟku malait toṭarccikku mēṟkil uḷḷatu.
āṟṟuppaṭuttiya aṭiyavaṉ kūṟiya muṟaippaṭiyē putiyavaṉ attalaṅkaḷaik kāṇavēṇṭumāyiṉ, mutalil tirupparaṅkuṉṟattai vaḻivaṭṭu, piṉpu ēṟattāḻa nūṟu kal tūram teṟkē ceṉṟu alaivāyai aṭaiya vēṇṭum. aṅkuḷḷa murukaṉai vaḻipaṭṭa piṉpu avaṉ mīṇṭum maturai māvaṭṭattiluḷḷa paḻaṉiyai aṭaiya vēṇṭum; piṉpu aṅkiruntu apputiyavaṉ teṉ kaṉṉaṭa māvaṭṭattiluḷḷa ērakattai aṭaiyavēṇṭum. āṟṟuppaṭuttiya aṭiyavaṉ paraṅkuṉṟattai aṭuttu āvi naṉkuṭiyaik kūṟiyiruttal vēṇṭum. atuvē muṟaiyākum. avaṉ ekkāraṇaṅ koṇṭō aṅṅaṉam kūṟāmal, iraṇṭāvatākak kuṟikka vēṇṭiya iṭattai mūṉṟāvatākak kuṟittuviṭṭāṉ. oruvēḷai avaṉ inta iṭaṅkaḷaiyellām putiyavaṉ ceṉṟu kāṇavēṇṭum eṉṟu niṉaittuk kūṟavillai pōlum! avaṉ, murukaṉ ciṟappākak kōvil koṇṭirunta iṭaṅkaḷait teḷivākakkūṟi, piṉpu apperumāṉ tōṉṟum catukkam canti nīrttuṟai mutaliyavaṟṟaiyellām kūṟi, attakaiya perumāṉaic caraṇaṭaivatē uyyum vaḻi eṉṟu eṇṇik kūṟiyiruttal vēṇṭum eṉṟu koḷvatē poruttamākum.
2. porunar āṟṟuppaṭai
itu karikāṟcōḻaṉiṭam paricil peṟṟu mīṇṭa porunaṉ vaḻiyil putiya porunaṉaik kaṇṭu avaṉai avvaḷḷalpāl āṟṟuppaṭuttiyatākap pāṭappaṭṭuḷḷatu. itaṉaip pāṭiyavar muṭattāmakkaṇṇiyār. ivarē nāmō ūrō aṟiyumāṟillai. ippāṭalil kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷa nilavaruṇaṉai, putiya porunaṉ cellattakum vaḻi eṉpaṉa cōḻanāṭu paṟṟiyaṉavākavē uḷḷaṉa. ivaṟṟai nōkka, paricu peṟṟa porunaṉ putiya porunaṉaic cōṇāṭṭu ellaiyuḷ āṟṟuppaṭuttiṉāṉ eṉṟu koḷvatē poruttamākum.
porunarāṟṟuppaṭai irunūṟṟunāṟpatteṭṭu aṭikaḷai uṭaiyatu. inneṭumpāṭṭaip pāṭiya āciriyar oṉṟu mutal 178 aṭikaḷ varaiyil viṟaliyiṉ varuṇaṉai, porunaṉ karikālaṉiṭam ceṉṟa pōtirunta vaṟiya nilai, karikālaṉatu upacarippu, avaṉuṭaiya vīram koṭai paṟṟiya ceytikaḷ ākiyavaṟṟaikkūṟi, 179 ām aṭiyiliruntu 248ām aṭi varaiyil (69 aṭikaḷil) cōḻanāṭṭu vaḷattaik kūṟiyuḷḷār. ivar, putiya pāṇaṉ etu vaḻiyākac ceṉṟu karikālaṉai evvūril kāṇavēṇṭum eṉpatai ippāṭaliṟ kuṟikkavēyillai eṉpatu kavaṉikkattakkatu. ivar ippakutiyil kāviriyiṉ nīrvaḷam, cōḻa nāṭṭu marutanilac ciṟappu, ciṟṟūrkaḷiṉ vaḷam ākiyavaṟṟaiyē kūṟiyuḷḷār. ivvivaraṅkaḷai nōkka, perumpāṇāṟṟuppaṭai ciṟupāṇāṟṟuppaṭai, kūttarāṟṟuppaṭai ākiya mūṉṟaiyum pāṭiya āciriyarkaḷaip pōla ivar putiya porunaṉukku muṟaippaṭi vaḻikūṟavillai eṉpatu teḷivākiṟatu. piṟa āṟṟuppaṭaikaḷ putiya pāṇaṉaiyō kūttaṉaiyō āṟṟuppaṭuttum muṟaiyil, kuṟippiṭṭa ovvoru vaḷḷalaiyum pukaḻvataṟkākavē pāṭappaṭṭatu. eṉiṉum, avaṟṟuḷ ovvoṉṟilum vaḻi cemmaiyākak kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷatu. attakaiya vaḻi ipporunarāṟṟup paṭaiyil kūṟappaṭavillai. karikālaṉuṭaiya talainakarattiṉ peyarum ciṟappum kuṟikkappaṭavillai. eṉavē, putiya porunaṉ etu vaḻiyākac ceṉṟu karikālaṉaikkāṇa vēṇṭum eṉṟu paricu peṟṟa porunaṉ virumpiṉāṉ eṉpatai ippāṭal koṇṭu kūṟakkūṭavillai. ivai aṉaittaiyum nōkka, karikālaṉatu ciṟappaiyum cōḻanāṭṭu vaḷattaiyumē kūṟi, paricu peṟṟa porunaṉ putiya porunaṉaik karikālaṉiṭam āṟṟuppaṭuttiṉāṉ eṉṟu karutattakum muṟaiyil ippāṭal amaintuḷḷatu eṉṉalām.
tirumurukāṟṟuppaṭaiyilum porunarāṟṟup paṭaiyilum- ciṟupāṇ āṟṟuppaṭai, perumpāṇāṟṟup paṭai, kūttārāṟṟuppaṭai eṉpavai pōlat teḷivāka vaḻi kūṟappaṭavillai eṉpatu aṟiyattakkatu. immuṟaiyil muṉṉiraṇṭum oru vakaiyiṉa; piṉṉavai mūṉṟum vēṟu vakaiyiṉa eṉpatu niṉaiviṟkoḷḷattakum.
3. ciṟupāṇāṟṟuppaṭai
ōymāṉāṭṭu nalliyakkōṭaṉ kiṭaṅkil eṉṉum taṉ talainakaril iruntāṉ. avaṉiṭam paricil peṟṟu mīṇṭa ciṟupāṇaṉ, vēṟoru ciṟupāṇaṉai avaṉiṭam āṟṟup paṭuttiyatāka iṭaikkaḻināṭṭu nallūr nattattaṉār eṉṟa pulavar ciṟupāṇāṟṟuppaṭaiyaip pāṭiyuḷḷār.
paricil peṟṟa ciṟupāṇaṉ putiyapāṇaṉai nōkki, ``kaṭal parantu eṟṟip porutalālē alaiyum nīraiyuṭaiya karaiyil veḷḷiya maṇaliṭattu niṉṟa tāḻai, aṉṉam pōlap pūkkum; iḷavēṉiṟkālam toṭaṅkukiṉṟa nāḷil ceruntimalar taṉṉaik kaṇṭāraip poṉ eṉṟu maruḷacceyyum; kaḻimuḷḷi nīlamaṇi pōlap pūkkum; neṭiya tāḷiṉaiyuṭaiya puṉṉaimaram nittilam pōla arumpukaḷai veḷippaṭuttum. nī ivaṟṟai neytal nilattu neṭuvaḻiyiṟkāṇalām. avvaḻiyil  nīlamaṇi pōlum (uppaṅ) kaḻi cūḻnta ūrkaḷaiyuṭaiya paṭṭiṉam kāṇalām. atu matilōṭē (eyilōṭē) peyar peṟṟa paṭṭiṉam1 (matiṟpaṭṭiṉam, allatu cōppaṭṭiṉam, allatu eyiṟpaṭṭiṉam) eṉṟu kūṟukiṟāṉ. nacciṉārkkiṉiyar `eyiṟpaṭṭiṉam eṉṟē urai kūṟiyuḷḷār. ciṟupāṇāṟṟuppaṭai iṟuti veṇpāvil nalliyakkōṭaṉ `eyiṟpaṭṭiṉa nāṭaṉ eṉṟu kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷāṉ.
`eyiṟpaṭṭiṉam eṉpatu iṟṟaināḷ tiṇṭivaṉam vaṭṭattil uḷḷa marakkāṇamāyirukkalām eṉṟu aṟiñar kūṟuvar.2 marakkāṇattiṟku vaṭamēṟkil - ēṟattāḻa irupatukal tolaivil-kiṭaṅkil irukkiṟatu. marakkāṇattiṟkut teṉmēṟkil vēlūr uḷḷatu. vēlūriliruntu kiṭaṅkilukkup pōkum pātaiyil āmūr iruppatākac ciṟupāṇaṉ ceppiyuḷḷāṉ. ataṟku aṇmaiyil kiṭaṅkil iruppatākakkūṟi, āmūr vaḻic cellumpaṭi tūṇṭukiṟāṉ.
mutalil eyiṟpaṭṭiṉattai aṭaiyumpaṭi ciṟupāṇaṉ putiya pāṇaṉukkuk kūṟukiṟāṉ; ataṉai aṭaiyattakum kaṭalōra vaḻiyaiyum pulappaṭuttukiṟāṉ. vaṭakkiliruntō allatu teṟkiliruntōtāṉ karaiyōramāka oruvaṉ eyiṉpaṭṭiṉattai aṭaital kūṭum. teṟkiliruntu puṟappaṭum oruvaṉ kiṭaṅkilukkuc cella - allatu vēlūrukkuc cella - vaṭakkiluḷḷa eyiṟpaṭṭiṉam cellat tēvaiyillai; avaṉ nērē vēlūrukkō allatu kiṭaṅkilukkō vaṭakku allatu vaṭamēṟku nōkkic cellalām. ivvivaraṅkaḷaiyum, `kaṭalōramākac celliṉ eyiṟpaṭṭiṉattai aṭaiyalām, eṉṟu ciṟupāṇaṉ kūṟutalaiyum nōkka, nattattaṉār tamatu ūrākiya (eyiṟpaṭṭiṉattiṟka vaṭakkiluḷḷa) iṭaikkaḻi nāṭṭu nallūriliruntē parica peṟṟa ciṟupāṇaṉ putiya pāṇaṉai āṟṟuppaṭuttiyatākap pāṭiyirukkalām eṉṟu karututal poruttamākum.
`iṭaikkaḻi nāṭu eṉpatu ceṅkaṟpaṭṭu māvaṭṭattu maturāntakam vaṭṭattil uppaṅkaḻikkum kaṭaṟkaraikkum iṭaippaṭṭa nilappakutiyākum. aḵtu ippoḻutu `eṭakkanāṭu eṉṟu maruvi vaḻaṅkappaṭukiṟatu. annāṭṭiṉ teṉkōṭiyil `nallūr eṉṉum ciṟṟūr uḷḷatu. nattattaṉār eṉṟa pulavar avvūril iruntār eṉṉum cevi vaḻicceyti iṉṟum avvūrilum cuṟṟuppuṟa ūrkaḷilum nilaittuḷḷatu.
aṅkiruntu puṟappaṭṭa ciṟupāṇaṉ kaṭalōramākat teṟku nōkki naṭantu, ōymāṉāṭṭaic cērnta kaṭaṟkaraip paṭṭiṉamāṉa eyiṟpaṭṭiṉattai aṭaiyumpaṭi vaḻi kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷatu. iraṇṭiṟkum iṭaiyil ēṟattāḻa eṭṭukkal tolaivu irukkalām. eyiṟpaṭṭiṉattiliruntu mullai nilavaḻiyē ceṉṟāl, vēlūrai aṭaiyalām eṉpatu kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷatu. eyiṟpaṭṭiṉattiṟkut teṉmēṟkil ēṟattāḻa 12 kal tolaivil vēlūr uḷḷatu. vēlūrukkum āmūrukkum iṭaiyil marutanilam uḷḷatu. `āmūr eṉṉum ūr iṉṟu illai. vēlūrukku mēṟkil koṇṭāmūrum vaṭamēṟkil ciṟṟāmūr, nallāmūr eṉṉum ūrkaḷum uḷḷaṉa. ivaṟṟuḷ nallāmūr kiṅkilukkut teṟkil āṟu kal tolaivil uḷḷatu. maṟṟavai mikutolaivil uḷḷaṉa. āmūr varai nāṭṭu vaḷappam kūṟiya pulavar, āmūraip paṟṟip pēciyapiṟaku āmūrkkum kiṭaṅkilukkum iṭaippaṭṭa nilattaip paṟṟi oṉṟum kūṟāmal kiṭaṅkilaip paṟṟip pēcat toṭaṅki viṭṭār. eṉavē, āmūr kiṭaṅkilukku aṇmaiyil iruntiruttal vēṇṭum eṉpatu terikiṟata. innilaiyil ottu varuvatu iṉṟuḷḷa nallāmūrēyākam. atu vēlūrukku vaṭa mēṟkil ēṟattāḻa 11 kal tolaivil uḷḷatu.
4. perumpāṇāṟṟuppaṭai
perumpāṇāṟṟuppaṭaiyaip pāṭiyavar kaṭiyalūr uruttiraṅ kaṇṇaṉār eṉpavar. kaṭiyalūr eṉṉumūr evviṭattatu eṉpatu kūṟa iyalavillai. avar kūṟiyuḷḷa perumpāṇaṉ putiya perumpāṇaṉai eṅkuc cantittāṉ eṉpatum teriyavillai. āyiṉ, apperumpāṇaṉ kūṟiyuḷḷa vaḻiyil vēṟṟaracar nāṭu kūṟappappaṭavillai; toṇṭai nāṭṭu nilaṅkaḷum ūrkaḷumē kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa. ivaṟṟaik kūrntu nōkkiṉ, perum pāṇaṉ toṇṭaināṭṭiṉ uṭpakutiyiliruntē putiya pāṇaṉukkuk kāñcikkuc cella vaḻi kūṟiyuḷḷāṉ eṉpatu teḷivākat terikiṟatu.
perumpāṇaṉ putiyapāṇaṉukku mūṉṟu iṭaṅkaḷait teḷivākak kūṟiyuḷḷāṉ. avai muṟaiyē `nīrppeyaṟṟu eṉṉum iṭattiṉ ellai yil amainta tuṟaimukanakaram, kāñcikku muṉṉuḷḷa paḷḷikoṇṭa perumāḷkōvil (tiruveḵkā), kāñcimānakaram eṉpaṉavākum. perumpāṇaṉ mutalil tuṟaimuka nakarattai aṭaiya avaṉukku vaḻi kūṟiyuḷḷāṉ; piṉpu aṅkiruntu kāñcikkuc  cella vaḻi kūṟiyuḷḷāṉ. itaṉāl apputiyavaṉ eḷitil kāñcikkuc cellum vaḻiyaiyē perumpāṇaṉ kūṟiyuḷḷāṉ eṉṟu karututal takum. avaṉ mutalil kaṭaṟkarai nakarai aṭaiyumpaṭi kūṟiyuḷḷatai nōkka, avaṉ vaḻi kūṟiya iṭattiliruntu akkaṭaṟkarai nakarai aṭaivatē eḷiteṉak karutiyiruttal vēṇṭum. avaṉ kaṭaṟkaraikkuc cēymaiyiliruntu vaḻi kūṟiyiruppiṉ, kaṭaṟkarai nakarai mutalil aṭaiyumpaṭi kūṟiyirāṉ; mikutiyāka naṭakkumpaṭi ceytirāṉ. eṉavē, perumpāṇaṉ kaṭaṟkaraikku aṇmaiyiliruntē putiṇa pāṇaṟka vaḻi kūṟiyiruttal vēṇṭum eṉak koḷvatu poruttamākum.
tuṟaimuka nakarattiṟkup pōkum vaḻi
perumpāṇaṉ putiya perumpāṇaṉaic cantitta iṭattilirunta kūṟiyuḷḷa vaḻi itu eṉpatai niṉaiviṟ koṇṭu, kīḻ varum ceytikaḷaik kavaṉittal vēṇṭum:
1. umaṇar uppu vaṇṭikaḷaiyum taṉi māṭukaḷaiyum ōṭṭic cellum neṭiya vaḻikaḷ vaḻiyiṟkāṇappaṭum. avvaḻikaḷil vaṇikar kaḻutaikaḷiṉmītu miḷakuppotikaḷai ēṟṟic ceṉṟu vāṇikam ceyvar. avvaḻikaḷil cuṅkaccāvaṭikaḷ uṇṭu; nāṭukāval ceyyum viṟpaṭai vīrar ūrkaḷ uṇṭu. avvaḻikaḷiṟkāṭukaḷum uṇṭu.
2. kāṭukaḷait tāṇṭiyatum pālai nilam kāṇappaṭum. aṅku eyiṉar īttilaik kuṭicaikaḷil vāḻvar. ippālai nilattaik kaṭantavuṭaṉ eyiṉar araṇkaḷ irukkum.
3. araṇkaḷukku appāl mullai nila makkaḷākiya iṭaiyar kuṭiyiruppukaḷ kāṇappaṭum.
4. mullai nilam tāṇṭiya piṉpu vayalum vayal cārnta iṭamumākiya marutanilam kāṇappaṭum.
5. marutanilattil kuḷaṅkaḷum ērikaḷum uṇṭu. taruppaippul vēynta kuṭicaikaḷil vāḻum valaiyar, nīr nilaikaḷil valai vīci mīṉ piṭippar. marutanilattil uḷḷa kuḷaṅkaḷilum ērikaḷilum maṇamikka malarkaḷ malarntirukkum. aṅkuḷḷōr avaṟṟaip paṟippar.
6. ammarutanilap pakutiyil celliṉ, maṟaiyavar uṟaipati (piṟkāla akaram allatu piramatēyam, allatu caturvēti maṅkalam) oṉṟai aṭaiyalām. aṅku vētamōti vēḷvi ceyyum vētiyar vāḻvar.
7. aṭuttu, makaḷir nīrāṭum tuṟai kāṇappaṭum. attuṟaiyil makaḷir nekiḻaviṭṭa maṇikaḷ patitta nakaiyaic ciccilippaṟavai eṭuttuc ceṉṟu maṟaiyavar vēḷvic cālaiyil naṭṭuvaitta tūṇmītu amarum. ammaṟaiyavar vāḻum iṭam `nīrpeyaṟṟu eṉpatu. ataṉ ellaiyil tuṟaimukam amaintuḷḷatu.
8. aṅku mēṟṟicaiyiliruntu veṇṇiṟak kutiraikaḷaiyum vaṭaticaiyiliruntu pala poruḷkaḷaiyum koṇṭuvarum kappalkaḷ cūḻntu kiṭakkum kaṭaṟpakkam uṇṭu. aṅkup paṇṭacālaikaḷaiyum paratavar māṭaṅkaḷaiyum celvar vaḷamaṉaikaḷaiyumuṭaiya paṭṭiṉam uṇṭu. kalaṅkarai viḷakkamum aṅku uṇṭu.
tuṟaimuka nakarattiliruntu kāñcikku vaḻi
1. tuṟaimukappaṭṭiṉattiliruntu kāñci nōkkic cellum vaḻiyil teṉṉantōppukaḷ mikutiyāyuṇṭu. attōppukaḷil makkaḷ kuṭiyiruppukaḷ irukkum. aṅkup palāppaḻamum, vāḻaippaḻamum, iḷanīrum, nuṅkum kiṭaikkum.
2. avaṟṟukkappāl uḷḷa vaḻiyil viṇ varuṭum māṭaṅkaḷaiyuṭaiya ūrkaḷ kāṇappaṭum.
3. piṉpu vaḷḷikkūttāṭum puṟanāṭukaḷ pala irukkum.
4. ivai aṉaittaiyum kaṭanta piṉpu, perumāḷ paḷḷi koṇṭuḷḷa iṭam kāṇappaṭum. aṅka veyil nuḻaiyāta iḷamarakkā uṇṭu; maṇal uṇṭu; nīr niṟainta kuḻikaḷ, poḻilkaḷ mutaliyaṉa uṇṭu. aṅkup poḻutu pōkkac celpavar kuppikkaḷḷaip paruki aḻakiya makaḷirōṭu pakaṟpoḻutu viḷaiyāṭip periya nīrttuṟaiyil nīrāṭuvar.
5. piṉpu cōlaikaḷum kāvaṟkāṭum cūḻnta kāñci mānakara matil kāṇappaṭum. ammatil ceṅkal matilākum. ammatiluḷḷa kāñci mūtūr amaintirukkum.
5. kūttarāṟṟuppaṭai
(malaipaṭukaṭām)
caṅkakāla naṉṉaṉatu malaināṭu iṉṟuḷḷa vaṭavārkkāṭṭu māvaṭṭattil vaṭakkut teṟkākap paraviyuḷḷa cavvātu malaikaḷum avaṟṟaic cūḻavuḷḷa nilappakutiyumākum. ammalaikaḷiṉ aṭivārap pakutiyil irunta kuṟuṅkāṭṭil vaṟiya kūttaṉum avaṉaic cērnta viṟali mutaliyōrum taṅkiyiruntaṉar. appoḻutu naṉṉaṉiṭam paricil peṟṟu malaikaḷil vaḻi naṭantu aṭivārattai aṭaintu, kuṟuṅkāṭṭu vaḻiyē tirumpi vantukoṇṭirunta kūttar talaivaṉ, vaṟiya kūttaraik kuṟuṅkāṭṭil cantittāṉ; avarkaḷai naṉṉaṉpāl āṟṟuppaṭutta virumpi, akkuṟuṅkāṭṭiliruntu naṉṉaṉatu ceṅkaṇ mānakarukkuc cellum malai vaḻiyaik kūṟiṉāṉ.
paricil peṟṟa pāṇaṉ mutalil kuṟuṅkāṭṭiliruntu malaiyaṭivāram nōkkic cellum vaḻiyaik kūṟi, aṅkup payirāvaṉavaṟṟai virittuk kūṟiṉāṉ; malai ēṟic celkaiyil cila ūrkaḷil kiṭaikkum uṇavu vakaikaḷaik kūṟiṉāṉ; malai vaḻikaḷil tiṉaippuṉattai aḻikkum paṉṟikaḷaip piṭikkak kaṟpoṟikaḷ vaikkappaṭṭiruttal vaḻakkamātalāl, pakalil maṭṭum payaṇam ceyyumpaṭi vaṟpuṟuttiṉāṉ; palarum pōkāta vaḻiyiluḷḷa tuṉpaṅkaḷai eṭuttuk kūṟiṉāṉ; vaḻiyil naviramalai, aṅkuḷḷa kāriyuṇṭik kaṭavuḷ kōvil, naviramalaiyil irunta kōṭṭai, tūcippaṭai ākiyavai  paṟṟi aṟivittāṉ; kāṭṭil kāṉavaṉ ampu paṭṭa paṉṟi iṟattal, malaippāmpukaḷ iruttal paṟṟik kūṟikkuṟavarum maruḷum kuṉṟam, ataṉ ucciyil kāval puriyum kāṉavar, ammalaippakkattil uṇṭākum pala vakai ōcaikaḷ ākiyavaṟṟai viḷakkamākak kūṟiṉāṉ.
naṉṉaṉatu periyamalaiyait tāṇṭiya piṟaku āṅkāṅku irunta araṇkaḷ, aṅkirunta ciṟu vaḻikaḷ, avaṟṟaik kaṭakkum muṟai, vaḻi kāṭṭiyiṉ utavi peṟṟup pōtal, periya kāṭukaḷ, vaḻiyil naṭukaṟkaḷ, yāḻ vācittu naṭukaṟkaḷai vaṇaṅkutal paṟṟi aṟivuṟuttiṉāṉ; naṉṉaṉōṭu māṟupaṭṭa makkaḷ vāḻum ūrkaḷ āyiṉum, avarkaḷ putiyavarai upacarittal, kāṭṭil kōvalar upacarippu, mēlum vaḻi naṭappiṉ nāṭu kākkam vēṭar upacarippu, mēlum vaḻiyil mullai nila ūrkaḷ, valaiyar upacarippu, marutanila ūrkaḷ, cēyāṟu etirppaṭal, ataṉ karai vaḻiyē celliṉ naṉṉaṉ talainakarāmākiya ceṅkaṇmāvai aṭaital ākiyavai paṟṟik kūṟiṉāṉ.
perumpāṇaṉ kūṟiya vaḻi
kāñciyait talainakarāyk koṇṭu toṇṭai nāṭṭai āṇṭu vanta toṇṭaimāṉ tiraiyaṉiṭam paricil peṟṟu mīṇṭu vantu koṇṭirunta perumpāṇaṉ oruvaṉ, vaṟiya perumpāṇaṉ oruvaṉai vaḻiyiṟkaṇṭu, tāṉkaṇṭa avviṭattiliruntu apputiyavaṉaik kāñcikkuc ceṉṟu paricil peṟumāṟu āṟṟuppaṭuttal perumpāṇāṟṟup paṭaiyiṉ nōkkamākum.
toṇṭai nāṭu eṉpatu ēṟattāḻa iṉṟuḷḷa ceṅkaṟpaṭṭu, vaṭavārkkāṭu, nellūr māvaṭṭattiṉ teṉpakuti, teṉṉārkkāṭṭu māvaṭṭattil ōymāṉāṭu nīṅkalākat tiṇṭivaṉa vaṭṭattiṉ mēṟkuppakuti, viḻuppuravaṭṭam ākiyavaṟṟait taṉṉakattē koṇṭa nilappakutiyākum.
perumpāṇāṟṟuppaṭaiyaip pāṭiyavar kaṭiyalūr uruttiraṅkakaṇṇaṉār eṉpavar. kaṭiyalūr eṉpatu evviṭattatu eṉpatu aṟiya iyalavillai. avar kūṟiyuḷḷa perumpāṇaṉ putiya perumpāṇaṉai eṅkuc cantittāṉ eṉpatum teriyavillai. āyiṉ, apperumpāṇaṉ kūṟiyuḷḷa vaḻiyil vēṟṟaracar nāṭu kūṟappaṭavillai; toṇṭai nāṭṭu nilaṅkaḷam ūrkaḷumē kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa. avaṟṟaik kūrnta nōkkiṉ, perumpāṇaṉ toṇṭai nāṭṭiṉuḷḷiruntē putiṇa pāṇaṉukkuk kāñcikkuc cella vaḻi kūṟiyuḷḷāṉ eṉpatu teḷivākat terikiṟatu.
perumpāṇaṉ putiya pāṇaṉukku mūṉṟu iṭaṅkaḷait teḷivākak kūṟiyuḷḷāṉ. avai muṟaiyē, nīrppeyaṟṟu eṉṉum iṭattiṉ ellaiyil amainta tuṟaimukanakaram, kāñcikku muṉṉuḷḷa paḷḷikoṇṭa perumāḷ kōvil (tiruveḵkā), kāñci mānakaram eṉpaṉavākum. avaṉ mutalil tuṟaimuka nakarattai aṭaiyavaḻi kūṟiyuḷḷāṉ; piṉpu aṅkiruntu kāñcikkuc cellavaḻi kūṟiyuḷḷāṉ. itaṉāl apputiyavaṉ eḷitil kāñcikkuc cellum vaḻiyaiyē perumpāṇaṉ kūṟiyuḷḷāṉ eṉṟu karututal takum. avaṉ mutalil kaṭaṟkarai nakarai aṭaiyumpaṭi kūṟiyuḷḷatai nōkka, avaṉ vaḻikūṟiya iṭattiliruntu akkaṭaṟkarai nakarai aṭaivatai eḷiteṉak karutiyiruttal vēṇṭum. avaṉ kaṭaṟkaraikkuc cēymaiyiliruntu vaḻi kūṟiyiruppiṉ, kaṭaṟkarai nakarai mutalil aṭaiyumpaṭi kūṟiyirāṉ; mikutiyāka naṭakkumpaṭi ceytirāṉ. eṉavē, perumpāṇaṉ kaṭaṟkaraikku aṇmaiyiliruntē putiyapāṇaṟku vaḻi kūṟiyiruttal vēṇṭum eṉak koḷvatu poruttamākum.
tuṟaimuka nakarattiṟkup pōkum vaḻi
perumpāṇaṉ putiya perumpāṇaṉaic cantitta iṭattiliruntu kūṟiyuḷḷa vaḻi itu eṉ koṇṭu, kīḻvarum ceytikaḷaik kavaṉi
1.``ckz® uppu vaṇṭikaḷaiyum ōṭṭic cellum neṭiya vaḻikaḷ vaḻi avvaḻikaḷil vaṇikar kaḻutaikaḷiṉmītu miḷakup potikaḷai ēṟṟic ceṉṟu vāṇikam ceyvar. avvaḻikaḷil cuṅkaccāvaṭikaḷ uṇṭu; nāṭu kāval ceyyum viṟpaṭai vīrar ūrkaḷ uṇṭu. avvaḻikaḷiṟkāṭukaḷum uṇṭu.
2. ``kāṭukaḷait tāṇṭiyatum pālai nilam kāṇappaṭum. aṅku īttilaik kuṭicaikaḷil vāḻum eyiṟṟiyar, māṉ tōlil paṭuttiruppar; pullaricaiyai nilavuraliṟkuṟṟi, uvar nīril camaippar; uppukkaṇṭam uṇpar. eyiṉar tūṟukaḷil vēṭṭaiyāṭip paṉṟi, muyal mutaliyavaṟṟaip piṭippar.
``ippālai nilattaik kaṭantavuṭaṉ eyiṉar araṇkaḷ irukkum. aṅkuc civanta neṟcōṟum uṭumpiṉ poriyalum uṇṇakkiṭaikkum.
3. ``araṇkaḷukku appāl iṭaiyar kuṭiyiruppu uḷḷa mullai nilam kāṇappaṭum. aṅku vāḻum iṭaiyar āṭṭukkiṭāyiṉ tōlaip pāyalākakkoḷvar; mōr, pāl mutaliyavaṟṟai viṟṟup paṇṭaṅkaḷai vāṅki eṇpar; tiṉaiccōṟum, varakuccōṟum, pālum, avaraip paruppukkūṭṭum uṇpar; varaku vaikkōlāl amainta kūrai vīṭukaḷil vāḻvar.
4. ``mullai nilattaik kaṭanta piṉpu vayalum vayal cārnta iṭamumākiya marutanilam kāṇappaṭum. aṅku neṟcōṟum peṭṭaikkōḻip poriyalum karuppañcāṟum karuppuk kaṭṭiyum uṇṇakkiṭaikkum.
5. ``marutanilattil kuḷaṅkaḷum ērikaḷum uṇṭu. taruppaippuṟ kuṭicaikaḷil vāḻum valaiyar nīrnilaikaḷil valaivīci mīṉpiṭippar; avaṟṟai viṟṟu vāḻvar. aṅkuc cuṭṭa mīṉ iṟaicciyum aricikkūḻāl ākkiya kaḷḷum uṇavākak kiṭaikkum.
``marutanilattil uḷḷa kuḷaṅkaḷilum ērikaḷilum maṇamikka malarkaḷ malarntirukkum. aṅkuḷḷōr avaṟṟaip paṟippar. nīyum uṉṉaic cērntavarum appūkkaḷaic cūṭalām.
6. ``ammarutanilap pakutiyil celliṉ, maṟaiyavar uṟaipati (piṟkāla akaram allatu piramatēyam allatu caturvēti maṅkalam) oṉṟai aṭaiyalām. aṅku vētamōti vēḷvi ceyyum vētiyar vāḻvar.
7.``mL¤J makaḷir nīrāṭum tuṟai kāṇappaṭum. attuṟaiyil makaḷir nekiḻaviṭṭa maṇikaḷ patitta nakaiyaic ciccilippaṟavai eṭuttuc ceṉṟu maṟaiyavar vēḷvic cālaiyil naṭṭuvaitta tūṇiṉmītu amarum; ammaṟaiyavar vāḻumiṭam nīrppeyarttu (nīrppēr) eṉpatu. ataṉ ellaiyil tuṟaimukam amaintuḷḷatu.
8. ``aṅku mēṟṟicaiyiliruntu veṇṇiṟak kutirai kaḷaiyum vaṭaticaiyiliruntu pala poruḷkaḷaiyum koṇṭu varum kappalkaḷ cūḻntukiṭakkum kaṭaṟpakkam uṇṭu. aṅkup paṇṭacālaikaḷaiyum paratavar māṭaṅkaḷaiyum celvar vaḷamaṉaikaḷaiyumuṭaiya paṭṭiṉam uṇṭu. kalaṅkarai viḷakkamum aṅku uṇṭu. appaṭṭiṉam piṟpaṭak kāñciyai nōkkic celvīr.
tuṟaimukanakarattiliruntu kāñcikku vaḻi
1. ``tuṟaimukappaṭṭiṉattiliruntu kāñcinōkkic cellum vaḻiyil teṉṉantōppukaḷ mikutiyāyuṇṭu. attōppukaḷil makkaḷ kuṭiyiruppukaḷ irukkum. aṅkup palāppaḻamum, vāḻaippaḻamum, iḷanīrum, nuṅkum kiṭaikkum.
2. ``avaṟṟukkappāl uḷḷa vaḻiyil viṇ varuṭum māṭaṅkaḷaiyuṭaiya ūrkaḷ kāṇappaṭum.
3. ``piṉpu vaḷḷikkūttāṭum puṟanāṭukaḷ pala irukkum.
4. ``ivai aṉaittaiyum kaṭantapiṉpu perumāḷ paḷḷi koṇṭuḷḷa iṭam kāṇappaṭum. aṅku veyil nuḻaiyāta iḷamarakkā uṇṭu; maṇal uṇṭu; nīr niṟainta kuḻikaḷ, poḻilkaḷ mutaliyaṉa uṇṭu. aṅkup poḻutu pōkkac celpavar kuppikkaḷḷaip paruki, aḻakiya makaḷirōṭu pakaṟpoḻutu viḷaiyāṭip periya nīrttuṟaiyil nīrāṭuvar. nīṅkaḷ aṅku iḷaippāṟuṅkaḷ; perumāḷai vāḻtti yāḻai vācittuc celluṅkaḷ.
5. ``piṉpu cōlaikaḷum kāvaṟkāṭum cūḻnta kāñci mānakara matil kāṇappaṭum. ammatil ceṅkalmatilākum. ammatilukkuḷ kāñci mūtūr amaintirukkum.
tuṟaimukanakaram etu?
perumpāṇaṉ kūṟiyuḷḷa ivvaḻikaḷil iraṇṭām vaḻi kaṭaṟkaraippaṭṭiṉattiṟkum kāñcikkum iṭaippaṭṭa tātaliṉ, nām ārāyattēvai illai. mutal vaḻi eṅkiruntu toṭaṅkiyiruttal kūṭum eṉpataik kaṇṭaṟital payaṉtarum. ataṉaik kaṇṭaṟiyum muṉpu, perumpāṇaṉ kuṟippiṭṭuḷḷa `nīrppeyaṟṟu eṉṟa iṭam yāteṉak kāṇpatu nalam. ataṉ ellaiyil tuṟaimukam iruntateṉṟum iṟakkumati nikaḻnta teṉṟum aṅku vaḷam mikunta paṭṭiṉam iruntateṉṟum perumpāṇaṉē kūṟiyuḷḷāṉ.
ōymāṉāṭṭukku vaṭakkēyirunta toṇṭaināṭṭil māmallapuramē pallavar kālattil ciṟanta tuṟaimukap paṭṭiṉamāyiruntatu. ki.pi. 7ām nūṟṟāṇṭil naracimmavarmaṉ ilaṅkaiyaracaṉāṉa māṉavaṉmaṉukku utaviyāka irumuṟai kappaṟpaṭaiyai māmallapurattiliruntē ilaṅkaikku aṉuppiṉāṉ.1 atē nūṟṟāṇṭiṉ muṟpātiyil yuvāṉ cuvāṅ eṉṟa cīṉavaḻippōkkaṉ inta māmallapuram ciṟanta tuṟaimukanakaram eṉṟu pārāṭṭiyuḷḷāṉ.2 ki.pi. 8ām nūṟṟāṇṭil vāḻnta tirumaṅkaiyārvār māmallapuram ciṟanta tuṟaimukanakaram eṉpataik kīḻ varum pāṭalil teḷivākak kuṟittuḷḷār:
``pulaṅkoḷnitik kuvaiyōṭu
	puḻaikkaimmāk kaḷiṟṟiṉamum
nalaṅkoḷnava maṇikkuvaiyum
	cumanteṅkam nāṉṟo cintu 
kalaṅkaḷiyaṅ kum mallaik
	kaṭaṉmallait talacayaṉam
valaṅkoḷmaṉat tāravarai
	vāṅkoḷēṉ maṭaneñcē.3
ivaṟṟai nōkkat toṇṭai nāṭṭil māmallapuramē ciṟanta tuṟaimukanakarāy iruntatu eṉpatu teḷivākum. āyiṉ, `immāmallapuramē toṇṭaimāṉ tiraiyaṉ kālattilum tuṟaimukanakarāmāy iruntatā? eṉpatu āyvukkuriyatu.
``nīrppeyaṟṟu eṉpataṉ ellaiyil tuṟaimukap paṭṭiṉam iruntatu, eṉṟu perumpāṇāṟṟuppaṭai pēcukiṟata. ``nīrppeyaṟṟu eṉpatu yātu? `peyaṟṟu eṉpatu peyal+ṟu eṉṉum iraṇṭāl āṉatu; `peytalaiyuṭaiyatu eṉpatu itaṟkup poruḷākum. `nīrppeyaṟṟu4 eṉpatu `nīriṉatu peytalaiyuṭaiyatu eṉap poruḷpaṭum. itu kaṭaṟkaraippakuti eṉṟu perumpāṇāṟṟuppaṭai kūṟukiṟatu. eṉavē, pāṭalil kuṟikkappaṭṭa nīr kaṭal nīrāy iruttal vēṇṭum. kaṭal nīr kaḻi vaḻiyē nilattuṭceṉṟu eppoḻutum kaṭal nīraip peytukoṇṭiruppatāl, ---peytalaiyuṭaiyatu eṉṉum poruḷil innilappakuti `nīrppeyaṟṟu eṉṟu pulavarāl kuṟikkappaṭṭatu pōlum!
`nīrppeyaṟṟu eṉpatu `kaṭal nīr uṭpeytalaik koṇṭatākiya nilam eṉap poruḷpaṭalām; aḵtāvatu, uppaṅkaḻiyaiyuṭaiya nilappakutiyākum. annilappakutiyāṉa ellaiyil (kaṭalōrattil) tuṟaimukamum paṭṭiṉamum iruntaṉa eṉpatē iṅku koḷḷat takum poruḷākum.1 ittakaiya iṭam yātu?
māmallapurattiṟku iraṇṭukal teṟkē kaṭal nīr nilattuḷ nuḻaintu māmallapurattiṟkut teṉmēṟkil araikkal tolaivu varai paraviyuḷḷatu; māmallapurattiṟku mēṟkil toṭaṅki vaṭakkē mūṉṟu kaltolaivil uḷḷa cāḷuvaṉ kuppam varaiyil maṇal veḷi paraviyuḷḷatu. iṅṅaṉam māmallapurattiṟku vaṭakkilum teṟkilum uḷḷa maṇal veḷiyai ūṭuruvikkoṇṭē iṉṟaiya pakkiṅkām kālvāy celkiṟatu. immaṇal veḷikaḷ paṇṭaikkālattil kaṭal nīraip peṟṟiruntamaiyāṟṟāṉ iṉṟu maṇal veḷikaḷāyuḷḷaṉa. eṉavē, caṅkakālattil kaṭal nīrp peytalaiyuṭaiya nilamāka ippakutiyiruntiruttal vēṇṭum eṉpatu teḷivu. ūrār ippakutiyai iṉṟu `kaḻi veḷi eṉkiṉṟaṉar. ittakaiya pakutiyil ellaiyil tuṟaimukamum paṭṭiṉamum iruntaṉa eṉṟu perumpāṇaṉ kūṟiyuḷḷāṉ. ākavē, avaṉ kuṟittavai piṟkāla māmallapuram irunta pakutiyākum. 
iṅṅaṉamāyiṉ, `nīrppeyaṟṟu nilattaiyaṭaiya uppaṅkaḻiyait tāṇṭutal vēṇṭum. akkaḻikku muṉṉarē maṟaiyavar uṟaiyapati iruntiruttal vēṇṭum. ki.pi. ēḻām nūṟṟāṇṭiṉ iṭaippakutiyil (ki.pi. 630-660) vāḻnta mutalām naracimmavarmaṉ iraṇṭām pulikēciyai veṉṟamaiyāl, taṉṉai `makāmallaṉ (māmallaṉ) eṉṟu vaḻaṅkik koṇṭāṉ. avaṉ taṉatu nāṭṭup periya tuṟaimuka nakarattait tiruttiyamaittu ataṟku `makāmallapuram eṉap peyariṭṭāṉ. atuvē nāḷaṭaivil `māmallapuram eṉṟum, `mallapuram eṉṟum, `māmallai eṉṟum `mallai eṉṟum maruvi vaḻaṅkalāyiṟṟu. iṅṅaṉam naracimmavarmaṉ `makāmallapuram eṉṟu peyariṭumuṉpu, attuṟaimuka nakaram eppeyar peṟṟiruntatu eṉpatai iṅkuḷḷa cāṉṟukaḷaik koṇṭu aṟiya iyalavillai. perumpāṇaṉ tuṟaimukap pakutiyaik kūṟi, ataṉai aṭuttirunta pakutiyaip `paṭṭiṉam eṉṟu kuṟippiṭṭiruttalaik kāṇa, piṟkāla māmallapuram irunta pakuti caṅkakālattil `paṭṭiṉam eṉa vaḻaṅkappaṭṭatu eṉṟu karutuvatē poruttamākum.
perumpāṇaṉ, mutaliṟ kaṭaṟkaraiyil uḷḷa paṭṭiṉam cella vaḻi kūṟiyuḷḷāṉ. nilappaṭattai (ceṅkaṟpaṭṭu māvaṭṭapaṭattai)k kavaṉittup pārttuc cila uṇmaikaḷai iṅku aṟital vēṇṭum. paṭṭiṉattiliruntu vaṭamēṟkil ēṟattāḻa 35 kaltolaivil kāñciyuḷḷatu. perumpāṇaṉ putiya pāṇaṉai mikavum uḷ nāṭṭil cantittiruppiṉ, aṅkirunta kiḻakkut ticaiyil (kaṭaṟkaraip) paṭṭiṉattiṟkuc ceṉṟu, aṅkirunta vaṭamēṟkil uḷḷa kāñcikkuc cellumpaṭi neṭuntolaivu vaḻiyaik kūṟiyirāṉ; cantitta iṭattiliruntē vaṭamēṟkilō, teṉmēṟkilō uḷḷa kāñcikkup pōkumpaṭi vaḻi kūṟiyiruppāṉ. avaṉ aṅṅaṉam kūṟāmai, tāṉ putiya pāṇaṉaic cantittu vaḻi kūṟat toṭaṅkiya iṭam, kaṭaṟkaraikku aṇmaiyil iruntiruttal kūṭum eṉpatai uṇarttukiṟatu. mēlum, akkālattil aḵtu cemmaiyāṉa pātaiyāyum iruntirukkalām. kaṭaṟkaraikkuc ciṟitu uḷtaḷḷiya variyākap paṭṭiṉattiṟku vaṭamēṟkiliruntum teṉmēṟkiliruntum appaṭṭiṉattai nōkki varalām. inta iraṇṭuḷ oṉṟaiyē perumpāṇaṉ kūṟiyiruttal vēṇṭum. avaṉ paṭṭiṉattiṟkuc cellum vaḻi paṟṟik kūṟiya vivaraṅkaḷai ārāyiṉ, avaṉ kūṟiyatu enta vaḻi eṉpatu pulappaṭum. avai muṉpē kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.
perumpāṇaṉ, mutalil umaṇar uppu vaṇṭikaḷaiyum taṉimāṭu kaḷaiyum ōṭṭicceṉṟa neṭiya vaḻikaḷaik kūṟiyuḷḷār; avvaḻikaḷil kaḻutaikaḷiṉmītu miḷakup potikaḷai ēṟṟi vāṇikam ceyyum vaṇikaraiyum, avvaḻikaḷil irunta cuṅkac cāvaṭikaḷaiyum kūṟiyuḷḷāṉ; aṭuttu nāṭukāval ceyyum viṟpaṭaivīrar ūrkaḷaiyum kāṭukaḷaiyum kuṟittuḷḷāṉ.
avaṉ kūṟiya iṭattiliruntu paṭṭiṉam nōkkic cellumvaḻi (kūrntu paṭittup pārppiṉ), neytal- pālai-mullai-marutam, mīṇṭum neytal eṉṉum muṟaiyil amaintuḷḷataikkāṇalām. ammuṟaiyiṟcelliṉ, mutal umaṇar uppu vaṇṭikaḷ cellum neṭiyavaḻikaḷaik kāṇalām. umaṇaruṭaiya uppu vaṇṭikaḷ uppaḷaṅkaḷi liruntē uppai ēṟṟik koṇṭum cellum. eṉavē, perumpāṇaṉ payaṇam toṭaṅkum iṭattiṟku arukil perumpālum uppaḷaṅkaḷ iruntirukkalām. aṅkiruntu uppu vaṇikar uppai vaṇṭikaḷil ēṟṟi uḷnāṭu nōkkic cellutal vaḻakkam.`ulku’ eṉpatu `cuṅkam eṉap poruḷ paṭum. atu kaṭalvaḻiyē iṟakkumatiyākum poruḷkaḷukku vitikkappaṭṭa variyākum. ivvariyai vāṅkum āyattuṟaikaḷ kaṭaṟkaraiyai aṭuttē iruttal vaḻakkam eṉpatai aṟiyap perumpāṇaṉ kaṭaṟkaraikku aṇittāṉa vaḻiyaiyē kūṟiṉāṉ eṉpatē poruttamākum.
attakaiya uppaḷaṅkaḷ mēṟkūṟappaṭṭa paṭṭiṉattiṟku vaṭakkil kaṭaṟkaraippakutiyil kōvaḷam, kēḷampākkam pakutikaḷil iṉṟuḷḷaṉa. āyiṉ, paṇṭaik kālattil iruntamaikkuk kalveṭṭukaḷiṟ cāṉṟillai.1 ceyyūr, cūṇāmpēṭu eṉṉum iṭaṅkaḷil uppaḷaṅkaḷ mikutiyākum. ceyyūr, uppaḷaṅkaḷ cōḻar kālattilum, peyar peṟṟavai.2 ivvuppaḷaṅkaḷ caṅka kālattilum iruntirukkalām eṉṟu karututal poruttamākum.
nāṭukāval ceyyum viṟpaṭai vīrar ūrkaḷ vaḻiyil iruntaṉa. avaṟṟaiyaṭuttuk kāṭukaḷ iruntaṉa. kāṭukaḷukku appāl pālainilam- pālai nilattil muyal, paṉṟi vāḻum tūṟukaḷ iruntaṉa. avaṟṟukkappāl vēṭṭuvar araṇkaḷ iruntaṉa. avaṟṟaik kaṭantu iṭaiyar vāḻnta mullai nilappakuti iruntatu. appāl vaḷam mikunta marutanilam iruntatu.
ivvivaraṅkaḷai niṉaiviṟkoṇṭu uppaḷaṅkaḷ mikunta ceyyūrukku vaṭakkil iṉṟuḷḷa ūrppeyarkaḷaik kāṇpatu nalam payakkum. vēṭṭaikkārakkuppam, ceṅkāṭṭūr, pālūr (pālaiyūr), toṇṭaimāṉ ciṉṉattoṇṭaimāṉ nallūr, nallāṟṟūr (marutanallūr, nilam), āyappākkamum avaṟṟiṉ poruḷum kāṇat takkavai. katiravācakaṉ paṭṭiṉam eṉṟa caturaṅkappaṭṭiṉattiṟkum māmallapurattiṟkum iṭaiyil mikappala ērikaḷum kuḷaṅkaḷum iruttal kāṇalām. ``kuḷaṅkaḷilum ērikaḷilum pūtta malarkaḷai makkaḷ paṟippārkaḷ. nīṅkaḷ avaṟṟaic cūṭic celluṅkaḷ, eṉṟu perumpāṇaṉ putiya pāṇaṉukkuk kūṟiṉāṉ allaṉō? annīrnilaikaḷ ivaiyāyiruttal kūṭum.
ivaṟṟukkappāl maṟaiyavar uṟaipati iruntatākap perumpāṇaṉ kūṟiyuḷḷāṉ. māmallapurattiṟkuc ciṟitu mēṟkil kaḻi veḷikkappāl pūñcēri eṉṉum ciṟṟūr irukkiṟatu. atu mikappaḻaiya kālattil pirāmaṇar ūrāy iruntateṉṟu tam muṉṉōr kūṟiyatāka iṉṟu avvūril uḷḷa mutiyavar kūṟukiṉṟaṉar. mutaṟcaṭaiyavarmaṉ cuntara pāṇṭiyaṉ kālattil (ki.pi. 1266il) māmallapurattuk kalveṭṭoṉṟu terivikkiṟatu.1 māmallapurattup   perumāḷ kōvil paṭṭarkaḷ ayyaṉaṅkarāc caturvēti maṅkalattil vāḻntaṉar eṉṟu māmallapurattup perumāḷ kōvil paṭṭarkaḷ vāḻnta avvūr māmallapurattiṟku miku aṇmaiyil iruntiruttal vēṇṭum. iṉṟu ippeyaruṭaṉ ōr ūrum māmallapurattiṟku aṇmaiyil illai. atu kālappōkkil aḻintu pōyirukkalām. iṅṅaṉamē ki.pi. iraṇṭām nūṟṟāṇṭil iruntateṉap perumpāṇaṉ kūṟiya maṟaiyavar uṟaipatiyum kālappōkkil aḻintirukkalām.
perumpāṇaṉ kūṟiyuḷḷa vaḻipaṟṟiya vivaraṅkaḷaiyum maturāntakam ceṅkaṟpaṭṭu vaṭṭaṅkaḷiṉ kaṭalōrap pakutiyil uḷḷa ūrkaḷiṉ peyarkaḷaiyum avvūrkaḷ paṟṟiya vivaraṅkaḷaiyum ottiṭṭuk kāṇkaiyil, perumpāṇaṉ ceyyūrukkut teṟkilō, ciṟitu taḷḷit teṉmēṟ kilō iruntu putiyapāṇaṉukku vaḻi kūṟiyiruttal vēṇṭum eṉpatu uyttuṇarappaṭum.
iṉip perumpāṇaṉ putiya pāṇaṉai evviṭattilirunta āṟṟuppaṭuttiyiruttal kūṭum eṉpataik kāṇpōm:
kāñci, maturai, koṟkai, ārkkāṭu pōṉṟa caṅkakālap peyarkaḷ periya nakaraṅkaḷaik kuṟippaṉa ātalālum, caṅkakālattiṟkup piṟpaṭṭa ilakkiyaṅkaḷilum toṭarntu kuṟikkappaṭṭu vantamaiyālum iṉṟaḷavum makkaḷ pēccu vaḻakkil māṟāmal irunta varukiṉṟaṉa. āyiṉum, varalāṟṟuc ciṟappup peṟāta cila ūrkaḷiṉ peyarkaḷum pulavar piṟanta ūrkaḷ palavaṟṟiṉ peyarkaḷum pāṭal peṟṟa talaṅkaḷ palavaṟṟiṉ peyarkaḷum iṉṟu māṟi vaḻaṅkukiṉṟaṉa. caṅka kālattiṟkup piṉpu innāṭṭai ayalaracar pala nūṟṟāṇṭukaḷ āṇṭamaiyum ūrkaḷil araciyal-camayac ciṟappukaḷ kālappōkkil kuṟaintamaiyum potumakkaḷiṉ tavaṟāṉa uccarippumē peyarmāṟṟattiṟkuc ciṟappuṭaik kāraṇaṅ kaḷākum. kalveṭṭukaḷilē kāṇappaṭum paṇṭaip peyarkaḷ ikkālattil evvevvāṟu māṟutal aṭaintuḷḷaṉa eṉpatai iṅku aṟivatu nallatu:
paṇṭaippeyar	kalveṭṭuccāṉṟu	ikkālappeyar
villipākkam	(178 of 1936-37)	villivākkam
vayiramēkapuram	(253 of1913)	vayirapuram
vikkiramapāṇṭiyaṉ 	(289 of 1915)	vikkiravāṇṭi				caturvētimaṅkalam
mūññār	(50 of 1919)	muṉṉūr
