tiruviṭaiccuram	(16 of 1932-33)	tiruvaṭicūlam
cāttaṇampākkam	(25 of 1932-33)	cātrampākkam
nākarkōvil pakutiyil īraveṅkām- īrāṅkyam eṉavum, veḷḷai veṅkāyam - veḷḷāṅkyam eṉavum, patanīr-patani eṉavum paini eṉavum, tiṟavukōl-tuṟaval eṉavum, tūmpumaṭai eṉpatu tūmpāmaṭai eṉavum māṟi vaḻaṅki varutalum iṅku niṉaivu kūrtaṟkuriyatu. ivaṟṟaikkāṇa, perumpāṇāṟṟup paṭaiyaip pāṭiya uruttiraṅkakaṇṇaṉāratu ūrp payarum ivvāṟu urukkulaintu pōyirukkumō eṉpatu eṇṇa vēṇṭuvatāyuḷḷatu.
ceyyūrukkut teṉmēṟkil ēṟattāḻa āṟaraikkal tolaivil kaṭukkalūr eṉṉum peyaruṭaṉ oru ciṟṟūr uḷḷatu. caṅkakālak kaṭiyalūr eṉṟa peyar kālappōkkil pala māṟutalkaḷai aṭaintu iṉṟu kaṭukkalūr eṉṟu vaḻaṅkukiṟatu eṉṟu koḷḷalām. kaṭiyalūr- `kaṭukalūr allatu `kaṭukkalūr eṉa evvāṟu māṟiyiruttal kūṭum eṉpatu ārāyccikkuriyatu.
1.	(cuṅkam) tavirttaruḷiṉa eṉpatu (cuṅkam) tavuttaruḷiṉa eṉṟu tiripuvaṉa cakkaravartti irācarāca tēvaṉatu tirukkaḷarp paṭṭayattil āḷappaṭṭuḷḷatu. itaṉāl, collil uḷḷa ikaram makkaḷ uccarippāl ukaramātal kūṭum eṉpatu terikiṟatu. ivvāṟē kaṭiyalūr eṉpatu kaṭuyalūr eṉa māṟiyirukkalām.
2. atiyamāṉ eṉṉum peyar kālappōkkil atikamāṉ eṉavum, potiyil malai eṉpatu potikai malai eṉavum māṟi vaḻaṅkuvatai nām naṉku aṟivōm. iṅku yakaram kakaramāy māṟiviṭṭatu. ivvāṟē kaṭiyalūr-kaṭukalūr eṉa māṟiyirukkalām.
3. atai-attai, itai-ittai, etai-ettai eṉa varuvatu pōlavum, putūr-puttūr eṉa varuvatu pōlavum, kaṭukalūr eṉpatu kaṭukkalūr eṉa māṟiyirukkalām. ivaṟṟai nōkka, caṅkakālak kaṭiyalūr iṉṟu kaṭukkalūr eṉṟu māṟiyatil viyappillai.
4. pañcāyattu oṉṟippil amaintuḷḷa ciṟṟūrkaḷil paṭṭiyalil intak kaṭukkalūr, kaṭukkāḷūr eṉa acciṭappaṭṭuḷḷatu. itu pūvalūr eṉpatu pūvāḷūr eṉa māṟi vaḻaṅkappaṭutal pōlak koḷḷat takkatākum. ūrppeyarkaḷ iṅṅaṉam kālappōkkil urumāṟutalai mēlē kūṟappaṭṭa palacāṉṟukaḷai nōkki eḷitil uṇaralām.
kaṭukkalūriliruntu vaṭakku nōkkip puṟappaṭum oruvaṉ uppaḷappakuti, kāṭu, pālai vaḻikaḷilē naṭantu ceṉṟutāṉ vaḷam mikunta marunilap pakutiyai aṭaital kūṭum eṉpatai aṟintukoḷḷalām. caṅkakālattil pālāṟu ceṅkaṟpaṭṭu vaṭṭattiṟ pāyavillai; vaṭavārkkāṭṭu māvaṭṭattiliruntu tirumāṟpēṟu, tiruppācūr, tiruvēṟkāṭu, tirumullai vāyil vaḻiyākac ceṉṟu, eṇṇūrukku arukiṟkaṭaliṟkalantu vantatu; ki.pi. 13ām nūṟṟāṇṭilō ataṟkup piṉṉarōtāṉ kāñcikku arukil pāyumāṟu ataṉpōkku māṟṟappaṭṭatu.1 eṉavē, caṅkakālattil pālāṟu ceṅkaṟpaṭṭu māvaṭṭattiṟ pāyavillai eṉpatu iṅku aṟiyattakum. ataṉāṟṟāṉ atuperum pāṇāṟṟuppaṭaiyil kuṟikkappaṭavillai.
anta marunilappakutiyil iṉṟaiya pālāṟu kaṭaloṭu kalakkum iṭattiṟku vaṭakkil oru ciṟiya āṟum pala kuḷaṅkaḷum ērikaḷum amaintuḷḷaṉa. anta marutanilap pakutiyaik kaṭantāl, uppu nīrum maṇalum kalanta pakuti māmallapurattiṟku mēṟkil amaintuḷḷamai kāṇalām. itu muṉpē kūṟappaṭṭatu.
itukāṟum kūṟappaṭṭa vaḻi ēṟpuṭaittāyiṉ, caṅka kālak kaṭiyalūr eṉpatu iṉṟuḷḷa kaṭukkalūlō eṉpatu poruttamāyiṉ, uruttiraṅ kaṇṇaṉār, tamatu ūrākiya kaṭiyalūriliruntē māmallapurattiṟkuc cellum vaḻiyaiyum, aṅkiruntu kāñcikkuc cellum vaḻiyaiyum tāmē perumpāṇaṉāyiruntu putiya perumpāṇaṉukkuk kūṟiṉār eṉṟu koḷvatu poruttamākum.
uruttiraṅkaṇṇaṉār iḷantiraiyaṉaiyum karikāla vaḷavaṉaiyum pāṭiṉa periyārāvar. karikālaṉ kālam ki.pi. mutal nūṟṟāṇṭiṉ iṟutiyum iraṇṭām nūṟṟāṇṭiṉ muṟpakutiyumākum eṉpatu muṉpē viḷakkappaṭṭatu. ciṟupāṇāṟṟuppaṭai ki.pi. mūṉṟām nūṟṟāṇṭil pāṭappaṭṭateṉpatum mēlē kūṟappaṭṭatu. ataṉaip pāṭiya nattattaṉār ūrāṉa iṭaikkaḻi nāṭṭu nallūr, kaṭukkalūrukkut teṉkiḻakkil iraṇṭaraik kal tolaivil amaintuḷḷatu. avar ciṟupāṇaṉukkuk kūṟiya vaḻiyai ārāyiṉ, avaṉait tamatu nallūriliruntē puṟappaṭac coṉṉār eṉpatu teḷivākum.
tamakku ēṟattāḻa oru nūṟṟāṇṭukku muṉpu tamatu ūrukku aṇmaiyil vāḻnta kaṭiyalūr uruttiraṅkaṇṇaṉār tammūriliruntē kāñcikku vaḻi kūṟip perumpāṇāṟṟuppaṭai pāṭiyatu pōlavē nattattaṉār tamatu nallūriliruntē kiṭaṅkilukku vaḻi kūṟic ciṟupāṇāṟṟuppaṭaiyaip pāṭiṉār eṉpatai avar kuṟittuḷḷa vaḻiyai nōkkit teḷivuṟa uṇaralām. intap perumpulavar iruvarum toṇṭai nāṭṭiṉarāvar. ivaruḷ muṉṉavar, toṇṭai nāṭṭut talainakarukku vaḻiyai kūṟiṉār; piṉṉavar toṇṭai nāṭṭai aṭuttirunta ōymāṉāṭṭut talainakarukku vaḻiyaik kūṟiṉār.
5. aivakai nilaṅkaḷ
1. kuṟiñci nilam
muṉṉurai
tamiḻccāṉṟōr tamiḻaka nilattai nāṉku vakaiyākap pirittu `nāṉilam eṉappeyariṭṭaṉar. avai kuṟiñci, mullai, marutam, neytal eṉappaṭum. kuṟiñci eṉpatu, malaiyum malai cārnta iṭamumākum. ippakutiyiṟ kuṟiñci eṉṉum peyar koṇṭa malarkaḷē ciṟappāṉavai. kāṉavar avaṟṟai virumpi aṇintaṉar. ikkāraṇaṅkaḷāl ippakuti kuṟiñci eṉap peyar peṟṟateṉak koḷḷalām. malaiyilum malai cārnta iṭattilum kāṭukaḷ iruttalē peruvaḻakku. akil, cantaṉam, ciṟu mūṅkil, peru mūṅkil, palā, curapuṉṉai, vāḻai, mā mutaliya palavakai maraṅkaḷ ceṟinta kāṭukaḷ irukkum. kuraṅkiṉaṅkaḷ, yāṉai, puli, karaṭi, kāṭṭuppaṉṟi, kāṭṭuppacu, varaiyāṭu mutaliya vilaṅkukaḷ akkāṭukaḷil iruttal iyalpu. mēṟkut toṭarcci malai pōṉṟa periya malaikaḷilum avaṟṟiṉ carivukaḷilum miḷakukkoṭi, maraṅkaḷaic cuṟṟip paṭarum. periya malaikaḷil nīraruvikaḷ kīḻ nōkkip pāyntapaṭiyirukkum. kuṟṟāla nīraruviyē itaṟkēṟṟa cāṉṟākum.
kuṟiñci nilat talaivaṉ, ` veṟpaṉ, poruppaṉ, cilampaṉ eṉṉum tiṇaippeyar peṟṟāṉ; talaivi `koṭicci eṉappaṭṭāḷ. kuṭi makkaḷuḷ āṭavar, `kāṉavar, kuṉṟuvar, vēṭṭuvar eṉappaṭṭaṉar; avar tam peṇṭir, `kuṉṟuvittiyar, vēṭṭuvittiyar, kuṟattiyar eṉap peyar peṟṟaṉar. kuṟiñci nila kaṭavuḷ murukaṉ.
innilattavar toḻil tiṉai mutaliyaṉa payiriṭutal, tēṉ eṭuttal, kiḻaṅku akaḻtal, kiḷōṭṭutal, vēṭṭaiyāṭal mutaliyaṉa. ivarkaḷ `murukiyam, toṇṭakappaṟai, kuṟiñci yāḻ eṉṟa icaikkaruvikaḷaip payaṉpaṭuttiṉārkaḷ; kuṟiñcippaṇṇaip pāṭiṉārkaḷ. kuṟiñci nila vilaṅkukaḷuṭciṟantavai puli, karaṭi, paṉṟi, yāṉai eṉpaṉa: paṟavaikaḷuṭ ciṟantavai kiḷiyum mayilumākum. kāntaḷ malarum, vēṅkai malarum, cuṉaik kuvaḷai malarum iṅkuc ciṟantavai. kuṟiñci nila ūrkaḷ, ` ciṟukuṭi, kuṟiñci eṉap peyarpeṟṟaṉa.
kuṟiñci nilam iyaṟkaiyaḻaku vāyntatu; taṉimai nirampiyatu. ātaliṉ kaḷavu oḻukkattiṟku ēṟṟa iṭamāṉa itaṉaikkoṇṭu kūṭalum kūṭal nimittamum in nilattukkuriyavai eṉap pulavar pulaṉeṟi vaḻakkam ceytaṉar.
malaiyaruviyiṉ māṇpu
tirumurukāṟṟuppaṭaiyaip pāṭiya nakkīrar oru periya aruviyaip paṟṟik kīḻ varumāṟu kūṟiyuḷḷār; avar kūṟiyuḷḷa vivaraṅkaḷ paṭittu iṉpuṟattakuvaṉavākum.
``malaiyucciyil pala iṭaṅkaḷil tōṉṟum aruvikaḷ kīḻ nōkkip pāykaiyil kāṟṟāl alaippuṇṇum pala tukiṟkoṭikaḷaip pōlak kāṇappaṭukiṉṟaṉa. ivvaruvikaḷ ōriṭattil oṉṟu cērntu pēraruviyāy uruveṭuttuk kīḻ nōkkip pēriraiccal iṭṭukkoṇṭu pāykiṉṟaṉa. appēraruvi taṉ pōkkil ciṟu mūṅkiliṉ vēraip piḷakkiṟatu; tēṉīkkaḷ amaitta tēṉkūṭukaḷaik keṭukkiṟatu; naṉku muṟṟiṉa āciṉip palāppaḻaṅkaḷ veṭittuc citaṟiya cuḷaikaḷaik koṇṭu celkiṟatu. malaiyucciyil uḷḷa curapuṉṉaiyiṉ naṟiya malarkaḷ avvaruvi nīril utirkiṉṟaṉa. aruviyiṉ ōṭṭattaiyum ōcaiyaiyum kaṇṭum kēṭṭum karukkuraṅkukaḷuṭaṉ kariya mukattaiyuṭaiya mucukkalaikaḷ naṭuṅkukiṉṟaṉa. aruvi nīr, pukaraiyaṇinta mattakattaiyuṭaiya periya peṇ yāṉai kuḷiraṭaiyumpaṭi vīcukiṟatu; taṉ pōkkil akappaṭṭa yāṉaikkompukaḷait taṉṉuḷ aṭakki, poṉṉum maṇiyum niṟam viḷaṅkumpaṭi mēlē koṇṭu kutittu, tattutalaiyuṟṟup poṭiyāṉa poṉṉait teḷḷukiṟatu; vāḻaiyiṉ periya mutal tuṇiyumpaṭiyum tēṅkiṉ iḷanīrkkulai utirumpaṭiyum avviraṇṭaṉaiyum mōtukiṟatu; miḷakukkoṭiyiṉ kariya kottukaḷaic cāyvikkiṟatu; mayilkaḷ, kōḻikaḷ mutaliya paṟavaikaḷai veruvi ōṭacceykiṟatu; āṇ paṉṟiyaiyum karaṭiyaiyum malaikkukaikaḷil patuṅkum paṭi ceykiṟatu; kariya kompukaḷaiyuṭaiya kāṭṭup pacukkaḷiṉ erutukaḷai muḻakkamiṭac ceykiṟatu. iṅṅaṉam pēraruvi pāykiṉṟa periya malaiyil paḻam muṟṟiṉa cōlai pala irukkiṉṟaṉa. (aṭi, 295-317).


iṉikkum cuṉai nīr
kuṟiñci nilam kaṟpāṟaikaḷ mikunta iṭamātaliṉ, paḻutta miḷaku appāṟaikaḷiṉmītu cintikkiṭattal iyalpu; nīṇṭa periya cuṉaikaḷil māmpaḻaṅkaḷ mutaliya paḻaṅkaḷ utirntu kiṭattal iyalpu. iṅṅaṉamē cuṉaiyiṉ arukil uḷḷa palā marattu muṟṟiya paḻam veṭittu veḷippaṭum cuḷaikaḷ cuṉai nīril viḻutalum iyalpu. ippaḻaṅkaḷil uḷḷa tēṉ, cuṉainīril kalakkum. tēṉ kalanta cuṉainīrai mayil parukum; parukavē, mayakka muṇṭākit taḷḷāṭum (ku.pā. aṭi, 186-194).
ciṟukuṭi
malaimītu vaḷarum maram, ceṭi, koṭikaḷiliruntu utirum maṇamikka malarkaḷāl malaiccāral, maṇam ceyta maṉaipōla maṇattal iyalpu. accāralil malaivāṇar kuṭiyiruppu amaintirukkum. atu `ciṟukuṭi eṉappaṭum. aḵtāvatu, cila vīṭukaḷaik koṇṭa kuṭiyiruppu eṉpatu poruḷ. aṅku vāḻum kāṉavar, kāvaṭiyait tōḷiṟ(   ) kāvumaram tammiṟ porutu paṭṭa yāṉaiyiṉ kompukaḷālāṉatu. ataṉ iru muṉaikaḷilum uṟikaḷ uṇṭu. avarkaḷ anta uṟikaḷil pala paṭṭikaḷai (kaṭakaṅkaḷai) vaittuḷḷārkaḷ; avaṟṟil malaittēṉaiyum, kiḻaṅkukaḷaiyum, paṉṉi iṟaicci mutaliya palavakai iṟaiccikaḷaiyum koṇṭu varukiṉṟārkaḷ. acciṟukuṭi vaḷaviya pala putuvaruvāyiṉaiyuṭaiyatu. iṅṅaṉam malaiccāralil ciṟukuṭi amaintiruttalpōlavē, malaiyil pala uyaraṅkaḷil cīṟūrkaḷ palaamaintirukkum (malaipaṭu. aṭi, 151-162).
malai nāṭṭil antikkāṭcikaḷ
katiravaṉ mēṟṟicaiyil maṟaikiṟāṉ. māṉkaḷ marattaṭiyil tiraḷkiṉṟaṉa; pacukkaḷ kaṉṟukaḷai aḻaittapaṭi maṉṟukaḷil nuḻaikiṉṟaṉa; ūtukiṉṟa kompu pōṉṟa ōcaiyaiyuṭaiyatum vaḷainta vāyaip peṟṟatumākiya aṉṟil, paṉaiyiṉ uḷ maṭaliliruntu taṉ peṭaiyai aḻaikkiṉṟatu; pāmpu tāṉ mēytaṟ poruṭṭut taṉ māṇikkattai veḷiyē umiḻkiṉṟatu; kōvalar pala iṭaṅkaḷilum niṉṟu āmpaṟkuḻaliṟpaṇ icaikkiṉṟaṉar; āmpaliṉ aḻakiya itaḻkaḷ muṟukku aviḻkiṉṟaṉa; pārppār antikkālattuc ceyyun toḻilkaḷai nikaḻttukiṉṟaṉar; celvamaṉaikaḷil polivu peṟṟa toṭiyaṇinta makaḷir viḷakkai ēṟṟi antikkālattut toḻilai nikaḻttukiṉṟaṉar; kāṭṭil vāḻkiṉṟavar viṇṇait toṭum paraṇiṉ mītu tīkkaṭai kōlālē neruppaip piṟappittu erikkiṉṟaṉar. mēkaṅkaḷ periya malaiyiṭattaic cūḻntu kaṟukkiṉṟaṉa; kāṭṭil uḷḷa vilaṅkukaḷ `kalleṉṉum ōcai uṭaiyaṉavāy oṉṟaṟkoṉṟu māṟi olikkiṉṟaṉa; paṟavaikaḷ kūṭukaḷiliruntu āravārikkiṉṟaṉa (ku.pā.aṭi, 215-228)
iravil
malai nāṭṭil iravu nēraṅkaḷil (pakaliṟkukaikaḷil patuṅkiyirunta) pulikaḷ irai tēṭi naṭamāṭum; yāḷikaḷ, karaṭikaḷ, kāṭṭu erutu, kaḷiṟu, malaippāmpukaḷ mutaliya pala vakaip pāmpukaḷ iraiyait tēṭiyalaiyum; āḻamāṉa nīr nilaikaḷil vāḻum mutalaiyum karāmum iṭaṅkarum nīrkkaraiyil varum; vaḻi paṟippavar, vaḻikaḷil kolaik karuvikaḷuṭaṉ maṟaintiruppar; āṅkāṅku vaḻukkunilam amaintirukkum; vaḻi velvatu pōlat tōṉṟit tiṭīreṉa muṭivaṭaiyum iṭaṅkaḷ cila pakutikaḷil amaintirukkam. ātalāl, malai nāṭṭil iravu nēraṅkaḷil vaḻinaṭattal ētum taruvatākum (ku.pā. aṭi, 251-259).
kāṉavar uḻaippu
kāṉavar, tōrai nel mutaliyavaṟṟaip payiriṭa nilamillāta pōtu naṟiya akil maraṅkaḷaiyum cantaṉa maraṅkaḷaiyum veṭṭi avai irunta nilattaip patappaṭutti viḷainilamākkuvar; tōrai nel, veṇciṟu kaṭuku, aivaṉa nel, veṇṇey, iñci, mañcaḷ, miḷaku ivaṟṟaip payirākkuvar; tiṉaippuṉaṅkaḷaik kāval kāppar; avaraiyaip payiriṭavar (ma. kā. aṭi, 286-293). kāṉavar yāṉaiyālō puliyālō tākkappaṭāta periya marakkiḷaikaḷi ṉiṭaiyil paraṇai amaippar; apparaṇil iruntukoṇṭu payirkaḷait tiṉṉa varum kiḷi, karaṭi, yāṉai, kāṭṭup paṉṟi mutaliyavaṟṟaik kavaṇkal eṟintum, paṟaiyaṭittu ōcaiyuṇṭākkiyum, erikoḷḷiyaik kāṭṭiyum viraṭṭuvar; kaiyāṟcuṟṟiṉa kālattut taṉṉiṭattup piṟakkum ōcaiyāl kiḷi mutaliya vaṟṟai ōṭṭuṅkaruvi `taḻal eṉappaṭum. ataṉaik `kavaṇ eṉpārum uḷar. mūṅkilaik kaṇṇukkuk kaṇ uḷḷāka naṟukkip palavākap piḷantu ōcaiyuṇṭāka oṉṟilē taṭṭuvatōr karuvi `taṭṭai eṉappaṭum. ivai pōṉṟa kiḷi kaṭi karuvi piṟitoṉṟu, kuḷir eṉappaṭum. kāṉavar ivaṟṟiṉ utaviyāl paṟavaikaḷaiyum piṟa vilaṅkukaḷaiyum viraṭṭuvar. malaivāṇar makaḷirē perumpālum pakaṟkālattil tiṉaip puṉaṅkaḷaik kāval kāppar (ku. pā. aṭi, 35-44).
kāṭṭuppaṉṟi payirkaḷai aḻippatil vallatu. ataṉāl, kāṉavar ataṉaip piṭikkak kuḻikaḷait tōṇṭuvar; avaṟṟait taḻaikaḷāl mūṭuvar. kuḻikaḷai aṟiyātu naṭakkum paṉṟi oru kuḻiyil viḻum. uṭaṉē kāṉavar ataṉait tākkik kolvar (ma. kā. aṭi, 294-295). muṟṟiṉa tiṉaippuṉattaip paṉṟi koḷḷai koḷvatu iyalpu. ātalāl, kāṉavar atu varum vaḻikaḷiṟ kaṟpoṟikaḷaip porutti, ataṉ varukaiyait taṭuppar. (malaipaṭu. aṭi, 193-5). yāṉai tiṉaippayirait tiṉṉum. ataṉāl kāṉavar villil nāṇ ēṟṟi ampai yāṉai mītu eyvar; kāṭellām `kal leṉṉum ōcai uṇṭākumpaṭi vāyai maṭittu viṭukiṉṟa cīḻkkaiyāl mikka ōcaiyai uṇṭākki, akkaḷiṟṟait tiṉaippuṉaittiṉiṉṟum ōṭṭuvar (ku.pā. aṭi, 156-161).
iṅṅaṉam kāṉavarāl viraṭṭappaṭṭa yāṉai ciṉam viḷaṅkuvataṟkuk kāraṇamākiya matattālē maṉam cerukkik kār kāla iṭiyaip pōla muḻakkattai uṇṭākkit taṉ tutikkaiyaic curuṭṭi nilattē eṟintu kūṟṟuvaṉaip pōlak kaṭukip pāyntōṭum; vaḻiyiṟkāṇpaṉavaṟṟai aḻikkum (ku. pā. aṭi, 161-166): kāṉavar paṉṟikaḷaip piṭikkak kuḻi tōṇṭuvatu pōlavē periya paḷḷaṅkaḷait tōṇṭi yāṉaiyaip piṭippatu vaḻakkam (pa. pālai, aṭi, 221-4)
malai nāṭṭil kāṉavar uḻaippiṉāl eḷ, tiṉai, avarai, varaku, mūṅkil nel, veṇciṟukaṭuku, iñci, mañcaḷ, vāḻai, kūvaikkiḻaṅku, vaḷḷikkiḻaṅku, āciṉippalā, aivaṉanel, veṇṇail  mutaliyaṉa vaḷamuṟap payirāyiṉa (malaipaṭu. aṭi, 102-117). naṉṉaṉatu malai ucciyil akilum cantaṉa maraṅkaḷum vaḷarntaṉa; poṉ, maṇi mutaliyaṉavum kiṭaittaṉa (kṣa, aṭi, 170,  urai).
kāṉavar kaṇṇēṇi cārttit tēṉ eṭuppar. `kaṇṇēṇi eṉpatu kaṇukkaḷil aṭi vaittu ēṟic cellumpaṭi amaintuḷḷa mūṅkil. malaiyucciyil ōṅki vaḷarnta marattiṉucciyil uḷḷa tēṉiṟālai aḻikkumporuṭṭuc ceṅkuttāṉamalaiyil ēṟuvataṟku ataṉ ayalil ivviru mūṅkilkaḷaik kūṭṭi niṟuttiyamaippatu vaḻakkam (malaipaṭu. aṭi, 315-7, uraiyum aṭikkuṟippum).
pulavar, pāṇar, kūttar, pōṉṟa kalvimāṉkaḷ, malaippayaṇattil vaḻi teriyātu tikaippuṟṟa poḻutu malaivāṇarum malai kāvalarum avarkaṭku uṇavaḷittu upacarittu vaḻi kāṭṭutal vaḻakkam (malaipaṭu. 425-7).
muṉpu vaḻiyaṟiyātu oru vaḻiyiṟceṉṟu mīṇṭavar, putiyavar tammaip pōlac ceṉṟu iṭar uṟātapaṭi cantiyaik kaiyāl tuṭaittu aṭaiyāḷamāka ūkam pullai muṭintu vaippar (malaipaṭu. aṭi, 392-3).
makaḷir ceyalkaḷ
ilvāḻkkaiyil īṭupaṭṭa makaḷir tam kaṇavarkkut tuṇaiyāyp payirttoḻilil īṭupaṭṭaṉar; illaṟap paṇikaḷil īṭupaṭṭaṉar. maṇamākāta makaḷir tiṉaip puṉattaiyum piṟa payil nilaṅkaḷaiyum kāval kāttaṉar; ōyvu nēraṅkaḷil veḷḷiya tukilai okkum aḻakiya aruviyil nīrāṭiṉar; ceṟivuṇṭāṉa malaiyil paḷiṅkaic corinta vaittāṟpōṉṟa paranta cuṉaiyiṟ kuṭaintu viḷaiyāṭiṉar; poṉṉil aḻuttiṉa nīlamaṇi pōlattam mutukil tāḻntu kiṭanta piṉṉutal amainta kariya kūntalil irunta nīraip piḻintaṉar; īrattaip pularttiṉar. cuṉaiyil nīrāṉamaiyiṉ avartam kaṇkaḷ civantaṉa.
ammakaḷir tamkūntalai aivakaiyāka oppaṉai ceytu koṇṭaṉar. avai (1) kuḻal (2) aḷakam, (3) koṇṭai, (4) paṉiccai, (5) tuñcai eṉpavai. orutti ceytukoḷḷum ivvaimpāl oppaṉai aḻakai avaḷ kātalaṉ pukaḻtal uṇṭu. (ku.pā. aṭi, 138-9, uraiyum aṭikkuṟippum ) vāḻaippū vaṭivil muṭikkappaṭṭa kūntal, `paṉiccai eṉappeyar peṟṟatu (ci. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 21-2). ivvakaik kūntal oppaṉai koṇṭum caṅkakālat tamiḻar nākarikattai naṉku uṇaralām.
piṉpu ammakaḷir ceṅkāntaḷ mutaliya toṇṇūṟṟukku mēṟpaṭṭa malaināṭṭu malarkaḷaip paṟittaṉar; paciya maṇamuḷḷa maḻaikaḷaip paṟittaṉar;1 avaṟṟai, maḻai peytu tūymaiyākkappaṭṭa akaṉṟa pāṟaiyiṟ kuvittaṉar; malarkaḷiṉ puṟavitarkaḷai nīkkiviṭṭu iṭaiyil uṭukkattakum taḻaiyuṭaikaḷaic ceytu koṇṭaṉar; pala vēṟu niṟaṅkaḷaiyuṭaiya mālaikaḷait toṭuttut tamatu melliya kariya kūntalil aḻaku peṟac cuṟṟikkoṇṭaṉar (ku. pā. aṭi, 54-104).
naṉṉaṉuṭaiya malaikaḷiṉ uccikaḷil vāḻntirutta kāṉavar, naṟavai aruntit tam makaḷiroṭu māṉtōl pōrtta ciṟupaṟai olikkak kuravaik kūttu nikaḻttiṉar. tiṉaiyaik kuṟṟiya makaḷir, tiṉaiyaik kuṟṟik koṇṭē vaḷḷaippāṭṭaip pāṭiṉar (malaipaṭu. aṭi, 320-22; 342).
talaivaṉ, kaḷavuppuṇarcci nikaḻum poḻutu, talaiviyai maṇam ceytukoṇṭu vāḻvatākavum avaḷaip piriyātiruppatākavum teyvaṅkaḷiṉmītu cūḷ ceytu aruvi nīraip parukuvāṉ (ka. pā. aṭi, 208-211); piṉṉar avaḷaip palar aṟiya maṇappāṉ. atu `nāṭaṟi naṉmaṇam eṉappaṭṭatu. (ku. pā. aṭi, 231-234). malaivāṇar, tam malaiccāralkaḷil teyvaṅkaḷ vāḻntaṉa eṉṟu nampiṉar (pe. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 493-4).
pala vakai olikaḷ
naṉṉaṉatu malai nāṭṭup pakutiyil pakaṟpoḻutil pala vakai olikaḷ eḻuntapaṭi iruntaṉa. avaṟṟuḷ,
1. taṉ iṉattaip pirinta āṇ yāṉaiyaik kāṉavar piṭikka muyaṉṟa pōtu uṇṭāṉa āravāram oṉṟu;
2.	 ampu eyyappaṭṭa paṉṟiyāl kollappaṭṭa kāṉavarkkāka maṟṟavar aḻum ōcai oṉṟu;
3. tam kaṇavar mārpil puli pāyntu uṇṭākkiya puṇṇai āṟṟuvataṟkākak koṭicciyar pāṭiya pāṭalōcai oṉṟu;
4. mutal nāḷilē pūtta poṉpōlum kottiṉai yuṭaiya vēṅkai malarkaḷaip paṟittaṟku makaḷir `puli-puli eṉṟu kūviya ōcai oṉṟu;
5. puli kaḷiṟṟiṉ mītu pāyntataik kaṇṭu ataṉ piṭi ceyta iṭiyōcai pōṉṟa piḷiṟal oṉṟu;
6. taṉ kuṭṭi eṭuttaṟkariya āḻnta muḻaiyil tavaṟi vīḻntu iṟantataik kaṇṭu manti alaṟiya ōcai oṉṟu;
7. kāṉavar ēṟaviyalāta uyarattil kaṇṇēṉiyiṉ utaviyāl ēṟit tēṉīkkaḷai viraṭṭit tēṉ eṭutta pōtu uṇṭāṉa āravāram oṉṟu; 
8. naṉṉaṉuṭaiya vīrar avaṉuṭaiya pakaivar kuṟumpukaḷai aḻittapōtu uṇṭāṉa makiḻcci āravāram oṉṟu;
9. naṟavai nāṭkālaiyiṟkuṭitta kāṉavar tam peṇṭiruṭaṉ kūṭic ciṟupaṟai ōcaikkēṟpak kuravaik kūttāṭiya āravāram oṉṟu;
10. kāṭṭāṟṟu neṭiya cuḻiyil akappaṭṭa kaḷiṟṟiṉatu valiya ciṉattait taṇivittup periya kampattil piṇippataṟkut tamatu ēval toḻilaic ceytaṟkuk kāraṇamāṉa pēccukaḷaip pēci avaṟṟil payilappaṇṇum pākaratu āravāram oṉṟu;
11. olikkum mūṅkilāṟceyta taṭṭaiyaip puṭaittup puṉantōṟum kiḷikaḷai ōṭṭum makaḷir ceyta āravāram oṉṟu;
12. kāṭṭu erutum pōril valla kalai māṉum pōriṭuvataik kaṇṭavar ceyta āravāram oṉṟu;
13. erumaikkaṭākkaḷ tammuṭporutalāl uṇṭāṉa āravāram oṉṟu;
14. palākkoṭṭaikaḷiṉmītu kaṉṟukaḷaip piṇaittuk kāntaḷiṉatu tuṭuppup pōṉṟa maṭalāl aṭittuk kaṭā viṭṭup piḷḷaikaḷ ceyta āravāram oṉṟu;
15. karumpālaiyiṉ ōcai oṉṟu;
16. tiṉaiyaik kuṟṟikkoṇṭē makaḷir pāṭiya vaḷḷaippāṭṭu oli oṉṟu;
17. paṉṟi cēmpiṉ kiḻaṅkaiyum mañcaṭkiḻaṅkaiyum akaḻātirukkak kāṉavar atai viraṭṭak koṭṭiya paṟai ōcai oṉṟu;
18. aruvikaḷil teyva makaḷir kuṭaintāṭukaiyil uṇṭāṉa ōcai oṉṟu;
19. inta ōcaikaḷāl malaiyiṭatteḻunta etiroli oṉṟu. ivvolikaḷ aṉaittaiyum maṉattāl niṉaittup pārppiṉ, malaināṭṭup pakaṟkāṭcikaḷ ciṟanta ōviyaṅkaḷāy nam akakkaṇ muṉ kāṭciyaḷittu iṉpuṟuttum (malaipaṭu. aṭi, 294-344).
kuṟiñcinilattukkuriya teyvam murukaṉ. kāṉavar apperumāṉai vaḻipaṭṭa muṟaimai paṟṟiya vivaraṅkaḷ `camayam eṉṉun talaippiṉkīḻ virivākak kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa. avartam uṇavup poruḷkaḷum viruntiṉaraip pēṇiya muṟaiyuṭ `uṇavu eṉṉuṟ talaippiṉ kīḻ uraikkappaṭṭuḷa.
naṉṉaṉukku vaḻaṅkappaṭṭa kuṟiñcinilap poruḷkaḷ
āmāṉiṉ kuḻavi, iḷaiya yāṉaikkaṉṟu, vāy tiṟavāta karaṭikkuṭṭi, malaiyāṭṭukkiṭāy, kīrippiḷḷai, maraiyāṉiṉ kuḻavi, āṇ uṭumpu, tōkai mayil, kāṭṭukkōḻiyiṉ cēval, muḻavaip pōṉṟa periya palāppaḻam, cāṟu muṟṟiṉa iṉiya māmpaḻaṅkaḷ, maṇakkum naṟaikkoṭi, nūṟaikkiḻaṅku, marattiliruntu citaṟiyutirnta paḷiṅku pōṉṟa karuppūram, vilai matippuṭaiya māṇikkakkaṟkaḷ, yāṉaik kompukaḷ, kāntaḷ malarkaḷ, puṉṉaip pūkkaḷ, tilakappūkkaḷ, cantaṉak kaṭṭaikaḷ, miḷaku, mūṅkiṟkuḻaiyil muṟṟaviṭṭa kaḷḷiṉ teḷivu, mūṅkiṟkuḻaiyilē tōytta tayir, tēṉiṟālkaḷ, āciṉippalā ākiyavai naṉṉaṉuṭaiya araṇmaṉai muṟṟattil malaivāṇarāl koṇṭuvantu vaikkappaṭṭaṉa (malaipaṭu. aṭi, 498-529).
cēraṉ ceṅkuṭṭuvaṉ malai vaḷam kāṇac ceṉṟa pōtu malaivāṇar avaṉukku etiril koṇṭuvantu vaitta kāṇikkaipporuḷkaḷōṭu (cilappatikāram, kātai 25; aṭi, 37-55) ivaṟṟai oppunōkki makiḻalām.
2. mullai nilam
muṉṉurai
kāṭum kāṭu cārnta iṭamum `mullai eṉappaṭum. iṅkukkāṭu eṉpatu kuṟiñci nilakkāṭu pōṉṟa marac ceṟivuṭaiya kāṭaṉṟu; `iḷaṅkāṭu eṉṟu collat takum muṟaiyil amainta nilappakutiyākum; iṅku āṭumāṭukaḷiṉ mēyccalukkuriya pul veḷikaḷ niṟaintiruntaṉa; koṉṟai, kāyā, kuruntam mutaliya maraṅkaḷ iruntaṉa. mallikai, mullai, piṭavu, taḷavam mutaliya ceṭi koṭikaḷ iruntaṉa. ivaṟṟuḷ mullaiyē ciṟantu kāṇappaṭṭatu. iṅku vāḻnta āyarum āycciyarum mullai malarkaḷai mikavirumpic cūṭikkoṇṭaṉar. ātaliṉ, innilam `mullai eṉap peyar peṟṟatu. taṉṉaip pirinta talaivaṉ taṉṉiṭam varum varaiyil āṟṟiyirukkum talaiviyiṉ oḻukkattai `mullai eṉṟu akapporuḷ ilakkaṇam kūṟukiṟatu.
mullai nilattalaivaṉ aṇṇal, tōṉṟal, kuṟumpoṟai nāṭaṉ eṉap peyar peṟṟāṉ. talaivi, maṉaivi, kiḻatti eṉap peyar peṟṟāḷ. kuṭi makkaḷuḷ āṭavar āyar, kōvalar, iṭaiyar, potuvar eṉappaṭṭaṉar. avartam peṇṭir āycciyar, kōvicciyar, iṭaicciyar, potuvicciyar eṉappaṭṭaṉar. avarkaḷ toḻil, āṭumāṭukaḷai mēyttalum, varaku cāmai mutaliyavaṟṟaip payiriṭutalumākum. avarkaḷ ēṟukōṭpaṟaiyai muḻakkiṉārkaḷ; mullai yāḻ icaittārkaḷ; pullāṅkuḻal, āmpaṟ kuḻalkaḷai vācittārkaḷ. uḻai, pulvāy, muyal mutaliya vilaṅkukaḷ annilattukkuriyavai. kāṉakkōḻi, cival eṉṉum paṟavaikaḷ aṅkuc ciṟappāṉavai.
pattuppāṭṭuḷ ovvoru nāṭṭu mullai nilattu vivaraṅkaḷum ovvoru pāṭṭil kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa. avaṟṟai muṟaippaṭi iṅkuk kāṇalām.
ōymāṉāṭṭu mullai nilam
putiya arumpukaḷaiyuṭaiya avaraik koṭikaḷ pavaḻam pōṉṟa pūkkaḷaip pūttaṉa; kariya arumpiṉaiyuṭaiya kāyākkaḷ tiraṇṭa mayiliṉ kaḻuttup pōṉṟa pūkkaḷaip pūttaṉa; mucuṭṭaikkoṭi koṭṭam pōṉṟa pūkkaḷuṭaṉ viḷaṅkiyatu; vaḷaviya ,kulaiyiṉaiyuṭaiya kāntaḷkaḷ, kaiviralkaḷaip pōlap pūttaṉa; kollaiyiṭattu neṭiya vaḻikaḷil intira kōpam eṉṉum pūccikaḷ ūrntaṉa. ivai, kār kālattai uṇarttiṉa. mullaikkoṭikaḷ mullaippūkkaḷ malarvatāl pēraḻakuṭaṉ viḷaṅkiṉa (ci. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 164-9). itu nāṭukaḷ eṉṉum pakutiyilum kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷatu.
toṇṭai nāṭṭu mullai nilam
āyar kurampai: varakukkaṟṟai mutaliyavaṟṟāl vēyappeṟṟa kuṭicai, kurampai eṉappaṭṭatu. ak kurampaiyiṉ uḷ nuḻaiyac ciṟiya vāyil iruntatu. avvāyilil kaḻikaḷāṟkaṭṭappaṭṭa katavu iruntatu. kuṭicaiyiṉ kūraiyait tāṅki niṉṟavai kuṟiya kālkaḷ. akkālkaḷil āṭṭu maṟikaḷ niṉṟu tiṉṉattakkapaṭi taḻaikaḷ kaṭṭappaṭṭiruntaṉa. āṭṭukkiṭāyiṉ tōlkaḷaip pāyalākakkoṇṭu akkurampaikkuk kāvalaṉāṉa vīṭṭu mutiyavaṉ paṭuttiruntāṉ. kurampaikku etiril muṟṟam iruntatu. atil tāmpukaḷ kaṭṭiṉa kuṟiyamuḷaikaḷ iruntaṉa. ammuḷaikaḷil āṭumāṭukaḷ kaṭṭappaṭṭaṉa. ittakaiya cila kurampaikaḷaiyuṭaiyatē mullai nilac ciṟṟūrākum. acciṟṟūril vaḷainta mukattiṉaiyuṭaiya cemmaṟiyāṭu kaḷuṭaṉē veḷḷāṭukaḷum taṅki vāḻntaṉa. acciṟṟūr kaṭṭumuḷḷālākiya vēliyiṉaiyuṭaiyatu.
āyar makaḷ
āyar makaḷ vaikaṟaiyil eḻuntu, tayiraik kaṭaintu, veṇṇaiy eṭuttāḷ; pūkkaḷāṟ ceyta cumaṭṭait1 talaiyilē vaittāḷ; ataṉmītu mōrppāṉaiyai vaittukkoṇṭu kuṟiñci nilam ceṉṟu, mōrai viṟṟāḷ. avaḷ māmai niṟattiṉaḷ; mūṅkil pōṉṟa tōḷkaḷai yuṭaiyavaḷ; karumaṇal pōṉṟa kūntalaiyuṭaiyavaḷ; tāḷuruvi eṉṉum nakai acaiyum kātiṉaḷ. avaḷ mōr viṟṟa mutalaikkoṇṭu taṉ kuṭumpattukku vēṇṭiya nel mutaliyavaṟṟai vāṅkik koṇṭāḷ; ney viṟṟa vilaikkup pālerumaiyaiyum nalla pacuvaiyum kariya erumai nākiṉaiyum vāṅkiṉāḷ; avaṟṟōṭu taṉ maṉaikku mīṇṭāḷ. avaḷum avaḷaic cērntavarum tiṉaiccōṟum pālum uṇṭaṉar.
āyaṉ
āyaṉ ceruppu viṭāmaṟkiṭanta vaṭuvaḻuntiṉa valiya aṭiyiṉaiyuṭaiyavaṉ; pacukkaḷai ōṭṭum taṭiyaik kaiyiṟ piṭittavaṉ; maraṅkaḷai veṭṭum kōṭari piṭittamaiyāl, taḻumpu amainta valiya kaiyiṉaṉ. avaṉ iraṇṭu talaikaḷilum uṟiyiṉaiyuṭaiya kākkaḷ mēlē iruntamaiyāl uṇṭāṉa taḻumpiṉait tōḷkaḷil uṭaiyavaṉ; pacukkaṟanta pāṟkaiyait taṭaviṉa talai mayiraiyuṭaiyavaṉ; maraṅkaḷiliruntum koṭikaḷiliruntum paṟitta malarkaḷai mālaiyāka uṭaiyavaṉ; oṟṟaiyāṭaiyai uṭaiyavaṉ; pāṟcōṟṟai uṇpavaṉ. avaṉ kaṉṟukaḷaiyum pacukkaḷaiyum kāṭṭil mēyaviṭṭāṉ; takka patattil veṭṭi oḻuṅka ceyyappaṭṭa mūṅkiṟkaḻiyil tīkkaṭai kōliṉ utavi koṇṭu ceyyappaṭṭa tuḷaiyil vāyai vaittup pala vakai iṉiya ōcaikaḷai eḻuppiṉāṉ; pālaip paṇṇai vācittāṉ; piṉpu kumiḻiṉatu uṭpoyyākiya kompiṭattē vaḷaittuk kaṭṭiṉa viralāl teṟittu vācikkum maraṟkayiṟākiya narampiṉaiyuṭaiya vil yāḻil kuṟiñcip paṇṇai vācittāṉ.
mullai nilac cīṟūrkaḷ
mullai nilattil payiriṭṭu vāḻnta kuṭimakkaḷ irunta cīṟūr cilavē. avarkaḷatu vīṭṭu muṟṟattil piṭikaḷ niṉṟālpōla varakiṉaik koṇṭa kutirkaḷ niṉṟaṉa; vīṭṭup pantaril yāṉaiyiṉ kālai otta varaku tirikai naṭap paṭṭiruntatu. vīṭṭaiyaṭutta koṭṭilil kuṟiya vaṇṭi uruḷaikaḷum kalappaikaḷum cuvaril cārtti vaikkappaṭ ṭiruntaṉa. vīṭu varaku vaikkōlāl vēyappaṭṭiruntatu.
iccīṟūr makkaḷ uḻavut toḻiliṟpayiṉṟa periya erutukaḷaik kalappaiyil cērttu, uṭumpiṉ mukattai otta peruṅkoḻu nilattil maṟaiya aḻutti, muṟpaṭi vaḷaiya uḻutaṉar; piṉpu vitaittaṉar; kaḷai eṭuttaṉar; payir viḷaintatum aṟuvaṭai ceytaṉar (pe. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 147-205).
mullaippāṭṭil mullai nilam
kār kālattil nuṇmaṇaṟpāṅkāṉa nilattil irunta neruṅkiṉa ilaikaḷaiyuṭaiya kāyā añcaṉam pōla malarntaṉa; taḷiraiyum kottiṉaiyumuṭaiya koṉṟai, naṉṟākiya poṉṉaic (poṉṉiṟap pūkkaḷai) corintaṉa. kōṭal marattiṉ kuvinta mukaikaḷ akaṅkai pōla virintaṉa; tiraṭci niṟainta tōṉṟi kurutipōlap pūttaṉa; kāṭu taḻaitta civanta nilattup peruvaḻiyil muṉpaṉi toṭaṅkum tiṅkaḷil pōtiya maḻaiyaip peṟṟa varaku katirīṉṟatu. annilattil muṟukkuṇṭa kompiṉaiyuṭaiya kalai māṉum ataṉ peṇ māṉam tuḷḷi viḷaiyāṭiṉa. ( mu.pā. aṭi, 92-100).
pāṇṭi nāṭṭu mullai nilam
pāṇṭi nāṭṭu mullai nilattil ciṟiya tiṉai aṟuvaṭai ceyyappaṭṭatu; eḷḷiḷaṅkāy muṟṟiyatu; kariya tāḷaiyuṭaiya varakiṉatu karitākiya katir muṟṟiyatu; āḻnta kuḻikaḷil vilaiyuyarnta maṇikaḷ kiṭantu viḷaṅkiṉa; oḷiyiṉaiyuṭaiya pūkkaḷaip peṟṟa koṉṟai maraniḻalil irunta pāṟaimītu mucuṇṭai malarkaḷum mullai malarkaḷum utirntu kiṭantaṉa. teḷinta nīraiyuṭaiya paḷḷaṅkaḷil nīlamaṇi eṉṟu maruḷum neytal toyyiṟkoṭiyōṭē māṟupaṭa malarntaṉa (ma.kā. aṭi, 271-285). ic ceyti `nāṭukaḷ eṉṉum pakutiyilum kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷatu.
kār kālattil mullai nilattil paruvamaḻai naṉku peytatu. veḷḷam kāl naṭaikaḷiṉ mēyccalukku iṭaiyūṟātaliṉ, vaḷainta kōliṉaiyuṭaiya kōvalar veḷḷattai veṟuttaṉar; tam kāl naṭaikaḷai mēṭṭu nilattil mēyaviṭṭaṉar; kāntaḷiṉ nīṇṭa itaḻkaḷālāṉa tam kaṇṇiyil nīralaittālē kalakkam eytiṉar; kuḷirāl naṭuṅkiṉar; avartam paṟkaḷ paṟai koṭṭiṉa. avarkaḷ kaikaḷai neruppiṟkāṭṭic cūṭu uṇṭākkik koṇṭārkaḷ; akkaikaḷait taṅkaḷ kavuḷil vaittu amaiti peṟṟārkaḷ.
maḻaiyālum veḷḷapperukkiṉālum kāl naṭaikaḷ mēytal toḻilai maṟantaṉa; kuraṅkukaḷ kuḷirāl naṭuṅkiṉa; kāṟṟu mikutiyāl maraṅkaḷil taṅkiyirunta paṟavaikaḷ nilattil vīḻntaṉa; pacukkaḷ kuḷiriṉ mikutiyāl pāl arunta vanta taṅkaḷ kaṉṟukaḷai utaittaṉa; mucuṭṭai veḷḷaip pūkkaḷaiyum pīrkkup poṉṟip pūkkaḷaiyum pūttaṉa; maḻainīr viraintu pāykaiyil kayalkaḷ ataṉpōkkiṉai etirttu nīntiṉa. appoḻutu avaṟṟaip piṭikkak kokkukaḷum nāraikaḷum kāttiruntaṉa (neṭunal. aṭi, 1-20).
naṉṉaṉatu malai nāṭṭu mullai nilam
mullai nilam mullai mutaliya maṇamikka malarkaḷaiyuṭaiya koṭikaḷ mikuntatu. villiṉ ōcaikku veruvic civanta kaṇṇaiyuṭaiya maraiyēṟu, kuṟiñci nilattai aṭuttuḷḷa mullainilak kuṟuṅkāṭṭil viraintōṭum. pacukkaḷ vēṟṟup pulaṅkaḷil ceṉṟu mēyntu varum. kōvalar avaṟṟiṉ pālaikkaṟantu vaḷaiyalkaḷai aṇinta tam makaḷir maṉam makiḻumpaṭi koṇṭu varuvar. mullai nilakkāṭukaḷil cemmaṟi āṭukaḷum veḷḷāṭukaḷum kalantu `kalleṉṉum ōcaiyuṭaṉ taṅkiyirukkum. aṅkuḷḷa mullainila makkaḷ pālum pāṟcōṟum uṇpārkaḷ; avaṟṟai viruntiṉarkkum uvappuṭaṉ aḷippārkaḷ; āṭukaḷiṉ tōlkaḷait taittup paṭukkaiyākap payaṉpaṭuttuvārkaḷ; koṭiya vilaṅkukaḷ āṭukaḷai neruṅkātavāṟu tīmūṭṭi iravaik kaḻippārkaḷ (malaipaṭu. aṭi, 404-420). mullai nilamakkaḷ mūṅkiṟkuḻaiyil erumaittayirait tōyttārkaḷ (malaipaṭu. aṭi, 523).


3. pālai nilam
pālaiyiṉ iyalpu
kuṟiñci nilamum mullai nilamum aṭuttaṭuttu iruppavai. ivai mutuvēṉiṟkālattil tamakkuriya nīr vaḷattiṟkuṟaintu makkaḷ nilaittu vāḻa vacatiyaṟṟa mikka veppattai aṭaiyum. akkālattil annilappakuti `pālai eṉap peyar peṟum.
kuṭikaḷaik kāttōmpum kaṭamaiyuṭaiya aracaṉ, appoṟuppiṉaip puṟakkaṇittuk kuṭi ōmpāta amaiccarōṭu kūṭit taṉ koṭuṅkōlāṭciyāl nāṭṭai araciyal aṟṟa nāṭākkiṉāṟpōlak katiravaṉ mutirnta vēṉil eṉṉum amaiccaṉōṭu kūṭik kuṟiñciyaiyum mullaiyaiyum pocukkuvatāl, iru nilaṅkaḷum taṅkaḷ iyaṟkai muṟaimaiyiliruntu māṟit taṅkaḷaic cērntāmai vemmaiyāl tuṉpuṟuttum `pālai eṉṉum vaṭivaip peṟum. itaṉai iḷaṅkōvaṭikaḷ,
``mullaiyum kuṟiñciyum muṟaimaiyiṉ tirintu
nalliyal piḻantu naṭuṅkutuyar uṟuttup
pālai eṉpatōr paṭivaṅ koḷḷum1
eṉṟu kūṟiyuḷḷār.
kuṟiñci nilam maṭṭum taṉiyē pālaiyākat tiritalum uṇṭu.2 iṅṅaṉamē mullai nilam taṉiyē pālaiyākat tiritalum uṇṭu.3 iṅṅaṉam pālaiyāyt tirinta nilattaiyum cērttu nilam aivakaiyākak kōṭalum uṇṭu. eṉavē, `pālai eṉpatu kuṟiñci nilattai allatu mullai nilattaic cārntatu; naṉcey puṉcey viḷaivu aṟṟatu; nīr vaḷam mikak kuṟaintatu; veppam mikuntatu; cemmaiyāṉa pātaiyaṟṟatu; makkaḷ nērmaiyāka vāḻa vacatikkuṟaiyuḷḷatu eṉpaṉavaṟṟai eḷitil aṟiyalām.
pālai nilat taṉmaiyaip paṟṟi nacciṉārkkiṉiyar (tol. akat. 9, urai), `pālait taṉmaiyāvatu, kālaiyum mālaiyum naṇpakalaṉṉa kaṭumaikūrac cōlai tēmpik kūval māṟi, nīrum niḻalum iṉṟi, nilam payaṉ tuṟantu, puḷḷum māvum pulampuṟṟu iṉpamiṉṟit tuṉpam peṟuvatu, eṉṟu kūṟiyuḷḷamai kavaṉikkattakum.
ippālainilattil vēṭṭuvar vāḻntaṉar; vaḻippaṟi ceyvataip piḻaippākak koṇṭa āṟalai kaḷvar vāḻntaṉar. pālai nilat talaivaṉ `viṭalai, kāḷai, mīḷi eṉappaṭṭāṉ. talaivi `eyiṟṟi eṉappaṭṭāḷ. kuṭi makkaḷuḷ āṭavar `eyiṉar, maṟavar eṉappaṭṭaṉar; peṇṭir `eyiṟṟiyar, maṟattiyar eṉappaṭṭaṉar. ivarkaḷ vāḻnta ūrkaḷ `paṟantalai, kuṟumpu eṉap peyar peṟṟaṉa. ivarkaḷ toḻil vaḻippaṟi ceyvatum, pakaivaruṭaiya kāl naṭaikaḷaik kavarvatum, ūrkaḷukkuc ceṉṟu koḷḷaiyaṭittu varuvatumākum. ivartam paṟai, cūṟaikōṭpaṟaiyum nirai kōṭpaṟaiyumākum. innilattukkuriya yāḻ, pālai yāḻ ākum; paṇ, pañcuram eṉpatu. marā, kurā, pātiri malarkaḷ iṅkuc ciṟantavai. iruppai, ōmai, uḻiñai, nemai, pālai, yā eṉṉum maraṅkaḷ iṅkuc ciṟantavai.
innilattukkuriya akavoḻukkam piritalum pirital nimittamum ākum. kalvi, poruḷīṭṭal mutaliya ceyalkaḷukkākat talaivaṉ talaiviyaip pirital pālai oḻukkam eṉappaṭṭatu. ivarkaḷ koṟṟavai, aiyai eṉappaṭṭa turkkaiyai vaḻipaṭṭārkaḷ.1
pattuppāṭṭuḷ kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷa pālai nilam paṟṟiya ceytikaḷai iṉikkāṇpōm:
toṇṭai nāṭṭup pālai nilam
eyiṟṟiyar
pālai nilattil īntiṉ ilaiyāl vēynta kuṭicaikaḷil eyiṉar (vēṭṭuvar) vāḻntaṉar. piḷḷaiyaip peṟṟa eyiṟṟi māṉ tōlākiya paṭukkaiyil muṭaṅkik kiṭantāḷ. eyiṟṟiyar uḷi pōṉṟa vāyiṉai yuṭaiya kaṭappāraikaḷāl karampai nilattaik kiḷaṟip pullariciyaic cērttukkoṇṭu ceṉṟaṉar. avartam kuṭicaikaḷiṉ muṉ puṟattil viḷā maraṅkaḷ iruntaṉa. aṅku nilattil ural tōṇṭap paṭṭiruntatu. eyiṟṟiyar annilavuralil tām cērttuk koṇṭu vanta pullariciyaic corintu, kuṟiya ulakkaiyāl kuṟṟiṉar; ciṟiya aḷavu nīraik koṇṭa kiṇaṟṟiliruntu uvarnīrai mukantu, ulai vaittaṉar; pullariciccōṟṟaic camaittaṉar; accōṟṟai uppukkaṇṭattōṭu uṇṭaṉar; tammai nāṭi vanta viruntiṉarkkut tēkkilaiyil avaṟṟaip paṭaittaṉar.


eyiṉar
eyiṉar kuṭṭaikaḷai aṭuttuk kuḻikaḷait tōṇṭiṉar; kuṭṭaiyil irunta nīraip paruka vanta paṉṟiyai ampeytu vīḻttat tām tōṇṭiya kuḻikaḷil patuṅkiyiruntaṉar; paṉṉi vēṭṭai payaṉpaṭāta poḻutu muyalkaḷaip piṭikkak kuṟuṅkāṭṭil vēlikaḷil valaikaḷai virittaṉar; vēṭṭai nāykaḷuṭaṉ ceṉṟu tūṟukaḷai aṭittu, muyalkaḷai ōṭac ceytaṉar. avai añcit ticaiyaṟiyātu ōṭi valaiyil akappaṭṭaṉa. iṅṅaṉam eyiṉar pālai nilattil vēṭṭaiyāṭiṉar.
eyiṉar araṇ
toṇṭai nāṭṭil mēlē kūṟappaṭṭa pālai nilattai aṭuttu eyiṉar araṇ amaintiruntatu. aṅkup pala vīṭukaḷ iruntaṉa. avvīṭukaḷil vēlkaḷum viṟkaḷum ampukaḷum niṟaintiruntaṉa. tiraṇṭa kālkaḷaik koṇṭa pantaraiyuṭaiya kāval mikunta vīṭu oṉṟu iruntatu. avvīṭṭil caṅkilikaḷāl piṇikkappaṭṭa nāykaḷ iruntaṉa. avai vēṭṭai nāykaḷ, avvīṭṭil ampukkaṭṭukaḷum tuṭi mutaliya vācciyaṅkaḷum vaikkappaṭṭiruntaṉa. antak kaṭimaṉaiyaic cūḻa ūkampullāl vēyappaṭṭa matil iruntatu. ammatilaic cuṟṟilum muḷ vēli amaintiruntatu. avvēliyaic cūḻak kāvaṟkāṭu kāṇappaṭṭatu. matilil irunta vāyilil nīṇṭa muṉaiyum uṟutiyum vāynta kuḻukkaḷ niṟuttappaṭṭiruntaṉa. araṇiṉ vāyil, valiya kaṇaiya maram ēṟpaṭṭa uṭkataviṉai uṭaiyatu. inta eyiṉar araṇ, toṇṭaimāṉ āṭcikkuriyatu. eṉavē, nāṭṭaik kākkum nilappaṭaikaḷuḷ oṉṟu pālai nilattil vaikkappaṭṭiruntatu pōlum! inta araṇil  irunta eyiṉar, villilum vēlilum payiṟci peṟṟavarāvar. ivar mēṟkūṟiya muyal vēṭṭaiyāṭiya eḷiya eyiṉariṉam mēmpaṭṭa maṟavarāvar. āṟalaikaḷ varai aṭakkavum nāṭṭu vāṇika vaḻikaḷaip pālai nilattiṟ pātukākkavum ivarkaḷ maṉṉaṉāl amarttappaṭṭavarkaḷ eṉak karutalām.
pōr maṟavar
ikkuṭiyiṟpiṟanta cūl koṇṭa makaḷ, yāṉai taṉ etirē variṉum, pāmpu taṉmēl ūrntu celliṉum, vāṉattil iṭi tōṉṟiṉum añciyatillai. attakaiya maṟavar kulamakaḷir peṟṟeṭutta maṟavarākiya eyiṉar, koḷḷai koṇṭu uṇṭalaiyē urimaiyākak koṇṭaṉar. avarkaḷ talaivaṉ āṇ puli pōṉṟa vīramuṭaiyavaṉ; pulleṉṟa tāṭiyai uṭaiyavaṉ. avaṉ taṉ vīraruṭaṉ ceṉṟu, taṉ pakaivar nāṭṭup pacukkaḷaik kavarntu vantu, avaṟṟaik kaḷḷukku vilaiyākap pōkkiṉāṉ; piṉpu taṉ illattiṟcamaitta kaḷ  vakaiyuḷ nellāṟcamaitta kaḷḷaip parukiṉāṉ; āṭṭiṟaicciyai uṇṭāṉ. iṅṅaṉamē avaṉuṭaiya vīrarum kaḷḷaip paruki iṟaicciyai uṇṭaṉar. piṉpu aṉaivarum maṉṟiṟkūṭi mattaḷa muḻakkattiṟku ēṟpa iṭattōḷai valappakkattil vaḷaittu, makiḻcciyuṭaṉ kūttāṭiṉar.1 avartam kuṭiyiruppukku appāl mullai nilam amaintiruntatu(pe. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 83-147).
pāṇṭi nāṭṭup pālai nilam
pālainilattil āṟalaikaḷvar maṟaintu niṉṟu vaḻippōkkarait tuṉpuṟuttalum, kolai puritalum, kolai kaṇṭu makiḻtalum vaḻakkam. itaṉāl, tamiḻ maṉṉar eyiṉaruḷ takkavaraip pōr vīrarākki nāṭu kāvaṟ paṇiyil amarttiṉar. pālainila vaḻikaḷil kuṭimakkaṭkut tīṅku nērāmal pārppatē avartam talaiyāya kaṭamai. pāṇṭi nāṭṭup pālai vaḻikaḷaik kāval kāttavar iḷaiñar. villēntiya kaiyiṉar; kuḻaiyāl vēynta kuṭilkaḷil vāḻntaṉar; taḻai viraviṉa kaṇṇiyiṉai aṇintaṉar; kaṭiya coṟkaḷai uṭaiyavar; valimai mikuntavar (ma. kā. aṭi, 310-314).
pālai paṟṟiya piṟa ceytikaḷ
āṟalaikaḷvar pālai nilavaḻiyē cellum pāṇaraiyō kūttaraiyō tākka muṉaitalum vaḻakkam. appoḻutu avarkaḷ pālai yāḻai icaittu, urukkamākap pāṭuvārkaḷ. yāḻōcaiyum miṭaṟṟōcaiyum vaṉṉeñcarākiya āṟalaikaḷvar maṉattaiyum kavarumām. avarkaḷ taṅkaḷ kolaikkaruvikaḷaiyum nekiḻa viṭṭut taṅkaḷai maṟantu niṟpārkaḷām ( po. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 21-2). pālai eṉṉum paṇ mikavum iṉimai vāyntatu (pe. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 180). talaivaṉ pōr mutaliyavaṟṟuḷ oṉṟukkākat talaiviyai viṭṭup piriyum oḻukkam `pālai eṉappaṭum (neṭunal. nac. urai). pālai eṉpatu oru maram. malaināṭṭu makaḷir ataṉ malaraip piṟa malarkaḷōṭu viravit taḻaiyum mālaiyum amaittu aṇintaṉar (ku.pā. aṭi, 77).
4. marutanilam
muṉṉurai
vayalum vayalaiccārnta iṭamum marutam eṉappaṭum. āṟṟuppāyccal ērippāyccal uḷḷa nilappakutiyē marutanilamākum. innilattil maruta maraṅkaḷ mikutiyātaliṉ, itu marutam eṉap peyar peṟṟatu. inta nilam nīrvaḷattāl ciṟantatu; nel, karumpu, pukaiyilai mutaliya uyariya payirkaḷ naṉku payirākum nilam; uṇavukkuṟaipāṭu illāta nilam. ātaliṉ, aivakai nilaṅkaḷilum marutamē uyarvākak karutappaṭukiṟatu. ulakattil pukaḻ peṟṟa paḻaiya nākarikaṅkaḷ aṉaittum āṟṟuppāyccal niṟainta maruta nilattilētāṉ tōṉṟiṉa eṉpatu varalāṟu kūṟum uṇmaiyākum.
`veḷḷiya pūkkaḷaiyuṭaiya karumpukaḷuṭaṉē cen nellum vaḷarntu kuvaḷaiyōṭē perumaiyaiyuṭaiya itaḻkaḷaiyuṭaiya neytalum mayakkappaṭṭu mutalaikaḷ cerukkit tirinta iṭamakaṉṟa poykaikaḷai yuṭaiya marutanilam eṉṟu nacciṉārkkiṉiyar kūṟiyuḷḷār (pa. pālai. aṭi, 239-42 urai). itu marutanilac ciṟappai naṉku terivippatākum.
innilattut talaimakaṉ, `makiḻnaṉ, ūraṉ eṉappaṭṭāṉ; talaimakaḷ, `maṉaivi eṉappaṭṭāḷ. kuṭimakkaḷ uḻavar, kaḷamar, kaṭaiyar eṉappaṭṭaṉar; avartam peṇṭir, `uḻattiyar, kaṭaiciyar eṉappaṭṭaṉar. innilakkaṭavuḷ intiraṉ. ivarkaḷ nilattai uḻutal, vitaittal, kaḷai eṭuttal, nīr pāyccutal, aṟuvaṭai ceytal, kaṭā viṭal, āṟukaḷilum poykaikaḷilum nīrāṭal mutaliya toḻilkaḷil īṭupaṭṭārkaḷ. innilattiṟkuriyatu marutayāḻ; iṅkuc ciṟantirunta malarkaḷ tāmaraiyum kaḻunīrumākum. ittakaiya ciṟappuṭaiya marutanilam paṟṟip pattuppāṭṭuḷ kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷa ceytikaḷai iṅkuk kāṇpōm.
cōḻanāṭṭu marutanilam
vaṭaveḷḷāṟṟukkum teṉ veṟṟāṟṟukkum iṭaippaṭṭa nilappakuti cōḻanāṭu. innāṭṭaik kāviri taṉ naṉṉirāl pala nūṟṟāṇṭukaḷākak kāttu varukiṉṟatu. kañcakkullai tīyavum, marakkompukaḷai nerupputtiṉṉavum, mēkam kaṭal nīrai mukattalai maṟappavum nērum poḻutu nāṭṭil periya vaṟkaṭam tōṉṟum. akkoṭiya kālattilum kāviriyil nīr peruki varum. annīr nāṭṭaic ceḻippākkum. (cōḻa nāṭṭu vaḷam `nāṭukaḷ eṉṉum talaippil virivākak kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷatu).
ōymāṉāṭṭu marutanilam
ōymāṉāṭṭil peyar peṟṟa yāṟukaḷ illai. nāṭu maḻaiyai nampiyiruntatu. āṅkāṅkup periya nīr nilaikaḷ amaikkappaṭṭiruntaṉa. ērippāyccalaiyuṭaiya nilappakutiyē marutavaḷattuṭaṉ kāṇappaṭṭatu. an nilappakuti vēlūriliruntu āmūr varaiyil paravi iruntatu. ataṉ nīr vaḷam `ōymāṉāṭu eṉṟa talaippil virittuk kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷatu
toṇṭai nāṭṭu marutanilam
toṇṭai nāṭṭaip paṉṉeṭuṅkālamāy vaḷappaṭutti varuvatu pālāṟu. atu perumpāṇaṉ putiya pāṇaṉai āṟṟuppaṭuttiya vaḻiyil avaṉ kālattil iruntiruppiṉ, ataṉaip paṟṟik kūṟiyiruppāṉ. avaṉ kuṟitta tuṟaimuka nakarattiṟkuc cella vēṇṭumāyiṉ, pālāṟṟaik kaṭantutāṉ cella vēṇṭum. iḵtu iṉṟaiya nilaimai. pālāṟu māmallapurattiṟkut teṟkē ēṟattāḻap patiṉaintu kal tolaivil iṉṟu pāykiṉṟatu. āyiṉum. perumpāṇaṉ kālattil pālāṟu kāñcikku ēṟattāḻa eṭṭukkal vaṭakkil pāyntakoṇṭiruntatu. ki.pi. 13ām nūṟṟāṇṭiṟkup piṉpē ataṉ pōkku māṟṟappaṭṭatu. ataṉāl, appēriyāṟu kāñcikkut teṟkil pāyat toṭaṅki vāyalūr eṉṉum iṭattiṟku arukil kaṭaliṟ kalakkalāyiṟṟu. itu paṟṟiya vivaraṅkaḷai ippakutiyiṉ īṟṟil uḷḷa kuṟippiṟkāṇka. taṉ kālattil kāñcikkut teṟkē pālāṟu pāyātatālētāṉ perumpāṇaṉ appēri yāṟṟaik kuṟikkavillai eṉpatu iṅku aṟiyattakum.
perumpāṇaṉ kuṟiñci, pālai, mullai nilappakutikaḷaip paṟṟip pēciya piṉpu marutanilam paṟṟic cila vivaraṅkaḷaik kūṟiyuḷḷāṉ; annilappakuti iṉṟuḷḷa māmallapurattiṟkum pālāṟṟiṉ vaṭakaraikkum iṭaippaṭṭa tākum. aṅku ērikaḷ amaintuḷḷaṉa. māmallapurattiliruntu kaccikkuc ceṉṟa vaḻiyil tōppukaḷ iruntamaiyaip perumpāṇaṉ kuṟittuḷḷāṉ. ivaṟṟai nōkka, iṉṟuḷḷavāṟē caṅkakālat toṇṭai nāṭṭilum ērippāyccal peṟṟirunta nilappakutiyē marutanilamāyk kāṭciyaḷittatu eṉpatai aṟiyalām. toṇṭai nāṭṭu marutanilam paṟṟiya ceytikaḷait `toṇṭai nāṭu, eṉṉum talaippiṟ kāṇalām.
pāṇṭi nāṭṭu maruta nilam
pāṇṭi nāṭṭu yāṟukaḷuḷḷē peyar peṟṟavai `vaiyai, porunai eṉpaṉa. vaiyai pāṇṭi nāṭṭiṉ vaṭapakutiyaiyum, porunai pāṇṭi nāṭṭiṉ teṉ pakutiyaiyum nīṇṭa kālamāy vaḷappaṭutti varukiṉṟaṉa. āyiṉum, `maturai eṉṉum pāṇṭiyar talainakaraiyaṭuttup pāynta vaiyaiyē caṅkanūlkaḷil ciṟappākap pēcappaṭṭuḷḷatu. pāṇṭi nāṭṭu marutanilam paṟṟiya vivaraṅkaḷ, `pāṇṭi nāṭu eṉṉun talaippil virivākat tarappaṭṭuḷḷatu.
marutam
ūṭalum kūṭalumākiya oḻukkam marutanilattiṟku uriyateṉa ilakkaṇanūl kūṟum. avvoḻukkattiṟkē `marutam eṉpatu peyar.
`marutam cāṉṟa marutat taṇpaṉai eṉpatu ciṟupāṇāṟṟuppaṭai (aṭi, 186). innilattiṟkuriyatu marutayāḻ eṉpatu. marutappaṇ eṉpatum vaḻakkil iruntatu. marutappaṇ kālaippaṇ eṉappaṭṭatu. yāḻōr maturaiyil kālaiyil marutappaṇṇai vācittaṉar (ma. kā. aṭi, 657-8).
marutanilattil uṇavuppañcamillai. ātaliṉ, makkaḷ taṅkaḷ ōyvu nēraṅkaḷaik kalviyilum kalai vaḷarcciyilum celaviṭat toṭaṅkiṉārkaḷ. marutanila makkaḷālētāṉ ulakil nuṇkalaikaḷum piṟa kalaikaḷum cemmaiyāy vaḷarcciyaṭaintaṉa; āṭalum pāṭalum ōviyamum ciṟpamum vaḷarcci peṟṟaṉa. cōṟṟukkavalai illātatāl nilakkiḻār palar parattaiyarōṭu paḻakalāyiṉar. eṉavē, tamiḻ nūlkaḷil parattaiyar pirivu ēṟpaṭṭatu. parattaiyar poruṭṭut talaivaṉ talaiviyai viṭṭup pirintāṉ; talaivi ūṭal koṇṭāḷ. talaivaṉ, pāṇaṉ, viṟali mutaliyōraik koṇṭu talaiviyiṉ ūṭalait tīrttut talaiviyaik kūṭiṉāṉ. itaṉālētāṉ `maruta nilattiṟku ūṭalum kūṭalum uriya, eṉṟu akapporuḷ ilakkaṇam aṟaiyalāyiṟṟu.


5. neytal nilam
muṉṉurai
kaṭalum kaṭal cārnta iṭamum neytal eṉap peyar peṟum. iṅku neytal malar mikutiyātaliṉ, innilam ippeyar peṟṟatu eṉṉalām. kātalaippirinta kātali taṉ taṉimaiyai niṉaintu iraṅkalum iraṅkal nimittamum ākiya oḻukkam paṟṟi innilam neytal eṉap peyar peṟṟatu eṉṟu kūṟappaṭutalum uṇṭu.
kaṭaṟkaraiyil vāḻnta paratavarē innilattukkuriya kuṭimakkaḷ. avarkaḷ paṭṭiṉam eṉṟa pērūrkaḷilum pākkam eṉṟa ciṟṟūrkaḷilum vāḻntārkaḷ. avaruḷ talaivarāyiṉār `cērppaṉ, pulampaṉ; eṉappaṭṭaṉar; avartam peṇṭir `parattiyar, nuḷaicciyar eṉappaṭṭaṉar. avartam kuṭimakkaḷuḷ āṭavar, `paratar, nuḷaiyar, aḷavar, valaiyar eṉappaṭṭaṉar. avartam peṇṭir `parattiyar, nuḷaicciyar, aḷattiyar, valaicciyar eṉappaṭṭaṉar.
neytal nilamakkaḷ maḻaikkaṭavuḷai (varuṇaṉai)t teyvamākak koṇṭāṭiṉārkaḷ. avarkaḷ kaṭaliṟceṉṟu valaivīci mīṉ piṭittaṉar; avaṟṟai viṟṟaṉar; uppai viḷaittaṉar; uppai viṟṟaṉar; vanta poruḷaik koṇṭu vāḻntaṉar; ammakkaḷ mīṉkaḷaip piṭittal, avaṟṟai ularttutal, uppu viḷaittal, mīṉaiyum uppaiyum viṟṟal, paṟavaikaḷai ōṭṭal, kaṭalāṭutal mutaliya toḻilkaḷil īṭupaṭṭiruntārkaḷ. avarkaḷ mīṉkōṭpaṟai, pampai, viḷari yāḻ eṉṉum icaikkaruvikaḷaip payaṉpaṭuttiṉārkaḷ; cevvaḻi eṉṉum paṇ icaittārkaḷ. avarkaḷ tāḻai, nīr muḷḷi, aṭampu puṉṉai, ñāḻal eṉṉum malarkaḷai aṇintārkaḷ.
cōḻanāṭṭu neytal nilam, ōymāṉāṭṭu neytal nilam, toṇṭai nāṭṭu neytal nilam, pāṇṭi nāṭṭu neytal nilam paṟṟiya ceytikaḷ `nāṭukaḷ eṉṉum aṭutta pakutiyil tarappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa. neytal nila makkaḷiṉ ceyalkaḷ `viḷaiyāṭṭukaḷ eṉṉun talaippil iṭam peṟṟuḷḷaṉa.
neytal neṭuvaḻi
iṭaikkaḻi nāṭṭiliruntu ōymāṉāṭṭuk kaṭaṟkarai vaḻiyē ceṉṟa neṭuvaḻiyil eyiṟpaṭṭiṉam iruntatu. anneṭuvaḻi pala kālamāka vāṇi vaḻipāyum nāṭu viṭṭu nāṭu cellum peruvaḻiyāyum iruntatu pōlum! nallūr nattattaṉār ataṉaip `pukaḻtal amainta neytal nilattu neṭiya vaḻi eṉṉum poruḷil,
``pāṭal cāṉṟa neytal neṭuvaḻi
(ci. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 151) eṉṟu kūṟiyuḷḷār.
pālāṟṟiṉ pōkku
pālāṟṟiṉ tōṟṟam
maicūr nāṭṭil peṅkaḷūr, kōlār, tumkūr, maicūr, hācaṉ, kaṭūr, ṣimōkā, cittal turkkam eṉa eṭṭu māvaṭṭaṅkaḷ uḷḷaṉa. ovvoru māvaṭṭattilum pala vaṭṭaṅkaḷ uṇṭu. kōlār māvaṭṭattil cikpallapūr eṉṉum peyar koṇṭa vaṭṭam oṉṟākum. avvaṭṭattil nanti turkka malaittoṭar uḷḷatu. attoṭaril tippakiri, piramakiri, ceṉṉa kēcavamalai, arikarēcuvara malai, kalavara turkkam, nanti turkkam eṉap pala malaikaḷ uṇṭu.
ceṉṉakēcavamalai kaṭalmaṭṭattiṟku mēl 4762 aṭi uyaramuḷḷatu. itaṉ ucciyil aṭarnta kāṭukaḷ uḷḷaṉa. immalaiyiṉ  vaṭapakutiyil tōṉṟum yāṟu uttarappinākiṉi eṉpatu; teṉpakutiyil tōṉṟum yāṟu taṭciṇappinākiṉi eṉpatu. ivai muṟaiyē vaṭapeṇṇaiyāṟu, teṉpeṇṇaiyāṟu eṉṟu tamiḻil peyar peṟum. inta iraṇṭu yāṟukaḷukkum iṭaiyil pālāṟu tōṉṟukiṟatu.
pālāṟṟiṉ pōkku
kōlār māṭṭattil tōṉṟum pālāṟu kōlār vaṭṭam, mulpākal vaṭṭam, cīṉivācapuravaṭṭam, pauriṅpēṭṭai vaṭṭam ākiyavai vaḻiyākat teṉkiḻakkil pāykiṉṟatu; pauriṅpēṭṭai vaṭṭattiṉ kiḻakkil maicūr nāṭṭaik kaṭantu, vaṭavārkkāṭṭu māvaṭṭattaic cērnta paḻaiya kaṅkuṇṭi camīṉ cīmaiyai aṭaikiṟatu.
kaṅkuṇṭic cīmaiyai aṭainta pālāṟu muppatukal ceṉṟu kiḻakkut toṭarcci malaikaḷiṉ vaḻiyē pāyntu vāṇiyampāṭip paḷḷattākkai aṭaikiṉṟatu. piṉpu atu cavvātu malaikaḷiṉ kuṟukkīṭṭāl ciṟiya vaṭakkil ceṉṟu piṉpu kiḻakku nōkkip pāykiṟatu. ārkkāṭṭiṟkuk kiḻakkil aintukal tolaivil pālāṟṟiṉ kuṟukkē ōr aṇai kaṭṭappaṭṭuḷḷatu. kāvērip pākkattukku1 appāl inta yāṟu ceṅkaṟpaṭṭu māvaṭṭattuk kāñcīpura vaṭṭattuḷ nuḻaikiṟatu; kāñcikkut teṉkiḻakkiṟ ceṉṟu, iṟutiyil kiḻakku nōkkip pāyntu, caturaṅkappaṭṭiṉattiṟkut2 teṟkil mūṉṟu kal tolaivil kaṭaliṟkalakkiṉṟatu. ippālāṟṟiṉ nīḷam ēṟattāḻa 230 kal ākum.
kalveṭṭuc ceyti
kāvērippākkattukku arukil uḷḷa koṇṭāpuram eṉṉum ciṟṟūril uḷḷa kōvil kalveṭṭu oṉṟu, akkōvil pālāṟṟukkut teṟkil iruppateṉak kuṟittuḷḷatu. āyiṉum, iṉṟu akkōvil pālāṟṟukku vaṭakkil uḷḷatu.3 itaṉai nōkka, ekkāraṇattālō piṉ nūṟṟāṇṭukaḷil, kāvērip pākkattiṟku arukilirunta pālāṟṟiṉ pōkku vaṭakkiliruntu teṟku nōkki māṟiyiruttal vēṇṭum eṉpatu teḷivākiṟatu.
iṅṅaṉam pālāṟṟiṉ pōkku māṟak kāraṇam, pālāṟu kāñciyai aṭuttuc cella vēṇṭum eṉṟa nōkkattōṭu kāñci kāvalaṉuṭaiya uyaraluvalaṉāṉa kaṇṭa kōpālaṉ eṉpavaṉ, aracaṉ viruppappaṭi āṟṟiṉ pōkkai māṟṟiyatē eṉṟu cevivaḻic ceyti ceppukiṉṟatu.4
tirumuṟaiccāṉṟukaḷ
kāvērippākkattu ēri mikap periyatu. anta ēriyiliruntu veḷippaṭum mikutiyāṉa nīrē korttalaiyāṟu eṉṉum peyaruṭaṉ kiḻakkil pāykiṉṟatu. atu vaḻiyil tiruttaṇikaiyāṟu, nakariyāṟu eṉpavaṟṟiṉ nīraip peṟṟuc ceṉṉaikku vaṭakiḻakkil uḷḷa eṇṇūrukku arukil kaṭaliṟkalakkiṉṟatu. ikkottalaiyāṟu pāyum kāvērippākkattup paḷḷattākkil oru kālattil pālāṟu pāyntiruttal vēṇṭum eṉṟu ārāycciyāḷar karutukiṉṟaṉar. pālāṟṟup paṭukaiyum kottalaiyāṟṟup paṭukaiyaiyum iṇaikkum ciṟṟāṟu oṉṟu iṉṟum `paḻaiya pālāṟu eṉṉum peyaril iruppatē iṅṅaṉam karutak kāraṇamākum.1 iḵtu uṇmaiyāy irukkalām eṉpatait tirumuṟaippāṭalkaḷum piṟapāṭalkaḷum tiruppācūrk kalveṭṭum meyppikkiṉṟaṉa.
1. kāñcikku vaṭamēṟkil ēṟattāḻa ēḻukal tolaivil uḷḷa tirumāṟpēṟu eṉṉum civatalam pālāṟṟiṉ teṉkaraiyil iruntatu eṉṟu ki.pi. 7ām nūṟṟāṇṭil vāḻnta tiruñāṉa campantar tamatu patikattiṟ pāṭiyuḷḷār.
``tiraiyār pāliyiṉ teṉkarai māṟpēṟu2
ki.pi. 12ām nūṟṟāṇṭil (ki.pi. 1133-1150) tiruñāṉaca mpantar mutaliya caivap periyārkaḷiṉ varalāṟukaḷaip periya purāṇam eṉṉum peruṅkāppiyamākap pāṭiyaruḷiya cēkkiḻār perumāṉum itaṉaiyē kūṟiyuḷḷār.3 tirumāṟ pēṟṟukku aṇmaiyil uḷḷa kōvintavāṭi akaram eṉṉum ūril `paḻaiya pālāṟueṉṉum peyaruṭaṉ yāṟu oṉṟu iṉṟum kāṇappaṭukiṉṟatu.4
2. kāñciyiliruntu kaliṅkattiṉmītu paṭaiyeṭuttuc ceṉṟa mutaṟkulōttuṅkaṉ (ki.pi. 1070-1120) paṭaittalaivaṉāṉa karuṇākarat toṇṭaimāṉ kāñcikkum kaliṅkattukkum iṭaiyil pala yāṟukaḷai kaṭantāṉ. avaṟṟuḷ mutalyāṟu pālāṟu eṉṟu akkālattil pāṭappaṭṭa kaliṅkattup paraṇi kūṟukiṉṟatu.1 eṉavē, ki.pi. 11, 12ām nūṟṟāṇṭukaḷil pālāṟu kāñcikku vaṭakkil pāyntu koṇṭiruntatu eṉpatu teḷivākiṟataṉṟō?
3. ceṉṉaikku mēṟkil ēṟattāḻap patiṉaintu kal tolaivil uḷḷa pūvirunta vallikku vaṭakkil iraṇṭu kal tolaivil tiruvēṟkāṭu eṉṉum civatalam uḷḷatu. itu pālāṟṟiṉ vaṭakaraiyil iruntatu eṉṟu cēkkiḻār perumāṉ periya purāṇattiṟ pāṭiyuḷḷār.2 iṉṟu avyāṟu `paḻaiya pālāṟueṉṟum `kāṭu veṭṭiyāṟu eṉṟum kūṟappaṭukiṟatu.3
4. tiruvēṟkāṭṭiṟku vaṭakiḻakkil ēṟattāḻa āṟu kal tolaivil vaṭatirumullaivāyil eṉṉum civatalam amaintuḷḷatu. appati pālāṟṟiṉ vaṭakaraiyil iruntatu eṉṟu ki.pi. 9ām nūṟṟāṇṭiṉarāṉa cuntarar attalam paṟṟiya patikattiṟpāṭiyuḷḷār. acceyyuḷ,

eṉpatu.
5. ceṉṉaiyiliruntu arakkōṇam cellum iruppuppātaiyai aṭuttuḷḷa ilampaiyaṅkōṭṭūr tiruviṟkōlam (kūvam), tiruvūṟal (takkōlam) eṉṉam civatalaṅkaḷum pālāṟṟiṉ vaṭapāl iruntaṉa eṉṟu cēkkiḻār ceppiyuḷḷār.1
pācūrkkalveṭṭu
6. tiruppācūrc civaṉ kōvilil aimpattu mūṉṟu kalveṭṭukaḷ uḷḷaṉa. avaṟṟuḷ oṉṟu kaliṅkattup paraṇi koṇṭa mutaṟ kulōttuṅkaṉatu (ki.pi. 1070-1120) nāṟpattāṟām āṭci yāṇṭil (ki.pi. 1116 il) veṭṭappaṭṭatu.
``āmūrkkōṭṭattu mōntūr nāṭṭu mōntūrp pāṇṭippākkam oṟṟi koṇṭāṉukkuk kīḻmalai mōkūr nāṭṭu irāca nārāyaṇa caturvēti maṅkalattu makācapaiyār nilattai viṟṟaṉar. ammaiyappar tirumañcaṉattukkup pālāṟṟu nīraik koṇṭu varavum nantavaṉam amaikkavum annilam viṟkappaṭṭatu, eṉpatu akkalveṭṭuc ceytiyākum.2
tiruppācūrkku aṇmaiyil pālāṟu pāyntu koṇṭiruntatu eṉpatu ikkalveṭṭāl naṉku viḷaṅkukiṟataṉṟō?
muṭivurai
iccāṉṟukaḷ aṉaittaiyum nōkkak ki.pi. 12ām nūṟṟāṇṭu varaiyil pālāṟu, kāñcikku vaṭakkil uḷḷa tirumāṟpēṟu, vaṭakiḻakkil uḷḷa tiruppācūr, tiruvēṟkāṭu, tirumullaivāyil vaḻiyākac ceṉṟu eṇṇūrukku arukil kaṭaliṟkalantiruttal vēṇṭum eṉpatu teḷivātal kāṇka.
6. nāṭukaḷ
cōḻanāṭu
kāviriyiṉ ciṟappu
kañcaṅkullai tīytal, marakkompukaḷai nerupput tiṉṉutal, malaiyaruvikaḷ vaṟṟutal, mēkam kaṭal nīrai mukattalai maṟattal ākiyavai. nērumpoḻutu nāṭṭil periya vaṟkaṭam tōṉṟum. akkoṭiya kālattilum kāviriyāṟṟu nīr perukivarum; naṟaikkoṭi, narantampul, akil, cantaṉam ākiyavaṟṟaic cumantu vantu tuṟaitōṟum taḷḷic cellum; kuḷam mutaliya nīr nilaikaḷiṟpukum. annīril makaḷirum maintarum nīrāṭuvar. nel viḷaiccal, kāviri vaḷattāl mikutiyākum. uḻavar, nāṭōṟum kaṭā viṭṭuk kuṉṟu eṉṟu collumpaṭi kuvitta nellaik kutirkaḷil nirappuvar. oru vēli nilam āyiraṅkalamākiya cennellai viḷaikkum. ittakaiya viḷaiccalukkuk kāraṇam, kāviriyāṟēyākum. kāviri iṅṅaṉam taṉatu nīrāl cōḻanāṭṭaip pātukākkiṟatu (po. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 233-248).
veḷḷi eṉṉum mīṉ tāṉ niṟṟaṟkuriya vaṭaticaiyil nillāmal teṉticaiyiṟcelliṉum, maḻai tāṉ peyya vēṇṭum kālattup peyyātoḻiyiṉum, kuṭaku malaiyil tōṉṟip pāyum kāviri poyyātu, kālantōṟum pāyntukoṇṭēyirukkum. kāviri nīr cōḻanāṭṭiṟ pāykaiyil poṉṉaik karaiyil pōkaṭum. kāviri vaḷattāl cōḻanāṭṭu vayalkaḷil viḷaital māṟātu naṭaipeṟum (pa.pālai, aṭi, 1-7).
cōḻanāṭu
cōḻanāṭṭiṉ ovvoru `mā nilattilum tiṭar tōṟum neṟkūṭukaḷ poruntiyirukkum. tāḻnta teṉṉai maraṅkaḷaiyuṭaiya kuḷirnta maraccōlaikaḷil kuṭiyiruppukaḷ irukkum. aṅkuḷḷa makkaḷ kuruti kalanta cōṟṟaip paliyāka iṭuvārkaḷ. kākkai appaliyai viḻuṅkum. atu āmaiyiṉ pārppai eṭuttu vantu paci varumpōtu tiṉṉap pātukāttu vaikkum. āṇmayilkaḷ vaḷaivuṭaiya kāñcimarattilum cevviya marutamarattilum taṅkum; pākaṟpaḻattaiyum, palāp paḻattaiyum tiṉṉum. appoḻutu avaṟṟiṉ peṇ mayilkaḷ avaṟṟai aḻaikkum. āṇ mayilkaḷ avaṟṟaip poruṭpaṭuttāmal, yāḻōcai pōṉṟu vaṇṭukaḷ neytal nilattiṟpāṭuvataik kēṭṭu, aṅkuc ceṉṟu, pāṭaṟku ēṟpat taṅkaḷ tōkaiyai virittu nilavu pōṉṟa .iṭumaṇalil āṭum.
mullai nilakkāṭukaḷil taḷavu, tōṉṟi, mullai, tēṟṟā, poṉ pōlum pūviṉaiyuṭaiya koṉṟai, nīlamaṇi pōlum pūviṉaiyuṭaiya kāyā eṉpavai malarum. mullai nila makkaḷ akkāṭukaḷil vāḻtalai veṟukkiṉ, marutanilam ceṉṟu annilattaip pukaḻvārkaḷ.
nāraikaḷ kaṭal iṟavaittiṉṟu puṉṉai marakkiḷaikaḷil taṅkum; akkiḷaikaḷiṉ mītu mōtum tiraikku añciṉ, marutanilattup paṉai maṭaliṟceṉṟu taṅkum.
neytal nilamākiya kaṭaṟkaraiyai aṭutta pākkattil kulaikaḷaik koṇṭa teṉṉai maraṅkaḷum, vāḻai maraṅkaḷum, malarnta curapuṉṉai maraṅkaḷum, koḻuviya kāntaṭceṭikaḷum vaḷamuṟat tōṉṟum. aṅkut tuṭiyōcai pōlum ōcaiyaiyuṭaiya pērāntai vāḻum. paratavar appākkattu vāḻkkaiyai veṟuppiṉ, kuṟiñciyiṟceṉṟu annilattaip pukaḻvar.
kuṟavar tam kuṟiñci nilappūkkaḷai veṟuppiṉ, neytaṟpūkkaḷaic cūṭuvar. mullai nila (kāṭṭu)k kōḻikaḷ (marutanilattu) nellait tiṉṉum; maruta nilattu vīṭṭukkōḻikaḷ (mullainilattut) tiṉaiyait tiṉṉum; malaināṭṭukkuriya mantikaḷ uppaṅkaḻiyil mūḻkum; uppaṅkaḻiyil tiriyum nāraikaḷ malaiyil taṅkum. cōḻanāṭu ittakaiya nāṉilac ciṟappuṭaiyatu (po. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 180-226).
karumpiṉ pāku kāyccum poḻutu uṇṭākum pukai cuṭutalāl, vayalil uḷḷa neytaṟpūkkaḷ vāṭum. erumaikkaṉṟukaḷ kāytta cenneṟkatirkaḷait tiṉṟu neṭuṅkūṭṭiṉ niḻalil uṟaṅkum. cōḻanāṭṭil kulaikaḷaiyuṭaiya teṉṉaiyum, vāḻaiyum, kamukum, maṇam nāṟum mañcaḷum, māvum, kulaikaḷaiyuṭaiya paṉaiyum, aṭi paranta cēmpum, muḷaiyiṉaiyuṭaiya iñciyum mikuti. cōḻa nāṭṭu vaḷam mikunta ciṟṟūrkaḷ oṉṟukkoṉṟu aṇimaiyil irukkum (pa. pālai, aṭi, 8-28).
poykaiyiṉ karaiyil vaḷarntuḷḷa kaṭampamarattu malarkaḷ kōtai pōlak kāṇappaṭum. ammalarkaḷ intira kōpattaiyotta tātai utirkkum. attātu nīr uṇṇum tuṟaiyiṟpaṭiyum. annilaiyil attuṟai ōviyaṉāl varaiyappeṟṟa ōviyam pōlak kāṭciyaḷikkum. mēl nōkki eḻukiṉṟa periya nakilai otta centāmaraiyiṉ mukai, aḻakiya mukam pōla malarum. kuṟṟamaṟṟa uḷḷaṅkaiyaic cātiliṅkam tōyntālaṉṉa civanta itaḻkaḷ attāmarai malaril irukkum. avvaḻakiya itaḻkaḷ cūḻnta cempoṉṉāṟ ceytālotta (malarp) pīṭattilē āṇ tumpi taṉ uyirkkuk kāvalākiya iṉiya peṭaiyait taḻuvikkoṇṭu uṟaṅkum; kālaiyil tuyileḻuntu cīkāmaram eṉṉum paṇṇaippāṭum. cōḻanāṭu ittakaiya vaḷam mikunta nilam cūḻnta acaiyāta kuṭiyiruppukaḷaiyuṭaiyatu. (ci.ā,paṭai, aṭi, 68-78).
ōymāṉāṭu
nallūriliruntu eyiṟpaṭṭiṉam varaiyil (neytal)
kaṭaṟkaraiyil uḷḷa veḷḷiya maṇalil tāḻai aṉṉampōlap pūkkum; iḷavēṉiṟkālam toṭaṅkum nāḷil cerunti malar poṉṉaippōlap pūkkum; kaḻimuḷḷi nīlamaṇi pōla malarum. neṭiya tāḷaiyuṭaiya puṉṉai muttup pōla arumpum. kaṭaṟkarai ōrattil ikkāṭciyaip pārttukkoṇṭē vaṭakkiliruntu teṟku nōkki variṉ, anneytal nilattu neṭiya vaḻiyil nīlamaṇi pōlum uppaṅkaḻi cūḻnta ūrkaḷaiyuṭaiya eyiṟpaṭṭiṉam tōṉṟum. appaṭṭiṉattil kuḷirnta nīraiyuṭaiya kuḷaṅkaḷ uṇṭu (ci. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 146-153).
eyiṟpaṭṭiṉattiliruntu vēlūr varaiyil (mullai, pālai)
eyiṟpaṭṭiṉattiliruntu vēlūr nōkkic cellum vaḻiyil avarai, pavaḻam pōlap pūkkaḷaik kāṭṭum; kariya arumpiṉaiyuṭaiya kāyāmalarkaḷ, mayiṟkaḻuttaip pōlap pūkkum; mucuṭṭai, koṭṭam pōlum pūvai veḷippaṭuttum; kulaiyiṉaiyuṭaiya kāntaḷ, kaiviral pōlap pūkkum. kollai vaḻikaḷil intirakōpam eṉṉum tampalap pūccikaḷ ūrum. ittakaiya mullai nilattil uḷḷatu vēlūr. aṅku eyiṉar kuṭicaikaḷ irukkum. (ci. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 164-173).
vēlūriliruntu āmūr varaiyil (marutam)
vēlūriliruntu āmūr nōkkic cellum vaḻiyil maruta nilakkāṭci tōṉṟum. kāñci maram ciṟiya kompukaḷaiyum kuṟiya tāḷaiyum uṭaiyatu. ataṉkaṇ naṟiya pūkkaḷ kāṭciyaḷikkum. ciccilippaṟavai am marattaṭiyil nīr nilaiyiluḷḷa kayal mīṉaippaṟṟa amayam pārkkum. appaṟavaiyiṉ niṟam nīlamaṇi pōṉṟatu; ataṉ vāy poṉṉiṟam pōṉṟatu. atu kīḻē pāyntu kayal mīṉait taṉ alakāṟpaṟṟum poḻutu, ataṉkāl nakaṅkaḷ nīrnilaiyiluḷḷa tāmarai ilaikaḷaik kiḻikkum. attāmarai veṇṭāmarai. avveṇṭāmarai malaril uḷḷa tēṉai uṇṇak kariya vaṇṭukaḷ varicaiyākac cūḻum kāṭci, tiṅkaḷaiccērum karumpāmpai oppattōṉṟum. ittakaiya vaḷam poruntiya nilattil āmūr uḷḷatu. (ci. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 178-188).
iṭaikkaḻi nāṭu1
nāṭṭu amaippu
ciṟupāṇāṟṟuppaṭai āciriyarāṉa nattattaṉār iṭaikkaḻi nāṭṭiṉar. iṭaikkaḻi nāṭu ceṅkaṟpaṭṭu māvaṭṭattaic cērntatu; ceyyūrukkuk kiḻakkilum teṉkiḻakkilum teṟkilum kaṭaṟkaraiyōrattiṟparaviyuḷḷatu. innāṭṭiṉ vaṭakkut teṟku nīḷam ēṟattāḻap pattukkal kiḻakkut teṟkil akalam araikkal mutal nāṉku kal varaiyil uḷḷatu. iḵtu ēṟattāḻa irupattaintu caturamail parappuṭaiyatu. innāṭu kiḻakkil kaṭalai ellaiyāy uṭaiyatu. maṟṟa mūṉṟu pakkaṅkaḷilum paranta kaḻi veḷikaḷ amaintuḷḷaṉa. innāṭṭiṉ iṭaiyilum kaḻi veḷikaḷ nīṇṭu kiṭakkiṉṟaṉa. itu paṟṟiyē innāṭu iṭaikkaḻi nāṭu eṉṉum peyar peṟṟatu pōlum!
iṭaikkaḻi nāṭu muḻumaiyum maṇal niṟaintu kāṇappaṭukiṟatu. `cila āyiram āṇṭukaḷukku muṉpu innāṭu kaṭaṟpakutiyāy iruntiruttal vēṇṭum. kaṭaliṟkontaḷippu ēṟpaṭṭu nilappakutikaḷ cila kaṭaluḷ amiḻntapōtu kaṭaṟpakutikaḷiṟcila nilamākavum māṟiyiruttal vēṇṭum. aṅṅaṉam māṟiya kaṭaṟpakutikaḷuḷ oṉṟāka ivviṭaikkaḻi nāṭu iruttal kūṭum, eṉṟu aṟiñar karutukiṉṟaṉar.
maḻaikkālattil innāṭṭiṉ vaṭakku, mēṟku, teṟku ellaikaḷil uḷḷa kaḻi veḷikaḷ nīr nirampi innāṭu oru tīvu pōṉṟa kāṭciyai viḷaikkiṉṟatu. pakkiṅkām turai ceṉṉai āḷunarāyiruntapōtu avar peyarāl kaṭalōramāka veṭṭappaṭṭa kālvāyē `pakkiṅkām kālvāy eṉpatu. atu veṭṭappaṭṭa piṉpu akkālvāy vaḻiyākap paṭakukaḷ ceṉṉaikkum iṭaikkaḻi nāṭṭiṟkum poruḷkaḷaik koṇṭu celkiṉṟaṉa. makkaḷ celavum naṭaipeṟukiṉṟatu.
cālaikaḷ
iṭaikkaḻi nāṭṭiṉ teṉmēṟkup pakutiyil uḷḷa kaḻiveḷiyil kālappōkkil maṇmēṭu amaintu viṭṭatu. ammēṭṭup pakutiyil cālai amaikkappaṭṭatu. accālai, iṭaikkaḻi nāṭṭiṉuḷ iraṇṭu kal tolaivu varai-iṭaikkaḻi nāṭṭu veṇṇāṅkuppaṭṭu eṉṉum ciṟṟūr varai nīṭṭappaṭṭatu. maturāntakattiliruntu cūṉāmpēṭu vaḻiyāka innāṭṭiṟku mutaṉ mutal accālai virivākkappaṭṭatu. innāṭṭil ippoḻutu cālaikaḷ pala amaikkappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.
ālamparaikkōṭṭai
iṉṟu iṭaikkaḻi nāṭṭiṉ talainakaram kaṭappākkam eṉpatu. ivvūriṉ ellaikku uṭpaṭṭa kaṭaṟkarai ōrattil mulīm maṉṉarāl periya kōṭṭai oṉṟu kaṭṭappaṭṭatu. kiḻakkukkaraiyōrattil irunta kaṭaṟ koḷḷaikkārarai aṭakkavē ikkōṭṭai kaṭṭappaṭṭateṉa vaḻivaḻic ceyti kūṟukiṟatu. iḵtu iṉṟu aḻinta nilaiyiluḷḷatu. cuṟṟuppuṟa araṇkaḷ maṭṭumē kāṇappaṭukiṉṟaṉa. cuvarkaḷ iṭintu maṇṭiya ceṭikaḷukkiṭaiyil maṟaintuḷḷaṉa. kutiraikkoṭṭil, neṟkaḷañciyam mutaliya kaṭṭaṭaṅkaḷ pāḻaṭaintuḷḷaṉa. ikkōṭṭaiyiṉ parappu ēṟattāḻap patiṉaintu ēkkar irukkalām. itaṉaic cuṟṟilum akaḻi iruntatu. akaḻi kaṭaluṭaṉ iṇaintavāṟu tōṇṭappaṭṭuḷḷatu. ikkōṭṭaikku arukiluḷḷa ciṟṟūr ālamparai eṉpatu. ikkōṭṭai ālamparaik kōṭṭai eṉṟē iṉṟu vaḻaṅkappaṭukiṟatu. itu 18ām nūṟṟāṇṭiṟ ciṟappuṟṟiruntatu. mucaparjaṅku eṉpavar tammai ātaritta pireñcukkārarkku itaṉaip paricākat tantār. itu car ayarkūṭṭu eṉṟa āṅkilēyap paṭaittalaivarāl 1760il aḻikkappaṭṭatu. kōṭṭaikkarukil taṅku viṭuti oṉṟu 1860 varaiyil iruntatu.1
kaḻi veḷi
iṭaikkaḻi nāṭṭuk karaiyōram kāñcikkuc cellum neṭuñcālai iruntamaikkuriya aṭaiyāḷaṅkaḷ kāṇappaṭukiṉṟaṉa. pirayāṇikaḷ taṅka vacatiyāka āṅkāṅkac cattiraṅkaḷ uḷḷaṉa. innāṭṭiṉ teṟkil kaṭal nīrai uḷḷē koṇṭu varum kaḻi veḷi amaintuḷḷatu. paṇṭaikkālattil itaṉaik kaṭakkap pālam oṉṟu iruntatu. aḵtu ippoḻutu iṭintu payaṉaṟṟu viṭṭatāl, makkaḷ paṭaku mūlamākavē kaḻi veḷiyaik kaṭakkiṉṟārkaḷ.
viḷaivum toḻilum
inta nāṭu maṇaṟpāṅkāṉa maṇ vaḷam peṟṟatu. ātalāl, iṅku mā, palā, teṉṉai, paṉai, muntirikai, cavukku maraṅkaḷē mikutiyāy vaḷarkiṉṟaṉa. nāṭṭiṉ naṭuvil uḷḷa cila iṭaṅkaḷil nel ciṟitaḷavu payirākiṟatu. puṉceyppayirkaḷuḷ kēḻvaraku maṭṭum payirākiṟatu.
innāṭṭiṉar teṉṉai paṉai ōlaikaḷaikkoṇṭu kīṟṟu muṭaikiṉṟaṉar; taṭukkuc ceykiṉṟaṉar; teṉṉai nāraikkoṇṭu kayiṟu tirikkiṉṟaṉar; patanīraik koṇṭu paṉai vellam tayārikkiṉṟaṉar; ilai taikkum vēlaiyum ceykiṉṟaṉar; paṉaiyōlai maṭṭaikaḷiliruntu narampukaḷai eṭuttuc ceppañceytu mēṉāṭukaṭku aṉuppukiṉṟaṉar.
innāṭṭu ūrkaḷ
iṭaikkaḻi nāṭṭil pattoṉpatu ciṟṟūrkaḷ amaintuḷḷaṉa. avai, muttukkāṭu, ōtiyūr, nayiṉār kuppam, mutaliyār kuppam, paṉaiyūr, viḷampūr, kaṅkatēvaṉ kuppam, cēmpuli puram, kappivākkam, nallūr, karumpākkam, paḷḷampākkam, kaṭappākkam, ālamparai, vēmpaṉūr, kōṭṭaikkāṭu, veṇṇāṅkuppaṭṭu, tēṉpākkam, kuḷattūr eṉpaṉa. ivaṟṟuḷ ālamparai eṉṉum ciṟṟūrē pakkiṅkām kālvāykkuk kiḻakkiluḷḷatu.
innāṭṭil patiṉaintu toṭakka nilaippaḷḷikaḷ uḷḷaṉa; uyartoṭakkappaḷḷikaḷ mūṉṟu uḷḷaṉa; kaṭappākkattil uyarnilaippaḷḷi oṉṟum uḷḷatu. innāṭṭil ēṟattāḻa irupatiṉāyiravar makkaḷ vāḻkiṉṟārkaḷ.
iṭaikkaḻi nāṭṭu ūrkaḷuḷ nallūr eṉpatu oṉṟu. atil vāḻntavar nattattaṉār eṉṟa pulavar. avar tam nāṭṭiṟkut teṟkilirunta ōymāṉāṭṭu aracaṉāṉa nalliyakkōṭaṉmītu ciṟupāṇāṟṟuppaṭaiyaip pāṭiṉār eṉpatu muṉpē kūṟappaṭṭataṉṟō? avar kālam ēṟattāḻak ki.pi. 3ām nūṟṟāṇṭākum. iḵtu iṭaikkaḻi nāṭṭup paḻamaiyai iṉitu uṇarttuvatākumaṉṟō?
nattattaṉār piṟanta nallūril avar niṉaivāka avaratu uruvaccilai 18-6-1958il ceṉṉai mānila amaiccar uyartiru paktavaccalam avarkaḷ talaimaiyil niṟuvappaṭṭatu. nattattaṉār tamatu pāṭalāl tamatu iṭaikkaḻi nāṭṭukku aḻiyāppukaḻai nilaipeṟac ceytuḷḷār. avar tiruppeyar vāḻka! avaraip peṟṟa iṭaikkaḻi nāṭu vāḻka!
cēranāṭu
periya vāyaiyuṭaiya erumai, mīṉkaḷ citaṟumpaṭi nīril naṭantu, vaḷaviya itaḻaiyuṭaiya ceṅkaḻunīrp pūvait tiṉṉum; paciya miḷakuppoṭi paṭarnta palāmara niḻalil paṭukkum. appoḻutu aṅku vaḷarntirukkum mañcaḷatu melliya ilai erumaiyiṉ mutukiṉait taṭavum. erumai acai pōṭumpōtu atu tiṉṟa ceṅkaḻunīrp pūviliruntu tēṉ maṇam ataṉ vāyiṟparavum. acaiyiṭṭa piṉpu avverumai kāṭṭu mallikai malarkaḷ paravikkiṭakkum iṭattil tuyil koḷḷum. cēranāṭu ittakaiya vaḷamuṭaiyatu. (ci. ā. paṭai, 41-47).
toṇṭai nāṭu
mullai nilac ciṟṟūrkaḷ
viṭattēr toṭari eṉṉum oruvakai muḷ maraṅkaḷ cūḻa vaḷarnta toḻukkaḷaiyuṭaiya mullainilac ciṟṟūrkaḷiṉ viṭṭu muṟṟaṅkaḷil varaku mutaliyaṉa koṭṭi vaikkum kutirkaḷ irukkum. avai peṇ yāṉaikaḷ niṉṟāṟpōṉṟa kāṭciyai nalkum. vīṭṭup pantaril yāṉaiyiṉ kālai okkum varaku tirikai naṭappaṭṭirukkum. vēlai oḻinta nāḷil vaṇṭi uruḷaikaḷum kalappaiyum koṭṭil cuvarmītu cārttappaṭum; erutukaḷum kaṭṭi vaikkappaṭum. varaku vaikkōl vēynta kūraiyuṭaiya vīṭukaḷ ciṟṟūrkaḷai aḻaku ceyyum (pe. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 184-195).
neytal
toṇṭai nāṭṭu neytal nilattil uppu viḷaikkappaṭṭatu; mīṉ piṭikkappaṭṭatu. kaṭaṟṟuṟaippaṭṭiṉam kaṭal vāṇikattiṟ ciṟantu viḷaṅkiyatu. aṅku vāṇikattāṟciṟanta neytal nilamakkaḷ vāḻntārkaḷ (pe. ā. aṭi, 322-336)
marutam
yāḷi pāytalāl yāṉaikaḷ palavum kalaṅki ōlamiṭal pōla marutanilattil karuppañcāṟṟaippiḻiyum ālaikaḷ oliyeḻuppum. aṅkukkaruppañcāṟṟaik kaṭṭiyākak kāyccum koṭṭilkaḷ uṇṭu. pāṇar mutaliya putiyavar karuppañcāṟṟai mutalil parukalām; piṉpu karumpiṉ kaṭṭiyait tiṉṉalām. (pe. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 207-262).
pāṇaruḷ iḻinta nilaiyil uḷḷavar mīṉ piṭippatu vaḻakkam. avarkaḷ tūṇṭiliṭṭu mīṉaip piṭippārkaḷ. annīr nilaikaḷil centāmarai malarkaḷ pūkkum. avai kaṭavuḷukkuriyavai. pāṇar mutaliyavar avaṟṟaip paṟittut cūṭār. cātiliṅkam pōṉṟa itaḻaiyuṭaiya kuvaḷaimalarkaḷum nīlappūkkaḷum piṟamalarkaḷum ciṟu nīr nilaikaḷil malarntu kāṇappaṭum. ūrār avaṟṟaip paṟippar; vaḻippōkkarākiya pāṇar mutaliyōrkkum cūṭattaruvar (pe.ā. paṭai, aṭi, 283-296).
tōppukkuṭikaḷ
paṭṭiṉam piṟpaṭa mēlum kāñciyai nōkki vaḻi naṭappavar, vaḻiyil teṉṉantōppukaḷaik kāṇpar. aṅku ural pōṉṟa yāṉaiyiṉ uṭampai okkum caruccaraiyaiyuṭaiya teṅkiṉ uyarnta ōlaikaḷai muṭaintu vēynta maṉaikaḷ irukkum. avaṟṟiṉ muṟṟaṅkaḷil mañcaḷ payirākum; vīṭṭiṟkup piṉṉē maṇam nāṟum pūntōṭṭaṅkaḷ uṇṭu. aṅku palāppaḻam, iḷanīr, vāḻaippaḻam, paṉai nuṅku, vaḷḷikkiḻaṅku mutaliyaṉa uṇṇavum parukavum kiṭaikkum.
cila tōppukaḷil pākku maraṅkaḷum teṉṉai maraṅkaḷum aṭarntu kāṇappaṭum. aṅkuḷḷa kuṭimakkaḷ kuṭilukku veḷiyē aṭuppu vaittuc camaippārkaḷ. cōṟṟaiyākkum aṭuppil uḷḷa pāṉai acaintu viḻumpaṭi marattiṉ mītiruntu muṟṟiya periya tēṅkāykaḷ nilattil viḻum. ittakaiya tōppukaḷaiyuṭaiya iṭam pākkam eṉappaṭum.
pērūrkaḷum ciṟṟūrkaḷum
tōppu ūrkaḷukku appāl matil cūḻnta ūrkaḷ āṅkāṅku irukkum. avaṟṟil viṇṇaiyaḷāvum māṭaṅkaḷ viḷakkamuṟṟirukkum. appāl, vaḷḷikkūttaic ciṟappāka āṭum ciṟṟūrkaḷ kāṇappaṭum. (vaḷḷikkūttu eṉpatu, vaḷḷi tirumaṇam paṟṟiya naṭaṉak kaḷiyāṭṭam. itu āṇpāṟkum peṇpāṟkum potuvāy varuvatu).
tiruveḵkā uḷḷa iṭam
mēlē kūṟappaṭṭa ciṟṟūrkaḷukku appāl kāñcikku arukil katiravaṉ oḷikkatirkaḷ uṭpuka iyalāta nerukkamuṭaiya iḷamarac cōlaikaḷ uṇṭu. aṅku ilai nerukkattil kuyilkaḷ nuḻaintu cellum. kurukattikkoṭi (kuṟukiya aṭimarattaiyuṭaiya kāñci marattaic) cūḻntu paṭarum. aṅku maṇal mikuti.ammaṇaṟparappil vaṭṭamāṉa paḷḷaṅkaḷil nīr tēṅkiyirukkum. annīril kurukkatti malarkaḷ viḻuntu kiṭakkum kāṭci - appavaṇikar kariya caṭṭiyil pāluṭaṉē vēṇṭuvaṉa kūṭṭiccērtta appam pālilē kiṭappatu pōṉṟirukkum. (iṅṅaṉam pāl eṉpatu kuḻiyiluḷḷa teḷinta nīrukkum, appam eṉpatu kurukkatti malarukkum uvamaiyākum).
cōlaiyil taṅki nīrāṭip poḻutai iṉpamākak kaḻikka virumpum āṭavarum peṇṭirum paccaik kuppikaḷil uḷḷa kaḷḷaip parukuvar. mātar makaravāy vaṭiviṟceyta talaikkōlattai aṇivar; kuḷirnta pārvaiyuṭaiyavar. āṭavar ammātaruṭaṉ pakaṟpoḻutu viḷaiyāṭi, tuṟakkattai okkum pūmalinīrttuṟaiyil iḷavēṉiṟkālattu iṉpattai nukarvar. aṅku aḻakiya pakkamalaiyil yāṉai kiṭantāṟpōla pāmpaṇaiyākiya paṭukkaiyil perumāḷ paḷḷi koṇṭuḷḷār. (vaḻippōkkarāṉa pāṇar . attirumālai vāḻtti yāḻaic ciṟitu vācittu avviṭattiṉiṉṟu celvar (pe. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 352-392).
pāṇṭi nāṭu
marutanilam
maḻai nīr pala yāṟukaḷākap perukkeṭuttuk kaḻaṉikaḷaiyum maṭukkaḷaiyum poykaikaḷaiyum piṟa nīr nilaikaḷaiyum nirappum. nīr nilaikaḷil tāmaraippū, neytaṟpū, nilappū, āmpaṟpū, mutaliya pūkkaḷ malarntu maṇam parappum. kampuṭkōḻi tāmarai ilaikaḷil uṟaṅkum mīṉ piṭippavar appaṟavaiyiṉ uṟakkam keṭumpaṭi vaḷḷaik koṭikaḷait taḷḷi valai vīci mīṉkaḷaip piṭippar; avaṟṟaik koṉṟu kuvittalāl, ōcaiyeḻum. karumpālaikaḷ vēlai ceyvatāl ōcaiyeḻum. kaḻaṉikaḷil uḻattiyar kaḷaikaḷaip paṟippatil ōcaiyuṇṭākum. mūttu valiyaṟṟa erutu cēṟṟil akappaṭum. kaḷḷuṇṭa maḷḷar ataṉaic cēṟṟiliruntu appuṟappaṭuttum muyaṟciyil ōcaiyeḻum. nellai aṟuvaṭai ceyyum poḻutu tāḷai ariyum ōcai eḻum. tirupparaṅkuṉṟattil (murukaṉukku) viḻā eṭukkum ōcai eḻum. āṟukaḷil putunīr varumpoḻutu kaṇavarum maṉaiviyarum cērntu nīrāṭum ōcai uṇṭākum. pāṇarvīṭukaḷil mīṉkaḷ ularttappaṭum; pāṇar cilar vīṭukaḷil āṭal pāṭal oli eḻum. ivvōcaikaḷ yāvum maruta nilattaiccērntavai (ma. kā. aṭi, 238-270).
mullai nilam
kāṭum kāṭu cūḻnta nilamumākiya mullaiyil tiṉai, eḷḷiḷaṅkāy, varaku mutaliyaṉa payirākum. kāṭṭil nauvi māṉ taṉ piṇaiyōṭē tuḷḷi viḷaiyāṭum. koṉṟai maraniḻalil pāṟai irukkum. paciya payirkaḷ uḷḷa iṭaṅkaḷil mucuṇṭaippūkkaḷum mullai malarkaḷum utirntu parantu kiṭakkum. nīruḷḷa paḷḷaṅkaḷil nīlamaṇi pōṉṟa neytal malarkaḷ toyyiṟkoṭiyōṭu kāṇappaṭum. (ma. kā. aṭi, 271-285).
kuṟiñci nilam
malaināṭṭār mēṭṭu nilattu akil cantaṉam ākiya maraṅkaḷai veṭṭi nilattaip patappaṭuttit tōrai nellai vitaittu aṟuvaṭai ceyvar; aivaṉanel eṉṉum veṇṇaillaiyum payirākki aṟuvaṭai ceyvar; ivaṟṟaiyum iñci mañcaḷ miḷaku mutaliya paṇṭaṅkaḷaiyum kal taraiyil kuvittu vaippar.
ittakaiya malai vaḷam ceṟinta kuṟiñci nilattil tiṉaikkatiraik kotta varum kiḷikaḷai ōṭṭum ōcai orupāl kēṭkum; avaraittaḷirait tiṉṉum āmāvai ōṭṭakkāṉavar ceyyum āravāram orupālkēṭkum. kuṟavaṉāl tōṇṭappaṭṭa mūṭiṉa vāyaiyuṭaiya poyk kuḻiyilē viḻum āṇ paṉṟiyaik koṉṟatāl uṇṭāṉa āravāram maṟṟoru pāl kēṭkum. vēṅkaip pūkkaḷaip paṟikkum kuṟappeṇkaḷ `puli-puli eṉṟu kūṟum āravāram piṟitorupāl kēṭkum. puli paṉṟiyait tākkik kollum ōcai vēṟorupāl kēṭkum. ivvōcaikaḷ ellām nīrōṭum kālkaḷaiyuṭaiya pakka malaikaḷiṟcūḻntu malaiyiṭattē māṟimāṟi olikkum. (ma. kā. aṭi, 281-301).
vēṉiṟkuṉṟam (kōṭai malai)
mūṅkiliṟpiṟanta neruppup paciya tūṟukaḷaic cuṭum. ataṉāl, yāṉaikaḷ avviṭattai viṭṭu akalum. neruppiṉāl tuḷaiyuṇṭa mūṅkilkaḷ kāṟṟuppukuvatāl vācciyakkārar vācciyattai vācittāṟpōṉṟa ōcaiyai uṇṭākkum. malaippiḷavukaḷil ūkampul nirampa vaḷarntirukkum. kukaikaḷil cūṟāvaḷikkāṟṟup pukunta kāṟṟu mikunta kaṭal pōla olikkum. innilaikaḷaiyuṭaiyatu vēṉiṟkuṉṟam.
pālai nilam
nīr vaḷamaṟṟatu pālai nilam. pālai nilamakkaḷ vaḻippaṟiceytu piḻaippavarkaḷ. avarkaḷāl annila vaḻiyē cellum nāṭṭu makkaḷiṉ uṭaimaikkum uyirukkum tīṅku nēriṭum. ātaṉāl, aracaṉ āṟalai kaḷvarālēṟpaṭum tuṉpattaip pōkka nāṭu kāvalarai niyamippatu vaḻakkam. (ma. kā. aṭi, 302-310).
neytal nilam
pāṇṭi nāṭṭu neytal nilam kaṭal vāṇikacciṟappuṭaiyatu. kaṭal kaṭanta nāṭukaṭku muttu, caṅku, palavēṟu paṇṭaṅkaḷ, veḷḷuppu, karumpiṉ vellam kūṭṭip poritta puḷi, mīṉ uṇakkal,pēraṇikalaṅkaḷ ākiyavaṟṟaik kappalkaḷ pāṇṭi nāṭṭiliruntu ēṟṟic cellum. akkappalkaḷ kutiraikaḷai iṅku iṟakkumati ceyyum. ikkaṭal vāṇikattāl nāṭu vaḷam peṟṟirukkum. (ma. kā. aṭi, 315-325).
pāṇṭi nāṭṭil mēlē collappaṭṭa kuṟiñci, pālai, mullai, marutam, neytal eṉṉum aintu kūṟukaḷaiyuṭaiya nilaṅkaḷum uṇṭu. vācciyaṅkaḷ muḻaṅkum tirunāḷ nilaipeṟṟa terukkaḷaiyum, tuṇaṅkaik kūttaiyum kuravaikkūttaiyum maṇam vīcukiṉṟa parattaiyar cēriyaiyum putu varuvāyaiyum uṭaiya akaṉṟa ūril paḻaṅkuṭimakkaḷ neruṅki vāḻvārkaḷ. ittakaiya ūrkaḷ pala pāṇṭi nāṭṭil uṇṭu (ma. kā. aṭi, 326-331).


naṉṉaṉatu malai nāṭu
malaiyaṭivāram
`naṉṉaṉukkuriya malaināṭṭai (cavvātu malait toṭarai)c cērnta aṭivārappakutiyil kollai nilaṅkaḷ mikuti. akkollaikaḷil mucuṇṭaik koṭiyil malarkaḷ vāṉattiluḷḷa kārttikai mīṉ pōla veṇmaiyāka malarum. eḷḷukkāykaḷ uḷḷē ney koḷḷumpaṭi vaḷarum. tammil viḷaiyāṭipporukiṉṟa yāṉaikkaṉṟukaḷiṉ oṉṟōṭu oṉṟu cērnta kaikakaḷaip pōlat tammiṟpiṇaiyum katirkaḷaiyuṭaiya tiṉai muṟṟum. avaraikaḷ muṟṟiṉa tayiriṉatu pitircci pōlum pūkkaḷ utirntu arivāḷaip pōṉṟa vaḷainta kāykaḷaik koḷḷum. varakukaḷ, tarukkam ceyvōṉ kaiyiṭattu iṇainta viralkaḷaiyotta iraṭṭitta katirkaḷ muṟṟum. malarkaḷ mikunta kāṭṭil maḻaiyāl vaḷam peṟṟa mūṅkil nel aval iṭikkum paruvattai aṭaiyum. nilattai uḻāmal kaḷaikkoṭṭāl paṇpaṭuttappaṭṭa nilattil vitaikkappaṭṭa veṇciṟukaṭuku neruṅki viḷaiyum. oruvarāl paṇṇappaṭāta iñcippāvaikaḷ (pommai pōlum kiḻaṅkukaḷ) naṉku vaḷarntu mutirntu uṟaippaik koḷḷum. koḻumai vāynta koṭiyiṉaiyuṭaiya kavalai, valiya peṇyāṉaiyiṉ maṭitta muḻantāḷaiyokkumpaṭi, kuḻikaḷil cemmaiyāy vaḷarntu muṟṟum.
malaiyai vēlkuttutal pōla- malaiccāralil vaḷarntu vāḻaiyiṉ pūkkaḷ malaiyaik kuttiṉāṟpōla vaḷarntirukkum. vāḻaikkāy neruṅkiṉa kulaikaḷ paḻuttuk kaṉiyum. perumūṅkil nel muṟṟip payaṉpaṭattakka nilaiyil irukkum. kālamallāk kālattilum nilacciṟappāl payaṉait tarum maraṅkaḷ payaṉaik koṭukkum. kāṟṟu vīciṉ nāval maraṅkaḷ tammaṭiyilē kiṭakkum pāṟaikaḷiṉ mītu nāvaṟpaḻaṅkaḷai utirkkum. viṭāytta kālattil vāynīr ūṟutaṟkuk kāraṇamāṉa uyavaik koṭinīr tēṭa vēṇṭātapaṭi mikutiyākap paṭarum. kūvaikkiḻaṅkukaḷ poṭiyākum nilaiyil muṟṟittiraḷum. māmpaḻaṅkaḷiṉ cāṟumikuntu uṇpārai vēṟoṉṟiṟ cellavoṭṭāṭal taṭukkum. āciṉip palāppaḻaṅkaḷ veṭittu vitaikaḷai veḷiyiṟcintum. pērāntaikaḷ ciṟupaṟai muḻakkamiṭutal pōla muḻakkamiṭum neṭiya malaippakkattil, mikka maḻaiyaip peṟṟu vaḷam peṟṟa palāmaraṅkaḷil paḻukkum palāppaḻaṅkaḷ vaḻiccellum kūttaruṭaiya mattaḷaṅkaḷ pōlat toṅkit tāḻntirukkum.
vayalkaḷil aivaṉa nellum veṇṇellum pālkaṭṭic ciṟitu muṟṟik kāṟṟum aṭittamaiyāl naṉṟāka viḷaintirukkum. iṉiya kōlākiya karumpu, tōṭu kaviḻtalōṭu taṇṭu tiraṇṭu naṉku vaḷarntu, kāṟṟiṉāṟ cāyntu, karumpālaiyiṟ ceṉṟu payaṉpaṭattakka paruvattil irukkum. neytal, karumaiyē vaṭivu koṇṭāṟpōla malarntirukkum. tīyaiyotta ceṅkāntaḷ malariṉatu mukai maḻaiyāl vaḷamuṟa vaḷarum. paruntu ataṉaic cataiyeṉṟeṇṇi eṭuttuc ceṉṟu, alakāl kīṟippārttuk kīḻē pōṭṭuviṭum. ammalariṉ itaḻkaḷ pāṟaitōṟum cintikkiṭattal veṟiyāṭukaḷattai niṉaivūṭṭum. ittakaiya cūḻnilaiyamainta malaippakkam maṇam ceyta maṉai pōlak kāṭciyaḷikkum. ammalaippakkatil ciṟukuṭi (ciṟṟūr) irukkum. (malaipaṭu. aṭi, 97-151).
ariya vaḻi
malaimītu palarum pōkum paḻakkamāṉa pātaiyum, paḻakkamaṟṟa pātaiyum uṇṭu. paḻakkamaṟṟa pātaiyil nilappiḷavukaḷ kāṇappaṭum. appiḷavukaḷ cilavaṟṟil pāmpukaḷ irukkum. vaḻiccelvōr appāmpukaḷai maṉattāṟkuṟittal ceyvar; koṭiya vilaṅkukaḷ variṉ, marattil ēṟik koḷvar. viṟaliyar pāmpukaḷait toḻuvar; vilaṅkukaḷ kiṭakkum neṟiyai viṭṭu vilaki valappakka vaḻiyai vaḻiyākac ceytukoḷvar. malai mītuḷḷa tiṉaippuṉaṅkaḷai yāṉaikaḷ cūṟaiyāṭum. uyarnta paraṇil uḷḷa kāṉavaṉ, kaiyaik koṭṭik kavaṇ kaṟkaḷai vīcuvāṉ. akkaṟkaḷ paṟavaikaḷ uyiraiyum vilaṅkukaḷ uyiraiyum pōkka vallavai ātaliṉ, yamaṉai oppavai. avai ōcaiyuṭaṉ kuṟitavaṟātu virainta varum. vaḻippōkkar akkaṟkaḷukkut tappa maraṅkaḷiṉ piṉ niṟpārkaḷ.
vaḻiyil kāvaṟkāṭukaḷ irukkum. akkāṭṭaic cūḻnta akaḻiyil yāṉaiyai viḻuṅkum mutalaikaḷ irukkum. oruvar akaḻiyil iṟaṅkutal aritu; akaḻiyiliruntu karaikku ēṟutalum aritu. appātaiyil maraṅkaḷiṟ cuṟṟikkiṭakkiṉṟa koṭikaḷaip paṟṟupkōṭākak koṇṭu kāl vaḻukkalait tavirntu tappa vēṇṭum; oruvarai oruvar pātukāttuc cella vēṇṭum. malaiyarukku aṭarntu vaḷarnta pakkamalaiyil vīḻntōrai maṟaikkum āḻamuṭaiya kuḷaṅkaḷukka arukil pāci paṭarntirukkum. ataṉmītu kāl vaippavar vaḻukki viḻuvar. avvaḻi pōtaṟka arumaiyuṭaiyatu. mēlum tuṇintu celpavar, vaḻi muḻumaiyilum piṉṉi vaḷarnta nuṇṇiya kōlkaḷaiyuṭaiya ciṟumūṅkilōṭu vēḻattiṉ melliya kōlkaḷaiyum paṟṟukkōṭākap piṭittuc cella vēṇṭum.
naviramalai-kāriyuṇṭikkaṭavuḷ
aṅṅaṉam ceṉṟa piṉpu naviramalaiyai aṭaiyalām.aṅkup paḻaiya kōṭṭaiyuṇṭu. tūcip paṭaiyiṉar maḻai pōlap poḻiyum ampukaḷaiyuṭaiyavar. aṅku maṭuvuḷḷa āṟṟaṅkaraiyil ōr ūr uṇṭu. ammalaiyil oru kōvil uṇṭu. akkōvilil kāriyuṇṭikkaṭavuḷ (civaperumāṉ) uḷḷār. aṅku eppoḻutum maḻai peyvatāl kūttar tam icaikkaruvikaḷai uṟaikaḷiliruntu veḷiyē eṭuttu icaikkāmal, iṟaivaṉai vaḻipaṭṭuc cella vēṇṭum. aṅṅaṉam cellukaiyil mayilkaḷ tōkaiyai virittu āṭikkoṇṭirukkum; mūṅkil marakkiḷaikaḷil āṇ kuraṅkukaḷ pāyntu viḷaiyāṭum; tēruruḷ pōlat tēṉ iṟālkaḷ āṅkāṅkuk kāṇappaṭum. vaḻippōkkar ivaṟṟaip pārppiṉ, avar pōkum kuṟukiya pātai tavaṟiviṭum; ātalāl, vaḻimēl viḻi vaittuc cellavēṇṭum (malaipaṭu. aṭi, 193-241).
kāṭṭu vaḻi
aṅṅaṉam cellumvaḻi kāṭṭiṉuḷ celvatu. aṅku uyarnta marakkiḷaikaḷil paraṇ amaittukkoṇṭu kāṉavar kavaṇ kalluṭaṉ iruppar; villaiyum ampaiyum koṇṭiruppar. avaruḷ oruvaṉ eyta ampiṉāl tākkuṇṭa kāṭṭuppaṉṟi, ciṟitu tolaivu ōṭi iṟakkum. atu kiḻaṅkukaḷai akaḻntu tiṉṟamaiyāl ataṉ kompukaḷil aḻukkup paṭintirukkum.
vaḻiyil viḻuntukiṭakkum periya maraṅkaḷai otta malaippāmpukaḷ kiṭakkum. vaḻippōkkar avvaḻiyai viṭṭu vēṟu vaḻiyiṟcella vēṇṭum. mēlum, vaḻiyil āṅkāṅkē neṭuñtolaivu maṇam vīcum malarkaḷum paḻaṅkaḷum kāṇappaṭum. avai teyvaṅkaḷukku uriyavai. avaṟṟai aṇukalākātu. vaḻiyil ālamarattil pala vakaip paṟavaikaḷ kūṭi iṭum ōcai pala icaikkaruvikaḷ icaippatupōla irukkum. attakaiya iṭaṅkaḷai ellām kaṇṭukoṇṭē cellalām.
vaḻiyil maraṅkaḷ aṭarnta kuṟuṅkāṭu uṇṭu. ñāyiṟṟiṉ veḷiccam ataṉkaṇ paṭutal aritu. ticai teriyāmal mayaṅkum irākkālamāyiṉum, villaiyēntic cuḻaṉṟu tiriyum iyalpuṭaiya kuṟavarum mayaṅkum kuṉṟam aṅku uṇṭu. avvaḻiyiṟcellāmal tavirtal vēṇṭum. ucci malaiyiliruntu iṉiya ōcaiyuṭaṉ aruvikaḷ iḻiyum. kāṭukaḷaik kāttu varum kāṉavar ammalaimītu iruppar. avarkaḷ vaḻippōkkariṉ iṭaraittīrkka viraivar; uṇpataṟku iṉiya paḻaṅkaḷaiyum cūṭuvataṟku iṉiya pūkkaḷaiyum kāṭṭuvar; iṭaiyūṟu mikka vaḻikaḷil muṉ naṭantu ceṉṟu vaḻikāṭṭuvar; avarkaḷ mēlum kūṟum vaḻiyai uṭkoṇṭu vaḻippōkkar pōvatu nalam payakkum.
pala vakai ōcaikaḷ
pakkamalaikaḷ putiya vaḻippōkkarkkut talai mayakkattai uṇṭākkum. aṅkuk kuṟiyavum neṭiyavumāṉa kuvaṭukaḷ kāṇappaṭum. avaṟṟil muṟaippaṭi iṟaṅka vēṇṭum; avaṟṟiṉ iṟakkattil malarkaḷ kiṭakkum iṭattil taṅki iḷaip pāṟalām. aṅku iḷaippāṟum pōtu malaippakutikaḷi liruntu pala vakai ōcaikaḷ kēṭkum.
naṉṉaṉatu akaṉṟa iṭattaiyuṭaiya malai, makaḷir āṭutaṟkēṟṟatum muḻavu kaṇṇuṟakkam aṟiyātatum ākiya akaṉṟa ūriṭattiṟkoṇṭa tirunāḷaip pōlac ciṟantirukkum. ittakaiya ciṟappukaḷaiyuṭaiya periya malai vaḻiccellum viṟaliyar, kuṟiñcippaṇṇaip pāṭuvar; kūttar aṅkuṟaiyum teyvaṅkaḷai vēṇṭik koṇṭu mēlum vaḻinaṭappar. (malaipaṭu. aṭi, 242-360)
mēlum malai vaḻi
vaḻiyil maḻaittuḷikaḷ paṭalām. uṭaṉē pāṇar kūttar mutaliya vaḻippōkkar pakkattil uḷḷa malaikkukaikaḷuḷ ceṉṟu otuṅkuvar. vaḻikaḷil nīr tēṅkiya paḷḷaṅkaḷ irukkum. kōlai ūṉṟik koṇṭu paḷḷattil kāl aḻuntātapaṭi viḻippuṭaṉ vaḻi naṭattal vēṇṭum. cila iṭaṅkaḷil kāynta vēl pōlak kūrmaiyum cūṭum poruntiya kaṟkaḷaikkoṇṭa pāṟaikaḷ irukkum. avviṭaṅkaḷil mālai nērattil cella vēṇṭum.
vaḻiyil naṉṉaṉuṭaiya yāṉait tiraḷaiyuṭaiya araṇkaḷ irukkum. avvaraṇkaḷiṟ piṉṉi vaittāṟ pōṉṟa koṭikaḷ neruṅkiya ciṟukāṭukaḷ uṇṭu. acciṟukāṭukaḷil ciṟiya vaḻikaḷ uṇṭu. avvaḻikaḷil irumaruṅkum vaḷarntuḷḷa marakkiḷaikaḷ, vaḻiccelpavar mukattil aṭippaṉapōla vaḻiyai maṟaittuk koṇṭirukkum. avaṟṟai nīkki muṉ celpavaṉaip piṉpaṟṟi ovvoruvarum muṟaiyākac cella vēṇṭum. yāṉaikaḷ tammuṭ cērntu porutāṟpōṉṟa tōṟṟattuṭaṉ pāṟaikaḷ oṉṟōṭoṉṟu piṇaintu kāṇappaṭum. avviṭattup periya kāṭukaḷ uṇṭu. apperiya kāṭukaḷil pakaivaruṭaṉ pōriṭṭu uyir tuṟanta naṉṉaṉuṭaiya vīrarkaṭku naṭappaṭṭa kaṟkaḷ uṇṭu. ovvoru kallilum vīraṉuṭaiya peyarum pukaḻum poṟikkappaṭṭirukkum. avvaḻic cellum kūttarum pāṇarum annaṭukalliṉ teyvaṅkaḷ makiḻa yāḻai vācittup pāṭiccelvar.
cilar vaḻiyaṟiyāmal tavaṟāka naṭattaṟkariya nilattiṟ ceṉṟu mīṇṭu vantu, piṉ varum putiyavarum avvāṟu ceṉṟu mīḷātapaṭi pala vaḻikaḷum kūṭiṉa cantiyaik kaiyāl tuṭaittu aṭaiyāḷamāka ūkampullai muṭintiṭṭu vaippar. vaḻiyil marāmara niḻalil vīrarporuṭṭu naṭappaṭṭa kaṟkaḷ irukkum. naṉṉaṉuṭaṉ poruntāta pakaivar irukkum nilaṅkaḷum mikappalavākum. tattam ūrkaḷiliruntu niṉaippiṉum talai naṭuṅkavikkum curamum aṅku uṇṭu. `tēṉ corikiṉṟa kaṇṇiyiṉaiyum poruḷ koṭuttuk kavinta kaiyaiyum uṭaiya taṉakkeṉṟu oru poruḷum pēṇāta naṉṉaṉaik kāṇac celkiṉṟōm. eṉṟu kūṟum pāṇar mutaliya putiyavarkaḷ, pakaivar ūrkaḷilum naṉmatippaiyum upacarippaiyum peṟuvar. puliyāṟkollappaṭṭa taṉ peṇ mālai niṉaittu varunti āṇ māṉ kūppiṭum. kāṭṭaik kaṭappiṉ mullainilam kāṇappaṭum. (malaipaṭu. aṭi, 361-405).
iṭaiyar kuṭiyiruppukaḷaik kaṭantu maṟunāṭ kālaiyil vaḻi naṭakkumpoḻutu kūriya ampiṉaiyum koṭiya villiṉaiyum uṭaiya nāṭu kākkum vēṭarkaḷ etirppaṭuvārkaḷ; naṉṉaṉiṭam cellataṟkuriya vaḻiyaik kāṭṭuvārkaḷ. putiyavar avvaḻiyē celvatu nallatu.
avvaḻiyil tēṉuṇṭāka malarnta marāviṉ pūṅkottukaḷum yām pūkkaḷum kāṇappaṭum. avaṟṟai ularnta maral nārilē taḷirkaḷōṭu neruṅkak kaṭṭip putiyavar cūṭikkoḷvar; parukkaik kaṟkaḷaiyuṭaiya mēṭṭu nilattil uḷḷa paḷḷaṅkaḷil maḻai nīr taṅkiyirukkum. putiyavarannīraik kuṭittu, vaḻikkup payaṉpaṭa mukantu celvar. ammēṭṭu nilattil cila ūrkaḷ uṇṭu. ovvōr ūrilum pullāl vēynta kuṭilkaḷ irukkum. aṅku uṇṭu uṟaṅkiya putiyavar viṭiyaṟkālattil puḷ nimittam pārttut tam celaviṉai mēṟkoḷvar (malaipaṭu. aṭi, 405-448).
maruta nilam
naṉṉaṉatu kuḷirnta maruta nilattaiyuṭaiya nāṭu, kāñci maraṅkaḷ, melliya viḷainilaṅkaḷ, poḻilkaḷ, paḷḷikaḷ mutaliyavaṟṟaiyuṭaiyatu. annāṭṭu ūrkaḷ kuṭi nīṅkātavai; pāṇar mutaliya muttamiḻ vāṇaraip pala nāḷum pātukākka vallavai.
nellaiyaṟukkum uḻavar, payirkaḷukkiṭaiyē maṟaintuvāḻum paṟavaikaḷai veruṭṭappaṟai muḻakkuvar. avvōcaiyaik kēṭṭa āṇ erumai veruvit taṉ iṉattiṉiṉṟum pirinta vaḻippōkkarmītu pāyum. cēyāṟṟu nīr paḷḷamāṉa iṭattil viḻumpōtu nīril pala kumiḻikaḷ tōṉṟum. avyāṟu oḻiviṉṟi ōṭikkoṇṭirukkum. atu kāṇpavar kaṇṇukku iṉiya kāṭciyai nalkuvatu. `makkaḷ ataṉ oru karaiyai vaḻiyākak koṇṭu ceṉṟu, naṉṉaṉatu talainakarāṉa ceṅkaṇmāvai aṭaivar (malaipaṭu. aṭi, 449-477).
naṉṉaṉatu malai nāṭu
kūttarai āṟṟuppaṭuttum kūttar talaivaṉ mutalil naṉṉaṉ cēy naṉṉaṉatu koṭaic ciṟappaik kūṟukiṟāṉ; piṉpu naṉṉaṉatu malai nāṭṭil ciṟanta kāvalai uṭaiya naviram eṉṉum malaiyaiyum aṅkuk kōyil koṇṭu kāriyuṇṭik kaṭavuḷai (nīlakaṇṭaṉ eṉṉum peyarkoṇṭa civaperumāṉaip) paṟṟiyum kūṟukiṟāṉ; piṉṉar naṉṉaṉuṭaiya muṉṉōr ciṟappaik kuṟikkiṉṟāṉ. ivai aṉaittaiyum muṉṉuraiyākak kūṟiya attalaivaṉ, piṉpu muṟaiyē tarai vaḻiyaiyum malai vaḻiyaiyum kūṟukiṟāṉ; iṟutiyil, `malai vaḻiyē cellumpōtu naṉṉaṉatu malai nāṭṭil tōṉṟi varum cēyāṟu etirppaṭum. ataṉ oru karai vaḻiyē ceṉṟu naṉṉaṉatu talainakarai aṭaika, eṉṟu kūṟukiṟāṉ.


naṉṉaṉatu malai nāṭu etu?
naṉṉaṉatu malai nāṭu etu eṉpatai aṟiya malaipaṭu kaṭāttil iraṇṭē kuṟippukaḷ irukkiṉṟaṉa. oṉṟu, cēyāṟu; maṟṟoṉṟu, naviramalai. cēyāṟu naṉṉaṉuṭaiya malaikaḷil tōṉṟippāyvateṉak kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷatu. `cēyāṟu eṉpatu iṉṟu `ceyyāṟu eṉṟu vaḻaṅkappaṭukiṟatu. atu vaṭavārkkāṭṭu māvaṭṭattiluḷḷa cavvātu malaittoṭariṉ vaṭakkil tōṉṟit teṟku nōkki malaikaḷilēyē pāyntu varuvatu. cēyāṟu cavvātu malaikaḷiliruntu talai vaḻiyē ēṟattāḻa āṟu allatu ēḻukal tolaivil varum vaḻiyil ataṉ teṉ karaiyil ceṅkam (ceṅkammā) eṉṉum ūr amaintuḷḷatu. avvūrc civaṉ kōvilil patiṉoru kalveṭṭukaḷ irukkiṉṟaṉa. avai ki.pi. patiṉōrām nūṟṟāṇṭu mutal patiṉāṟām nūṟṟāṇṭu varaiyil appakutiyai āṇṭu vantu cōḻar, pāṇṭiyar, vicaya nakara maṉṉar kālattuk kalveṭṭukaḷākum. avaṟṟuḷ oru kalveṭṭu naviramalai eṉṉum peyarai mikat teḷivākak kuṟikkiṉṟatu. ataṉaik kīḻē kāṇalām.
`āṭaiyūr nāṭṭu eliyūṟṟukku mēṟkum.... uḷḷiṭṭa nāṭum malaiyum aṭivāramum teṉkarai nāṭu mūvarai veṉṟa nallūrkku mēṟkum ciṟṟiṅkaikkuk kiḻakku uṭpaṭṭa nāṭum malaiyuṭ uṭpaṭṭuṭ nāṭum inta iraṇṭu karai nāṭṭukku uṭpaṭṭa nāṭṭavaruṭ nāṭṭu nāyakañ ceyvārkaḷum maṉṟāṭuvārkaḷum piḷḷai mutalikaḷum (taṉi) yāḷkaḷum paṭai nāyakañ ceyvārkaḷum taṉiyāḷ mutalikaḷum..... kūvic cēvakarum konta viccātirarum naviramalait teṉpaṟṟu nāṭṭavarum nāṭṭu mutalikaḷum vaṭamalai nāṭṭavarum nāṭṭu mutalikaḷum vaṭamalai nāṭṭavarum nāṭṭu mutalikaḷum uḷḷuppaṭṭa pala caṉattōmum aṭivārattu malaiyāḷarum malaiyāḷa mutalikaḷum mutunīr malaiyāḷamum malaiyaraṇ mutalikaḷum ceṭṭikaḷum vāṇikarum kaṇakkarum karumapperumpaṉṉāṭṭavarum paṉṉāṭṭu mutalikaḷum poṟko(ṟṟa) kaikku (kāḷarum āṇ) ṭārkaḷum civappiramāṇarum maṉṟāṭikaḷum uvaccarum teṉkarai nāṭṭu vaṭatalai nāṭṭavarum teṉmalai1 nāṭṭārum uṭpaṭṭa nāṭṭavarum tella ... pulava(ru)m paṇṇuvārum niyāyattārum paṉṉiraṇṭu paṇimakkaḷumuḷḷiṭṭa perum vēṭarum pāṇarum paṟaiyarum paṟai mutalikaḷum cakkiliyarum iruḷarum uḷḷiṭṭa aṉaittuc cātikaḷum.2
malaipaṭukaṭāttukku urai eḻutiya nacciṉārkkiṉiyar avvuraiyiṉ iṟutiyil,
`iraṇiya muṭṭattup peruṅkuṉṟūrp peruṅ kaucikaṉār palkuṉṟak kōṭṭattuc ceṅkaṇmāttu vēḷ naṉṉaṉ cēy naṉṉaṉaip pāṭiya malaipaṭukaṭām eṉṟu kuṟittuḷḷār.
tañcaic cōḻar, maturai nāyakkar eṉṟārpōla, ceṅkaṇmāttu naṉṉaṉ eṉpatil varum `ceṅkaṇmā eṉpatu naṉṉaṉatu talainakaram eṉap poruḷpaṭum. `kaṇmāy eṉpatu `kammāy eṉṟu maruvi vaḻaṅkutal pōlac `ceṅkaṇmā eṉpatu `ceṅkammā eṉṟu kālappōkkil vaḻaṅkalāyiṟṟu eṉpatai aṟiyalām. atu piṉṉum `ceṅkammā eṉṟum, `ceṅkaimā eṉṟum ceṅkam eṉṟum civaṉ kōyil kalveṭṭukaḷil poṟikkap paṭṭuḷḷatu.
``ceṅkamā uṭaiyar tiruiṭavattuṟai
nāyaṉārkkuc ceṅkaimā teṉpiṭākai1
āraṇ vaṭṭattiluḷḷa tēvikāpuram mutal pōḷūr vaṭṭamum ceṅkam vaṭṭamum palkuṉṟak kōṭṭattaic cērnta pakutikaḷ eṉpatait tēvikāpuram kalveṭṭukaḷum2 kalacappākkam kalveṭṭukaḷum3 naviramalaiyai aṭutta paḷḷattākkiluḷḷa vīralūrk kalveṭṭukaḷum4 piṟavum5 uṇarttukiṉṟaṉa.
itukāṟum kūṟappaṭṭa pala vakaic cāṉṟukaḷāl cavvātu malaikaḷ naṉṉaṉatu malai nāṭṭaic cērntavai eṉpatum, ammalait toṭariṉ teṟkil cēyāṟṟiṉ teṉkaraiyil amaintuḷḷa iṉṟaiya ceṅkam allatu ceṅkammā eṉṉum ūrē paḻaiya ceṅkaṇmā eṉpatum, ivaṟṟaic cūḻavuḷḷa nilappakutiyē naṉṉaṉatu nāṭu eṉpatum teḷivātal kāṇka.
cavvātu malaikaḷ
cavvātu malaittoṭar vēlūrukkut teṉmēṟkil ēṟattāḻa ēḻu kal tolaivil toṭaṅkit tirupputtūr vaṭṭattiṉ teṉkiḻakkuk kōṭi varaiyil (ciṅkāram pēṭṭaik kaṇavāy eṉṉum iṭam varaiyil) nāṟpatu kal nīḷam paraviyuḷḷatu; kiḻakku mēṟkil ēṟattāḻap pattukkal nīḷam amaintuḷḷatu. immalait toṭar vēlūr, pōḷūr, ceṅkam, tirupputtūr ākiya nāṉku vaṭṭaṅkaḷil paraviyuḷḷatu. immalait toṭar pala nilaikaḷai uṭaiyatu. ovvoru nilaiyilum malaivāṇar vāḻum cīṟūrkaḷ uḷḷaṉa. cavvātu malaikaḷiṉmītu 138 cīṟūrkaḷ uḷḷaṉa. immalaittoṭaraic cuṟṟilum aṭivārattil cila āṇṭukaḷukku muṉ varai aṭarnta kāṭukaḷ iruntaṉa. kālappōkkil pātaikaḷ amaikkavum ūrkaḷ amaikkavum kāṭukaḷ aḻikkappaṭṭaṉa. āyiṉum, kuṟuṅkāṭukaḷ cila iṉṟum āṅkāṅku irukkiṉṟaṉa. nīṇṭa malaiyaṭivārap pakutiyil āṅkāṅkuc ciṟṟūrkaḷum irukkiṉṟaṉa. avaṟṟuṭ cila, pala nūṟṟāṇṭukaḷāy iruntu varupavai eṉpatu appakutiyiluḷḷa kalveṭṭukaḷāl1 aṟiyappaṭum uṇmaiyākum.
malaivaḻi
paricu peṟṟa kūttaṉ, putiya kūttaṉukku mutalil tarai vaḻiyaik kūṟukiṟāṉ; piṉpu malaimītu cellum vaḻiyaik kūṟukiṟāṉ; aṅkup palarum pōkāta vaḻiyaiyum kuṟippiṭukiṟāṉ. piṉṉar, naviramalaiyil2 irunta tūcip paṭaiyaiyum kōṭṭaiyaiyum kuṟippiṭukiṉṟāṉ;3 aṅku irunta kāriyuṇṭik kaṭavuḷ (civaperumāṉ) kōvilaik kuṟippiṭukiṉṟāṉ; piṉpu malaiyiluḷḷa kāṭṭu vaḻiyaik kuṟikkiṉṟāḷ. avaṉ mēlum malai vaḻiyaik kūṟum poḻutu mullai nilak kōvalar vāḻum ciṟṟūrkaḷaiyum avarkaḷ viruntu pōṟṟutalaiyum viḷakkamākak kūṟukiṉṟāṉ;4 ataṉ piṉṉar marutanilac ceḻumaiyaik kūṟi appakutiyil cellum cēyāṟu eṉṉum āṟṟaik kuṟippiṭukiṉṟāṉ;2 ataṉ oru karaiyai vaḻiyākak koṇṭu ciṟitu tolaivu celliṉ naṉṉaṉatu talainakarai aṭaiyalām eṉṟu vaḻi kūṟi muṭikkiṉṟāṉ.
naṉṉaṉatu malai nāṭṭup paṭattaikkoṇṭu (vaṭa ārkkāṭṭu māvaṭṭap paṭattaik koṇṭu) kūttar talaivaṉ kūṟum vivaraṅkaḷ poruntumāṟṟai ārāyiṉ, ēṟattāḻa oru vaḻiyaik kaṇṭaṟiyalām. avaṉ kuṟippiṭum mutal malaiyē parvatamalai eṉṉum naviramalai. atu mūlaikkāṭṭu malaiyiliruntu vaṭakkilum kiḻakkilum teṟkilum veḷiyē taṉippaṭa amaintuḷḷatu. mēṟkil ataṉ oru ciṟupakuti mūlaikkāṭṭu malaiyuṭaṉ oṭṭikkoṇṭu irukkiṟatu. acciṟu pakuti vaḻiyākavē evarum naviramalaiyiliruntu mēl ticaiyil cavvātu malaikaḷukkup pōtal iyalum.
naviramalaikku vaṭakkil ēṟattāḻa nāṉkukal tolaivil `periya malai irukkiṉṟatu. ataṟku mēṟkil toṭaṅkum mūlaikkāṭṭu malai teṟkāka vaḷaintu piṟaku teṉkiḻakkākat tirumpip parvatamalaiyōṭu poruntiyuḷḷatu. immūlaikkāṭṭu malaikku mēṟkil cēyāṟu varaiyil irukkum malaippakuti teṉmalai eṉṟa peyar peṟum. atil ūrkaḷ pala uṇṭu.
periyamalaikkum parvatamalaikkum iṭaippaṭṭa nilappakutiyil pala ciṟṟūrkaḷ1 irukkiṉṟaṉa; kuṟuṅkāṭukaḷum uṇṭu. muṉpu aṭarnta kāṭukaḷ iruntaṉa eṉṟum piṉpu avai kālappōkkil aḻikkappaṭṭaṉa eṉṟum, avviṭaṅkaḷil putiya ūrkaḷ amaikkappaṭṭaṉa eṉṟum avvūrkaḷil uḷḷa mutiyavar uraikkiṉṟaṉar. iṅṅaṉam ippakutiyil amaintirunta kuṟuṅkāṭukaḷuḷ oṉṟil nam kūttar talaivaṉ kūttar kuḻuvaik kaṇṭirukkalām. kūttarkuḻu, avaṉ coṟpaṭi, aṅkiruntu tarai vaḻiyē pala ūrkaḷaik kaṭantu parvatamalaimītu ēṟik kāriyuṇṭikkaṭavuḷai vaḻipaṭṭu, ammalai mītē mēṟku nōkkic ceṉṟu, mūlaikkāṭṭu malaippakutiyai aṭaintu, piṉpu teṉmalaippakuti ūrkaḷ vaḻiyē ceṉṟu, cēyāṟṟiṉ karaiyai aṭaintirukkalām. piṉṉar ataṉ oru karai vaḻiyē ēṟattāḻap pattukkal tolaivu naṭantu, naṉṉaṉatu kōnakaramāṉa ceṅkaṇmā eṉṉum ūraic cērntirukkalām.2
7. toṇṭai nāṭṭu ūrkaḷ
ciṟṟūrkaḷ
