6. naḷḷi
`naḷḷi pōril ciṟantavaṉ; neṭiya koṭumuṭikaḷaip peṟṟa malai nāṭṭai uṭaiyavaṉ; paricilar nāṭōṟum illaṟam naṭattap poruḷutavi purintavaṉ, eṉṟu naḷḷi eṉṉum vaḷḷalaippaṟṟic ciṟupāṇāṟṟuppaṭai ceppukiṉṟatu (aṭi, 103-107).
pāṭiya pulavar
vaṉparaṇar eṉṟa pulavar ivvaḷḷaliṉmītu pāṭiya mūṉṟu pākkaḷ puṟanāṉūṟṟil iṭam peṟṟuḷḷaṉa. akanāṉūṟṟil paraṇar (152), kapilar (238) eṉṉum pulavar iruvar ivaṉaip pāṭiyuḷḷaṉar. kuṟuntokaiyil kākkai pāṭiṉiyār nacceḷḷaiyār ivvaḷḷalatu mullai nilattaip pāṭiyuḷḷār (210).
naḷḷi nāṭu
maturaikkut teṟkiluḷḷa malai nāṭṭil oru pakuti ivvaḷḷalukku uriyatāy iruntatu eṉṟu koḷḷalām. annāṭṭil naḷḷi eṉṉum peyaruṭaṉ ōr ūr iṉṟum uḷḷatu. ivaṉatu nāṭu `kaṇṭīra nāṭu eṉappaṭṭatu. ataṉāl, ivaṉ `kaṇṭīrakkō eṉappaṭṭāṉ. ivaṉatu nāṭṭu malaittoṭaril aruvikaḷ ōcaiyuṭaṉ kīḻ nōkki vantukoṇṭirukkum. (puṟam. 148).
ivaṉatu nāṭṭu mullai nilattil iṭaiyar ney urukkiṉar. kākkai pāṭiṉiyār nacceḷḷaiyār anta neyyaip pukaḻntu parāṭṭiyuḷḷār (kuṟun. 210). ivaṉatu malaiccarivil cōlaikaḷ mikkiruntaṉa. am malaiccarivil kāntaḷ malarkaḷ piṟa malarkaḷum nalla maṇattai nalkiṉa (akam. 152).
koṭaic ciṟappu
vaṉparaṇar eṉṟa pulavar vaṟumaiyāl vāṭiṉār. avar, tam cuṟṟattuṭaṉ puṟappaṭṭu naḷḷiyiṉ kaṇṭīra nāṭṭil naṭantu ceṉṟār; oru nāḷ vaḻinaṭai varuttattāl oru palāmarattaṭiyil amarntiruntār. appoḻutu naḷḷi akkāṭṭiṟku māṉ vēṭṭaikku vantiruntāṉ. avaṉ kālil kaḻalum talaiyil maṇikaḷ patitta oru nakaiyum aṇin tiruntāṉ. avaṉaik kaṇṭa pulavarum uṭaṉ ceṉṟōrum eḻuntu niṉṟaṉar. avaṉ avarkaḷai irukkumpaṭi kai kavittāṉ; taṉ kaiyilirunta tīkkaṭai kōlāl tī mūṭṭiṉāṉ; attīyil tāṉ vēṭṭaiyil koṉṟa vilaṅkiṉ ūṉai vatakkiṉāṉ; ataṉaip pulavarkkum avaruṭaṉ vantavarkkum vaḻaṅkiṉāṉ. avarkaḷ uṇṭu, malaiccāralil oḻukiya aruvi nīraip paruki ayarvu nīṅkiṉārkaḷ.
`naḷḷi eṉṟa avvaḷḷal, pulavarai nōkki, yām kāṭṭu nāṭṭiṭattēm. empāl vilai matippuṭaiya naṉkalam vēṟu illai, eṉṟu kūṟit taṉ mārpil aṇintirunta muttumālaiyaiyum kaiyil aṇintirunta kaṭakattaiyum koṭuttāṉ. pulavar avaṉatu vaḷḷaṉmaiyai viyantu, aiyaṉē, nīvir yār? namatu nāṭu etu? eṉṟu viṉaviṉār. avaṉ patil collātu ceṉṟu viṭṭāṉ. avvaḻiyil vantōr pēcikkoṇṭē coṟkaḷāl, avaṉ tōṭṭi malai nāṭṭiṟku uriya talaivaṉ naḷḷi eṉpataip pulavar uṇarntār; tām avaṉaik kaṇṭu paricil peṟṟa nikaḻcciyai oru ceyyuḷākap pāṭi makiḻntār (puṟam. 150).
ippulavar perumāṉ naḷḷiyiṉ koṭait taṉmaiyil uḷḷattaip paṟikoṭuttār; naḷḷi, niṉatu taḷarcci illāta valiya muyaṟciyāl ākiya naccappaṭum celvattai yām vāḻttuvōm. nī, nāḷ tōṟum nalla aṇikaḷaiyum kaḷiṟukaḷaiyum niṉṉai nāṭi varum paricilarkku aḷippavaṉ. uṉatu vaḷḷaṉmaiyaik kaṇṭu viyanta ematu nā, piṟarkku vaḻaṅkum perumaiyillāta aracaraip poyyākap pukaḻum puṉmaiyai aṟiyavillai (puṟam. 148).
ippulavar, naḷḷi, nī vāḻvāyāka! kālaiyil marutap paṇṇum mālaiyil cevvaḻippaṇṇum icaittaṟkuriyavai. niṉṉāl utavappaṭṭa pāṇar, inta icai marapai maṟantu, cevvaḻiyaik kālaiyilum marutattai mālaiyilum muṟai piṟaḻntu icaikkiṉṟaṉar. niṉatu koṭaitiṟam avarai ammuṟaimaiyai maṟakkac ceytatu! (puṟam. 149) eṉṟu naḷḷiyiṉ koṭait taṉmaiyaip palapaṭap pārāṭṭi makiḻntār.
naḷḷi iḻaikkappaṭṭa poṉ nakaikaḷaiyum neṭiya tērkaḷaiyum kaḷiṟukaḷaiyum paricilarkku vaḻaṅkupavaṉ eṉṟu kapilar pārāṭṭiyuḷḷār (akam. 238).
`Ú® ah®? eṉṟu vaṉparaṇar kēṭṭa kēḷvikkut tāṉ iṉṉavaṉ eṉṟu collātu ceṉṟa avaṉatu aṭakkamum, yām kāṭṭu nāṭṭiṭattōm; emmāl vilaiyuyarnta aṇikaḷait tara iyalātu, eṉṟu kūṟit tāṉ aṇintirunta aṇaikaḷaik koṭutta avaṉatu taṉṉalamaṟṟa ceykaiyum avaṉai vaḷḷalkaḷ eḻuvaruḷ oruvaṉākkiṉa. apperumakaṉ taṉatu koṭaicciṟappāl pulavar ulakil aḻiyāc ciṟappaip peṟṟāṉ.
vaḷḷalkaḷ eḻuvarkkum piṉ vanta kumaṇaṉaip pāṭiya peruñcittiraṉār, naḷḷi, ācaippaṭṭut taṉṉai niṉaintu varuvāratu vaṟumai tolaiya vaḻaṅkiyavaṉ; taṉ pakaivarait turattiyavaṉ, eṉṟu naḷḷiyiṉ vaṇmaiyaiyum vīrattaiyum pārāṭṭiyuḷḷār (puṟam. 158).
7. ōri
muṉṉurai
ōri eṉpavaṉ curapuṉṉai maraṅkaḷaiyum kuṟiya maraṅkaḷaiyum koṇṭa nalla nāṭukaḷaik kūttarkku vaḻaṅkiyavaṉ; kāri eṉṟa kutiraiyaiyuṭaiya kāriyuṭaṉ ōri eṉṟa kutiraiyaik koṇṭu malaintavaṉ. itu ōriyaip paṟṟic ciṟupāṇāṟṟuppaṭai kūṟum ceytiyākum (aṭi, 107-111).
ikkūṟṟaikkoṇṭu ivaṉ enta nāṭṭai āṇṭu vantāṉ eṉpatum, ivaṉuṭaiya koṭaittaṉmaiyum vīramum piṟavum aṟiyak kūṭavillai. āyiṉ, ivaṉ iyalpukaḷaip paṟṟik kaḻaitiṉ yāṉaiyār (puṟam.204), vaṉparaṇar (puṟam. 152, 153) eṉpavar pāṭiyuḷḷaṉar. ivaṉaip paṟṟiya kuṟippukaḷ akanāṉūṟu naṟṟiṇai, kuṟuntokaip pāṭalkaḷil (paraṇar, kapilar, pālattaṉār, kallāṭaṉār eṉpavar pāṭalkaḷ) kāṇappaṭukiṉṟaṉa. ivai aṉaittaiyum koṇṭu ivaṉatu varalāṟṟai iṅkuk kāṇpōm.
ōri
ivaṉ ātaṉ ōri (puṟam.153) eṉṟum, valvil ōri (puṟam. 152) eṉṟum peyar peṟṟavaṉ. ivaṉ eyta ampu mutalil yāṉaiyaik koṉṟu vīḻttiyatu; piṉpu puliyaik koṉṟatu; piṟaku puḷḷimāṉ kalaiyai maṭiyac ceytatu; ataṉ piṉṉar āṇ paṉṟiyai vīḻttiyatu; ataṟku appāl uṭumpiṉ uṭaliṟceṉṟu taittatu. iṅṅaṉam orē ampil pala uyirkaḷai vīḻttum āṟṟal peṟṟa ivaṉ, `valvil ōri eṉap paṭṭāṉ (puṟam. 152). ipperumakaṉ pacumpoṉṉāṟ ceyta aṇiyiṉaiyum vaḷainta kaṭakam amainta muṉ kaiyiṉaiyum uṭaiyavaṉ; pōriṟpaṭṭavaṉ (puṟam. 153). ivaṉuṭaiya vīrar `maḻavar eṉappaṭṭaṉar (naṟṟiṇai, 52).
kolli malai nāṭu
naḷḷi eṉṟa vaḷḷalaip pāṭiya vaṉparaṇar eṉṟa pulavar perumāṉ, ōri kolli malai nāṭṭut talaivaṉ eṉṟu kūṟiyuḷḷār. (puṟam. 152). kolli malai eṉpatu tiruccirāppaḷḷi māvaṭṭattiṟkum cēlam māvaṭṭattiṟkum ellaiyāy amaintuḷḷa niṇṭa malaittoṭarākum. itu, pala vaḷaṅkaḷum niṟainta malaittoṭar. immalait toṭariliruntu aruvikaḷ pāynta vaṇṇamirukkum. malai nāṭṭār malai nellai vitaittup payirākkuvar; vayalkaḷiṟ kaḷaiyāy muḷaitta malai mallikaiyōṭu paciya maralaik kaḷaintu eṟivar. avarkaḷ ciṟṟūrkaḷil, kāntaḷē iyaṟkai vēliyāy amaintirukkum. acciṟṟūrkaḷil irukkum makkaḷ uṇavillāta pōtu yāṉaiyiṉ kompai viṟṟu uṇavup poruḷkaḷai vāṅki uṇpārkaḷ. avar nāṭṭuk kollai malaiyiṉ mēṟpakkattil kaṇṇaiyum karuttaiyum kavarum pāvai oṉṟu amaintiruntatu (kuṟun. 100) eṉṟu kapilar kūṟiyuḷḷār. pulavarkaḷ taṅkaḷ ceyyuḷukkuriya talaimakaḷaik `kollip pāvai pōṉṟa talaimakaḷ eṉṟu varuṇippatu akkāla vaḻakkam. ōriyiṉ nāṭṭil peruṅkāṭu oṉṟu iruntatu. akkāṭṭil malar maṇam mikkiruntatu. ataṉāl, akkāṭṭu vaḻiyē vīciya kāṟṟu, maṇikkiṉṟa kūntalaiyuṭaiya talaivi eṉṟu paraṇar pāṭiyuḷḷār (kuṟun. 199).
ōriyiṉ kolli malaiyil mayilkaḷ cerukkuṭaṉ tiriyum (naṟṟiṇai, 265). ōrikku uriya kāṭṭil kumiḻa maraṅkaḷ mikuti. avaṟṟiṉ vaḷainta mūkkiṉaiyuṭaiya muṟṟiṉa kaṉikaḷ kīḻē viḻuntu kiṭakkum. avai iḷamāṉkaḷukku nalla uṇavākum eṉṟu paraṇar pakarntuḷḷār (naṟ. 6). kolli malai nāṭṭil palā maraṅkaḷ mikuti. ammalai nāṭṭil kār kālattup pūkkum malar, mikka maṇattai uṭaiyatu eṉṟu paraṇar oru ceyyuḷil (akam. 208) kūṟiyuḷḷār.
koṭaic ciṟappu
vaṉparaṇar, viṟali mutaliyōr ōriyaik kaṇṭu pāṭi āṭiṉ, apperumakaṉ tāṉ vēṭṭaiyāṭiya māṉiṉ iṟaicciyaiyum neyyai urukkiṉāṟpōṉṟa matuvaiyum taruvāṉ; taṉ malaiyil piṟanta poṉṉaip pala maṇikaḷōṭu kalantu taruvāṉ (puṟam. 152); paṭṭam mutalākiya pūṇkaḷai aṇinta yāṉaikaḷai irappōrkku vaḻaṅkuvāṉ; veḷḷi nārāl toṭukkappaṭṭa poṉṉari mālaiyaiyum piṟa aṇikaḷaiyum vaḻaṅkuvāṉ (puṟam. 153), eṉṟu vēṉ koṭaittaṉmaiyaip pārāṭṭiyuḷḷar.
kaḻai tiṉ yāṉaiyār eṉṟa pulavar, vāṉattil miṉ mutalāya tokutiyaiyuṭaiya maḻaiyaip pōla yāvarkkum eppōtum varaiyātu vaḻaṅkum vaṇmaiyai yuṭaiyavaṉ ōri, eṉṟu pārāṭṭiyuḷḷār (puṟam. 204). paraṇar, ōri, maḻai pōṉṟa koṭaiyaiyuṭaiyava;ṉaṉ, eṉṟu pukaḻntuḷḷār (naṟṟiṇai, 261).
poruḷ vaḻippiriyum talaimakaṉ piritaṟku uḷḷam eḻāṉāyt taṉ neñcai nōkki, neñcamē, koṭiya pōr ceyya valla pōr vīrar talaivaṉākiya ciṟanta koṭaiyaiyuṭaiya ōri eṉpavaṉatu kai vaṇmaikkup poruntiya celvamē nī īṭṭum poruḷāka niṉaikkuk kiṭaippatāyiṉum, apporuḷ talaiviyiṉ muyakkattiṉai viṭac ciṟantataṉṟu, eṉṟu kūṟiyatākap pālattaṉār kuṟittuḷḷār (naṟṟiṇai, 52).
ōriyiṉ iṟuti
muḷḷūr malaiyamāṉāṉa kāri eṉpavaṉ, cēramāṉ viruppattiṉpaṭi īkaittaṉmaiyāl mikka pukaḻai nilai nāṭṭiya valvil ōriyaip pōril koṉṟāṉ; avaṉatu kollimalai nāṭṭaic cēramāṉukku urimaiyāk kiṉāṉ. itu kallāṭaṉār kūṟṟu (akam. 209). iṅṅaṉam ōriyaik koṉṟa kāri, avaṉatu talai nakaril pukuntavuṭaṉ annakarattār avaṉai etirttup pēriraiccaliṭṭaṉar eṉṟu kapilar kūṟiyuḷḷār (naṟṟiṇai, 230).
vaḷḷalkaḷ eḻuvarukkum piṉ vanta kumaṇaṉaip pāṭiya peruñcittiraṉār eṉṟa paintamiḻppulavar, uyarnta ucciyaiyuṭaiya kollimalai nāṭṭai āṇṭa valiya villaiyuṭaiya ōri eṉṟu ūriyaip paṟṟik kūṟiyuḷḷār (puṟam. 158).
kolli malaittoṭarkku ēṟattāḻap pattukkal tolaivil cēlam māvaṭṭattiluḷḷa irācipuram eṉṉum ūril vicuvanātar kōvil uḷḷatu. akkōvilil valvil ōriyiṉ uruvaccilai niṟuttap paṭṭuḷḷatu. accilaiyiṉ kaiyil nīṇṭa periya vil kāṇappaṭukiṟatu. accilai caṅkakāla valvil ōriyai iṉṟum niṉaivuṟuttikoṇṭu niṟkiṉṟatu.
maḻavar perumakaṉāṉa ōri maṟaiyiṉum, avaṉ marapiṉar toṭarntu kolli malai nāṭṭai āṇṭu vantaṉar. ivarkaḷaip paṟṟi `maḻavar eṉṉum pakutiyil virittuk kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷatu. āṇṭuk kāṇka.
18. araciyal
1. araciyal
araṇmaṉai
nāṭṭaiyum nāṭṭiluḷḷa kuṭikaḷaiyum kāttu vantavaṉ kāvalaṉ eṉap peyar peṟṟāṉ. avaṉ vāḻnta maṉai pātukāval mikkatāy iruntatu. ataṉāl, aḵtu araṇmaṉai eṉappaṭṭatu. cilappatikāram araṇmaṉaiyaik `kōvil eṉṟē kuṟittuḷḷatu. kaṭavuḷ maṉaikkum kōvil eṉpatē peyar. maṉṉaṉaik kaṭavuṭ kūṟāka matitta caṅkakālac camutāyam, avaṉatu illattaiyum `kōvil eṉṟē vaḻaṅkiyatil viyapvillai.
maṉṉaṉatu araṇmaṉai paranta nilattil māṭamāḷikaikaḷōṭum kūṭakōpuraṅkaḷōṭum kaṭṭappaṭṭa mikap periya illamākum. araṇmaṉaiyil eḻunilai māṭam amaintiruttalum uṇṭu (mullaip pāṭṭu, aṭi 86). araṇmaṉai vāyil kōvil vāyilaip pōla uyarntum akaṉṟum iruntatu. yāṉai taṉmītu oru koṭiyai uyarttikkoṇṭu avvāyilil eḷitil nuḻaiyalām. araṇmaṉai pala maṉaikaḷaiyum vāyilkaḷaiyum maṇṭapaṅkaḷaiyum peṟṟiruntatu. nilā muṟṟaṅkaḷaik koṇṭa uyarnta māṭaṅkaḷ iruntaṉa. araṇmaṉai muṟṟattil kavari māṉkaḷum aṉṉappaṟavaikaḷum tāvit tirintaṉa. aracaṉukku eṉṟu taṉai maṉaiyum aracikku eṉṟu taṉi maṉaiyum amaintiruntaṉa. araci vāḻnta pakuti `antappuram eṉappaṭṭatu. aḵtu āṭavarkaḷ pukaviyalāta ariya kāvalai uṭaiyatu. araṇmaṉaic cuvarkaḷil pala ōviyaṅkaḷ tīṭṭappaṭṭiruntaṉa. aracamātēvi paṭukkum kaṭṭiliṉ ciṟappu neṭunalvāṭaiyil mikat teḷivākak kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷatu (neṭunalvāṭai, aṭi, 78-114).
pāṇṭimātēviyiṉ kaṭṭil tantattālākiyatu; ciṟanta vēlaippāṭu koṇṭatu. ataṉ mēṟkūrai ōviyaṅkaḷ eḻutappaṭṭatu. aṉṉap peṭaiyiṉ tūvi koṇṭu amaikkappaṭṭa mettaiyum talaiyaṇaikaḷum akkaṭṭilil iruntaṉa. ammettai mītu kañciyiṭṭuc calavai ceyyappeṟṟa tukil virikkappaṭṭiruntatu. ataṉmītu ceṅkaḻunīr malariṉ itaḻkaḷ parappappaṭṭiruntaṉa (neṭunal. aṭi, 117-135).
araca makaḷir anti nērattil viḷaṅkum kiraṇaṅkaḷiṉ iḷaveyil tōṉṟiṉāṟpōṉṟa niṟattai uṭaiyavar; mayil pōṉṟa cāyaliṉaiyum māntaḷir pōṉṟa mēṉiyaiyum uṭaiyavar; ciṟanta kaṟpuṭaiyavar; kal patitta nakaikaḷai aṇintavar; neruppup pōlum itaḻkaḷai uṭaiyavar; tāmarai pōṉṟa oḷiyuṭaiya mukattiṉaiyuṭaiyavar; iṉiya coṟkaḷaiyuṭaiyavar (ma. kā. aṭi, 702-712).
kālaiyil aracaṉ ceyalkaḷ
vaikaṟaiyil araṇmaṉaiyuḷ muracu olikkam. atu `paḷḷiyeḻucci muracam eṉappaṭum. appōtu cūtar niṉṟu aracaṉai vāḻttuvar; mākatar eṉpavar iruntu aracaṉ pukaḻaic colluvar; vaitāḷikar eṉpavar icaikkaruviḷai iyakkuvar; nāḻikaik kaṇakkar nērattai aṟivippar (ma. kā. 670-672).
aracaṉuṭaiya meykāppāḷar `perumūtāḷar eṉappaṭṭaṉar. avarkaḷ caṭṭai aṇintiruntaṉar; ciṟanta oḻukkamuṭaiyavar (mu. pā. 53-54). aracaṉukku utavi ceyyap paṇippeṇṭir palar iruntaṉar. avarkaḷ ciṟanta aḻakikaḷ; niṟainta nakaikaḷai aṇintavar; tam pāṭṭālum collālum kūttālum aracaṉai makiḻvippavar. avarkaḷ maṉṉaṉukkum avaṉ ēvaṟpaṭi pulavar pāṇar mutaliyōrkkum poṟkiṇṇaṅkaḷil matuvai vārttut taruvatu vaḻakkam (po. ā. paṭai, 84-87), (ma. kā. 779-81).
pāṇṭiyaṉ neṭuñceḻiyaṉ kālaiyil eḻuntu nīrāṭit taṉ vaḻipaṭu teyvattai vaṇaṅkiṉāṉ. appoḻutu avaṉuṭaiya mukattil paṇpaṭṭa ōviyaṉāl tīṭṭap peṟṟa pāvaiyiṭattē kāṇappaṭum kaḷai kāṇappaṭṭatu. avaṉ taṉ uṭampil cantaṉattaip pūcik koṇṭāṉ. avaṉatu mārpil muttu mālaiyum aṉṟalarnta pūmālaiyum viḷaṅkiṉa. avaṉatu tōḷil vīravaḷai viḷakkamuṟṟatu; kai viralkaḷil maṇikaḷ aḻuttiṉa mōtiraṅkaḷ iruntaṉa. avai taṉ iṭaiyil kañciyiṭṭuc calavai ceyyappaṭṭa tukilai uṭuttiruntāṉ. uṭaikku mēl cila aṇikaḷ polivu peṟṟu viḷaṅkiṉa. avaṉ kālil vīrakkaḻal aṇi ceytatu (ma. kā. aṭi, 715-722).
aimperuṅkuḻu
aracaṉukku āṭciyil utavi puriyum kuḻukkaḷuḷ ciṟappuṭaiyatu `aimperuṅkuḻu eṉpatu. amaiccar, purōkitar (ācāṉ), paṭaittalaivar, tūtuvar, cāraṇar eṉpavarē aimperuṅkuḻuviṉar eṉṟu cilappatikārattiṟku urai vakutta aṭiyārkku nallār kūṟiyuḷḷār. mācaṉam, pirōkitar, maruttavar, kaṇiyar, amaiccar eṉpavar aimperuṅkuḻuviṉar eṉṟu cilappatikāra arum patavuraiyāciriyar kūṟiyuḷḷār. ivaruḷ `mācaṉam eṉpatu kuṭimakkaḷāl terinteṭukkappaṭṭa piratinitikaḷaik kuṟippatu. ivarkaḷ kuṭikaḷiṉ nalaṉkaḷaiyum tēvaikaḷaiyum aracaṉiṭam eṭuttuk kūṟip pātukākkap payaṉpaṭṭārkaḷ; nāṭṭil camayat toṭarpāṉa ceyalkaḷaip purōkitar kavaṉittaṉar. ivarkaḷaic `camayap piratinitikaḷ eṉṟum kūṟulām. maruttuvar nāṭṭuc cukātārattaik kavaṉittu vantaṉar. kaṇiyar nāṭṭil naṭaipeṟa vēṇṭiya nalla ceyalkaḷait toṭaṅkuvataṟkuriya nāḷaiyum nērattaiyum kuṟikkavum, varuvatu uraikkavum payaṉpaṭṭaṉar. nāṭṭiṉ varuvāyaiyum, aracāṅkac celavaiyum, nīti muṟaiyaiyum amaiccar kavaṉittaṉar.1 avarkaḷ ekkālamum meyyaiyē pēcuvatāl pukaḻ vāyntavarkaḷ; talaimai amainta kāvitippaṭṭam1 aracaṉāl vaḻaṅkappaṭṭavarkaḷ (ma. kā. aṭi, 19, 20, 499).
eṇpērāyam
karaṇattiyalavar, karumavitikaḷ, kaṉakaccuṟṟam, kaṭai kāppāḷar, nakaramāntar, paṭaittalaivar, yāṉai vīrar, ivuḷi maṟavar eṉpavar eṇpērāyat tārāvar.2 ivaruḷ 1. kāraṇat tiyalavar-aracāṅkap peruṅkaṇakkar; 2. karumavitikaḷ-aracāṅka vēlaikaḷai naṭattum talaivarkaḷ; 3. kaṉakaccuṟṟam-aracāṅkap poruṭkāppu atikārikaḷ; 4. kaṭai kāppāḷar-nāṭu kākkum atikārikaḷ; 5. nakaramāntar-nāṭṭil irunta pala nakaraṅkaḷiṉ piratinitikaḷ; 6.paṭaittalaivar-kālāṭ paṭaittalaivar; 7.yāṉai vīrar-yāṉaippaṭaittalaivar; 8. ivuḷi maṟavar-kutiraip paṭaittalaivar.
maṉṉaṉ aimperuṅkuḻuviṉaraiyum eṇpērāyat tāraiyum kalantē āṭci purintāṉ. ipperumakkaḷ naṟkuṭip piṟappu, kalvi, nalloḻukkam, uṇmaiyuṭaimai, tūyavuḷḷam, naṭuvu nilaimai mutaliya naṟpaṇpukaḷ peṟṟiruttal vēṇṭum eṉṟu maṉṉar etirpārttaṉar; nāṭṭup peruviḻākkaḷilum nāṭṭup peruñceyalkaḷilum ikkuḻuviṉar paṅku koṇṭaṉar eṉpatu cilappatikāram-intira viḻavūreṭutta kātaiyāl aṟiyalām.
nāḷōlakkam
aracaṉatu kolu maṇṭapam `nāḷōlakkamaṇṭapam eṉappaṭum. aracaṉ ovvoru nāḷum ammaṇṭapattiliruntu araciyaṟceytikaḷaik kavaṉippatu vaḻakkam. aṅku avaṉukku utaviyāka aimperuṅkuḻuviṉar, eṇ pērāyattiṉar, maṇṭila mākkaḷ mutaliyōr kūṭiyiruppar. maṉṉaṉ pala mīṉkaḷukku iṭaiyil viḷaṅkum mati pōla avarkaṭku iṭaiyil viḷaṅkuvāṉ. aṅṅaṉam iruntu pōril veṟṟi peṟṟa taṉ vīrarkaḷukkup paṭṭamum1 paricilum nalkuvāṉ; tam pulamaiyaik kāṭṭip paricil peṟa vanta pulavar, pāṇar, kūttar mutaliyōrkkum paricil vaḻaṅkuvāṉ; piṉpu taṉ amaiccar kaḷuṭaṉ aracāṅkattiṉ naṭaimuṟaikaḷaik kavaṉippāṉ (ma. kā. aṭi, 725-778). kōtai eṉṉum cēra aracaṉatu nāḷōlakka iruppil ellāk kalaikaḷaiyum uṇarnta cīriyōr tiraṇṭu avaṉ kēṭpat tarukkaṅkaḷaik kūṟikkoṇṭiruntaṉar. (maturai antik kaṭait teruviṉ āravāram mēlē kūṟappaṭṭa cēraṉatu amaikkaḷa āravārattai ottiruntatu eṉṟu māṅku marutaṉār kūṟiyuḷḷār. ma. kā. aṭi, 511-526). naṉṉaṉatu avaikkaḷattil tām kaṟṟavai nāviṉiṭattē payiṉṟa nalla aṟiviṉaiyuṭaiyōr tiraṇṭiruntaṉar.2 (malaippaṭu. aṭi, 77-80); aracaṉiṭam nālvakaip paṭaikaḷ iruntaṉa. kutiraikaḷaip paṟṟiya nūl iruntatu. annūlil vallavarum iruntaṉar (pe. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 487-9).
aṟavuraiyum aṟivuraiyum
ācāṉ eṉpavaṉ irājakuru. avaṉ purōkitaṉ eṉṟu kūṟappaṭṭāṉ. avaṉ ciṟanta nūlkaḷiluḷḷa aṟavuraikaḷaiyum,  eṭuttukkūṟi maṉṉaṉai nalvaḻippaṭuttupavaṉ. nāṭṭil pukaḻ peṟṟa pulavarkaḷum aracaṉukku aṟivuraikaḷ kūṟutal vaḻakkam. pāṇṭiyaṉ neṭuñceḻiyaṉukku avaṉatu avaikkaḷat talaimaip pulavarāṉa māṅkuṭi marutaṉār eṉpavar aṟakkaḷa vēḷvi ceytu nalam peṟumpaṭi aṟivurai kūṟiyatai maturaik kāñciyāl aṟiyalām. (ma. kā. aṭi, 759-781).
aracāṭci
caṅka kālattil ovvōr ūrilum potumakkaḷāl tērnteṭukkappaṭṭa periyōr iruntu ūrāṭciyaik kavaṉittu vantaṉar. nāṭṭiṉ talai nakaril periya nītimaṉṟam iruntatu. aḵtu `aṟakkaḷam eṉṟum `aṟaṅkūṟu avaiyam eṉṟum peyar peṟṟatu. cila vaḻakkukaḷai maṉṉaṉē vicārittu nīti vaḻaṅkuvatum uṇṭu. iḷaiñaṉāṉa karikālaṉ mutiyavaṉaip pōla vēṭam pūṇṭu nīti vaḻaṅkiṉāṉ eṉṟu porunarāṟṟuppaṭai pēcukiṟatu (aṭi, 187-8). kāñciyai āṇṭa iḷantiraiyaṉ taṉ mantirac cuṟṟattōṭē iruntu muṟai vēṇṭiyavarkku muṟaiyum, makkaḷ kuṟaikaḷai vicārittu vēṇṭiyaṉavum ceytāṉ eṉṟu perumpāṇāṟṟup paṭai pakarkiṉṟatu (aṭi, 443-450). maturaiyil irunta aṟaṅkūṟu avaiyattār accam, tuṉpam, avā ākiyavaṟṟai nīkkiyavar; oru cārāriṭam ciṉamum maṟṟoru cārāriṭam makiḻvum kāṭṭātavar; tammait tulākkōlaip pōla naṭuvu nilaiyilē niṟuttikkoṇṭavar uyarnta koḷkai uṭaiyavar (ma. kā. aṭi, 489-492).
iḷantiraiyaṉ āṭciyil toṇṭai nāṭṭup peru vaḻikaḷ vīrarkaḷāl kākkappaṭṭaṉa. tuṟaimuka nakarattil iṟakkumatiyāṉa poruḷkaḷ vāṇikattiṉ poruṭṭuk koṇṭu cellappaṭṭa vaḻikaḷ pātukākkappaṭṭaṉa. karaiyōrattil āyattuṟaikaḷ iruntaṉa. cila iṭaṅkaḷil vīrarkaḷ araṇamaittukkoṇṭu vāḻntārkaḷ. anta araṇukkuḷ pōrkkaruvikaḷ iruntaṉa. vēṭṭai nāykaḷ iruntaṉa (pe. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 70-82; 117-129). tiraiyaṉ āṭciyil toṇṭai nāṭṭil vaḻip pōvāraik kollum āṟalaikaḷvar illai; iṭi iṭiyātu; pāmpukaḷum kollutalaic ceyyā. kāṭṭil vāḻum puli mutaliyaṉavum tuṉpam ceyyā; ātalāl, nīṅkaḷ niṉaitta iṭattē iḷaippāṟik kavalaiyiṉṟic cellalām, eṉṟu paricil peṟṟa perumpāṇaṉ vaṟiya pāṇaṉiṭam kūṟiyatu, tiraiyaṉatu aṟam malinta āṭcikkuc ciṟanta eṭuttukkāṭṭākum (pe. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 39-45). avaṉ aṟattiṟku māṟāṉavaṟṟai nīkkupavaṉ; aṟam purikiṉṟa ceṅkōlaṉ; nītimuṟai vēṇṭi varuvōraiyum, tam kuṟaiyaip pōkkikkoḷḷa virumpi varuvōraiyum varavēṟpāṉ; iṉcol kūṟuvāṉ; avarkaḷ vēṇṭuvaṉavaṟṟai vēṇṭiyavāṟē koṭuppāṉ; naṭuvu nilaiyil iruntu uṇmaiyaik kaṇṭaṟiyum kuṟṟamaṟṟa nuṇṇaṟivu uṭaiyavaṉ (pe. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 443-7).
iṅṅaṉamē pāṇṭi nāṭṭilum pālainila makkaḷāṉa āṟalaikaḷvarāl kuṭimakkaḷukkut tīṅku nērātapaṭi nāṭu kāval vīrarkaḷ amarttappaṭṭirun tārkaḷ. (ma. kā. aṭi, 310-312). avvīrarkaḷ vilnēntiyavarkaḷāy nāṭṭu vaḻikaḷaik kāval kāttārkaḷ. ivvāṟē naṉṉaṉatu malai nāṭṭai āṅkāṅku irunta vēṭarkaḷ kāttu vantārkaḷ. avarkaḷ koṭiya villaiyum kūriya ampukaḷaiyum koṇṭiruntārkaḷ. ammakkaḷ vaḻippōkkarkku vēṇṭiya vacatikaḷaic ceytārkaḷ (malai. aṭi, 421-427).
aracaṉatu ceṅkōlāṭciyiṉkīḻ avaṉiṭam paṇi purintavar nērmaiyāyp paṇi purintaṉar. karikālaṉ āṭciyil kāvirippūmpaṭṭiṉattuc cuṅka atikārikaḷ iravilum pakalilum cōmpaliṉṟit taṅkaḷ kaṭamaikaḷaic ceytu vantārkaḷ. (pa. pālai, aṭi, 120-125). karikālaṉ āṭciyil cōḻanāṭṭil puli mutaliya koṭiya vilaṅkukaḷiṉ tuṉpam uṇṭē tavirak kuṭikaḷaik kalaṅkac ceyyum pakai vēṟu illai (pa. pālai, aṭi, 26, 28). `ivaṉ taṉatu iḷamaipparuvattaikkoṇṭu muṟai vaḻaṅka māṭuvaṉō!  eṉṟu aiyuṟṟa mutiyavar iravarait tāṉ mutiya nītipati pōla vēṭam puṉaintu vaḻakkaik kēṭṭu uvakkac ceytavaṉ karikālaṉ eṉṟu porunakarāṟṟuppaṭai pukalkiṉṟatu (aṭi, 187-8). iṅṅaṉam avaṉ nīti vaḻaṅkiya ciṟappiṉaip piṟkālattil tōṉṟiya paḻamoḻip pāṭalum kīḻ varumāṟu pārāṭṭukiṉṟatu.
	uraimuṭivu kāṇāṉ iḷamaiyōṉ eṉṟa
naraimutu makkaḷ uvappa-naraimuṭittuc
collāl muṟaiceytāṉ cōḻaṉ kulaviccai
kallāmal pākam paṭum.
aracaṉ pakaivarai veṉṟu avar tiṟaiyākat tanta nakaikaḷaip pulavarkku vaḻaṅkiṉāṉ (malai. aṭi, 70-72) nalliyakkōṭaṉ taṉ paṭaittalaivarkaḷ koṇṭu vanta pakaivar nāṭṭup poruḷkaḷait taṉṉiṭam vanta ēḻai kaṭkum pāṇar mutaliyōrkkum vaḻaṅkiṉāṉ (ci. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 248-249). karikālaṉ pulavarkkup piṉ ēḻaṭi naṭantu ceṉṟu avarkku viṭai tarutal marapu (po. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 166).
pāṇṭiyaṉ neṭuñceḻiyaṉ oru poyyālē amiḻtuṭaṉ tēvar ulakam kiṭaippatāyiṉum poy pēcātavaṉ; ulaka maṉṉavaruṭaṉ tēvarkaḷ cērntu pōrukku variṉum, pakaivarkku añcip paṇiyātavaṉ; teṉṟicaiyil malaikaḷ niṟaiyumpaṭi vāṇaṉ eṉṟa cūraṉ vaitta cīriya poruṭkuviyalē kiṭaippatāyiṉum, piṟar kūṟum paḻiyai veṟuppavaṉ; vaṟiyarkkup poruḷai utavum neñciṉaṉ (ma. ka. aṭi, 197-205). ipperumakaṉ āṭci ceṅkōlāṭciyaṉṟō? māṅkuṭi marutaṉār neṭuñceḻiyaṉukku muṉpu āṇṭa pāṇṭiya maṉṉar eṅṅaṉam nāṭāṇṭaṉar eṉpatai araciyal nuṇṇaṟivōṭu kūṟiyuḷḷatu pārāṭṭattakum. ataṉaik kīḻē kāṇka.
pāṇṭi nāṭṭil maḻaivaḷam mikkiruntatu; yāṟukaḷ iṭaiyaṟātu nīrperukkeṭuttu oḻukiya vaṇṇam iruntaṉa. āṅkāṅkup pūmpoḻilkaḷum iḷamarak kākkaḷum ceḻittōṅkik kāṭci iṉpam nalkiṉa; uyirkaḷ paciyum piṇiyum iṉṟi uṭaluram peṟṟu eḻiluṭaṉ viḷaṅkiṉa. avar āṭciyil vāḻnta makkaḷ taṅkaḷ vāḻkkaikku oru kuṟaivaiyum kāṇātavarkaḷ; poy, kaḷavu mutaliya tīyavaṟṟai aṟiyātavarkaḷāy vāḻntārkaḷ. apperumakkaḷ āṇṭa ūḻi nallūḻi ākum. avvaḻiyil vāḻnta makkaḷ naṉmakkaḷ. ivaṟṟuk kellām kāraṇamāy amainta pāṇṭiya maṉṉar uyarntōr āvar (ma. kā. aṭi, 5-23).
oru nāṭṭiṉ ceḻippum kuṭimakkaḷiṉ nalvāḻvumē aracaṉatu ceṅkōṟciṟappai uṇarttum aṭaiyāḷaṅkaḷākum  eṉpatē māṅkuṭi marutaṉāratu araciyaṟ paṭṭaṟivu kaṇṭa uṇmaiyākum.
ōviyam, ciṟpam, icai, naṭaṉam, nāṭakam eṉpavai `nuṇkalaikaḷ eṉappaṭum. ivaṟṟōṭu ilakkiyakkalai neruṅkiya toṭarpuṭaiyatu. avaṟṟil vallavar pulavar; icaikkalaiyil vallavar paraṇar; naṭaṉak kalaiyilum nāṭakak kalaiyilum vallavar kūttar. ikkalaivāṇar vaṟumai iṉṟi vāḻntāltāṉ nāṭṭil ilakkiyam mutaliya kalaikaḷ vāḻum. kalaikaḷ nāṭṭu makkaḷai iṉpuṟutti naṟpaṇpukaḷai vaḷarppavai; nākarikattaiyum paṇpāṭṭaiyum vaḷarppavai. eṉavē, kalaivāṇar kavalaiyiṉṟi vāḻntāltāṉ nāṭṭumakkaḷ nallaṟivu peṟṟu vāḻtal iyalum. tamiḻp pēraracarum ciṟṟaracarum ivvuṇmaiyai naṉku uṇarntavar ātaliṉ, kalaivāṇarai mukamalarcciyuṭaṉ varavēṟṟu vēṇṭum utavikaḷaip purintaṉar. ivvivaraṅkaḷai aṭuttuk kāṇpōm:
2. pōr
pattuppāṭṭuḷ mullaippāṭṭu, maturaikkāñci, paṭṭiṉappālai eṉṉum mūṉṟu pāṭṭukaḷilētāṉ pōr paṟṟiya ceytikaḷ mikutiyāyuḷḷaṉa. ēṉaiyavaṟṟil pōraippaṟṟiya cila kuṟippukaḷē uḷḷaṉa.


eyiṉar araṇ
toṇṭaimāṉ tiraiyaṉatu āṭcikku uṭpaṭṭa toṇṭai nāṭṭil eyiṉaratu araṇ ciṟappuk kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷatu. pālai nilattil eyiṉar (vēṭṭuvar) vāḻntaṉar. avarkaḷ kuṭiyiruppukku appāl eyiṉar araṇ iruntatu. ataṉuḷ vīṭukaḷ iruntaṉa. avaṟṟil pakaivaraik kuttikkutti muṉai maḻuṅkiṉa vēlkaḷ paḻutu pārkkappaṭṭu varicaiyāyp palakaikaḷiṟceruki vaikkappaṭṭiruntaṉa; viṟkaḷ cārtti vaikkappaṭṭiruntaṉa. ampaṟāttūṇikaḷil ampukaḷ vaikkappaṭṭiruntaṉa. avvillaṅkaḷukku etiril oru pantal iruntatu. atil ampum kaṭṭukaḷum kaṭiya ōcaiyai uṇṭākkum `tuṭi eṉṟa icaikkaruvikaḷum vaikkap paṭṭiruntaṉa. illaṅkaḷaik kākkak kāval illam oṉṟu iruntatu. avvillattut tūṇkaḷil vēṭṭai nāykaḷ caṅkilikaḷāl piṇaikkappaṭṭiruntaṉa. ittuṇai illaṅkaḷaiyum cuṟṟi muḷvēli amaikkappaṭṭiruntatu. ataṉaic cuṟṟilum kāvaṟkāṭu iruntatu. eyiṉar araṇukku amainta vāyil kaṇaiya marattai uṭaiyatu; vāyil nilai cevvitu. vāyiliṉ muṉpuṟam neṭiya kūriya kaḻukkaḷ varicaiyāka niṟuttappaṭṭiruntaṉa (pe. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 117-128).
viricci kēṭṭal
vēntaṉ oruvaṉ maṟṟoru vēntaṉ nāṭṭiṉmītu paṭaiyeṭukkak karutiṉ, mutaṟkaṇ pakaivar nāṭṭu āṉiraiyaik kavarat taṉ paṭaittalaivarai ēvuvāṉ; avarkaḷ ēvalāl, naṟcol kēṭṭaṟkuriyavar ceṉṟu oru pākkattil taṅkit tam aracaṟku mēl varum ākkattai aṟiya naṟcol (viricci) kēṭpar. avarkaḷ kātil viḻuvatu naṟcollāyiṉ, uṭaṉē āṉiraiyaik kavarum muyaṟci mēṟkoḷḷappaṭum. naṟcol kēṭpataṟkuriyavar ūrai aṭutta pākkattuk kōvilil teyvattiṉ muṉṉilaiyil mullai malarkaḷaiyum neṉ maṇikaḷaiyum kalantu tūvip paṇintuniṟpar. appoḻutu akkōvilaiyaṭutta toḻuvattil irunta kaṉṟukaḷai nōkki āymakaḷ orutti, uṅkaḷ tāymār iṉṉē varukuvar, eṉṟu kūṟuvaḷ (mullaippāṭṭu, aṭi, 8-14).
pācaṟai amaittal
oru nāṭṭiṉ mītu pōr toṭukkac cellum aracaṉ tāṉum taṉ paṭaikaḷum taṅkiyirukkat taṉ nāṭṭu ellaip puṟattil pācaṟai amaittal iyalpu. caṅka kālattiṟ pācaṟai eppaṭi amaikkappaṭṭatu eṉpatu mullaippāṭṭil kīḻ varumāṟu kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷatu.
kāṭṭāṟu cūḻnta akaṉṟa neṭiya kāṭṭil irunta paciya tūṟukaḷ veṭṭappaṭṭaṉa; pakaippulattukkuk kāvalāy irunta vēṭṭuvaruṭaiya ciṟiya vāyilkaḷaiyuṭaiya araṇkaḷ aḻikkappaṭṭaṉa; kaṭal pōlap paranta avviṭattil muḷḷāl āṉa vēliyaik kāvaluṟumpaṭi vaḷaittup pōṭappaṭṭatu. vīrarkaḷ irukkat taḻaikkūraiyuṭaiya illaṅkaḷ amaikkappaṭṭaṉa; pala terukkaḷ amaintaṉa. nāṟcantiyāṉa muṟṟattil kāvalāka yāṉaikaḷ niṟuttappaṭṭaṉa. paṭait talaivarkaṭkuk kūṭāraṅkaḷ amaikkappaṭṭaṉa. avaṟṟil viṟkaḷaic cōvūṉṟi eṟikōlkaḷaiyum ūṉṟik kiṭukukaḷaiyum niraiyākak kutti araṇ amaikkappaṭṭatu. nīṇṭa kuttukkōlkaḷ varicaiyāka naṭappaṭṭaṉa. avaṟṟaic cuṟṟi matil tirai vaḷaittuk kaṭṭappaṭṭatu. illattuc cuvart tuṇiyil puli caṅkiliyāl piṇaikkappaṭṭataik kuṟittum ōviyam tīṭṭappaṭṭiruntatu. anta illattiṉuṟ puṟavaṟaiyum uḷḷaṟaiyum amaikkappaṭṭaṉa. uḷḷaṟaiyil aracaṉ tuyila vacati ceyyappaṭṭatu (mullaippāṭṭu, aṭi, 24-44).
pācaṟaiyil paruntum paṟakka muṭiyāta uyarcciyaiyuṭaiya araṇkaḷ irukkum. anta araṇil iruntu cēymaikkaṇ varum pakaivaraik kāṇalām. pācaṟaiyil kālaiyil paḷḷiyeḻucci muracam muḻaṅkum (maturaikkāñci, aṭi, 231).
iravil pācaṟai
aracaṉatu illattaic caṭṭaiyiṭṭa meykāppāḷar kāvalākac cūḻntu niṉṟaṉar. kuṟuntoṭiyaiyum kūntal acaintu kiṭakkiṉṟa aḻakiṉaiyu muṭaiya maṅkaiyar oḷivīcum vāḷai iṭuppiṟcerukiyiruntaṉar. avarkaḷ iravil viḷakkukaḷukku eṇṇey vārttuk koṇṭum avinta viḷakkukaḷai ēṟṟikkoṇṭum cuṟu cuṟuppāy iruntārkaḷ. nāḻikai vaṭṭilaik koṇṭu nāḻikaiyaik kaṇakkiṭum makkaḷ iravu muḻumaiyum uṟaṅkāmal paṇi purintārkaḷ. maṉṉaṉ uḷḷaṟaiyaic cuṟṟilum caṭṭaiyiṭṭa yavaṉa ūmaikaḷ kāval purintārkaḷ.
pakalil naṭaipeṟṟa pōril puṇpaṭṭuk kaḷaitta yāṉaikaḷ karumpaiyum neṟkatir iṭaiyē neruṅkappaṭṭuk kaṭṭippōkaṭṭa cāviyaiyum atimaturattaḻaiyaiyum tiṉṉātu avaṟṟāl tam neṟṟiyait tuṭaittuk koṇṭaṉa. yāṉaip pēccāṉa vaṭamoḻikaḷaik kaṟṟa pākar, palakāṟ collik kavaḷattait tiṉṉumpaṭi kavaitta muḷḷaiyuṭaiya parikkōlāl kuttiṉar.
maṉṉaṉ pōraippaṟṟiya niṉaivāl uṟakkam varāmal tavittāṉ; vāḷ veṭṭup paṭṭu varuntum kaḷiṟukaḷai eṇṇi varuntiṉāṉ; tiṟampaṭap pōriṭṭut taṅkaḷ ceñcōṟṟuk kaṭaṉaik kaḻittu iṟanta vīrarkaḷai eṇṇiṉāṉ; puṇpaṭṭa uṭampuṭaṉ pul uṇṇātu tavitta kutiraikaḷai niṉaintāṉ; oru kaiyaip paṭukkaiyiṉmītu vaittuk kaṭakam aṇinta oru kaiyai muṭiyōṭē cēravaittu, maṟunāṭpōraip paṟṟi eṇṇalāṉāṉ (mullaippāṭṭu, aṭi, 45-76).
paṭaiyeṭuppu
aracaṉ pakaivar nāṭṭaik kaippaṟṟa allatu pakaiyaracaṉatu valimaiyai oṭukka avaṉatu nāṭṭiṉmītu paṭaiyeṭuppāṉ. paṭaittalaivar, vañci mālai cūṭik kaḷḷuṇṭu mārpil cantaṉam pūcip pōrukku eḻuvar. atikamāṉ koṅku nāṭṭuc ciṟṟaracaṉ. avaṉ muṭimaṉṉaṉ allaṉ. aṅṅaṉamiruntum, avaṉiṭam kaṭal pōṉṟa paṭai iruntatu (ci. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 102-103) eṉiṉ, karikālaṉ neṭuñceḻiyaṉ pōṉṟa muṭimaṉṉariṭam peruṅkaṭal pōṉṟa tāṉai iruntatu eṉak kōṭalē poruttamākum. paṭaiyeṭukkum aracaṉ malaikaḷaiyum kāṭukaḷaiyum kaṭappāṉ; taṉ paṭaikaḷuṭaṉ ceṉṟu pakaivar araṇkaḷaik kavarvāṉ; uḷnāṭukaḷiṟ pukuvāṉ; maḻaiyōṭē māṟupaṭa ampukaḷait tūvip pōr purivāṉ. avaṉ kutiraikaḷ ōṭum vicaiyāl tukaḷkaḷai eḻuppum; caṅkam muḻaṅkum; kompu olikkum; pōr muracam muḻaṅkum; pakaivar tam perumai keṭumpaṭi kollappaṭuvar (maturaikkāñci, aṭi, 147-149, 180-185). pōr puriyum virar (tumpaip pōrāyiṉ) poṉṉāṟ ceyyappaṭṭa tumpaippūvaic cūṭuvar; vēl, vil, vāḷ, ampukaḷaik koṇṭu pōrāṭuvar. appaṭaik karuvikaḷil koṟṟavai iruppatāka vīrar nampiṉar (ci. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 102-103).1 pōr kaṭumaiyāy naṭaipeṟiṉ, pakaivar tākkutalukku āṟṟāta paṭai piṉ cariyum. appoḻutu accarinta paṭaiyait tāṅki vīraṉ oruvaṉ kallaṇaipōla niṉṟu pakaivarait tākkuvāṉ. ammuyaṟciyil avaṉ veṟṟi peṟiṉ, aracaṉ avaṉukku ēṉāti eṉṟa paṭṭam vaḻaṅkuvāṉ; `ēṉāti mōtiram eṉṟa peyaruṭaiya mōtirattaiyum aṇivippāṉ (ma. kā. aṭi, 719-740, urai viḷakkam).
muṉṉaṇippaṭai tūci eṉappaṭum; aṇi eṉpatu piṉṉaṇippaṭai; kūḻai-piṉ paṭai (puṟam. 88).
vēntar mayirkkaṇ muracaip peṟṟiruntaṉar. puliyaip porutu koṉṟu niṉṟu cilaittuk kōṭṭu maṇ koṇṭa erutu iṟantatum ataṉ tōlai mayil cīvāmal pōrtta murucu `mayirkkaṇ muracu eṉappaṭṭatu (ma. kā. aṭi, 732-3).
kōṭṭaiyai muṟṟukaiyiṭum vīrar uḻiñaippū mālaiyai aṇivar; yāṉaikaḷai ēvik kōṭṭaik katavukaḷai uṭaikkac ceyvar. yāṉaikaḷ taṅkaḷ kompu kaḷāṟkuttik katavai uṭaikkum (pa. pālai, aṭi, 228-231).
pōrkkaḷak kāṭci
pāṇṭiyaṉ neṭuñceḻiyaṉ cēra cōḻaraiyum aimperuvēḷiraiyum taṉ nālvakaip paṭaikaḷuṭaṉ pōrkkaḷattil cantikkiṟāṉ. avaṉuṭaiya yāṉaikaḷ kaṇṭōr `ivai malaikaḷō! eṉṟu maruḷutaṟkuk kāraṇamāṉa pēruṭal paṭaittavai. avai aṇi vakuttu niṟkiṉṟaṉa. avaṟṟiṉ mukattil aṇiyappaṭṭa poṉṉāl iyaṉṟa neṟṟippaṭṭaṅkaḷ paḷapaḷaveṉṟu miṉṉukiṉṟaṉa. avai tam etirē pakaippaṭai varutalaik kaṇṭatum ciṉam koḷkiṉṟaṉa. avaṟṟiṉ viḻikaḷiliruntu neruppu veḷippaṭukiṟatu. pākar avaṟṟaip pōrttoḻilil ēvukiṉṟaṉar. uṭaṉē avai pakaip paṭaiyuḷ pukuntu pōr puriyat toṭaṅkukiṉṟaṉa.
maṟṟoru pakkam pōr puriyum puravikaḷ viraintu pāykiṉṟaṉa. avaṟṟiṉ iyakkattāl eḻunta tukaḷ vāṉam muḻumaiyum paravi iruḷ cūḻacceykiṉṟatu. aḵtāvatu, ñāyiṟṟu maṇṭilam tukaḷkaḷāl maṟaikkappaṭukiṟatu.
vēṟoru pakkam, tērkaḷ tam urutteriyātapaṭi viraintu cuḻalkiṉṟaṉa. avaṟṟai iḻukkum kutiraikaḷ tāvittāvip pāykiṉṟaṉa. itaṉāl cūṟaikkāṟṟu aṭippaṭu pōṉṟa tōṟṟam pōrkkaḷattiṉ oru pakutiyil kāṇappaṭukiṉṟatu.
vēṟoru pakkam kālāṭpaṭaiyiṉar kaṭumpōr purikiṉṟaṉar; tam tōḷ valiyāl pakaivar paṭaiyaic citaṟaṭikkiṉṟaṉar; muṭivil veṟṟi muḻakkam ceykiṉṟaṉar 
(ma. kā. aṭi, 43-56).
paṭaiyeṭuppiṉ payaṉ
paṭaiyeṭuppavaṉ, tēvaippaṭiṉ, pakaivar ūrkaḷaiyum payirkaḷaiyum nīr nilaikaḷaiyum aḻippāṉ;1 `nāṭu eṉṟa peyaraiyiḻantu `kāṭu eṉṉum peyaraip peṟumāṟu ceyvāṉ. acceyalāl pacukkaḷ taṅkiyirunta iṭaṅkaḷil pulikaḷ mutaliyaṉa taṅkum; ūrāyirunta iṭaṅkaḷ pāḻāykkiṭakkum. cāṉṟōrkaḷ irunta ampalaṅkaḷ pēykaḷ vāḻiṭamākum. ūrkaḷ aḻitalāl ūrār uṇaviṉṟit tuṉpuṟuvar. avartam uṟaviṉar tam ūrkaḷiliruntu ceṉṟu avarkaṭkup pātu kāvalāka amaivar. periya māḷikaikaḷil irunta neṟ kutirkaḷ ventu aḻiyum. avviṭaṅkaḷil kūkaic cēval pēṭṭuṭaṉ iruntu kuḻaṟum. kuḷaṅkaḷil nīr eṭuppāriṉmaiyāl, yāṉai niṉṟāl maṟaiyum aḷaviṟku vāṭkōraiyum caṇpaṅkōraiyum neruṅki vaḷarum. pakaivarāl aḻikkappaṭṭa vayalkaḷil peṇ paṉṟikaḷuṭaṉ āṇpaṉṟikaḷ ōṭittiriyum (ma. kā. aṭi, 150-180, 225-258).
paṭṭiṉappālaiyil karikālaṉatu paṭaiyeṭuppāl naṭai peṟṟa aḻivukaḷ kīḻ varumāṟu kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa:
karumpum cennellum vaḷarntu kuvaḷaiyum neytalum malarntu viḷaṅkiya marutanilam, iṭamakaṉṟa poykai kaḷaiyuṭaiyatu. karikālaṉatu paṭaiyeṭuppu ammaruta nilakkuṭikaḷai ōṭṭiyatu. paṭaiyeṭuppāl ceykaḷum vāvikaḷum nīraṟṟaṉa. avaṟṟil aṟukum kōraikaḷum vaḷarntaṉa. makaḷir nīruṇṇum tuṟaiyiṟ ceṉṟu muḻukik kantu niṟuttappaṭṭuḷḷa ampalattai meḻuki, antikkālattil viḷakkēṟṟuvar. (avvampalattil irunta kantiṉaik karikālaṉ yāṉaikaḷ cāyttu viṭṭaṉa. avai avvampalattilēyē taṅkiviṭṭaṉa). maṉṟattil viḻā naṭaipeṟum. yāḻ mutaliya icaik karuvikaḷ icaikkappaṭum. karikālaṉ paṭaiyeṭuppāl ūr viḻā naṭaipeṟavillai; maṉṟattil accam kuṭikoṇ ṭiruntatu. talai vāyil, māṭam, aṭukkaḷai mutaliyavaṟṟaik koṇṭa periya vīṭukaḷ makkaḷiṉṟi iruntaṉa. avvīṭukaḷ cāntiṭṭa cuvarkaḷaiyuṭaiyavai. avvīṭṭut tiṇṇaikaḷil kiḷikkūṇṭukaḷ iruntaṉa. paṭaiyeṭuppāl avvillaṅkaḷ pāḻpaṭṭaṉa. aṅkuk kūkaikaḷum āṇṭalaip puṭkaḷum alaṟik koṇṭiruntaṉa. āṇ pēykaḷuṭaṉ peṇ pēykaḷ alaintu koṇṭiruntaṉa. periya maṉaikaḷil neṟkūṭukaḷ niṟaiya nel iruntatu. paṭaiyeṭuppil akkūṭukaḷ koḷḷai yiṭappaṭṭaṉa. vaṟuviya akkūṭukaḷiṉ uḷḷiruntu kūkaikaḷ alaṟiṉa. karikālaṉ pakaivaruṭaiya matilkaḷai aḻittāṉ; paṭai vīṭukaḷai aḻittāṉ; ūrkaḷaip pāḻākkiṉāṉ (pa. pālai, aṭi, 239-270). pōril pakaivaruṭaiya maṉaiviyaraiyum ēṉaiya makaḷiraiyum piṭittu vantu paṇi makaḷirākkik koḷḷutal paṇṭai marapu; ammakaḷir nīruṇṇum tuṟaiyilē ceṉṟu muḻuki ampalattai meḻukuvar; aṅku viḷakkiṉai ēṟṟuvar (pa. pālai, aṭi, 241-9).
pāṇṭiyaṉ neṭuñceḻiyaṉ pakaivar nāṭṭiṉmītu paṭaiyeṭuttuc ceṉṟu, avartam kāvalaiyuṭaiya poḻilkaḷai aḻittāṉ; ekkālattum vaḷam kuṉṟāta maruta nilaṅkaḷai neruppuṇṇac ceytāṉ; nāṭu eṉṉum peyar maṟaintu kāṭu eṉṉum peyar peṟacceytāṉ; ataṉāl, āṭu māṭukaḷ taṅkiyirunta iṭaṅkaḷil puli mutaliya koṭiya vilaṅkukaḷ taṅkalāyiṉa; ūrāy irunta iṭaṅkaḷ pāḻāyiṉa; annāṭṭu makaḷir tuṇaṅkaik kūttiṉaiyum kuravaik kūttiṉaiyum maṟantaṉar; cāṉṟōr irunta periya avaikaḷil pēy makaḷir āṭi ulāviṉar; illuṟai teyvaṅkaḷ ulāvi akaṉṟa ūril vīṭṭu vāyilil iruntu peṇṭir varunti aḻutaṉar; avar tam uṟaviṉar irunta vēṟṟu nāṭukaṭṭuc ceṉṟaṉar; periya māḷikaikaḷ ventu vīḻntaṉa; ammāḷikaiyil irunta karinta kutirkaḷil āntaikaḷ iruntu alaṟiṉa; ceṅkaḻunīr irunta poykaikaḷil yāṉaiyai maṟaikkum vāṭkōraiyum caṇpaṅkōraiyum neruṅki vaḷarntaṉa; erutukaḷ uḻuta vayalkaḷil paṉṟikaḷ ōṭittirintaṉa. iṅṅaṉam, neṭuñceḻiyaṉ paṭaiyeṭuppāl pakaivar nāṭukaḷ pāḻāyiṉa (ma. kā. aṭi, 152-176).
toṇṭaimāṉ iḷantiraiyaṉ veḷḷiya kompiṉaiyuṭaiya kariya yāṉaip piṇattaik kurutiyākiya āṟu iḻuttukkoṇṭu pōkumpaṭi porutavaṉ; turiyōtaṉaṉ mutaliya nūṟṟuvarum kaḷattilēyē iṟakkumpaṭi periya pōrai veṉṟa tarumaṉ mutaliyōraippōla, eṇṇil aṭaṅkāta paṭaiyuṭaṉē kōpittut taṉmēl vanta pakaivarai veṉṟavaṉ; avveṟṟik kaḷippiṉāl āravāram ceytavaṉ; taṉṉuṭaṉ pōriṭṭavar kaḷiṉ nāṭṭu ūr maṉṟaṅkaḷ pāḻākumpaṭi aḻittavaṉ; taṉakku aṭaṅki naṭantavar nāṭṭai vaḷamākkiyavaṉ (pe. ā. paṭai, 414-425). iḷantiraiyaṉ, ciṅkakkuruḷai yāṉai mītu pāyntu ataṉ mattakattaik koḷḷa virumpiṉāṟpōlap pakaivariṉ kāvalaiyuṭaiya matilai aḻittu aṅku irunta aracaruṭaiya muṭikkalam mutaliyavaṟṟai vāṅki vīramuṭi puṉaiyum iyalpu paṭaittavaṉ; ammatilaracaṉ cantu ceytaṟku uṭaṉpaṭṭālum, taṉ uṭaṉpaṭātavaṉ (pa. pālai, aṭi, 448-454).
naṭukal
pōril viḻuppuṇ paṭṭu iṟanta vīrarkkuk kal eṭuttu viḻāc ceytal marapu. atuvē tamiḻakattuḷ ciṟappuṟṟa vīrar vaṇakkamāy iruntateṉpatu tolkāppiyar virivākak kūṟalāl naṉku viḷaṅkum. 1.kaṟkāṇṭal, 2.kālkōḷ, 3.kallai nīrppaṭuttal, 4.kallai naṭutal, 5.vīraṉ peyar ceyal mutaliyavaṟṟaik kalliṉmītu poṟittal, 6 kāl koṇṭa teyvattiṟkuc ciṟappuc ceytu vāḻttal eṉa ikkal eṭuppu viḻā āṟuvakaippaṭum eṉpar tolkāppiyar.1 naṭukallaip pīliyālum malarālum aṇi ceytu, palliyam olikka viḻavu ceytal tamiḻar marapu. iṅṅaṉam nāṭṭappaṭum kalliṟkuk kōvilum matilum vāyilum ēṉaic ciṟappukaḷum ceytalum paḻantamiḻar marapu. itaṉaic ceṅkuṭṭuvaṉ kaṇṇakikkuk kōyil eṭuttataṉaik koṇṭu viḷakkamāka aṟiyalām.
iṅṅaṉam vīrarkkuk kal naṭṭamai-naṭṭu vaḻipaṭṭamai paṇṭaittamiḻ ilakkiyaṅkaḷil palaviṭattum parakkak kāṇalām.
oru nāṭṭiṉmēl paṭaiyeṭukka virumpum aracaṉ mutalil taṉ vīrarai ēvip pakaivaruṭaiya kālnaṭaikaḷaik kavarvāṉ. itu veṭcittiṇai eṉappaṭum. immuyaṟciyil īṭupaṭṭavar veṭci malarkaḷaic cūṭuvar. im muyaṟciyai etirttu niṟpatu `karantaittiṇai eṉappaṭum. avarkaḷ karantai malarkaḷaic cūṭikkoḷvārkaḷ. piṉpu annāṭṭiṉ mītu paṭaiyeṭuppu naṭaipeṟum. atu `vañcittiṇai eṉappaṭum. appayeṭuppai etirttu niṟl `kāñcittiṇai eṉappaṭum. kōṭṭaiyai muṟṟukaiyiṭal `uḻiñait tiṇai eṉappaṭum. kōṭṭaiyuḷ iruntu etirttal `noccittiṇai eṉappaṭum. kōṭṭaikkappāl veṭṭaveḷiyil naṭaipeṟum kaṭumpōr `tumpaittiṇai eṉappaṭum. pōril veṟṟi peṟutal `vākaittiṇai eṉappaṭum. ovvoru tiṇaicceyalilum īṭupaṭṭa vīrarkaḷ avvat tiṇaikkuriya malarkaḷai aṇintukoḷḷutal marapu.
ippōrkaḷil tam vīrattaikkāṭṭic ciṟanta vīrar pārāṭṭukkuriyavarāvar. oru paṭai citaṟi ōṭukiṉṟatu. uṭaṉē oru vīraṉ tōṉṟi appaṭaikku muṉ niṉṟu, pakaivarait tākki alaikkaḻittu, iṟutiyil pakaivar tākkutalāl maṭikiṟāṉ. ittakaiya vīrattai avaṉaic cērnta aracaṉum maṟṟa vīrarum pārāṭṭuvar. avaṉ iṟanta iṭattil allatu avaṉ uṭalai eritta iṭattil avaṉatu vīrattiṟku aṟikuṟiyāka oru kallai naṭuvar. akkallil avaṉatu uruvam poṟikkappaṭum. avvuvattiṉ kīḻ avaṉ peyarum vīracciṟappum kuṟikkappaṭum. iṅṅaṉam naṭappeṟum kal, muṉpu kūṟiyapaṭi naṉku tērnteṭukkappaṭṭum, nīrāṭṭappaṭṭum irukkum. akkalliṉmītu mayiṟpīli cūṭṭappaṭum. kal naṭappaṭṭa aṉṟu akkallaic cuṟṟilum mēlē tuṇippantal amaikkappaṭum.
	uyaricai veṟuppat tōṉṟiya peyarē
maṭañcāl maññai aṇimayir cūṭṭi
iṭampiṟar koḷḷāc ciṟuvaḻip
paṭañcey pantark kaṉmicai yatuvē
eṉpatu puṟanāṉūṟu (ce. 260).
naṉṉaṉatu malai nāṭṭil ittakaiya naṭukaṟkaḷ iraṇṭu iṭaṅkaḷil iruntaṉa. akkaṟkaḷiṉmītu iṟanta vīrar peyarkaḷum pīṭum poṟikkap paṭṭiruntaṉa. avaṟṟuṭcila, marāmaraṅkaḷiṉ niḻalilē naṭappaṭṭiruntaṉa. avvaḻic ceṉṟa kūttar viṟaliyar mutaliyōr tam yāḻai vācittu, anneṭukaṟkaḷil uṟainta teyvaṅkaḷai vaḻipaṭṭuc ceṉṟaṉar (malaipaṭukaṭām, aṭi, 386-396).
3. aracar vaḷḷaṉmai
muṉṉurai
tamiḻakattai āṇṭu vanta cēra cōḻa pāṇṭiyar eṉṟa muṭipuṭai mūvēntarum pāri, kāri, atikaṉ pōṉṟa ciṟṟaracarum paḻutta maraṅkaḷai nāṭic cellum paṟavaikaḷaip pōlat tammai nāṭi vanta iyaṟṟamiḻil valla pulavaraiyum, icaittamiḻil valla pāṇaraiyum, nāṭakattamiḻil valla kūttaraiyum malarnta mukattuṭaṉ varavēṟṟaṉar; arukiliruntu uṇavu aruntiṉar; uyarnta āṭaikaḷai vaḻaṅkiṉar; araṇmaṉaiyilēyē pala nāḷ irukkac ceytaṉar; iṟutiyil vēṇṭiya paricilai nalki viṭaiyaḷittaṉar.
iṅṅaṉam maṉṉarāl matippuppeṟṟa pulavar perumakkaḷ avarkaḷaip pārāṭṭip pāṭiya pāṭalkaḷ pala. avaṟṟuṭcila, puṟanāṉūṟṟilum patiṟṟuppattilum iṭam peṟṟuḷḷaṉa. nūṟu aṭikaḷukku mēṟpaṭṭa neṭum pāṭalkaḷ cila, pattuppāṭṭuḷ iṭam peṟṟuḷḷaṉa. karikālaṉai viyantu pāṭiya porunar āṟṟuppaṭai, paṭṭiṉappālai, nalliyakkōṭaṉai viyantu pāṭiya ciṟu pāṇāṟṟuppaṭai, toṇṭaimāṉ iḷantirai yaṉaip pārāṭṭip pāṭiya perumpāṇāṟṟuppaṭai, neṭuñceḻiyaṉaip pārāṭṭip pāṭiya maturaik kāñci, naṉṉaṉaip pōṟṟip pāṭiya kūttarāṟṟuppaṭai eṉpaṉa, aracar muttamiḻvāṇarai varavēṟṟu upacaritta muṟaiṟai naṉku pulappaṭuttavaṉavākum. iṉi ivaṟṟuḷ ovvoṉṟaiyum taṉittaṉiyē kāṇpōm:
karikālaṉ upacarippu
porunar eṉpavar, taṭāri eṉṉum icaikkaruvi koṭṭip pāṭum icaivāṇar. avaruḷ oruvaṉ taṉ vaṟumaiyaip pōkka viḻaintu, karikālaṉ araṇmaṉaiyai vaikaṟaiyilē aṭaintāṉ; taṉatu taṭāriyaik koṭṭik karikālaṉai vāḻttiṉāṉ. avvaḷavil karikālaṉ avaṉmuṉ tōṉṟiṉāṉ; muṉṉarē taṉṉōṭu paḻakiya naṇpaṉai varavēṟpatu pōlap porunaṉai varavēṟṟāṉ; upacāra moḻikaḷaik kūṟiṉāṉ; taṉakkuc ciṟitu tolaivil avaṉai irukkac ceytāṉ; avaṉai aruḷ uṇarcciyōṭu nōkkiṉāṉ; īrum pēṉum kuṭiyiruntu aracāṇṭa porunaṉatu kantalāṭaiyai akaṟṟiṉāṉ; `iḻai pōṉa vaḻi itu, eṉṟu kaṇṭaṟiya iyalāta nuṇṇiya nūlāl neyyappaṭṭa pūttoḻil amainta tukilaik koṭuttu uṭukkac ceytāṉ. avvaḷavil pāṭṭālum kūttālum collālum aracaṉai makiḻvikkum aḻakiya paṇippeṇṭir, porunaṉatu kaḷaippai, nīkkattakka matuvaip poṉ vaṭṭilil vārttuk koṭuttuk kuṭikkac ceytaṉar.
piṉpu porunaṉ uṟaṅkik kaṇ viḻittāṉ. vaṟutta āṭṭiṟaiccit tuṇṭaṅkaḷum, cuṭṭa iṟaiccit tuṇṭaṅkaḷum, mullai arumpiṉai otta ariciccōṟum paṭaikkappaṭṭaṉa. avaṟṟōṭu, paralaip poṭitta ataṉōṭē kūṭṭiya porikkaṟikaḷum paṭaikkappaṭṭaṉa. karikālaṉ, uṭaṉ iruntu, ivaṟṟaiyellām uṇṇumpaṭi porunaṉai upacarittāṉ. iṅṅaṉam nāḷkaḷ kaḻintaṉa. oru nāḷ apporunaṉ taṉatu ūr cella viṭai kēṭṭāṉ. avvaḷavil karikālaṉ, eṉatu kūṭṭattai viṭṭuppōka virumpukiṉṟāyō? eṉṟu ciṉantavaṉ pōlac collik kaḷiṟṟōṭu kaṉṟaiyum piṭiyaiyum avaṉukku vaḻaṅkiṉāṉ; avaṉukkup poṟṟāmarai malarai vaḻaṅkiṉāṉ; vēṇṭum paricilai nalkiṉāṉ; taṉ kālālē ēḻaṭi piṉṉē vantu vaḻiyaṉuppiṉāṉ (po. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 73-168).
nalliyakkōṭaṉ upacarippu
ōymāṉāṭṭai āṇṭa nalliyakkōṭaṉatu araṇmaṉai vāyil pulavarkkum porunarkkum pāṇarkkum kūttarkkum antaṇarkkum taṭaiyiṉṟit tiṟantu viṭappaṭṭatu. avarkaḷ enta nērattilum avvāyiluḷ taṭaiyiṉṟic cella vacatiyaḷikkappaṭṭatu (ci. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 203-206). nalliyakkōṭaṉ icaikkalaiyil vallavaṉ. avaṉ taṉṉiṭam paricil peṟa virumpi vanta pāṇaṉai makiḻvuṭaṉ varavēṟṟāṉ; mūṅkil āṭaiyai urittālotta mācillāta uṭaiyiṉai vaḻaṅki, uṭukkac ceytāṉ; kaḷ teḷivait tantu avaṉatu vaḻi naṭanta kaḷaippaip pōkkiṉāṉ; vīmapākattil ciṟanta camaiyaṟ kāraṉ camaittu vaitta uṇavup poruḷkaḷaip piḷḷaikaḷukkuc ciṟiya poṟkalaṅkaḷil uṇavaip paṭaittāṉ. tāṉ niṉṟapaṭi iruntu avarkaḷai upacarittu uṇpittāṉ; tāṉ taṉ pakaivaṉai veṉṟu koṇṭu vanta poṉṉaiyum poruḷaiyum pāṇaṉukku vaḻaṅkiṉāṉ; kutiraikaḷait tēril pūṭṭi attērmītu pāṇaṉai amaracceytu vaḻi kūṭṭi aṉuppiṉāṉ (ci. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 235-261).
iḷantiraiyaṉ upacarippu
kāñci nakarattu araṇmaṉaiyil vāḻnta iḷantiraiyaṉ, taṉṉai aṭainta perumpāṇaṉatu kantalāṭaiyai akaṟṟiṉāṉ; pālāviyai otta nūlāṟ ceyta tukiliṉai uṭukkac ceytāṉ; paṇpaṭṭa maṭaiyaṉ tayāritta pala vakai iṟaiccit tuṇṭaṅkaḷaiyum cennel ariccōṟṟaiyum paṭaittu uṇpittāṉ; pāṇaṉuṭaiya piḷḷaikaḷukkuc ciṟiya veḷḷik kalaṅkaḷil uṇavaip paṭaittāṉ; mukamalarcci yuṭaṉ tāṉ niṉṟapaṭi iruntu uṇpittāṉ; pāṇaṉatu talaimuṭiyil poṟṟāmaraiyaic cūṭṭiṉāṉ; poṉṉari mālaiyai viṟaliyarkku vaḻaṅkiṉāṉ; nāṉku kutiraikaḷ pūṭṭiya tēril perumpāṇaṉai amarac ceytu, vēṇṭum paricilai īntu vaḻiyaṉuppiṉāṉ (pe. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 467-493).
neṭuñceḻiyaṉ upacarippu
pāṇṭiyaṉ neṭuñceḻiyaṉ taṉṉai nāṭivanta porunarkkuk kaḷiṟum, piṭiyum, kaṉṟum koṭuttāṉ; poṉṉāṟceyta tāmaraippūvaic cūṭṭiṉāṉ; vilai uyarnta vēṟu aṇikalaṉkaḷai vaḻaṅkiṉāṉ (ma. kā. aṭi, 100-105); pāṇarkkup palavakai iṟaiccit tuṇṭaṅkaḷaiyum, pala vakaippaṭṭa cōṟṟaiyum, iṉiya matuvaiyum vaḻaṅkiṉāṉ; viṟaliyarkkut toṭikaḷai aṇivittāṉ; pāṇar makiḻumpaṭi yāṉaikaḷai vaḻaṅkiṉāṉ; tāṉ pakaivar araṇkaḷiṟ koṇṭa pala poruḷkaḷaiyum koṭuttāṉ (ma. kā. aṭi, 211-220); appāṇṭiyaṉ taṉatu araṇmaṉaiyil vaikaṟaiyil vantu tiraṇṭa akavarkkut (aḻaittup pukaḻpavar) tēraiyum kutiraikaḷaiyum vaḻaṅkiṉāṉ (ma. kā. aṭi, 223-224).
pāṇṭiyaṉ nāḷtōṟum taṉatu nāḷōlakka maṇṭapattiliruntu, pulavar varuka, pāṇar varuka, pāṇicciyar varuka, kūttar varuka, eṉṟu ovvoruvarāka aḻaittu, avarkkum avarāl pātukākkap peṟṟa avar kuṭumpat tiṉarkkum tērkaḷaiyum yāṉaikaḷaiyum vaḻaṅkiṉāṉ; iṟaicci, matu, porikkaṟikaḷ mutaliya uṇavupporuḷkaḷai viruntāka vaittāṉ (ma. kā. aṭi, 749-756). ammaṉṉatu araṇmaṉai vāyil muttamiḻvāṇarkku eṉṟum aṭaiyāta vāyilāy iruntatu (ma. kā. aṭi, 747-748).
naṉṉaṉ upacarippu
naṉṉaṉ pakaivarai veṉṟu, avar tiṟamaiyākat tanta pēraṇikalaṅkaḷaip pulavar, pāṇar, kūttar, cūtar, mākatar mutaliyōrkku vaḻaṅkiṉāṉ; maḻai pōlap poṉṉai vāri vaḻaṅkiṉāṉ. paruvam poyyāta mēkam piṉṉarum peyyumāṟupōla mēṉmēlum kuṟaiyāmal vaḻaṅkiṉāṉ (malaipaṭukaṭām; 70-76). apperumakaṉ taṉṉai nāṭi vanta kūttarai, nīvir eṉmītuḷḷa aṉpiṉāl iṅka vantatē cālum! eṉṟu upacarittāṉ; mukamalarntu avarkaḷai aṉpōṭu pārttāṉ; iḻai pōṉa iṭam aṟiyāta nuṇṇiya nūlāṟceyta kaliṅkattai uṭukkac ceytāṉ; avarkaḷaip pala nāḷ taṉṉuṭaṉ iruttiṉāṉ; mutal nāḷ pōṉṟa viruppattōṭē avarkaḷai naṉku naṭattiṉāṉ; kūttar talaivaṉukkup poṟṟāmaraiyaic cūṭṭiṉāṉ. avaṉuṭaṉ ceṉṟa viṟaliyarkkup pēraṇikalaṉkaḷai vaḻaṅkiṉāṉ. tērkaḷ, yāṉaikaḷ, ēṟukaḷai uṭaiya pacukkaḷ, kutiraikaḷ, peruñcelvam ivaṟṟai vaḻaṅki makiḻacciyōṭu vaḻiyaṉuppiṉāṉ (malaipaṭukaṭām, aṭi, 545-575).
aracar kalaivāṇarai upacarittatiliruntu nām aṟiyattakuvaṉa yāvai? aracar mutaṉmutalil vaṟumai vaṭivāy irunta kalaiñarkaḷiṉ kantalāṭaiyaik kaḷaintu, uyarnta putiya āṭaiyaik koṭuppataiyē mutaṟkaṭamaiyākak koṇṭaṉar. `āṭaiyaṟṟa maṉitaṉ arai maṉitaṉ, eṉpatai avvaracar naṉku uṇarttiruntaṉar. ataṉāl, kalaiñariṉ māṉattaikkākka mutalil āṭaiyai vaḻaṅkiṉar; ataṟkup piṉṉarē avartam kaḷaippaip pōkka iṉiya kuṭinīrai vaḻaṅkiṉar; kaḷaippu nīṅkiya piṉpu aṟucuvai uṇṭiyait tām niṉṟu uṇpittaṉar; avarkaḷait tam cuṟṟattāreṉak karuti upacarittaṉar; nāṭṭiṉ uyir nāṭi kalaiyē eṉpataiyum, kalai vāḻntāltāṉ kuṭimakkaḷiṉ uḷḷam paṇpaṭum eṉpataiyum, akkalaikkut kāvalarkaḷāṉa pulavar, pāṇar, kūttar eṉpār vaṟumaiyiṉṟi vāḻntāltāṉ kalai vāḻum eṉpataiyum tamiḻakattu aracar teḷivuṟa uṇarntiruntaṉar; ākavē, kalaivāṇarai ollum vakaiyālellām ōmpu vantaṉar.
kuṭi makkaḷ upacarippu
iṅṅaṉam muttamiḻvāṇarait tamiḻaracar maṭṭum upacarikkavillai; avar tam kuṭimakkaḷum upacarittārkaḷ. naṉṉaṉaik kāṇac ceṉṟa kūttarkku avaṉatu malai nāṭṭu mullai nilattil iṭaiyar makaḷir maṉamakiḻcciyōṭu pālai vaḻaṅkiṉar; tamakkeṉṟu camaittirunta pāṟcōṟṟai vaḻaṅkiṉar; āṭṭut tōṟpaṭukkaiyil paṭukka vaittaṉar. kūttar, naṉṉaṉatu nāṭu kākkum kāvaraikkaṇṭu tām naṉṉaṉaik kāṇappōvatākak kūṟiṉar. uṭaṉē akkāvalar avarkaḷukkup pala vakai iṟaiccit tuṇṭaṅkaḷaiyum kiḻaṅkukaḷaiyum vaḻaṅki uṇpittaṉar; avarkaḷ cella vēṇṭiya vaḻiyai viḷakkik kūṟiṉar (malaipaṭukaṭām, aṭi, 407-427). ivvivaraṅkaḷ, akkāla aracarkaḷum potumakkaḷum muttamiḻvāṇariṭam koṇṭirunta perumatippai naṉku viḷakkuvaṉavākum.
19. toḻilum vāṇikamum
1. toḻilkaḷ
uḻavum vāṇikamum ulakattut toḻilkaḷil mikuttuc collat takuvaṉa. avviraṇṭāltāṉ celva vaḷattaittiraṭṭal kūṭum, (ma. kā. 120-3) eṉpatu māṅkuṭi marutaṉār karuttu.
aivakai nilattuc ciṟapput toḻilkaḷ
kuṟiñci nilattu makkaḷ malaiccarivup pakutikaḷaiyum malaimītu camanilamāyuḷḷa pakutiyaiyum viḷainilamākkutal, malai nel tiṉai mutaliya kūla vakaikaḷai vitaittal, tiṉaippuṉaṅkaḷaik kāttal, tēṉeṭuttal, kiḻaṅku vakaikaḷaip payirākkutal, vēṭṭaiyāṭutal mutaliya toḻilkaḷil īṭupaṭṭiruntārkaḷ.
pālainila makkaḷ, piṟa nilaṅkaḷiluḷḷa āṉiraikaḷaik kavartal, vaḻippaṟi ceytal ākiya toḻilkaḷaic ceytārkaḷ. mullai nila makkaḷ cāmai vitaittal, varaku vitaittal, kālnaṭaikaḷai mēyttal, pāl tayir mōr veṇṇey ney ivaṟṟai viṟṟal mutaliya toḻilkaḷil īṭupaṭṭārkaḷ.
marutanila makkaḷ, vayalkaḷai uḻutal, nel vitaittal, nāṟṟu naṭutal, kaḷai eṭuttal, vayalkaḷukku nīr pāyccutal, aṟuvaṭai ceytal, kaṭā viṭutal mutaliya payirttoḻil toṭarpāṉa toḻilkaḷil īṭupaṭṭiruntārkaḷ.
neytal nila makkaḷ, ōṭam, mitavai, paṭaku mutaliyavaṟṟai amaittal, mīṉ piṭittal, uppai viḷaittal, mīṉ viṟṟal, mīṉkaḷai uppiṭṭup patappaṭuttutal, avaṟṟai viṟṟal mutaliya toḻilkaḷil muṉaintiruntārkaḷ.
inta aintu nila makkaḷum taṅkaḷukkuriya vīṭukaḷai amaikkum toḻilaiyum ceytu vantārkaḷ; maṇcuvar eḻupputal, vaikkōl mutaliyavaṟṟaikkoṇṭu kūraiyamaittal, maṇṇaikkoṇṭu ceṅkal ceytu ularttutal, ularntavaṟṟaic cūḷaiyiṭṭuc cuṭutal mutaliya toḻilkaḷaiyum aṟintiruntārkaḷ. ovvoru nilattilum paṟai, tuṭi, muḻavu, pampai mutaliya karuvikaḷaic ceyyum toḻilum naṭaipeṟṟatu. curuṅkakkūṟiṉ, ovvoru nilattilum avvannila makkaḷuṭaiya cūḻnilaikku ēṟpat toḻilkaḷ amaintiruntaṉa eṉalām. ittoḻilkaḷil āṭavarum peṇṭirum tattamakkuriya pakutiyaic ceytaṉar eṉṟu kūṟutal poruttamākum.
potut toḻilkaḷ
pattuppāṭṭuḷ pala toḻilkaḷukkuriya karuvikaḷiṉ peyarkaḷ kāṇappaṭukiṉṟaṉa; pala toḻilkaḷ peyarkaḷum kuṟikkappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa. ivai iraṇṭaiyum oṉṟu cērppiṉ, annūliṟkuṟikkappaṭṭuḷḷa toḻilkaḷ iṉṉavai eṉpatai eḷitil aṟiyalām.
1. kuḻici (pāṉai), aṭuppu (pe. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 99) eṉṉum peyarkaḷaik koṇṭu maṭpāṇṭat toḻil iruntamaiyai eḷitil aṟiyalām.
2. tēr, pāṇṭil, uḷi (ci. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 52, 258-260), ulakkai (pe. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 97), nukam, accu, pār, uruḷai (pe. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 63-66) eṉṉum poruḷkaḷiṉ peyarkaḷ akkālat taccut toḻilai niṉaivūṭṭukiṉṟaṉa. taccar `karuntoḻil viṉaiñar eṉṟu kuṟikkappaṭṭuḷḷaṉar (ci. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 257).
3. uḻukoḻu, kuyam (arivāḷ), kattirikai (po. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 29, 117, 242), yāṉaiyai aṭakkum tōṭṭi (tirumuruku. aṭi, 78), tōl, turutti (pe. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 206, 207), irumputtakaṭu (aṭi, 222), kavaimuṭkaruvi, muttikai (cammaṭṭi) (mul. pāṭṭu, aṭi, 35, 59), nilam akaḻum uḷi, vaḷaivukkatti, toṭalaivāḷ (ma. kā. aṭi, 635, 636, 637) eṉṉum karuvikaḷiṉ peyarkaḷ kollat toḻil naṉku naṭaipeṟṟatait terivikkiṉṟaṉa. ivai allāmal pōrkkaruvikaḷāṉa vāḷ, vēl, īṭṭi, cūlam mutaliyaṉavum kollaṉāl uruvākkappaṭṭaṉavē ākum.
4. ammi, kuḻavi, tirikai (pe. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 229) eṉpavai, kal taccar toḻilai niṉaivūṭṭukiṉṟaṉa.
5. `vārai eṉṉum collum `tottoḷippāy eṉṉum uraiyum (pe. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 50), pāy piṉṉum toḻil iruntamaiyaip pulappaṭuttum.
6. toṭutōl-ceruppu (pe. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 169; ma. kā. aṭi, 636) tōl toḻil iruntamaiyai uṇarttum.
7. pāṇṭimātēviyiṉ tantakkaṭṭiliṉmītu kañciyiṭṭuc calavai ceyyappaṭṭa tukil virikkappaṭṭiruntatu eṉpataṉāl (neṭunalvāṭai, aṭi, 134-135) calavait toḻil naṭaipeṟṟu vantatu eṉpatu naṉku tuṇiyappaṭum.
8. tukil, kaliṅkam mutaliya uyarnta āṭaikaḷum, cātāraṇa āṭaikaḷum vaḻakkil iruntamaiyai nōkka, necavut toḻil mikac ciṟanta toḻilāy iruntamai aṟiyappaṭum. `uṭai eṉṉum pakutiyil itu paṟṟiya viḷakkam kāṇka. kūṭārattuṇi eṉṉum oru vakai muraṭṭuttuṇiyum akkālattil neyyappaṭṭatu.
ituvaraiyiṟ kūṟappaṭṭa toḻilkaḷ ikkālattil kirāmak kaittoḻilkaḷ eṉṟu vaḻaṅkappaṭukiṉṟaṉa.
9. uppaṅkaḻikaḷukku arukil uppeṭukkum toḻil naṭaipeṟṟatu. uppeṭukkum nilappakuti `aḷam eṉappaṭum. attoḻil īṭupaṭṭavar `aḷavar eṉappaṭṭaṉar. upput tayārikkappaṭṭa iṭattilēyē uppu viṟkappaṭṭatu. kaṭalōra pakutikaḷil-uppaṅ kaḻiyuḷḷa iṭaṅkaḷil ittoḻil naṉku naṭaipeṟṟatu (ma. kā. aṭi, 117).
10. kuṭṭam, vayal, ilañci, poykai mutaliya nīr nilaikaḷil tūṇṭil, valai mutaliyavaṟṟaikkoṇṭu mīṉ piṭikkum toḻil naṭaipeṟṟatu (pe. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 270-274, 283-85 ma. kā. 247-255). kaṭaṟkaraip pakutiyil periya valaikaḷai vīci mīṉ piṭikkum toḻil naṭaipeṟṟatu. mīṉkaḷai uppiṭṭu uṇakkum toḻilum naṭaipeṟṟatu. (ci. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 163, ma. kā. aṭi, 319-20).
11. celvar vāḻum vaḷamaṉaikaḷilum araṇmaṉaikaḷilum payaṉpaṭuttappaṭṭa viciṟi, ālavaṭṭam eṉappaṭṭatu. ataṉait tayārittavaṉ `kaival kammiyaṉ eṉappaṭṭāṉ. aḵtu uṟaiyil iṭṭup pātukākkappaṭṭatu (ne. vāṭai, aṭi, 57, 58). itu `viciṟi ceyyum toḻil eṉappaṭum.
12. periya nakaraṅkaḷil nūlāl varintu pantum pāvaiyum ceyyum toḻilum (tirumuruku. aṭi, 68), nūlēṇi mutaliyaṉa ceyyum toḻilum (ma. kā. aṭi, 640) naṭaipeṟṟaṉa. ivai `nūl toḻil eṉappaṭum.
13. neṭṭiyaikkoṇṭu pala vakai malar mālaikaḷ pommaikaḷ mutaliyaṉa ceyyum toḻil vaḻakkiliruntatu (ci. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 54).
14. araciyal aluvalar, uyarkuṭip peṇṭir mutaliyōr caṭṭaiyum kaccum aṇintiruntaṉar eṉpatai nōkkat taiyal toḻil ciṟappuṟṟiruntamai aṟiyalām (pe. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 69). itu paṟṟiya piṟa vivaraṅkaḷai `uṭai eṉṉum pakutiyiṟ kāṇka.
15. mikak kūriya ciṟṟuḷi koṇṭu yāṉait tantattāl aracamātēvikkuriya vaṭṭakkaṭṭil amaikkappaṭṭiruntatu. ciṅkam mutaliyavaṟṟai vēṭṭaiyāṭutal pōṉṟa pala kāṭcikaḷ nuṇṇiya takaṭukaḷiṉmītu poṟikkappaṭṭaṉa. (neṭunal vāṭai, aṭi, 116-123) eṉṉum vivaraṅkaḷai nōkka, mika nuṭpamāṉa taccut toḻil vaḻakkil iruntamai aṟiyappaṭum.
16. aracamātēvikkuriya aṇaikaḷ aṉṉap pēṭṭiṉ tūviyāl āṉavai. kaṭṭiliṉmītu, paṭukkai (mettai) virikkappaṭṭiruntatu eṉṉum ceytikaḷ, akkālattil uyarnta muṟaiyil mettaikaḷum talaiyaṇaikaḷum tayārikkum toḻil uyarnilaiyil iruntataip pulappaṭuttum (neṭunal vāṭai, aṭi, 131-135).
17. maturai mānakaril caṅku aṟuttal, aṟutta caṅkai vaḷai mutaliyaṉavākak kaṭaital, aḻakiya maṇikaḷait tuḷaiyiṭutal, poṉ nakaikaḷaic ceytal, palavakai āṭaikaḷai neytal, pūmālaikaḷait tayārittal, palavakaic cāntukaḷait tayārittal pōṉṟa pala toḻilkaḷ naṭaipeṟṟaṉa eṉṟu maturaik kāñci (aṭi, 511-518) moḻikiṉṟatu. maṇiceyyum toḻilum naṭaipeṟṟatu (pa. pālai, aṭi, 232).
18. muṉpu kūṟappaṭṭa aracamātēviyiṉatu kaṭṭiliṉ mēṟkūṟaiyil ñāyiṟu, tiṅkaḷ, urōkiṇi mutaliya kōḷkaḷiṉ ōviyaṅkaḷ varaiyappaṭṭiruntaṉa (ne. vāṭai, aṭi, 159-163) eṉṉum ceyti akkāla ōviyat toḻilai uṇarttuvatākum.
19. poṉṉai aṭittuk kāppu mutaliyavaṟṟaic ceyyum taṭṭārat toḻilum, kalluppatitta nakaikaḷaic ceyyum irattiṉappaṇit taṭṭārat toḻilum ciṟappuṟa naṭaipeṟṟaṉa. pala vakai talaiyaṇikaḷ, kātaṇikaḷ, kaḻuttaṇikaḷ, tōḷaṇikaḷ, kaiyaṇikaḷ, viralaṇikaḷ, iṭaiyaṇikaḷ, kālaṇikaḷ pattuppāṭṭuḷ kuṟikkappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa. avai mikavuyarnta vēlaippāṭu koṇṭavai. avai paṟṟiya vivaraṅkaḷai `aṇikaḷ eṉṉum pakutiyil kāṇalām. appalavakai aṇikaḷum iruntamaiyai nōkka, akkālap poṟkollat toḻil mikavuyarnat nilaiyai aṭain tiruntamai teḷivākum.
20. neytal nila makkaḷākiya paratavar tamatu mīṉ piṭikkum toḻilukku ōṭam, paṭaku, mitavai mutaliyavaṟṟaip payaṉpaṭuttiṉar. avar avaṟṟai amaikkum toḻililum vallunarāyiruntaṉar. tamiḻakam caṅkakālak kaṭal vāṇikattil kīḻai nāṭukaḷuṭaṉum, mēlai nāṭukaḷuṭaṉum neruṅkiya toṭarpu koṇṭiruntamaiyai nōkkat tamiḻar kappal kaṭṭum toḻilil tērntavarāyiruntiruttal kūṭumeṉṟu karutul poruttamākum.
21. uṭalukku aḻakaik koṭukkum karuṅkāliyaic cīvik kāycci ataṉaip paciya pākkuṭaṉ kalantu cāyap pākkait tayārikkum toḻil naṭaipeṟṟatu (ma. kā. aṭi, 400-401).
22. caṅkakālat tamiḻakattil nūṟṟukkaṇakkāṉa pulavarkaḷ iruntamaiyaik kāṇkiṟōm; appulavarkaḷ ciṟṟūrkaḷaic cērntavarkaḷ eṉpatai aṟikiṟōm. itaṉāl akkālac ciṟṟūrkaḷilum pērūrkaḷilum kalvi kaṟpikkum toḻil uyarnta muṟaiyil iruntiruttal vēṇṭumeṉṟu karutul tavaṟākātu.
2. payirttoḻil
kuṟiñci nilappayirkaḷ
malaiyaic cuṟṟiyuḷḷa aṭivārap pakutiyil eḷ, tiṉai, avarai, varaku, mūṅkil nel, veṇiciṟukaṭuku, iñcikkiḻaṅku, kavalaikkiḻaṅku, malai vāḻai, mā, palā eṉpavai viḷaintaṉa (malaipaṭu. aṭi, 102-139).
malaimītu ciṟappākat tiṉai payir ceyyappaṭṭatu. cila kiḻaṅku vakaikaḷum payir ceyyappaṭṭaṉa.
mullai nilappayirkaḷ
avarai ciṟappākap payir ceyyappaṭṭatu (ci. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 164) tiṉai, eḷ, varaku mutaliyaṉa payirāyiṉa (ma. kā. aṭi, 271-272). mullai nilattil aṟuvaṭaiyāṉa varaku mutaliya vaṟṟaikkoṇṭa kutirkaḷ mullai nilac cīṟūrkaḷil peṇ yāṉaikaḷ niṉṟāṟpōla niṉṟaṉa (pe. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 186). varakuppayir muṉ paṇi toṭaṅkum paruvattil katir piṭikkumām (mul. pā. aṭi, 98-100).
maruta nilappayirkaḷ
kāviriyāṟum ataṉ kiḷaiyāṟukaḷum cōḻanāṭṭil toṉṟu toṭṭup pāyntu varukiṉṟaṉa. karikālaṉ mutaliya cōḻamaṉṉarkaḷ āṟṟaṅ karaikaḷai uyarttiṉārkaḷ; aṇaikaḷaik kaṭṭiṉārkaḷ; vāykkālkaḷai veṭṭiṉār kaḷ  ivaṟṟāl cōḻanāṭu cōṟṟuvaḷam mikanta nāṭāyiṟṟu. aṅku oru mā nilattil tiṭar tōṟum neṟkūṭukaḷ iruntaṉa. oru vēli nilattil āyiram kalam cennel viḷaintatu (po. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 246-248). itaṉālētāṉ `cōḻavaḷanāṭu cōṟuṭaittu, eṉṉum paḻamoḻi vaḻaṅkalāyiṟṟu. iṉṟum cōḻanāṭu `tamiḻakattiṉ neṟkaḷañciyam eṉṟu kūṟappaṭukiṟatu.
uḻavar uḻavuttoḻiliṟ payiṉṟa periya erutukaḷaip pūṭṭi ērai uḻutaṉar; kalappaiyiṉ koḻu nilattil maṟaiya amukki uḻutaṉar eṉṟu perum pāṇāṟṟuppaṭai uḻavaip paṟṟip pēcukiṟatu (aṭi, 198-200). ceṟu, cey eṉṟu vayal peyar peṟṟiruntatu (pe. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 210). cennel, tōppi nel (pe. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 230, 142), mūṅkil nel (malaipaṭu. aṭi, 121) eṉa nel pala vakaippaṭum. veṟṟilaik koṭikaḷai vaḷarttu veṟṟilai payir ceyyappaṭṭatu (ma. kā. mo, 400-401) nghY«!1
3. vāṇikam
uḷ nāṭṭu vāṇikam
kuṟiñci nilamakkaḷ, tēṉ, kiḻaṅku, māṉ tacai, matu mutaliyavaṟṟaip piṟa nilamakkaḷukku viṟṟut taṅkaḷukku vēṇṭiya uṇavup poruḷkaḷai vāṅkik koṇṭārkaḷ. ivvāṟē neytal nilamakkaḷ mīṉ, ney, naṟavu mutaliyavaṟṟaip piṟanilamakkaḷukku viṟṟut taṅkaḷukku vēṇṭiya uṇavup poruḷkaḷaip peṟṟārkaḷ. marutanilamakkaḷ, aval, nel, karumpu mutaliyavaṟṟai viṟṟup piṟa nilattup paṇṭaṅkaḷaip peṟṟārkaḷ. (po. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 214-217). mullai nilamakkaḷ pāl, tayir, mōr, veṇṇey mutaliyavaṟṟaip piṟa nilaṅkaḷil viṟṟut taṅkaḷukku vēṇṭiya paṇṭaṅkaḷaip peṟṟārkaḷ. iṅṅaṉam paṇṭaṅkaḷaik koṭuttup paṇṭaṅkaḷaip peṟutal `paṇṭamāṟṟu eṉappaṭum. nāṇayaṅkaḷ tōṉṟuvataṟku muṉpu ippaṇṭamāṟṟu muṟaiyē ulakil neṭuṅkālam iruntu vantatu.
uṇavupporuḷkaḷuḷ mikacciṟantatu uppu. uppu vāṇikar uppaḷaṅkaḷiliruntu uppai vāṅki, vaṇṭikaḷil ēṟṟikkoṇṭu, ūrūrāyc ceṉṟu viṟṟaṉar. uppu vaṇṭiyē avartam vīṭākavum payaṉpaṭṭatu. uppu vāṇikaṉ maṉaiviyum cila camayaṅkaḷil vaṇṭiyōṭṭiṉāḷ. avaḷ kaṇavaṉ, vaṇṭiyiḻukkum erutukaḷ kaḷaippuṟṟāl vēṟu urutukaḷai vaṇṭiyil pūṭṭuvataṟkut tayārākat taṉṉuṭaṉ iraṇṭu erutukaḷai ōṭṭik koṇṭu uppu vaṇṭiyōṭu celvatu vaḻakkam (pe. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 55-59).
miḷaku, cēranāṭṭil viḷaintatu. atu piṟa nāṭukaḷukkuk koṇṭu cellappaṭṭatu. vaṇikar miḷakup potikaḷaik kaḻutaikaḷiṉmītu ēṟṟi ūrūrāyc ceṉṟu viṟṟaṉar (pe. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 80-81).
kappalkaḷil vantu tuṟaimuka nakaraṅkaḷil iṟakkumatiyāṉa muttu, pavaḷam, māṇikkam, cantaṉam mutaliya poruḷkaḷ uḷ nāṭṭu vaṇikarāl viṟkappaṭṭaṉa (pe. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 67-76).
tamiḻ nāṭṭu maṉṉar payirttoḻilaip pōlavē uḷ nāṭṭu vāṇikattaiyum veḷi nāṭṭu vāṇikattaiyum vaḷam peṟa vaḷarttaṉar; tam nāṭu muḻumaiyum vaṇṭikaḷ cellakkūṭiya nalla pātaikaḷai amaittiruntaṉar; vāṇikap poruḷkaḷaip pātukākka āṅkāṅkuk kāvalarai vaittiruntaṉar; peruvaḻikaḷilum kavartta vaḻikaḷilum viṟpaṭai vīrar iruntu kāval kāttaṉar (pe. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 78-81, ma. kā. aṭi, 310-312). pātaikaḷil cellum vaṇikap poruḷkaḷukku ulku (vari) vacūlikkappaṭṭatu; āṅkāṅkuc cuṅkac cāvaṭikaḷ iruntaṉa (pe. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 80-81).
nāḻi eṉpatu mukattalaḷavaiyiṉ peyar (mullaip pāṭṭu aṭi, 10). pīṭu mikka māṭa maturaiyil makaḷirum vāṇikam ceytaṉar (ma. kā. aṭi, 621-623).
akanāṉūṟu mutaliya akapporuḷ tokai nūlkaḷil tamiḻvāṇikar tamiḻakattukku vaṭakkēyum ceṉṟu vāṇikam ceytaṉar eṉpatai uṟutippaṭuttum kuṟippukaḷ pala kāṇappaṭukiṉṟaṉa. ivvuḷ nāṭṭu vāṇikam pāṭalipurattait talainakarāykkoṇṭu makata nāṭṭai nantarkaḷ āṇṭa kālam mutaṟkoṇṭu toṭarntu naṭaipeṟṟu vantatu eṉpatu akkuṟippukaḷiliruntu terikiṟatu. eṉavē, tamiḻ vaṇikar vaṭavintiyāvilum vāṇikam ceytu vantaṉar eṉpatu iṅku aṟiyappaṭum.
kaṭal vāṇikam
ēṟattāḻak ki. mu. āyirattil vāḻnta cālamaṉ aracar kālattiliruntē tamiḻar kaṭal vāṇikam ceytu vantaṉar eṉpatu ārāycciyil aṟiyappaṭukiṉṟatu. kaṭal vāṇikattiṟkuk kappalkaḷ tēvai. kappalkaḷ vantu taṅkavum, poruḷkaḷai ēṟṟavum iṟakkavum vacatiyāṉa tuṟaimukaṅkaḷ tēvai. caṅkakālat tamiḻakattil ittakaiya tuṟaimukaṅkaḷ paṟpala iruntaṉa eṉpataip perippuḷū āciriyar, piḷaiṉi, tālami pōṉṟa mēṉāṭṭu yāttirikar eḻutiyuḷḷa kuṟippukaḷiliruntu aṟiyalām.1
pattuppāṭṭuḷ cila tuṟaimuka nakaraṅkaḷ kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa. avai eyiṟpaṭṭiṉam, paṭṭiṉam (māmallapuram), koṟkai, kāvirippūmpaṭṭiṉam eṉpaṉa. eyiṟpaṭṭiṉam ōymāṉāṭṭut tuṟaimukanakaram; paṭṭiṉam eṉpatu, toṇṭai nāṭṭut tuṟaimukanakaram; koṟkai eṉpatu, pāṇṭi nāṭṭut tuṟaimukanakaram; kāvirip pūmpaṭṭiṉam eṉpatu cōḻa nāṭṭut tuṟaimuka nakaram.
eyiṟpaṭṭiṉattiṟku akil mutaliya maṇapporuḷkaḷ vantaṉa (ci. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 155). toṇṭaināṭṭup paṭṭiṉam eṉṟa tuṟaimukattil vaṭa nāṭṭup poruḷkaḷum mēlai nāṭṭukkutiraikaḷum piṟavum iṟakkumatiyāyiṉa. aṅku vāḻnta paratavar celva vaḷam peṟṟut tikaḻntaṉar. vaṇikar periya vaḷamaṉaikaḷil vāḻntaṉar. avartam makaḷir melliya tukilaiyum paciya vaṭaṅkaḷ kōtta maṇikaḷaiyum piṟa aṇikaḷaiyum aṇintu celvac ceḻippōṭu kāṇappaṭṭaṉar. avar tam kālkaḷil poṟcilampukaḷ olittaṉa. avarkaḷ poṉṉāṟceyta kaḻaṟcik kāykaḷaikkoṇṭu maṇalil viḷaiyāṭiṉārkaḷ. attuṟaimukanakaril mikavuyarnta kalaṅkarai viḷakkam iruntatu (pe. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 319-336, 346-348).
koṟkai nakarattil mutteṭuppār cēri, caṅku kuḷippār cēri eṉṉum pala cērikaḷiruntaṉa. aṅkuc ciṟappāka mutteṭukkum toḻilum, caṅkeṭukkum toḻilum naṭaipeṟṟaṉa (ma. kā. aṭi, 133-136). veṇmaiyāṉa uppu, karuppukkaṭṭi kūṭṭip poritta puḷi, uppiṭṭu ularttappaṭṭa mīṉ tuṇṭaṅkaḷ, pēraṇi karaṅkaḷ mutaliya poruḷkaḷ koṟkaiyiliruntu ēṟṟumatiyāyiṉa. kutiraikaḷ, yavaṉanāṭṭup pāvai viḷakkukaḷ, matuvakaikaḷ mutaliyaṉa iṟakkumati ceyyappaṭṭaṉa (ma. kā. aṭi, 318-324).
kāvirippūmpaṭṭiṉattil periya tuṟaimukam amaintiruntatu. aṅku ariya kāvalaiyuṭaiya paṇṭacālai iruntatu. ēṟṟumatip poruḷkaḷum iṟakkumatip poruḷkaḷum appaṇṭacālaiyil kuvintiruntaṉa. ovvoru paṇṭappotiyiṉ mītum cōḻa aracāṅka muttiraiyākiya puli muttirai poṟikkappaṭṭiruntatu. pakkattil cuṅkaccāvaṭiyum iruntatu. aṅkirunta tuṟaimuka aluvalar iravu pakal iḷaippiṉṟi vēlai ceytaṉar. kutiraikaḷ mikutiyāy iṟakkumatiyāyiṉa; cēranāṭṭiliruntu kaṭal vaḻiyē miḷakup potikaḷ vantaṉa; tamiḻakattiṟku vaṭapāliruntu māṇikkak kaṟkaḷum, cāmpūnatam eṉṉum poṉṉum, pāṇṭināṭṭu muttukaḷum, kuṭaku malaic cantaṉak kaṭṭaikaḷum akiṟ kaṭṭaikaḷum, kīḻtticaik kaṭaliliruntu pavaḻamum, kaṅkaic camaveḷiyil uṇṭāṉa poruḷkaḷum, kaṭārattil (malāyā) uṇṭāṉa poruḷkaḷum, cīṉam mutaliya nāṭukaḷiliruntu vanta karuppūram paṉinīr kuṅkumam mutaliyaṉavum iṟakkumatiyāyiṉa (pa. pālai. aṭi, 118-125, 185-192 urai).
kāvirippūmpaṭṭiṉattil vāṇikattiṉporuṭṭup palanāṭṭu makkaḷ kuṭiyēṟiyiruntārkaḷ (pa. pālai. aṭi, 214-217). poruḷkaḷai ēṟṟikkoṇṭu vanta marak kalam `vaṅkam eṉap peyar peṟṟatu (ma. kā. aṭi, 536).
caṅkakālattil tamiḻakattōṭu vāṇikam ceytu vanta airōppiyar yavaṉar eṉappaṭṭaṉar. avarkaḷ caṭṭai aṇintiruntārkaḷ; kaṇṇāṭip poruḷkaḷ, maṇap poruḷkaḷ, iyantirap poṟikaḷ, matu vakaikaḷ mutaliya vaṟṟait tamiḻnāṭṭil iṟakkumati ceytārkaḷ. avarkaḷ pāvai viḷakkuc ceyvatil paṇpaṭṭavarkaḷ.
