kaiyēntu aiyakal niṟaiyaney corintu
eṉpatu neṭunalvāṭai (aṭi, 101-102).
ikkālattil tamiḻakattup periya vaṇika nilaiyaṅkaḷil kūrkkar kāvalarāy iruttalaip pōlavē caṅka kālattil yavaṉa vīrar kōṭṭai kāvalarāyum aracaṉatu nampikkaikkuriya paṇiyāḷarāyum iruntuvantaṉar eṉpatu cilappatikārattālum mullaippāṭṭālum aṟiyappaṭum (mul. pā. aṭi, 59-66).
pūmpukār vaṇikar
`pūmpukār eṉpatu kāvirippūmpaṭṭiṉattukkuriya peyarkaḷuḷ oṉṟu. aṅkuk karikālaṉ kālattil vāḻnta vaṇikar tam paṇṭaṅkaḷaiyum piṟapaṇṭaṅkaḷaiyum viṟkumpōtum vāṅkumpōtum nērmaiyāka naṭantu koṇṭaṉar; tām koḷḷum paṇṭattait tām koṭukkum poruḷukku mikaiyākak koḷḷavillai; tām koṭukkum paṇṭattaiyum tām vāṅkum paṇṭattiṟkuk kuṟaivākak koṭukkavillai; ilāpattai veḷippaṭaiyākac colli viṟṟaṉar; aṟavaḻiyilēyē naṭantaṉar; uyirkkolaiyait tavirttaṉar; uyirkkolai purivōraiyum akkoṭun toḻililiruntu vilakkamuṟpaṭṭaṉar; pacukkaḷaik kāttaṉar; vēḷvikaḷaic ceytaṉar; tāṉaṅkaḷaic ceytaṉar; ēḻaikaḷ poruṭṭum tāṉaṅkaḷ ceytaṉar (pa. pālai. aṭi, 196-211).
20. illaṅkaḷum pāttiraṅkaḷum
1. illaṅkaḷ
kuṟiñci nila illaṅkaḷ
kuṟiñci, pālai, mullai, marutam, neytal ākiya aivakai nilaṅkaḷilum ciṟṟūrkaḷilum pērūrkaḷilum caṅkakālattil illaṅkaḷ evvāṟu amaintiruntaṉa eṉpatai innūlāl ōraḷavu aṟiyalām.
malaiyum malaicārnta iṭamumākiya kuṟiñci nilattil tiṉai mutaliya payirkaḷait tiṉṉa varum yāṉai, paṉṟi mutaliya vilaṅkuḷaiyum kiḷi mutaliya paṟavaikaḷaiyum viraṭṭu vataṟkākak kāṉavar uyarnta marakkiḷaikaḷil paraṇ kaṭṭiṉar. (pe. ā. paṭai, 51-52. kuṟiñci nilamakkaḷ kuṟiya kālkaḷai naṭṭut tiṇaiyarintatāḷāl vēynta kuṭilil vāḻntaṉar (ku. pāṭṭu, aṭi, 153-4). kaḻikaḷai naṭṭup pullāl vēynta kuṭilkaḷil cavvātu malai makkaḷ vāḻntārkaḷ (malaipaṭukaṭām, aṭi, 438-9).
pālai nila illaṅkaḷ
uṇavup poruḷkaḷaip payir ceyya iyalāta nīr vaḷamaṟṟa nilam pālaiyākum.
	mullaiyum kuṟiñciyum muṟaimaiyiṉ tirintu
nalliyal piḻantu naṭuṅkutuyar uṟuttup
pālai yeṉpatōr paṭivam koḷḷum
								-cilampu, kātai, 11, aṭi, 64-66.
ātalāl, pālai nilam perumpālum kuṟiñcikkum mullaikkum iṭaiyil amaintirukkum. aṅku veppam mikuti; naṉṉīr kiṭaittal aritu. viḷaivu iṉmaiyāl pālai nila makkaḷuṭcilar pālai nila vilaṅkukaḷaiyum paṟavaikaḷaiyum vēṭṭaiyāṭuvar; cilar, āṟalaikaḷvarākip piḻaippar. avartam illaṅkaḷ ciṟukuṭilkaḷēyākum. veyiṟkālattil avvillaṅkaḷil iruppōr veyilāl tuṉpuṟuvar (ciṟu. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 174) akkuṭilkaḷ vēliṉ muṉaiyai otta kūrmaiyiṉaiyuṭaiya muṉaikoṇṭa īntiṉuṭaiya ilaiyāl vēyappaṭṭavai. akkuṭilkaḷil māṉ tōlaiyē paṭukkaiyākak koṇṭu piḷḷaiyaip peṟṟa eyiṉamakaḷ muṭaṅkikkiṭantāḷ eṉṟu perum pāṇāṟṟuppaṭai pēcukiṟatu (aṭi, 86-90). nāṭṭup peruvaḻikaḷaik kāval purinta eyiṉar vāḻnta illaṅkaḷum kuṭilkaḷēyākum. avai kuḻaiyāl vēyappaṭṭavai; avaṟṟil vāḻntavar māṉ tōlaiyē paṭukkaiyākak koṇṭaṉar (ma. kā. 310-311).
mullai nila illaṅkaḷ
kāṭum kāṭu cārnta iṭamum mullaiyākum. innilattil āṭumāṭukaḷai mēytta āyar vāḻntaṉar. avarkaḷ vāḻnta kuṭilkaḷ varakuttaṭṭaiyāl vēyappaṭṭavai; avaṟṟiṉ kālkaḷil āṭṭumaṟikaḷ niṉṟu tiṉṉattakka taḻaikaḷ kaṭṭappaṭṭiruntaṉa. kuṭiliṉ katavu kaḻikaḷāl kaṭṭappaṭṭatu. kuṭiliṉ vāyil ciṟiyatu. akkuṭilil varakukkaṟṟaikaḷāl vēynta cēkkai iruntatu. āṭṭuk kiṭāyiṉ tōlkaḷē pāyalākap payaṉpaṭṭaṉa. kuṭiliṉ muṟṟattil kuṟiya muḷaikaḷ patikkappaṭṭiruntaṉa. avaṟṟil neṭiya tāmpukaḷ kaṭṭappaṭṭiruntaṉa. avai āṭumāṭukaḷaik kaṭṭap payaṉpaṭṭaṉa. iṅṅaṉam āyar vāḻnta illaṅkaḷaik koṇṭa ciṟṟūr, kaṭṭu muḷ vēliyiṉai uṭaiyatāyiruntatu (pe. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 147-154). cavvātu malaiyil vāḻnta āyar, āṭṭut tōlkaḷai oṉṟākat taittup paṭukkaiyākap payaṉpaṭuttiṉar; iravil koṭiya vilaṅkukaḷ tam kuṭilkaḷiṭam vārātapaṭi neruppai erittaṉar (malai, aṭi, 419-20).
mullai nilattuc cīṟūrkaḷil uḻutuṇpār vāḻntaṉar. aṅku irunta ilalaṅkaḷ varaku vaikkōlāl vēyappaṭṭavai; aḻakiyavai. illattiṉ muṟṟattil piṭi niṉṟāṟpōṉṟa varaku mutaliya kūla vakaikaḷ vaikkappeṟum kutirkaḷ iruntaṉa; muṟṟattup pantaril pāṉaiyiṉ kālai otta varaku tirikai naṭappaṭṭiruntatu. kalappaiyum uruḷaikaḷum vaikkappaṭṭa koṭṭil iruntatu. akkoṭṭiliṉ orupāl erutukaḷ kaṭṭappaṭṭiruntaṉa (pe. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 186-191).
marutanila illaṅkaḷ
vayalum vayal cārnta iṭamum marutamākum. marutam, nīrum pacumaiyāṉa vayalkaḷum tōṭṭaṅkaḷum tōppukaḷum cōlaikaḷum niṟaintuḷḷa iṭam. uḻavar vayal varappil taṅkip payirkaḷaik kāval kākkap putiya vaikkōlāl vēynta kavinta kuṭilai amaittuk koṇṭaṉar. ataṉ muṟṟattil uḻattiyar aval iṭittaṉar (pe. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 224-6).
vaḷamuṭaiya ūrkaḷil uḻavar vīṭukaḷiṉ muṟṟattil kaṉṟukaḷaik kaṭṭa neṭiya tāmpukaḷaik koṇṭa muḷaikaḷ naṭappaṭṭiruntaṉa. nīṇṭa ēṇikku eṭṭāta neṭiya vaṭiviṉaiyuṭaiya kutirkaḷ iruntaṉa. piḷḷaikaḷ anta muṟṟattil ciṟutēr uruṭṭi viḷaiyāṭiṉārkaḷ (pe. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 243-249). muṟṟattiṉ ittaku ciṟappaik koṇṭu illam naṉmuṟaiyil amaintiruttal vēṇṭum eṉṟu nām niṉaikkalām.
teṉṉantōppukaḷukku iṭaiyil marutanilac cīṟūrkaḷ pala amaintiruntaṉa. muṭaiyappaṭṭa teṉṉai ōlaikaḷ vēynta vīṭukaḷ avvūrkaḷil iruntaṉa. vīṭṭu muṟṟattil mañcaḷ payirāyiruntatu; maṇam nāṟiya pūntōṭṭam piṉṉē iruntatu (pe. ā, paṭai, aṭi, 351-356).
marutanilap pakutiyilētāṉ maṟaiyavar vāḻntu vantaṉar. toṇṭai nāṭṭil avarkaḷ illam oṉṟu irunta nilaiyaip perumpāṇāṟṟup paṭai kūṟukiṟatu. vīṭṭiṉ muṉ puṟam pantal amaintiruntatu. ataṉ ciṟiya kālkaḷuḷ oṉṟil pacukkaṉṟu kaṭṭappaṭṭiruntatu. avvīṭṭaik kōḻiyum nāyum neruṅkavillai. vīṭṭil kiḷi vaḷarkkappaṭṭatu. ataṟku vēta ōcai kaṟpikkappaṭṭatu. (aṭi, 297-300).
maruta nilattil valai vīci mīṉ piṭittu vāḻntavar `valaiyar eṉappaṭṭaṉar. avarkaḷ vañci marak kompukaḷaiyum kāñci marak kompukaḷaiyum kalantu naṭṭu vēḻakkōlai variccāka niraittut tāḻainārāl kaṭṭit taruppaip pullālē vēyappaṭṭa kuṟiya iṟappaiyuṭaiya kuṭilkaḷil vāḻntārkaḷ. avarkaḷ kuṭiliṉ muṟṟattil mīṉai vāri eṭukkum paṟikaḷ iruntaṉa. kuṭilaiyaṭuttu vaḷainta kālaiyuṭaiya puṉṉai marak kompukaḷ amaitta pantar iruntatu. appantaṉmītu curaikkoṭi mutaliya paṭarkoṭikaḷ paṭarntu kāykaḷōṭu viḷaṅkiṉa (pe. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 263-267).
neytal nila illaṅkaḷ
kaṭalum kaṭal cārnta iṭamum `neytal eṉappaṭum. innilattu makkaḷ mīṉ piṭittu vāḻntārkaḷ. kāvirippūmpaṭṭiṉattuk kaṭaṟkaraiyil vāḻnta paratavar, tāḻnta kūraiyaik koṇṭa kuṭilkaḷil vāḻntaṉar. kūraiyil tūṇṭiṟkampukaḷ ceruki vaikkappaṭṭiruntaṉa. kuṭiliṉ muṟṟattil mīṉ paṭikka utaviya valaikaḷ kāya vaikkappaṭṭiruntaṉa.
nakarattu illaṅkaḷ
nakaraṅkaḷil irunta pala vakai illaṅkaḷaip paṟṟiya kuṟippukaḷai aṭuttuk kāṇpōm:
toṇṭai nāṭṭut tuṟaimukappaṭṭiṉam piṟkālattil māmallapuram eṉappeyar koṇṭatākum. atu caṅka kālattil `nīrppeyṟṟu eṉṉum pērūriṉ oru pakutiyāyiruntatu. atu vāṇikat talamāy iruntamaiyiṉ, celvac ceḻumaiyōṭiruntatu. eṉavē, aṅkup pala terukkaḷ iruntaṉa. avaṟṟil irunta vīṭukaḷ māṭaṅkaḷaip peṟṟu uyarntiruntaṉa. `tēvar ulakattait tīṇṭum māṭaṅkaḷ eṉṟu perum pāṇāṟṟuppaṭai āciriyar avvillaṅkaḷaik kuṟittuḷḷār. ammāṭaṅkaḷil pēraṇi kalaṅkaḷai yuṭaiya makaḷir vāḻntaṉar; ammāṭaṅkaḷil pantaṭittu viḷaiyāṭiṉar. ammāḷikaikaḷiṉ muṉ irunta maṇalil ammāṭaṅkaḷukkuriya celva makaḷir amarntu kaḻaṅkāṭiṉar (aṭi, 325-335).
pāṇṭiyaṉ talainakarāṉa maturaiyil irunta cila illaṅkaḷ pala kūṟupāṭukaḷaip peṟṟu vāṉaḷāviyiruntaṉa; teṉṟaṟkāṟṟu olikkum pala cāḷaraṅkaḷaiyuṭai7yaṉa vāyiruntaṉa. `pala kūṟupāṭukaḷ-maṇṭapam, kūṭam, tāykkaṭṭu, aṭukkaḷai eṉṟāṟpōlum peyarkaḷaik koṇṭa illappakutikaḷ eṉpatu, nacciṉārkkiṉiyar tarum viḷakkamākum (ma. kā. aṭi, 357-58). periya māṭaṅkaḷil nilā muṟṟaṅkaḷ amaintiruntaṉa. ammāṭaṅkaḷil koṭikaḷ kaṭṭappaṭṭiruntaṉa (avai avarkaḷ camayattai uṇarttiya koṭikaḷāyirukkalām). maṅkaiyar ammāṭaṅkaḷil irunta nilā muṟṟaṅkaḷil niṉṟu kōvil viḻākkaḷaik kavaṉittaṉar (ma. kā. aṭi, 444-452).
celvar illaṅkaḷil iḷavēṉiṟkālattut tuyilum paṭukkaikkut teṉṟaṟkāṟṟait tarum cālēkam (cāḷaram) iruntatu. celvamakaḷir aṅku niṉṟu ulavuvatu vaḻakkam (neṭunalvāṭai, aṭi, 61-62). piḷḷaikaḷ mūṉṟu uruḷai kaḷaik koṇṭa ciṟu tērai uruṭṭi viḷaiyāṭuvataṟkēṟṟapaṭi celvar vīṭukaḷil akaṉṟa muṟṟam iruntatu (pa. pālai, aṭi, 20-25). maturai nakarattuc celvar illaṅkaḷ akaṉṟiruntaṉa; kāvalaraip peṟṟiruntaṉa; kuṟṟēval iḷaiñaraiyum peṟṟiruntaṉa (neṭunal, 49-50).
kāvirippūmpaṭṭiṉattu maruvūrppākkattil kaṭaṟkaraikku aṇmaiyil uyarnta māṭaṅkaḷaik koṇṭa vaḷamaṉaikaḷ iruntaṉa. avaṟṟil viḷakkukaḷ iravu muḻumaiyum erintukoṇṭiruntaṉa. viṭiyaṟkālaiyil kaṭalil mīṉ piṭikkac ceṉṟa pūmpukārp paratavarukku avviḷakkukaḷ ōraḷavu tuṇai purintaṉa (pa. pālai, aṭi, 112-115).
kāvirippūmpaṭṭiṉattup periya māḷikaikaḷil māṭattiṟkuc cellattakka aṇukiṉa paṭikaḷaiyuṭaiya neṭiya ēṇikaḷ iruntaṉa; pala kaṭṭukaḷ iruntaṉa; periyavāyilum ciṟiyavāyilum iruntaṉa; periya iṭai kaḻikaḷ iruntaṉa. ivvamaippukaḷaiyuṭaiya vaḷamaṉai `maḻai tōyum uyar māṭattai uṭaiyatu eṉṟu āciriyar kūṟiyuḷḷār (pa. pālai, aṭi, 142-145).
ittakaiya vaḷamaṉaikaḷil viruntiṟku vantavar mutalil māṭattut talai vāyilil neruṅkiyiruntaṉar; piṉpu uḷḷē ceṉṟu viruntuṇṭaṉar. ammāṭaṅkaḷiṉ cuvarkaḷ cāntiṭap peṟṟavai; uyarnta tiṇṇaikaḷai uṭaiyavai. attiṇṇai kaḷil kiḷikaḷ kūṇṭukaḷil iruntu vārttaikaḷ pēcikkoṇṭiruntaṉa (pa. pālai, aṭi, 261-264).
aracaṉ kōvil
(maturaiyil) pāṇṭiyarkku araṇmaṉai kaṭṭappaṭṭa viravaṅkaḷ neṭunalvāṭaiyil kīḻ varumāṟu kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa:
kaṭṭaṭam kaṭṭaṟkuriya iṭattil iraṇṭu kōlkaḷ naṭappaṭṭaṉa. akkōlkaḷiṭattuñ cāyā niḻalāl tārai pōka ōṭukiṉṟa nilaiyaik kuṟittukkoḷḷum taṉmai tappātapaṭi cūriyaṉ niḻal oru pakkattaic cārap pōkāta cittiraittiṅkaḷ naṭuvil pattiṉiṉṟa oru nāḷil patiṉaintām nāḻikaiyil kaṭṭaṭattiṟkuriya aṅkurārppaṇam paṇṇap paṭṭatu. ciṟpācāriyar kūritāka nūlai nērē piṭittut ticaikaḷaik kuṟittuk koṇṭārkaḷ. atticaikaḷil niṟkum teyvaṅkaḷaiyum kuṟaivaṟap pārttārkaḷ; aracarkkēṟṟa maṉaikaḷaiyum vāyilkaḷaiyum maṇṭapaṅkaḷ mutaliyavaṟṟaiyum kūṟupaṭuttiṉārkaḷ; vaḷainta uyarnta matilai eḻuppa ēṟpāṭu ceytārkaḷ. matilukku vāyil amaikkappaṭṭatu. avvāyilukku iraṇṭu katavukaḷ poruttappaṭṭaṉa. akkatavukaḷukkuc cevvarakkup pūcappaṭṭatu. vāyiliṉ mēl nilaiyil ilakkumiyiṉ uruvam cetukkappaṭṭiruntatu. avvuruvattiṉ iraṇṭu pakkaṅkaḷilum pakkattiṟkoṉṟāka iṇṭu peṇ yāṉaikaḷ kuvaḷai malarkaḷai ilakkumimītu corital pōṉṟa vāyil nilaiyil ciṟpaṅkaḷ amaikkappaṭṭaṉa. nilaiyil teyvam uṟaivatākat tamiḻar nampiṉarātaliṉ, annilaiyil veṇciṟu kaṭukum neyyum taṭavi vaittaṉar; avvāyil, koṭikaḷōṭu yāṉaikaḷ ceṉṟu pukumpaṭi uyarntiruntatu, malaiyai naṭuvē veḷiyākat tiṟantāṟpōṉṟiruntatu.
araṇmaṉai muṉṟiliṟparappaṭṭa maṇalil kavari māṉkaḷum aṉṉaṅkaḷum iyaṅkiṉa. nilāviṉ payaṉai araṇmaṉaiyiṉar nukarum neṭiya veḷḷiya nilā muṟṟam iruntatu. mēl māṭattil viḻum maḻainīr vantu viḻa makaravāyākap pakutta vāyiṉaiyuṭaiya pantam aṅku iruntatu. ammuṟṟattil mayilkaḷum iruntaṉa. araṇmaṉaiyil yavaṉar tanta pāvai viḷakkukaḷ iravil erintaṉa. antappurattil pala kaṭṭukaḷ iruntaṉa. avaṟṟil pāṇṭiyaṉ nīṅkalāka vēṟu āṭavar nuḻaiyāta nilaiyil ariya kāval iruntatu.
antappurattut tūṇkaḷ nīlamaṇiyaik kaṇṭāṟ pōṉṟa karumaiyiṉaiyum tiraṭciyaiyum uṭaiyavai. cuvarkaḷ cempiṉāl ceytāṟpōṉṟa vēlaippāṭu niṟaintavai. accuvarkaḷmītu vaṭivaḻakiṉaiyuṭaiya pala pūkkaḷaikkoṇṭa vallikkoṭikaḷ ōviyaṅkaḷāy varaiyappaṭṭirunṉa (neṭunalvāṭai, aṭi, 72-114).
mullaippāṭṭil aracaṉatu eḻunilaimāṭam iṭattāl ciṟantu uyarntiruntatu eṉpatu kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷatu (aṭi, 86). iṉṟu tañcāvūr araṇmaṉaiyil uḷḷa eḻunilai māṭattaik koṇṭu, caṅkakāla eḻunilaimāṭam eṅṅaṉam iruntiruttal kūṭum eṉpatai nām oruvāṟu uṇaralām.
ivvivaraṅkaḷ aṉaittum caṅkakālat tamiḻariṉ kaṭṭaṭakkalaiyaṟivai uṇarttuvaṉavākum. nakaraic cūḻntirunta kōṭṭaiccuvariṉ amaippum akaḻiyiṉ amaippum avartam kaṭṭaṭakkalaiyaṟivai mēlum mikuttuk kāṭṭuvaṉavākum.
maturaik kōṭṭaiyaic cūḻntirunta akaḻi, maṇ irunta aḷavum āḻamākat tōṇṭappaṭṭatu; nīlamaṇi pōṉṟa nīr nirampiyatu. kōṭṭai matil, vāṉait toṭumpaṭi pala kaṟpaṭaikaḷōṭu amaintiruntatu. matiliṉ vāyilil valimai mikunta teyva uruvaṅkaḷ amainta uyarnta nilai iruntatu. iṭukku illāmal iṇaikkappaṭṭa katavukaḷ poruttappaṭṭiruntaṉa. ak kōṭṭai vāyiliṉmītu malai pōla uyarnta māṭam amaintiruntatu (ma. kā. aṭi, 351-6).
2. ulōkaṅkaḷ
caṅkakālat tamiḻar, irumpu, cempu, poṉ, veḷḷi ākiya nāṉku ulōkaṅkaḷaik koṇṭu pala poruḷkaḷaic ceytu payaṉpaṭuttiṉar eṉpatu terikiṟatu. ivai ittamiḻ nāṭṭiṟ paṇṭutoṭṭē kiṭaittu vantaṉa eṉpatu pallava puram (pallāvaram), āticcanallūr mutaliya iṭaṅkaḷiṟkiṭaitta putai poruḷkaḷaikkoṇṭu naṉkaṟiyalām.1 iṉi ivai paṟṟip pattuppāṭṭuḷ kāṇappaṭum ceytikaḷaik kāṇpōm:
irumpu
toṇṭai nāṭṭil irumpaṭikkum kollaṉ iruntāṉ. avaṉatu ulaikkūṭam iruntatu. avaṉ vaikaṟaiyiyal taṉ ulaikkūṭattil vēlai ceytāṉ. avaṉ irumpaṭitta ōcai kēṭṭu māṭattu uṟaṅkiya puṟaviṉ cēval añci uṟakkattiliruntu viḻittatu (pe. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 436-40). arivāḷ, irumpu eṉappeyar peṟṟatu (malaipaṭu. aṭi, 113). irumpiṉāl ceyyappaṭṭa viḷakkil eṇṇeyum tiriyum iṭṭu viḷakkēṟṟappaṭṭatu (neṭunal. aṭi, 42-3). irumpu melliya takaṭākkappaṭṭatu (pe. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 222).
cempu
maturaip puṟañcēriyil irunta camaṇap paḷḷiyiṉ cuvarkaḷ cempiṉāṟceytāṟpōla uṟuti peṟṟu viḷaṅkiṉa (ma. kā. aṭi, 485). maturaik kaṭait teruvil cempu niṟuttu vāṅkappaṭṭatu (pe. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 514). pāṇṭiyaṉ araṇmaṉai, antappurattu neṭuñcuvarkaḷ cempiṭṭuc ceytāṟpōṉṟa uṟutiyum vēlaippāṭum peṟṟiruntaṉa (neṭunal. aṭi, 112).
poṉ
poṉ eṉṉum col `polam eṉṟu māṟutaṟkut tolkāppiyattilēyē viti (puḷḷi mayaṅkiyal, nūṟpā, 61) kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷatiliruntu poṉṉiṉ paḻaimaiyai naṉkaṟiyalām. poṉṉil pala vakai uṇṭu. araṇmaṉaiyil poṉṉālāṉa kalaṅkaḷ (pāttiraṅkaḷ) iruntaṉa. polaṅkalaṅkaḷil matu vārttut tarappaṭṭatu (po. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 85-7; ma. kā. aṭi, 779-80). poṟkalattil uṇavu paṭaikkappaṭṭatu (ci. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 244-5). maṉṉar poṉ mālaiyaik kaḻuttil aṇintiruntaṉar (ma. kā. aṭi, 61). tirumāl poṉ mālaiyai aṇintiruntāṉ (ma. kā. aṭi, 590-1). celvamakaḷir talai, kaḻuttu, tōḷ, kai, kātu, iṭai ākiya uṟuppukaḷil aṇinta pala vakai aṇikaḷum kal patitta nakaikaḷum uyarāṭavar aṇinta mālai, kaṭakam pōṉṟa aṇikaḷum poṉṉāl iyaṉṟaṉavēyākum. poṉkoṇṭu ceyyappaṭṭa nakaikaḷiṉ peyarkaḷum poṉṉiṉ vakaiyum `aṇikaḷ eṉṉum pakutiyil virivāyk kāṇalām.
mullaippāṭṭaip pāṭiya pulavar kāvirip pūmpaṭṭiṉattup poṉ vāṇikaṉār makaṉār nappūtaṉār eṉpavar. poṉṉiṉ vēṟupāṭṭaip pakuttaṟintavar poṉ vāṇikar eṉappaṭṭaṉar. avar maturaiyil vāḻntaṉar (ma. kā. aṭi, 513). poṉ nakaikaḷaic ceytavar `poṟkollar eṉappaṭṭaṉar.
veḷḷi
veḷḷiyālāṉa kalam (pāttiram), uṇkalamākavum payaṉpaṭṭatu. atu ciṟiyatāyum iruntatu; periyatāyum iruntatu. ciṟiya veḷḷikkalaṅkaḷ piḷḷaikaḷ uṇavuṇṇap payaṉpaṭṭaṉa. periya veḷḷikalaṅkaḷ periyavarkaḷ uṇavuṇṇap payaṉpaṭṭaṉa. tiraiyaṉ araṇmaṉaiyil ivveḷḷik kalaṅkaḷ iruntaṉa (pe. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 477-80). mullai malarkaḷ veḷḷiyiṉ niṟattai ottavai (ma. kā. aṭi, 280). pāṇṭiyaṉatu araṇmaṉaic cuvaril veḷḷiyai otta cāntu pūcappaṭṭatu (neṭunal. aṭi, 110).
3. pāttiraṅkaḷ
potumakkaḷ taṅkaḷ illaṅkaḷiṟ payaṉpaṭuttiya pāttiraṅkaḷiṉ peyarkaḷ palavākap pattuppāṭṭiṟ kāṇappaṭavillai; araṇmaṉaiyil payaṉpaṭuttiya pāttiraṅkaḷiṉ peyarkaḷum mikutiyākak kāṇappaṭavillai. ciṟcila pāttiraṅkaḷiṉ peyarkaḷē kāṇappaṭukiṉṟaṉa. avaṟṟaiyum vīṭṭup poruḷkaḷ vēṟu cilavaṟṟaiyum iṅkuk kāṇpōm.
puḷiyaṅkāy, nellikkāy mutaliya ūṟukāykaḷ vaikkappaṭṭa miṭā, `kāṭi vaitta kalaṉ (pe. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 56-7) eṉappaṭṭatu. cōṟu camaikkum pāṉai kuḻici eṉap peyar peṟṟatu (pe. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 98, 366). tayirppāṉaikkum ippeyar  vaḻaṅkappaṭṭatu (pe. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 159); appam cuṭap payaṉpaṭṭa caṭṭi, akal (pe. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 377) eṉappaṭṭatu. nīṇṭavuruvamum ciṟutta vāyumuṭaiya pāttiram, kuppi eṉappaṭṭatu. paccai niṟakkuppi paiṅkuṭam eṉappaṭṭatu. ataṉuḷ kaḷ vaippatu vaḻakkam (pe. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 380-82).
kuvinta vāyaiyuṭaiya nīruṇṇum pāttiram `tokuvāyk kaṉṉal eṉap peyar peṟṟatu (neṭu. aṭi, 64-66). nīr peytu vaikkum oru vakaip pāttiram `kuṟunīrkkaṉṉal eṉappaṭṭatu (mul. pāṭṭu, aṭi, 57).
karikālaṉ araṇmaṉaiyil irunta aḻakiya paṇip peṇṭir aracaṉukkum avaṉuṭaiya viruntiṉarkkum poṟkalattil makiḻai (kaḷḷai) ūṟṟik kuṭikkak koṭuttaṉar (po. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 84-87). `poṟkalam-poṉvaṭṭil eṉpatu nacciṉārkkiṉiyar urai.
toṇṭaimāṉ araṇmaṉaiyil pāṇarkkum avar tam piḷḷaikaṭkum viṇmīṉkaḷaip pōṉṟa ciṟiya veḷḷip pāttiraṅkaḷaiyum tiṅkaḷaip pōṉṟa periya veḷḷippāttiraṅkaḷaiyum parappi viruntu vaittaṉar eṉṟu perumpāṇāṟṟuppaṭaiyiṟ kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷatu (aṭi, 477-480). `talaivarāyiṉārkkup poṟkalam parappuvar eṉṟār eṉṟu nacciṉārkkiṉiyar kūṟiyuḷḷār.
pāṇṭiyaṉ talaiyālaṅkāṉattuc ceruveṉṟa neṭuñceḻiyaṉ polaṅkalattil maṇaṅkamaḻ tēṟalaip parukiṉāṉ (ma. kā. aṭi, 779-80).
`polaṅkalam-poṉ vaṭṭil eṉpatu nacciṉārkkiṉiyar urai. itē kalam `peṟalaruṅkalam (po. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 155-57) eṉṟum peyar peṟṟatu. `peṟutaṟkariya poṟkalam eṉpatu nacciṉārkkiṉiyar urai.
nalliyakkōṭaṉ araṇmaṉaiyil pāṇar pōṉṟa viruntiṉarkkum poṟkalam uṇkalamākap payaṉpaṭṭatu (ci. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 241-44).
vāyakaṉṟa tāmpāḷam `malarvāyp piḻā eṉappaṭṭatu. ariciyaik koṇṭu kaḷ tayārittavar ataṉaip payaṉpaṭuttiṉar (pe. ā. paṭai. aṭi, 276). naṉṉaṉatu malai nāṭṭil kaḻaiyil (mūṅkiṟkuḻaiyil) erumaiyiṉ pāl tayirukkākat tōykkappaṭṭatu (malai. aṭi, 523).
kaṭṭiliṉ kāl, pakkam uruṇṭirunta kuṭattai uṭaiya aṭiyaip peṟṟiruntatu (neṭunal. aṭi, 120-2). itaṉāl pakkam uruṇṭirunta kuṭam eṉṉum pāttiram akkālattil iruntamai veḷippaṭai.
nel, varaku mutaliya kūlaṅkaḷai vaikkak kutirkaḷ iruntaṉa (pe. ā,. paṭai, aṭi, 187). irumpu viḷakkum, cantaṉak kallum, ālavaṭṭamum (viciṟiyum) iruntaṉa. (neṭunal. aṭi, 42, 51, 58).
nellaiyum ariciyaiyum cēmittu vaikkap payaṉpaṭṭa poruḷ, mañcikai eṉappaṭṭatu. atu `koṭṭakāram eṉṟu nacciṉārkkiṉiyar kūṟiyuḷḷār. ippeyar iṉṟu malaiyāḷattil koṭṭāram eṉa maruvi vaḻaṅkukiṟatu.
21. uṇavum uṭaiyum
1. uṇavu
muṉṉurai
maṉitaṉ uyir vāḻa iṉṟiyamaiyāta poruḷ uṇavākum. paṇṭai maṉitaṉatu mutal toḻilē uṇavu tēṭalāyiruntatu. avaṉ iyaṟkaiyāyk kiṭaitta kāykaḷaiyum vitaikaḷaiyum kiḻaṅkukaḷaiyum uṇṭāṉ; piṉṉarp paṟavaikaḷaiyum vilaṅkukaḷaiyum vēṭṭaiyāṭi avaṟṟiṉ iṟaicciyaip patappaṭuttāmalē uṇṭu vantāṉ; aṟivum ārāycciyum perukapperukat tīyai uṇṭākka aṟintāṉ; ataṉ piṉṉarētāṉ atukāṟum paccaiyāy uṇṭu vanta poruḷkaḷaip pakkuvappaṭutti uṇṇat toṭaṅkiṉāṉ. uṇavu vāyilākavē camutāya uṇarcciyum vaḷarntatu. kuṭumpattiṉar cērntu payirt toḻilaic ceyyalāyiṉar. immuyaṟciyāl ciṟṟūrkaḷ tōṉṟiṉa. uṇavupporuḷkaḷai uṇṭākki uṇṇum muṟaikaḷ māṟa māṟa, uṇavuṭaṉ cuvaiyum nākarikamum piṟavum vaḷarat toṭaṅkiṉa. camaiyal toḻil oru kalaiyāy māṟiyatu eṉpataṟku `naḷa pākam, `vīmapākam eṉṉum toṭarkaḷē ēṟṟa cāṉṟākum. `vīmapākam pakaṟṟiya kuṟippuc ciṟupāṇāṟṟuppaṭaiyil iṭam peṟṟuḷḷatu. iṉip pattuppāṭṭuḷ kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷa uṇavup poruḷkaḷaik kāṇpōm:
porunar, pāṇar, kūttar eṉṉum kalaivāṇar pēraracaraiyum ciṟṟaracaraiyum kaṇṭu tam kalaikaḷai viḷakkip paricil peṟṟu vāḻntaṉar. maṉṉarkaḷ avarkaḷai iṉiya mukattuṭaṉ varavēṟṟu nalluṭaikaḷaiyum pala vakai uṇṭi vakaikaḷaiyum vaḻaṅki upacarittārkaḷ; vēṇṭiya poruḷutavi purintārkaḷ. kuṟiñci, pālai, mullai, marutam, neytal nilap potumakkaḷum akkalaivāṇarait tammāl iyaṉṟa varai uṇavu tantu upacarittaṉar. ivvivaraṅkaḷ varum iṭaṅkaḷil akkālat tamiḻar uṇavu vakaikaḷ kuṟippiṭappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa. maturaiyil ātular cālai iruntatu. aṅku vaḻaṅkappaṭṭa uṇavu vakaikaḷ maturaikkāñciyil kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa. ivaṟṟuṭaṉ pala kuṭi vakaikaḷum kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa. iṉi ivai paṟṟiya vivaraṅkaḷaik kīḻē kāṇpōm:
kuṟiñci nilattār uṇavu
cōḻanāṭṭuk kuṟiñcinila makkaḷ tēṉaiyum kiḻaṅkaiyum uṇṭārkaḷ; piṟa nilattārkkum viṟṟu mīṉ neyyaiyum naṟavaiyum vāṅkic ceṉṟārkaḷ (po. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 214-215). ciṟappu nāḷkaḷil ney mikka uṇavu uṭkoḷḷappaṭṭatu (ku. pāṭṭu. aṭi, 304).
naṉṉaṉukkuriya cavvātu malaiyiṉ aṭivārattil irunta ciṟṟūrkaḷil vāḻnta makkaḷ tiṉaiccōṟum neyyil venta iṟaicciyum uṇṭārkaḷ (malaipaṭukaṭām, aṭi, 168-169).
naṉṉaṉuṭaiya malaikaḷaic cērnta kuṟiñci nilattār, peṇ nāy kaṭitta uṭumpiṉ iṟaicciyaiyum kaṭamāṉ iṟaicciyaiyum paṉṟi iṟaicciyaiyum uṇṭaṉar; nellāṟcamaitta kaḷḷaiyum tēṉāṟceytu mūṅkiṟ kuḻaiyuḷ muṟṟiya kaḷḷaiyum parukiṉar; palākkoṭṭai, mā, puḷinīr, mōr ākiya ivaṟṟaik koṇṭu tayāritta kuḻampaiyum, mūṅkil aricic cōṟṟaiyum uṇṭaṉar (malaipaṭukaṭām, aṭi, 171-183); malai nāṭṭaik kāval purinta vīrar iṟaicciyaiyum kiḻaṅkaiyum uṇṭaṉar (aṭi, 425-426). malaimītu naṭantu ceṉṟa kūttar, tiṉaippuṉattuk kāvalaṉāl kollappaṭṭa kāṭṭup paṉṟiyiṉ mayiraip pōkki mūṅkil paṟṟiyeriyum neruppil vatakki, appaṉṟiyiṉ iṟaicciyait tiṉṟaṉar; tiṉṟu, eñciya pakutiyai vaḻiyuṇaviṟkāka eṭuttuc ceṉṟaṉar (aṭi, 243-249).
pālai nilattār uṇavu
ōymāṉāṭṭup pālai nila makkaḷāṉa vēṭṭuvar, iṉiya puḷiṅkaṟiyiṭappaṭṭa cōṟṟaiyum āmāviṉ cūṭṭiṟaicciyaiyum uṇṭaṉar (ci. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 175-177). toṇṭai nāṭṭup pālainila makkaḷ pullariciyaic cērttu nilavuraliṟ kuṟṟic camaitta uṇavai uppukkaṇṭattōṭu uṇṭārkaḷ; viruntiṉarkkut tēkkilaiyil uṇavu paṭaittārkaḷ (pe. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 95-100); mēṭṭu nilattil viḷainta īccaṅkoṭṭai pōṉṟa nellaricic cōṟṟaiyum uṭumpiṉ poriyalaiyum uṇṭārkaḷ (pe. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 130-133).
mullai nilattār uṇavu
toṇṭai nāṭṭu mullai nilattār pālaiyum tiṉaiyaricic cōṟṟaiyum uṇṭaṉar (pe. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 167-168); mullai nilac cīṟūrkaḷil iruntavar varakaricic cōṟum avaraip paruppum kalantu ceyta `kummāyam eṉap peyar peṟṟa uṇavai uṇṭaṉar (pe. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 192-195).
naṉṉaṉatu malai nāṭṭu mullai nilattār civanta avarai vitaikaḷaiyum mūṅkil ariciyaiyum mēṭṭu nilattil viḷainta nelliṉ ariciyaiyum puḷi karaikkappaṭṭa ulaiyiṟpeytu, kuḻainta puḷiyaṅkūḻākki uṭkoṇṭaṉar (aṭi, 434-436). poṉṉai naṟukkiṉāṟpōṉṟa nuṇṇiya orē aḷavuṭaiya ariciyai veḷḷāṭṭu iṟaicciyuṭaṉ kūṭṭi ākkiya cōṟṟaiyum tiṉaimāvaiyum uṇṭaṉar (aṭi, 440-445).
maruta nilattār uṇavu
cōḻanāṭu cōṟṟu vaḷam mikuntatu; nalla kāy kaṟikaḷ mikkatu. ātaliṉ, cōṇāṭṭār nalla aricic cōṟṟaiyum kāykaṟikaḷaiyum nirampa uṇṭiruttal vēṇṭum. āyiṉum, cilavē innūluḷ kuṟikkappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa. marutanila makkaḷ karumpum avalum kuṟiñci nilattārkkuk koṭuttu, māṉ tacaiyaiyum kaḷḷaiyum peṟṟukkoṇṭaṉar eṉpatu porunar āṟṟuppaṭaiyil kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷatu (aṭi, 216-217).
ōymāṉāṭṭu marutanilattār veṇcōṟṟaiyum naṇṭum pīrkkaṅkāyum kalanta kalavaiyai (kūṭṭai)yum uṇṭaṉar (ci. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 193-195). toṇṭai nāṭṭu maruta nilattuc ciṟu piḷḷaikaḷ (kālaiyil) paḻaiya cōṟṟai uṇṭaṉar; avalai iṭittu uṇṭaṉar (pe. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 223-226); toṇṭai nāṭṭu marutanilattār neṟcōṟṟaip peṭṭaikkōḻip poriyalōṭu uṇṭaṉar (pe. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 254-256). toṇṭai nāṭṭut tōppukkuṭikaḷ palāppaḻam, iḷanīr, vāḻaippaḻam, nuṅku, vaḷḷikkiḻaṅku, cōṟu mutaliyavaṟṟai uṇṭaṉar (aṭi, 356-366).
neytal nilattār uṇavu
ōymāṉāṭṭu neytal nilattār nuḷaicci aritta kaḷḷaiyum ularnta kuḻal mīṉiṉ cūṭṭiṟaicciyaiyum uṭkoṇṭaṉar (ci. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 156-163). toṇṭai nāṭṭup paṭṭiṉattil (ikkāla māmalla purattil) nellaiyiṭitta māvākiya uṇavai āṇ paṉṟikku iṭṭuk koḻukka vaittaṉar; aṅṅaṉam koḻutta āṇ paṉṟiyaik koṉṟu ataṉ iṟaicciyaic camaittu uṇṭaṉar; kaḷippu mikunta kaḷḷaipparukiṉar (pe. ā. paṭai, 339-345).
kāvirippūmpaṭṭiṉattu mīṉavar kaṭal iṟā, vayal āmai ākiya iraṇṭaiyum pakkuvam ceytu uṇṭaṉar (pa. pālai, aṭi, 63-64); paṉaṅkaḷḷai uṭkoṇṭaṉar (aṭi, 89); nellaricik kaḷḷaiyum parukiṉar (aṭi, 93). kaḷḷukkaṭaiyil mīṉ iṟaicciyum vilaṅku iṟaicciyum porikkappaṭṭu viṟkappaṭṭaṉa (aṭi, 176-178).
maṟaiyavar uṇavu
pāṟcōṟu, paruppuccōṟu, ākuti paṇṇutaṟku ēṟṟa irācāṉṉam eṉṉum nelliṉcōṟu, miḷakiṉ poṭiyuṭaṉ kalakkappaṭṭuk karuvēppilai iṭappaṭṭup pacuneyyiṟ kiṭantu venta kommaṭṭi mātuḷaṅkāy, māvaṭu ūṟukāy eṉpavaṟṟait toṇṭai nāṭṭu maṟaiyavar uṇṭaṉar 
(pe. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 304-310).
araṇmaṉaikaḷil viruntu
cōḻanāṭṭu maṉṉaṉāṉa karikālaṉ taṉṉai nāṭi vanta porunaṉukkum avaṉaic cērntavarkkum uṇavaḷitta tiṟam porunar āṟṟuppaṭaiyil piṉ varumāṟu pēcappaṭṭuḷḷatu:
porunar araṇmaṉaiyai aṭaintavuṭaṉ paṇip peṇṭir, parukiyavarai mayaṅkac ceyyum makiḻai (kaḷḷai)p poṟkalaṅkaḷil vārttut tantaṉar (aṭi, 84-88). porunar ataṉai uṇṭu, vanta kaḷaippaip pōkkikkoṇṭaṉar. koḻutta cemmaṟikkiṭāyiṉ iṟaiccittuṇṭaṅkaḷ cila, irumpuk kampiyil kōttuc cuṭappaṭṭaṉa; vēṟu cila iṟaicci vakaikaḷ, vēkavaikkappaṭṭaṉa; pala vaṭivaṅkaḷil amaitta palvēṟu iṉippuc cuvaiyuṭaiya paṇṇiyāraṅkaḷ (tiṉpaṇṭaṅkaḷ) vaikkappaṭṭaṉa. mullai arumpai otta melliya ariciccōṟum paṭaikkappaṭṭatu. pālaikkāycci ataṉōṭu kūṭṭiṉa porikkaṟikaḷum vaikkappaṭṭaṉa (aṭi, 103-116). piriyā viṭai peṟumpoḻutu iṉiyapū (kuṅkumappū) maṇakkiṉṟa tēṟal (kaḷ teḷivu) parukat tarappaṭṭatu (aṭi, 157).
ōymāṉāṭṭut talaivaṉāṉa nalliyakkōṭaṉ araṇmaṉaiyil pāṇarkkup pāmpu viṭam ēṟi mayakkiṉāṟpōla mayakkattai uṇṭākkum tēṟal (kaḷ teḷivu) tarappaṭṭatu; vīmacēṉaṉ varainta camaiyaṟkalai nūliṟkaṇṭapaṭi uṇavup poruḷkaḷ tayārikkappaṭṭup poṟkalaṅkaḷil paṭaikkappaṭṭaṉa (ci. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 237-244).
toṇṭai nāṭṭut talaivaṉāṉa iḷantiraiyaṉ eṉpāṉatu kāñci mānakarattu araṇmaṉaiyil camaiyalil vallōṉ pala iṟaicci vakaikaḷait tayārittāṉ; cenceṟcōṟṟai vaṭittāṉ; kaṇṭa carukkaraiyōṭu aṭicilai (carukkaraip poṅkal?) ākkiṉāṉ. iṅṅaṉam vallōṉāl ākkappaṭṭa palavakai uṇavupporuḷkaḷ pāṇar piḷḷaikaḷukkuc ciṟiya veḷḷikkalaṅkaḷilum periyavarkaḷukkup periya veḷḷikkalaṅkaḷilum paṭaikkappaṭṭaṉa. (pe. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 471-480).
naṉṉaṉ talainakarāṉa ceṅkaṇmāttu araṇmaṉaiyil, peṇ nāy kaṭittuk koṇarnta paciya niṇattaiyuṭaiya tacaikaḷum veṇṇey aricic cōṟum kūttarkkup paṭaikkappaṭṭaṉa (malai, 563-566).
maturaiyil uṇavu
`pīṭu māṭamaturaiyil vāḻnta pāṇar koḻuviya iṟaicci vakaikaḷait tiṉṟaṉar; pala vakaic cōṟṟai veṟuttuk kaḷḷai mikutiyākap parukiṉar. eṉpatu maturaikkāñciyil kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷatu (aṭi, 210-213). maturaiyil pala vakaic cōṟukaḷ tayārikkappaṭṭaṉa eṉpatu itaṉāl terikiṟataṉṟō? ikkālattil veṇcōṟu, ūṉ cōṟu (ikkālap pulāl piriyāṇi pōṉṟatu), puḷiccōṟu, tayirccōṟu, carukkaraip poṅkal, veṇpoṅkal eṉappaṭum cōṟṟu vakaikaḷ akkālattilum iruntaṉa eṉṟu karutalām.
teṉpāṇṭi nāṭṭup paratavar (mīṉavar), koḻutta iṟaicciyuṭṭuc camaikkappaṭṭa cōṟṟaic ciṟappāka uṇṭaṉar eṉṟu maturaikkāñci kūṟukiṟatu (aṭi, 141).
pāṇṭiyar talainakarāṉa maturaiyil ēḻaikaḷukkuc cōṟiṭum cālaikaḷ (ātular cālaikaḷ) iruntaṉa. avaṟṟil irunta eḷiyarvarkkup palāccuḷai, māmpaḻam, vāḻaippaḻam, muntirikaippaḻam, pākaṟkāy, vāḻaikkāy, vaḻutuṇaṅkāy (nīṇṭa kattarikkāy) mutaliya (camaitta) kāykaḷ, pala vakai ilaikkaṟikaḷ, iṉippup paṇṭaṅkaḷ, iṟaicci kalanta cōṟu, (pakkuvappaṭuttappaṭṭa) palavakaik kiḻaṅkukaḷ, pāṟcōṟu, pāl eṉpavai paṭaikkappaṭṭaṉa (ma. kā. aṭi, 527-535).
pāṇṭi nāṭṭil viḻā naṭaipeṟṟa iṭaṅkaḷil viḻākkāṇa vantavarkkellām cōṟu paṭaittal akkāla vaḻakkam (ma. kā. aṭi, 201-203).
pulāl aṟṟa uṇavu
perumpāṇaṉ toṇṭai nāṭṭil vētiyar vīṭṭil irācāṉṉam, mātuḷampiñcaip piḷantu miḷakup poṭiyum karuvēppilaiyum kalantu pacu veṇṇeyilē vēkavaitta poriyal mutaliyaṉa kiṭaikkum eṉṟu kūṟiṉāṉē tavirap pulāl kiṭaikkum eṉṟu kūṟavillai (pe. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 304-310). eṉavē, caṅkakāla vētiyar illaṅkaḷil pulāl uṇavu camaikkappaṭavillai eṉṟu karutalām.
kaṭaṟkaraippaṭṭiṉattiliruntu kaccikkuc cellum vaḻiyil irunta tōppukaḷil vāḻnta uḻavar illaṅkaḷil palāppaḻam, vāḻaippaḻam, iḷanīr, nuṅku, kiḻaṅkukaḷ ākiyavai uṇavākak kiṭaikkum eṉṟē apperumpāṇaṉ kūṟiyuḷḷāṉ. iṅkum avaṉ pulāl uṇavaik kuṟikkavillai eṉpatu kavaṉikkattakum (aṭi, 351-362). itaṉāl pulāl uṇṇāta vēḷāḷarum toṇṭai nāṭṭil iruntaṉar eṉṟu karutalām.
iṅṅaṉamē kāvirippūmpaṭṭiṉattil vāḻnta vēḷāḷar, kolai ceyyātavar; kaḷavu ceyyātavar; tēvarkaḷai vaṇaṅkiṉar; avarkaḷukku vēḷviyil āvuti koṭuttaṉar; pacukkaḷaiyum erutukaḷaiyum pātukāttaṉar; vētiyar pukaḻaip paravac ceytaṉar; ēḻaikaḷukkup pala paṇṭaṅkaḷaik koṭuttaṉar; ciṟanta nalloḻukkattaip piṉpaṟṟi naṭantaṉar (pa. pālai, aṭi, 109-205).
ūṟukaṟi
kuṭumpattuṭaṉ uppai vaṇṭikaḷil ēṟṟi ūr ūrāyc ceṉṟu vāṇikam ceytuvanta umaṇar, ūṟukāyppāṉai kaḷait tam vaṇṭikaḷil kaṭṭiyiruntaṉar. ūṟukāy, `kāṭi eṉappaṭṭatu. atu vaikkappaṭṭirunta pāttiram `kāṭi vaitta kalam eṉappaṭṭatu. `puḷiyaṅ kāy, nellikkāy mutaliyaṉa ūṟaviṭṭu vaittataṉaik `kāṭi eṉṟār, eṉpatu nacciṉārk kiṉiyar viḷakkam.
ciṟṟuṇṭi
kūviyar (appavāṇikar) `kariya caṭṭiyil pākuṭaṉē vēṇṭuvaṉa kūṭṭi nūlpōla amaittavaṭṭam (ikkāla iṭiyāppam pōṉṟatu) oru vakaic ciṟṟuṇṭiyeṉap perumpāṇāṟṟuppaṭaiyil kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷatu. (aṭi, 377-378). maturai nakarak kaṭaitteruvil ciṟṟuṇṭik kaṭaikaḷ iruntaṉa. avaṟṟiṟ pākil camaittal amainta nalla varikaḷaiyuṭaiya tēṉiṟālaip pōṉṟa melliya aṭaikaḷ ceyyappaṭṭaṉa; paruppaiyum tēṅkāyaiyum uḷḷīṭāyk koṇṭa kaṇṭa carukkarai kūṭṭipiṭitta `mōtakam1 eṉṟa oru vakait tiṉpaṇṭamum ceyyappaṭṭatu. iṉiya pākōṭu cērttuk karaitta māvaik koṇṭu kūviyar pala ciṟṟuṇṭi vakaikaḷaic ceytaṉar (ma. kā. aṭi, 624-627).
kuṭi vakai
aracaṉ mutal āṇṭi īṟāka aṉaivarumē akkālattil kuṭippaḻakkam uṭaiyavarāyiruntaṉar. āyiṉ, avaravar tarattiṟkut takkapaṭi kuṭi vakai vēṟupaṭṭiruntatu. pūntēṉaik koṇṭu oru vakaik kuṭi ceyyappaṭṭatu; vēṟu vakait tēṉaik koṇṭum kuṭi vakai tayārikkappaṭṭatu. iḵtu ikkāla `carpattup pōṉṟateṉṉalām. teṉṉaṅkaḷ, paṉaṅkaḷ, aricik kaḷ eṉappalavakaik kuṭivakaikaḷ vaḻakkil iruntaṉa. kaḷ mūṅkiṟ kuḻaiyil ūṟṟi muṟṟacceytum parukappaṭṭatu. mēṉāṭukaḷiliruntu yavaṉarāl iṟakkumati ceyyappaṭṭa kuṭi vakaiyum iruntatu. eḷiya makkaḷ mutal, nāṭāṇṭa maṉṉaṉ varaiyil ikkuṭiyil īṭupaṭṭiruntamaiyāl, avarkaḷ uṇavil ikkuṭi vakai ciṟappiṭam peṟṟiruntatu eṉṉalām. ovvoru kuṭivakaiyum pulavarāl taṉittaṉiyē ciṟappikkappaṭṭuḷḷatu.
kuṟiñci nilattār, neṭiya mūṅkilarici koṇṭu tayārikkappaṭṭa kaḷḷiṉ teḷivaip parukiṉar; tēṉaik koṇṭu tayāritta kaḷḷai mūṅkiṟkuḻaiyuḷ iṭṭu muṟṟac ceytu parukiṉar. ikkaḷ tēkkaḷ tēṟal eṉappaṭṭatu (muruku. aṭi, 195).
illaṅkaḷil nellaikkoṇṭum piṟaporuḷkaḷaik koṇṭum kaḷ camaikkappaṭṭatu.
illaṭu kaḷiṉ tōppi 2 paruki
eṉpatu perumpāṇāṟṟuppaṭaiyil uḷḷa (aṭi, 142) toṭarākum. itaṟku, `tamatu illiṟ camaitta kaḷḷukaḷil iṉitākiya nellāṟceyta kaḷḷaiyuṇṭu eṉṟu nacciṉārk kiṉiyar urai varaintuḷḷār (pe. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 142). maturai māvaṭṭattil toppi (tōppi) nel eṉa oru vakaiyuṇṭu. ittōpappi ariciyaik koṇṭu tayārikkappaṭṭa kaḷ `tōppi eṉap peyar peṟṟatu pōlum!
toṇṭai nāṭṭu valaiyar kaḷḷai eṅṅaṉam tayārittaṉar eṉpataip perumpāṇāṟṟuppaṭai kīḻvarumāṟu kūṟukiṟatu:
valaiyar mutalil kuṟṟāta koḻiyal ariciyaik kaḷiyākat tuḻāvik kūḻait tayārittu, ataṉai vāykaṉṟa taṭṭuppiḻāyil (tāmpāḷattil) ulara āṟṟuvar; nelmuṉaiyai iṭittu akkūḻiṟ kalappar; akkalavaiyai iraṇṭu pakalum iraṇṭu iravum ariyāmal cāṭiyil vaippar; atu naṉku muṟṟiya piṉpu viralālē alaittu arippar; aṅṅaṉam arikkappaṭum kaḷ vevviya nīrmaiyai uṭaiyatāka irukkum. iṅṅaṉam tayārikkappaṭṭa kaḷ `naṟumpiḻi eṉappaṭṭatu (pe. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 275-281).
maturai nakaril vāḻnta milēccar (yavaṉar mutaliya veḷi nāṭṭavar) vaṇṭukaḷ moykkum kaḷḷaip paruki makiḻntaṉar. akkaḷ `vaṇṭu mūcutēṟal eṉappaṭṭatu (ma. kā. aṭi, 33).
cōḻanāṭṭut tuṟaimukanakaramāṉa kāvirip pūmpaṭṭiṉattup paratavar paṉaṅkaḷḷaip parukiṉar. atu `peṇṇaip piḻi eṉap peyar peṟṟatu (pa. pālai, aṭi, 89). peṇṇai-paṉaimaram, kāvirippūmpaṭṭiṉattuc celva makaḷir maṭṭu eṉṉum peyar koṇṭa oruvakaik kaḷḷaiyum parukiṉar (pa. pālai, aṭi, 108). `maṭṭu-kaḷ eṉpatu nacciṉārkakkiṉiyar urai. āyiṉ, piṉṉūlāṉa cintāmaṇiyil `maṭṭu-kāmapāṉam eṉṟu nacciṉārkkiṉiyarē (ce. 98 urai) poruḷ kūṟiyuḷḷār. mēlē kūṟappeṟṟa celva makaḷir `matu eṉap peyar koṇṭa oru vakaik kaḷḷaiyum parukiṉar. `matu-kāmapāṉam eṉpatu nacciṉārkkiṉiyar urai (pa. pālai, 108). accelva makaḷir irākkālattil kaṇavarōṭu iṉpuṟap paṭṭāṭaikaḷai nīkkip parutti yāṭaikaḷai aṇintaṉar; `maṭṭu nīkki matu makiḻntaṉar, eṉṟu paṭṭiṉappālai āciriyar kūṟutalaikkāṇa, `maṭṭu eṉpatu cātāraṇa iṉcuvaippāṉam1 eṉṟum, ataṉāl ataṉai nīkki, vēṭkaiyait tūṇṭum `matu eṉṉum kāmapāṉattai2 uṭkoṇṭaṉar eṉṟum koḷvatu poruttamākum.
naṉṉaṉatu malai nāṭṭu makkaḷ, tēṉāl tayārikkappaṭṭa kaḷḷai mūṅkiṟkuḻaiyuḷ viṭṭu muṟṟa viṭṭup piṉpu ataṉ teḷivaip parukiṉārkaḷ eṉṟu malaipaṭu kaṭām kūṟukiṉṟatu. akkaḷḷiṉ teḷivu `tēkkaḷ tēṟal eṉappaṭṭatu (aṭi, 171, 522), iṅṅaṉam tēṉāṟceyta kaḷḷiṉ teḷivai mūṅkiṟ kuḻaiyil muṟṟa viṭṭup parukutal malaināṭṭār paḻakkam eṉṟu tirumurukāṟṟuppaṭaiyum
nī kaṭamai viḷainta tēkkaḷ tēṟal (aṭi, 195)
eṉat terivikkiṟatu.
naṉṉaṉatu malaināṭṭār vaikkum viruntil kalantu koḷpavar uṭumpu, kaṭamāṉ, paṉṟi ākiyavaṟṟiṉ patappaṭuttappaṭṭa iṟaiccit tuṇṭaṅkaḷai uṇṭu koṇṭē iṭaiyil mēlē collappaṭṭa tēkkaḷ tēṟalaip parukuvar; iṟutiyil naṟavu eṉṉum oru vakaik kaḷḷaiyum parukuvar eṉṟu āciriyar nacciṉārkkiṉiyar kūṟiyuḷḷār (malai. aṭi, 171-177). eṉavē, tēkkaḷ tēṟal vēṟu, naṟavu vēṟu eṉpatu teḷivākiṟatu. `naṟavu-nellāṟ camaitta kaḷ eṉpatu nacciṉārkkiṉiyar urai. malaipaṭukaṭām ceyyappaṭṭu ēṟattāḻat toḷḷāyiram āṇṭukaṭkup piṉpu tōṉṟiya takkayākap paraṇiyil, naṟavukoḷ makaḷir-kāmapāṉam ceyyum vāmamārkkap peṇkaḷ eṉpatu varaiyap peṭṭuḷḷatu (kaṇṇi, 24, urai). kampar tamatu irāmāyaṇattuḷ,
	kāmam varuntiya payirkku nīrpōl
arunaṟa(vu) aruntu vārai
			(ūrtēṭupaṭalam, ce. 107)
eṉṟu kuṟittuḷḷār. iṅkum naṟavu eṉpatu kāma pāṉattaiyē kuṟikkiṟatu eṉṉalām.
eṉavē, mēlē collappaṭṭa matu eṉpatum iṅkuc collappaṭṭa naṟavu eṉpatum kāmapāṉam eṉpatu iṅku aṟiyattakum.
karikālaṉ araṇmaṉaiyil parukappaṭṭa kaḷ `makiḻ1 (po. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 84) eṉavum, `makiḻ patam (makiḻcci viḷaikkum kaḷ) eṉavum peyar peṟṟatu (po. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 111); kuṅkumappū maṇattaiyuṭaiya kaḷḷiṉ teḷivu `pūkkamaḻ tēṟal eṉappaṭṭatu (aṭi, 157); pāṇṭiyaṉ taṉ araṇ maṉaiyil parukiyatu `maṇam kamaḻ tēṟal (aṭi, 780) eṉappaṭṭatu. atu poṉ vaṭṭilil tarappaṭṭatu. `maṇaṅkamaḻ tēṟal eṉṟataṉāṟ kāmapāṉamāyiṟṟu eṉpatu nacciṉārk kiṉiyar viḷakkam.
itukāṟum kūṟappaṭṭa pala kuṭi vakaikaḷai nōkka, kaḷ eṉpatu maṭṭu, matu, naṟavu, tēṟal eṉappala vakaippaṭṭatu eṉpatum, ivai tēṉ koṇṭum, nellaricikoṇṭum, paḻaṅkaḷ koṇṭum, teṉṉai, paṉai maraṅkaḷiṉ cāṟukoṇṭum tayārikkappaṭṭaṉa eṉpatum, ivaṟṟuṭcila mūṅkiṟkuḻaiyilum piṟa pāttiraṅkaḷilum iṭṭu muṟṟac ceytu parukappaṭṭaṉa eṉpatum, araṇmaṉai viruntukaḷil kuṅkumappū iṭṭu maṇamēṟiya pūṅkamaḻ tēṟal parukappaṭṭatu eṉpatum, ikkuṭi vakaikaḷ makkaḷ vāḻkkaittarattiṟku ēṟpa vēṟupaṭṭaṉa eṉpatum teḷiyalām.
teṉṉai marattiliruntum paṉaimarattiliruntum iṟakkappaṭṭup patappaṭuttappaṭum nīr ikkālattil `patanīr eṉṉum peyaril viṟkappaṭukiṟataṉṟō? annīr uṭampil kuḷircciyai uṇṭupaṇṇukiṟatu; kaḷaippaip pōkkukiṟatu; cuṟucuṟuppai uṇṭākkukiṟatu eṉṟu nāṭṭu maruttuvarum ataṉaip parukuvōrum kūṟukiṉṟaṉar. ippatanīrkkut `tēṟal (kaḷḷiṉ teḷivu) eṉṉum peyar poruttamēyākum. itaṉai evarum kuṟainta celavil parukalām; celvar itiṟ kuṅkumappū mutaliya maṇapporuḷkaḷaik kalantu maṇam mikac ceytu parukuvatum uṇṭu. ittakaiya tēṟalē caṅka kālap pulavar - pāṇar - kūttar - aracar - celvar mutaliyōr cātāraṇamākap parukiṉar eṉpatu poruntum.
ittēṟal, `pūkkamaḻ tēṟal, `maṇaṅkamaḻ tēṟal eṉṟu ciṟappikkappaṭṭatu. iḵtu araṇmaṉai aḻakikaḷāl poṟkalaṅkaḷil nirappu maṉṉaṉukkum viruntiṉarkkum tarappaṭṭatu. māṅkuṭi marutaṉār eṉṟa pulavar perumāṉ pāṇṭiyaṉai nōkki,
	viḷaṅkiḻai makaḷir polaṅkalat tēntiya
maṇaṅkamaḻ tēṟal maṭuppa nāḷum
makiḻntiṉi tuṟaimati peruma!
varaintunī peṟṟa nallū ḻiyaiyē.
									(ma. kā. aṭi, 779-783).
eṉṟu uḷamāra vāḻttiṉar eṉpatai nōkka, it tēṟal tīmaiyaic ceyyātatu eṉpatum, itu maṉṉarkku iṉṟiyamaiyāta kuṭivakai eṉpatum naṉku pulaṉākum.
cila āṇṭukaḷukku muṉpu varai kaḷḷukkaṭaikaḷil viṟkappaṭṭa mayakkantarum kaḷ vakaiyum caṅkakālattil uḻaippāḷikaḷāl uṭkoḷḷappaṭṭatu eṉpatum poruttamākum. ikkāla `pirānti, viki, pōṉṟa mayakkantarum uyarnta kuṭivakaikaḷē kāmapāṉam eṉṟu karutappaṭṭa `matu, naṟavu eṉap peyar koṇṭavai eṉṉalām.


2. uṭai
muṉṉurai
makkaḷ paṇṭaikkālattil mutaṉmutal āṭaiyiṉṟi iruntārkaḷ; piṉpu kālappōkkil taḻaikaḷaiyum marappaṭṭaikaḷiyum uṭaikaḷāka uṭukkat toṭaṅkiṉārkaḷ; vilaṅkukaḷiṉ tōlkaḷaiyum payaṉpaṭuttiṉārkaḷ; necavuttoḻilaik kaṇṭaṟinta piṉpē parutti āṭaikaḷaiyum paṭṭāṭaikaḷaiyum neyyat toṭaṅki ṉārkaḷ. makkaḷatu aṟivu vaḷara vaḷara, vacatikaḷ perukap peruka, avarkaḷuṭaiya vāḻkkai-vīṭu mutaliya palavaṟṟilum uyarntāṟpōlavē, uṭai vakaiyilum uyaralāyiṟṟu.
necavuttoḻil naṭaipeṟāta iṭaṅkaḷil iṉṟum taḻaikaḷum marappaṭṭaikaḷum tōlkaḷum āṭaikaḷākap payaṉpaṭukiṉṟaṉa. āppirikkāvil nilanaṭukkōṭṭaiyaṭutta iṭaṅkaḷil āṭavar, maravuriyai uṭukkiṉṟaṉar. peṇṭir, paṉai ōlaikaḷālākiya ciṟu pāvāṭaiyai aṇikiṉṟaṉar. pāliṉīciyāvil āṭavar, maravuriyai uṭukkiṉṟaṉar; peṇṭir, marappaṭṭaiyālākiya pāvāṭai allatu vakirntu piṉṉiya ilaiyālākiya āṭaikaḷai aṇikiṉṟaṉar. ātirēliyap paḻaṅkuṭikaḷ marappaṭṭaiyālākiya oru kaccaiyai uṭukkiṉṟārkaḷ. āppirikkāvi luḷḷa putar makkaḷ, mukkōṇa vaṭivamāṉa oru tōlai kālkaḷukkiṭaiyil kōttu, iṭuppaic cuṟṟi muṭintukoḷkiṉṟārkaḷ. avarkaḷuṭaiya peṇṭir oru kaccaiyai aṇikiṉṟaṉar. vaṭivamerikka intiyar āṭṭuttōlkaḷaiyum māṭṭuttōlkaḷaiyum uṭukkiṉṟaṉar.
mucukkaṭṭai, atti, īrappalāvaip pōṉṟa cila maraṅkaḷiṉ uṭpaṭṭaikaḷ taṇṇīril ūṟavaittu, maraccuttiyāl taṭṭi mirutuvākkappaṭum. appaṭṭai takaṭu pōṉṟu irukkum. ataṟku niṟam koṭukkappaṭum; allatu ōviyattāl aḻakupaṭuttappaṭum. atu pārvaikku neyta tuṇi pōla irukkum. pāliṉīciyāvil ittakaiya maravurikaḷ ciṟappiṭam peṟukiṉṟaṉa. aṅkup paḻaṅkuṭikaḷ ciṟappuc caṭaṅkukaḷiṉ pōtu ataṉai iṉṟum uṭukkiṉṟārkaḷ. pōrṉiyōvil uḷḷa kāyāṉkaḷum peljiyaṉ kāṅkōviluḷḷa nīkirōp peṇkaḷum varuttak kālaṅkaḷil maravuriyai aṇikiṉṟārkaḷ.1
ciṟpaccāṉṟu
caṅka kālattil taḻaiyuṭai, maravuri, paruttiyālum paṭṭālumākiya āṭaikaḷ, kaccai eṉpaṉa vaḻakkiliruntaṉa eṉpatu piṉ varum pattuppāṭṭuc cāṉṟukaḷaik koṇṭu aṟiyalām. pattuppāṭṭiṉ kālam ēṟattāḻak kiṟituvukkup piṟpaṭṭa mutal mūṉṟu nūṟṟāṇṭukaḷ eṉpatu muṉpē kūṟappaṭṭataṉṟō? akkālattil potuvāka intiyāvilum ciṟappākat takkaṇattilum irunta āṭai vakaikaḷai akkālac ciṟpaṅkaḷaikkoṇṭu ōraḷavu aṟiyalām.
āntira nāṭṭu amarāvatiyilum jakkayyapēṭṭaiyilum kiṭaitta ciṟpaṅkaḷ cila, akkāla āṭavar talaippākai, muḻaṅkāl varai toṅkum curukkaṅkaḷuḷḷa āṭai, pūvēlai koṇṭa iṭaikkaccai, atiliruntu toṅkum taitta ciṟu tuṇṭu ākiyavaṟṟai aṇintiruntaṉar eṉpatu acciṟpaṅkaḷāl terikiṟatu. peṇṭir muḻaṅkāl varaiyil toṅkum puṭaivaikaḷai uṭuttaṉar; talaikku nāṟcaturamāṉa tuṇikaḷāl palavakai muṭiccukaḷaic ceytu aṇintu vantaṉar eṉpatai acciṟpaṅkaḷ uṇarttukiṉṟaṉa. ciṟpaṅkaḷiṉ kālam ki. mu. 200-ki. pi. 100 ākum.
ki. pi. 100 mutal ki. pi. 400 varaiyil eṉṟu kaṇikkappaṭṭa kālattaic cērnta ciṟpaṅkaḷum kiṭaittuḷḷaṉa. akkāla āṭavar, vēṭṭiyum, mēlāṭaiyum, talaippākaiyum aṇintiruntaṉar. makaḷir, araiyil puṭaivaiyaiyum mēlē cila camayaṅkaḷilē ciṟiya tuṇṭaiyum aṇintaṉar; talaiyil talaippākaipōlavum vēṟu vakaiyilum tuṇi kaṭṭiṉar. muṟukkiṭṭa āṭaikaḷ iraṇṭu mūṉṟu varicaikaḷil iṭuppukkukkīḻē valappakkamāka muṭintu toṅkaviṭappaṭṭaṉa. peṇ mārpai maṟaittuḷḷa muṟaiyil orē oru ciṟpamē kāṇappaṭukiṟatu. peṇṭir mārpil āṭaiyaṟṟē iruntaṉar eṉṟu karutattakum muṟaiyil ciṟpaṅkaḷ kāṇkiṉṟaṉa. taitta āṭaikaḷum, caṭṭaikaḷum, kullāykaḷum cila camayaṅkaḷil aṇiyappaṭṭu vantaṉa. tuṟavikaḷ marappaṭṭai, pul, paḻattōl ivaṟṟaikkoṇṭu ceyyappaṭṭa uṭaikaḷai uṭuttārkaḷ.
teṉpāṇṭi nāṭṭil vāḻnta nākar, ulakap pukaḻ peṟṟa melliya āṭaikaḷai neytu ayal nāṭukaḷukku aṉuppiṉar. aracarkaḷ muḻaṅkāl varaiyil `laṅkōṭu pōṉṟa uṭaiyaṇintaṉar. itu `vaṭṭuṭai eṉappaṭṭatu. naṭuttara vakuppiṉar iṭuppaic cuṟṟi ōr āṭaiyum, talaiyaic cuṟṟi maṟṟoṉṟum kaṭṭiṉar. peṇṭir, iṭuppiliruntu kāl varaiyil toṅkumpaṭi puṭavai uṭuttaṉar. malai nāṭṭup peṇṭir, ilaikaḷaik kōtta taḻaiyuṭaiyai uṭuttaṉar. perumpālum akkālap peṇṭir, iṭuppiṟkumēl evvita āṭaiyum aṇintatākac ciṟpaṅkaḷaik koṇṭu kūṟa iyalavillai.1
caṅkakāla makkaḷ eṉṉeṉṉa uṭaikaḷai aṇintiruntārkaḷ eṉpatait tiṭṭamāka aṟiya iyalavillai. āyiṉum, pattuppāṭṭil āṅkāṅkuk kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷa vivaraṅkaḷiliruntu akkāla makkaḷ payaṉpaṭuttiya palavakai uṭaikaḷiṉ peyarkaḷ kāṇappaṭukiṉṟaṉa. avaṟṟai iṅkuk kāṇpōm.
taḻai uṭai
kuṟamakaḷ marāmarak kottukaḷai naṭuvē vaittu, ilaiyaiyuṭaiya naṟiya pūṅkottukaḷaic cuṟṟilum vaittut toṭutta periya-aḻakiya taḻaiyuṭaiyai uṭuttiṉāḷ (tirumuruku, aṭi. 201-203). neytal nilamakaḷ taḷirkaḷ, taḻaikaḷ, malarkaḷ ivaṟṟālākiya taḻaiyuṭaiyai aṇintiruntāḷ. kāvirippūmpaṭṭiṉattup paratavar cērippeṇṭir ittaḻai yuṭaiyai aṇintiruntaṉar (pa. pālai, aṭi, 91).
tukil-kaliṅkam
aracaṉ kañciyiṭṭuc calavai ceyyappaṭṭa tukilai (āṭaiyai) aṇintiruntāṉ (ma. kā. aṭi, 721). araci kaṇavaṉ taṉṉaip piriyā tirukkaiyil pūttoḻilaiyuṭaiyatu kilaiuṭuttiṉāḷ; kaṇavaṉaip pirintirunta kālattil mācēṟiya nūlāṟ ceyta kaliṅkattai (āṭaiyai) aṇintiruntāḷ. pūntukilmarīiya .........avir nūlkaliṅkam” (neṭu,145-6) eṉa varutalāl. ,tukil eṉpatu oruvaika āiṭa eṉpatum, kaliṅkam eṉpatu maṟṟeru vaikaāiṭa eṉpatum terikiṉṟaṉa.

paṭṭiṉattu (māmallapurattu)c celva makaḷir, paṉi mācu pōṉṟa mika nuṇṇiya tukilai uṭuttiruntaṉar (pe. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 329). kāviri ppūmpaṭṭiṉattuc celva makaḷir, pakaṟkālattil paṭṭuṭaikaḷai uṭuttiṉar; irākkālattil meṉmaiyāṉa tukilai uṭuttaṉar.
