kaccai-kaccu
kuṟiñci nilattalaimakaṉ (kātalaṉ) nuṇṇiya vēlaip pāṭamainta kaccaiyaik kaṭṭiyiruntāṉ (kuṟiñci. aṭi, 125). maturaiyai iravil kāval kāttavar nīlak kaccaiyai aṇintiruntaṉar (ma. kā. aṭi, 639).
aruccuṉaṉ pūttoḻil paranta kaccaiyai aṇintiruntāṉ eṉṟu ciṟupāṇāṟṟuppaṭai ceppukiṟatu (aṭi, 239). nallūr nattattaṉār aruccuṉaṉai nēriṟ kaṇṭavarallar; avaṉ kālattiṟkup paṉṉūṟu āṇṭukaṭkup piṟpaṭṭavar. avar vīmaṉaip paṟṟic colla vanta iṭattil,
pūviri kaccaip pukaḻōṉ taṉmuṉ
eṉṟu aruccuṉaṟku muṉṉavaṉ eṉṟu cuṭṭiyuḷḷār; aruccuṉaṉaip `pūviri kaccaip pukaḻōṉ eṉṟu pukaḻntuḷḷār. avar avaṉatu kaccaikkuc ciṟapput tantuḷḷataik kūrntu kavaṉippiṉ, aruccuṉaṉaip pōṉṟa ciṟanta pōr vīrar tamiḻakattil `pūviri kaccaiyai aṇintiruntaṉar pōlum eṉak karuta vēṇṭuvatāyuḷḷatu. aracamātēvi mārpil vampu (kaccu) valittuk kaṭṭiyiruntāḷ eṉṟu neṭunalvāṭai kūṟukiṟatu (aṭi, 149-150).
paṭam-moyppai
ikkālattil `caṭṭai eṉappaṭuvatu akkālattil `paṭam eṉappaṭṭatu. toṇṭai nāṭṭup peruvaḻikaḷaik kāval kātta vīrar caṭṭai aṇintiruntaṉar eṉṟu perumpāṇāṟṟuppaṭai kūṟukiṟatu. `paṭampukku-caṭṭaiyiṭṭu eṉṟu nacciṉārkkiṉiyar urai (aṭi, 69).
`paṭampukum milēccar eṉpatu mullaippāṭut toṭar (aṭi, 66). milēccar ayal nāṭṭār; avaruṭ cilar pācaṟaiyil aracaṉatu irukkaiyaik kāttu vantavar; ūmaiyar; caṭṭai aṇintiruntaṉar.
caṅka kālattil yavaṉar tamiḻakattuṭaṉ vāṇkam ceytaṉar. avaruṭ cilar, maturai, pūmpukār, vañci pōṉṟa tamiḻaracar talainakaraṅkaḷilum tuṟaimukap paṭṭiṉaṅkaḷilum vāṇikattiṉporuṭṭut tiṅkiyiruntaṉar. anta yavaṉar vaṭimpu tāḻntu perukkuñ ceṟitalaiyuṭaiya puṭaivai1 yuṭaiyai araiyil aṇintiruntaṉar; araikku mēl `meyppai (caṭṭai)yai aṇintiruntaṉar (mullaippāṭṭu, aṭi, 59-61).
kaḷḷaip paruki maturait terukkaḷil irākkālattil tirinta milēccar, muṉṉum piṉṉum toṅkalāka aṟuvaiyait toṅkaviṭṭuc ceṉṟaṉar eṉpatu neṭunalvāṭaiyil kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷatu (aṭi, 33-35).
aḻukkēṟiya kantalāṭai citāar (po. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 154) eṉavum, citarvai (pe. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 468). eṉavum vaḻaṅkappaṭṭatu.
vēṟu āṭaikaḷ
murukapperumāṉ `nalampeṟu kaliṅkam uṭuttiruntāṉ eṉpatu tirumurukāṟṟuppaṭaiyil kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷatu (aṭi, 109). murukaṉ uṭuttiruntatu cemmai niṟam peṟṟa āṭai eṉṟu nacciṉārkkiṉiyar kuṟittuḷḷār. apperumāṉ iṭaiyil utara pantattiṉmēl uṭuttut toṅkaviṭṭa meṉmaiyuṭaiya tukil avaṉ kuṟamakaḷiroṭu kuravaik kūttāṭukaiyil nilattiṟ poruntiyatu (aṭi, 213-214).
tirupparaṅkuṉṟattuc cōlaiyil murukaṉatu ciṟappaip pāṭi viḷaiyāṭiya cūraramakaḷir, intira kōpattai otta niṟam piṭiyāta (cāyam vaṟṟāta) iyalpāṉa cippākiya pūvēlaippāṭamainta tukilai uṭuttiruntaṉar.
kōpat taṉṉa tōyāp pūntukil (muruku. aṭi. 15).
`tuṇaṅkaik kūttāṭiya pūtaṅkaḷ tukilai uṭuttaṉa pōla (pe. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 234-235) eṉpatu uvamaiyākak kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷatu. `iṅkuk `tukil eṉpatu veḷḷaiyāṭaiyai eṉpatu nacciṉārkkiṉiyar urai.
tiruvāvi naṉkuṭiyil murukaṉai vaḻipaṭṭa muṉivar marappaṭṭaikkoṇṭu ceyyappaṭṭa uṭaiyai (maravuri uṭaiyai) uṭuttiruntaṉar. (aṭi, 126).
kantaruvar (icaivāṇar) pukaiyai mukantāl otta (mika melliya) aḻukkēṟāta tūyavuṭaiyiṉai aṇintiruntaṉar.
pukaimukan taṉṉa mācil tūvuṭai (aṭi, 138).
ērakattu murukaṉ kōvil aruccakar araiyil kāḻakam uṭuttiruntaṉar.
pularāk kāḻakam pulara vuṭīi (aṭi, 184).
`kāḻakam-kaliṅkam eṉpatu nacciṉārkkiṉiyar urai. neṭiya karaiyaiyuṭaiya nīla niṟap puṭaivai kāḻakam eṉappaṭṭatu (ma. kā. aṭi, 598).
pācaṟaiyil aracaṟkuk kūṭāram amaikkappaṭṭatu. kūṭārattaic cuṟṟilum matil pōla vaḷaittuk kaṭṭap payaṉpaṭṭa muraṭṭut tuṇi kaṇṭam eṉappaṭṭatu. (mullai, 44). `kaṇṭam-matiḷ tirai eṉpar nacciṉārkkiṉiyar. atu `kaṇṭattirai, palvaṇṇattirai eṉavum peyar peṟum eṉṟu nacciṉārkkiṉiyar cintāmaṇiyil (ce. 647, 873 urai) kūṟiyuḷḷār.
uṭaikkuriya peyarkaḷ
itukāṟum kaṇṭa cāṉṟukaḷāl nām aṟiyattakuvaṉa yāvai?
`tukil, aṟuvai, kaliṅkam eṉpavai mikavuyarnta melliya vēlaippāṭamainta āṭaikaḷ, avaṟṟai aracarum celvarum uṭuttaṉar; mēlāṭaiyākavum payaṉpaṭuttiṉar; kaṭavuḷar tiruvuruvaṅkaḷukkum aṇivittaṉar. kāḻakam eṉpatu oru vakai āṭai. ataṉai aruccakar aṇintiruntaṉar. muṉivar maravuri tarittiruntaṉar; kāṉavar, vīrar, kāvalar ākiyōr kaccai aṇintiruntaṉar; avaṟṟuḷ nīlakkaccai kuṟippiṭattakkatu, aracamātēvi mārpil kaccuk kaṭṭiyiruntāḷ; paṭṭāṭaikaḷum vaḻakkil iruntaṉa; kūṭāra matil tiraittuṇi `kaṇṭam eṉappaṭṭatu; araciyal aluvalar caṭṭai aṇiyum vaḻakkam iruntatu; aḻukkēṟiya kiḻinta kantalāṭai `citā ar eṉṟum `citarvai eṉṟum peyar peṟṟatu, eṉṉum vivaraṅkaḷ itukāṟum kaṇṭa cāṉṟukaḷ koṇṭu aṟiyappaṭum.
kāḻakam
kāvirippūmpaṭṭiṉattiṟkup pala nāṭukaḷiliruntu aṉuppappaṭṭa poruḷkaḷ vāṇikattiṟku vantiruntaṉa. avaṟṟuḷ kāḻakattup poruḷkaḷum iruntaṉa (pa. pālai. aṭi, 191). `kāḻakam-kaṭāram eṉpatu nacciṉārkkiṉiyar kūṟṟu. malāy nāṭṭil mēlkarai ōramāyuḷḷa `kaṭē eṉṉum iṭamē paṇṭaikkālattil `kaṭāram eṉappaṭṭatu. ataṉai veṉṟa mutalām irācēntira cōḻaṉ (ki. pi. 1012-1044) taṉṉaik `kaṭāram koṇṭāṉ eṉṟu vaḻaṅkikkoṇṭāṉ.1 kaṭāram eṉṟa kāḻakattiliruntu neytu aṉuppappaṭṭa āṭai `kāḻakam eṉappaṭṭatu pōlum! ērakattu aruccakar itaṉai aṇintiruntaṉar eṉṟu tirumurukāṟṟuppaṭai kūṟukiṟatu. itu tamiḻ nāṭṭu āṭai vakaikaḷuḷ kūṟappaṭātatu kavaṉikkattakum.
kaliṅkam
iṉṟaiya orisā mānilam paṇṭaik kālattil kaliṅkam eṉṟa nāṭāyiruntatu. ki. mu. iraṇṭām nūṟṟāṇṭil tamiḻaracar kūṭṭaṇiyai aḻittatākat taṉṉaik kūṟikkoṇṭa kāravēlaṉ kaliṅkanāṭṭup pēraracaṉāvaṉ. kaliṅkanāṭu uyarnta melliya āṭaikaḷukkup paṇṭu toṭṭē peyar peṟṟatu. kaliṅkar kaṭal vāṇikattilum peyar peṟṟavar. `koḷḷē kāl eṉṉum ūril neyyappaṭum āṭai `koḷḷē kāl eṉṟē kūṟappaṭutal pōlak kaliṅkanāṭṭu āṭai `kaliṅkam eṉṟē peyar peṟṟirukkalām.
22. aṇikaḷ
I
aṇikaḷiṉ tōṟṟam
paṇṭaikkāla makkaḷ toṭakkakālattil āṭaiyō aṇiyō illātavarāyirunta nilai oṉṟiruntatu. piṉpu ammakkaḷ kaṇṇukkiṉiya kāṭciyai nalkiya pala niṟattaḷir (kuḻai)kaḷaik kātil cerukiṉārkaḷ; pala vakai vitaikaḷaiyum koṭṭaikaḷaiyum kātukaḷil kaṭṭit toṅkaviṭṭārkaḷ; patappaṭuttappaṭṭa puṟkaḷaiyum nārkaḷaiyum muṟukkik kaiyilum kaḻuttilum aṇintārkaḷ; ilaikaḷōṭu kūṭiya koṭikaḷaik kaḻuttilum tōḷilum iṭaiyilum muṉkaiyilum cuṟṟikkoṇṭārkaḷ; palavakai malarkaḷaiyum ilaittaḷirkaḷaiyum mālaiyākat toṭuttu mārpilum iṭaiyilum aṇintu koṇṭārkaḷ; pala vakai maṇikaḷaiyum payaṉpaṭuttiṉārkaḷ.
kālam cellac cellak kātukaḷil cerukappaṭṭa kuḻai (taḷir), kātukaḷil tuḷai ceyyappaṭṭu aṇiyappaṭṭatu; paṉaiyōlai, curuḷākkap paṭṭuk kātil tuḷaiyil iṭappaṭṭatu. atu `kātōlai eṉap peyar peṟṟatu. araiyil aḻakukkāka aṇinta nār (kayiṟu) araināṇ (araiñāṇ) eṉap peyar peṟṟatu; tōḷil cuṟṟit toṭuttuk koḷḷappaṭṭatu `toṭi eṉappaṭṭatu. kātiṉ pala iṭaṅkaḷil vaittu oṭṭa vaittukkoḷḷappaṭṭa pūkkaḷ-kattirippū, ilavaṅkappū, murukuppū eṉap palavāṟu peyar peṟṟaṉa.
tōṭu-pūvitaḻ. itu paṉaiyōlaiyaiyum kuṟikkum. ippeyar kālappōkkil `tōṭu eṉappaṭṭatu. murukuppū-maṇam nāṟum pū. itupōṉṟa aṇi ikkālattil `muruvūppū eṉappaṭukiṉṟatu. `kompuppū eṉpatu `koppū eṉa maruviṟṟu. paṇṭai makkaḷ marakkompil uḷḷa pūkkaḷai aṇintu vantārkaḷ eṉpatai itu viḷakkukiṉṟatu. `tirukuppū eṉpatu muṟukkutalaiyuṭaiya pūvaik kuṟikkum. paṇṭai makkaḷ muṟukkuṇṭa vaṭivuṭaiya pūkkaḷai aṇintu vantārkaḷ eṉpatu itaṉāl terikiṉṟatu.
paṇṭai makkaḷ aṭuttapaṭi tāṅkaḷ aṇintu vanta nakaikaḷai marattil cetukkiṉārkaḷ; piṉpu īyam allatu cempai urukki mara accil vārttārkaḷ; puṟkaḷaiyum nārkaḷaiyum muṟukkik kai, kaḻuttu, iṭai mutaliya iṭaṅkaḷil aṇintāṟpōlavē, poṉ veḷḷik kampikaḷai muṟukkip pala aṇikaḷaic ceytārkaḷ; ulōkat takaṭukaḷ koṇṭu paḻaṅkaḷaip pōlavum vitaikaḷaip pōlavum ilaikaḷaip pōlavum nakaikaḷaic ceytārkaḷ; āyiṉ, avaṟṟukku mutaṟ peyarkaḷaiyē iṭṭu vaḻaṅkiṉārkaḷ. avai araiñāṇ, toṭi, kuḻai, mālai, kattarippū, ilavaṅkappū, vaḷai eṉap palavāṟu peyar peṟṟaṉa. mika melliya aḻakiya koṭikaḷāl āṉa iṭaiyaṇi kālappōkkil `cilkāḻ eṉavum `palkāḻ eṉavum peyar peṟṟatu; vaṭamoḻiyil `mēkalai mutaliya pala peyarkaḷaip peṟṟatu.
paṇṭai makkaḷuṭaiya camayak karuttukaḷum vaḻi pāṭṭukkuriya aṭaiyāḷaṅkaḷum avartam kaṟpaṉaiyai vaḷarttut `tāyittu, aim paṭaittāli pōṉṟa putiya nakaikaḷaic ceyyattūṇṭiṉa.
nakaikaḷ toṭarpāṉa ittakaiya paṭippaṭiyāṉa vaḷarcciyait teṉṉintiyāviṟ kāṇalām. iṅkuḷḷa paṇṭai makkaḷ muṟukkuṇṭa puṟkaḷaiyum nārkaḷaiyum kaṭakaṅkaḷākavum vaḷaiyalkaḷākavum aṇikiṉṟārkaḷ. kaṇṇāṭi maṇikaḷaiyum pavaḻaṅkaḷaiyum kaḻuttaṇikaḷāka aṇikiṉṟārkaḷ. ciṟṟūrkaḷil uḷḷa ēḻai makkaḷ veḷḷi, poṉ, pittaḷai, cempu, īyam mutaliya ulōkaṅkaḷaik koṇṭu paṇṭaimakkaḷ payaṉpaṭuttiya nakaikaḷ pōṟvaṟṟaic ceytu aṇikiṉṟārkaḷ. avaṟṟuḷ nuṇṇiya vēlaip pāṭamainta nakaikaḷum uḷḷaṉa.1
paṇṭai intiya aṇikaḷ
moheñca-tarō, harappā eṉṉum paṇṭai nakarap paḻam poruḷkaḷiṉ kālam ēṟattāḻak ki. mu. 3500-ki. mu. 300 eṉṉalām. aṅkuk kiṭaitta poruḷkaḷuḷ maṇ pommaikaḷ ciṟappāṉavai. avaṟṟil akkāla nakai vakaikaḷ kāṇappaṭukiṉṟaṉa. akkālap peṇṭir, iṭattōḷi liruntu kaṇukkāl varaiyil vaḷaiyalkaḷai aṇintiruntaṉar; valakkaiyil mēṟpakutiyiṉ kīḻkkōṭiyil kaṭakattaiyum, muṉ kaiyil cila vaḷaiyalkaḷaiyum aṇintiruntaṉar; talaiyil oppaṉai ceytiruntaṉar; kātaṇiyum kaḻuttaṇiyum aṇintiruntaṉar eṉpatu terikiṉṟatu.
kācumalai-`kaṇṭi eṉṟa peyaruṭaṉ irukku vētattil kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷatu. `aruccuṉaṉ pēṭikkōlattil irunta poḻutu kātaṇikaḷ, kaḻuttaṇikaḷ, vaḷaiyalkaḷ ākiyavaṟṟai aṇintiruntāṉ. tēvaṉ oruvaṉ avaṉukkup poṉ mālaiyum patakkamum aḷittāṉ, eṉṟu makāpāratam kūṟukiṉṟatu. `irāmaṉ taṉ maṇakkōlattil muttu muṭiyum kātaṇiyum muttu mālaiyum neṟṟiyil muttup paṭṭamum aṇintiruntāṉ. cītai palavakai nakai aṇintiruntāḷ eṉṟu irāmāyaṇam moḻikiṉṟatu.1 kāpūl paḷḷattākkil jalapātiṉ arukil paḻaiyaputtar kōviliṟkiṭaitta poṟpeṭṭi māṇikkak kaṟkaḷ patittatu. ataṉuḷ muttukaḷum, pavaḻaṅkaḷum, maṇikaḷum, taṅka nakaikaḷum iruntaṉa.
ki. mu. nāṉkām nūṟṟāṇṭil vāḻnta kauṭilyar, tamatu poruḷnūlil poṉ kiṭaikkum iṭaṅkaḷaiyum, poṉṉiṉ vakaikaḷaiyum, navamaṇikaḷaiyum, nakai vakaikaḷaiyum kuṟittuḷḷār. ivaṟṟait tokukkavum vāṇikam ceyyavum araciyal uyaraluvalaṉ oruvaṉ avar kālattil mōriya aracil paṇiyāṟṟiṉāṉ. ivaṟṟait tiruṭuvōrkku iṟappē taṇṭaṉaiyāka vitikkappaṭavēṇṭum eṉpatu keṭilyar karuttākum. muttu mālai, periya muttukaḷaiyuṭaiya mālai, oṟṟai muttuvaṭam, naṭuvil oru maṇi kōtta muttu mālai pōṉṟa aṇikaḷ kauṭilyarāṟ kuṟikkappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.1
manutaruma cāttirattiṉ kālam ēṟattāḻak ki. mu. 200 eṉṉalām. ēṟakkuṟaiya akkālattiṟ ceyyappaṭṭa `viḷaiyāṭṭu vaṇṭi (Toy Cart) eṉṉum nāṭakanūlil nakaikkaṭai oṉṟu ciṟappikkappaṭṭuḷḷatu. akkaṭaiyil poṉ, navarattiṉam mutaliyaṉa koṇṭu nakaikaḷ ceyyappaṭṭaṉa. nakaikaḷai;la pūvēlai ceyvateppaṭi eṉpatum viḷakkappaṭṭuḷḷatu. cila nikaḻccikaḷiṉ pōtu nakaikaḷ aṇiyavēṇṭum eṉṟu manu kūṟiyuḷḷar. camayattoṭarpāṉa ceyalkaḷiṉ pōtu nakaiyaṇivatu vaḻakkam.2 paṇṭai makkaḷ, pala nimuḷḷa cātāraṇa maṇikaḷaik koṇṭu kātaṇikaḷ, kaḻuttaṇikaḷ, kaiyaṇikaḷ, iṭaiyaṇikaḷ ākiyavaṟṟaic ceytu koṇṭaṉar. muttu, poṉ mutaliya vilai matippuḷḷa poruḷkaḷ kaṇṭupiṭikkappaṭṭa piṉpu celvariṭam paḻaiya maṇikaḷ arukiṉa. taṭcacīlattil kiṭaitta ciṟpaṅkaḷaik kāṇkaiyil akkālattil (ki. mu. 500- ki. pi. 300) kaṇṇāṭi vaḷaiyalkaḷ, caṅkavaḷaikaḷ, āmai ōṭu pōṉṟavaṟṟālākiya vaḷaikaḷ, tanta vaḷaiyalkaḷ vaḻakkil iruntamai pulaṉākum. vaṭavintiyāvil `ahichatrā (Ahichhatra) eṉṉum iṭattil maṇ pommaikaḷil kāṇappaṭum aṇikaḷ pala. avaṟṟiṉ kālam ki. mu. 300-ki. pi. 100 eṉṉalām. talaiyiliruntu muttuccaraṅkaḷ toṅkal, nākamuttiraiyuṭaiya talaiyaṇi, ampu-koṭi-aṅkucam eṉpavai poṟitta kātaṇi, vāḷ-vaccirāyutam-srīvatam poṟitta kaḻuttaṇi eṉpaṉa cila pommaikaḷiṟ kāṇappaṭukiṉṟaṉa. vēṟu cila pommaikaḷil kaṉatta kātu vaḷaiyaṅkaḷum, vaḷaiyalkaḷum, pūvēlaippāṭu koṇṭa kāppukaḷum kāṇappaṭukiṉṟaṉa.3
taṭcacīlam (ki. mu. 500-ki. pi. 300), pajāt (ki. mu. iraṇṭām nūṟṟāṇṭu), parhūt (ki. mu. 150), cāñci (ki. mu. 150), (vaṭa) maturai (ki. pi. 1,200), kāntāram (ki. pi. 50-200) ākiya iṭaṅkaḷiṟ kiṭaitta ciṟpaṅkaḷaiyum ajantāc ciṟpaṅkaḷaiyum (ki. pi. 1-7 nuṟṟāṇṭukaḷ) kāṇkaiyil, ki. mu. 500 mutal ki. pi. 600 varaiyil vaṭavintiyāvil irunta pala vakai aṇikaḷaip paṟṟiya vivaraṅkaḷ pulaṉākiṉṟaṉa. vaṭa vintiya makkaḷ muṭi mutal aṭi varaiyil pala vakai aṇikaḷai aṇintiruntārkaḷ. avaṟṟuṭpala, kal patitta nakaikaḷ; ellōrum talaiyaṇi aṇintiruntaṉar; āṭavarum peṇṭirum nakaikaḷait tarittiruntaṉar eṉṉum vivaraṅkaḷ terikiṉṟaṉa.
kāḷitācar eṉṟa vaṭamoḻip perumpulavar, ki. pi. aintām nūṟṟāṇṭiṉ muṟpakutiyaic cērntavar eṉṟu varalāṟṟaṟiñar kūṟukiṉṟaṉar. avar tam kālattu nakaikaḷait tām ceyta nūlkaḷil kuṟittuḷḷār; poṉṉum maṇikaḷum koṇṭu ceyyappaṭṭa pala vakai mēkalaikaiḷaik kūṟiyuḷḷār. avai mēkalā, hēmamēkalā, kāñci, kiṇkiṇi, racaṉa eṉpavai. ivaṟṟuṭcila, oli eḻuppuvaṉavākum. oṉpatu vakai maṇikaḷalāl allatu muttukaḷāl ākiya muṭivalai, muṭi, kūntal aṇikaḷ, karṇapūṣaṇam, karṇapūram, kuṇṭalam, maṇi kuṇṭalam eṉap pala vakaippaṭṭa kātaṇikaḷ kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa. maṇi kuṇṭalam eṉpatu māṇikkak kaṟkaḷ patikkappaṭṭa toṅkal.1
teṉṉāṭṭu aṇikaḷ
āticca nallūr aṇikaḷ
ēṟattāḻak ki. mu. iraṇṭāyiram āṇṭukaḷukku muṟpaṭṭa āticcanallūrp putaikuḻikaḷiliruntu eṭukkappaṭṭa nakaikaḷum maṇpatumaikaḷiṉ mītu kāṇappaṭum nakaikaḷum appaḻaṅkālattu aṇivakaikaḷai naṉku uṇarttukiṉṟaṉa. akkāla makkaḷ, cōḻi vakaikaḷai aḻakupaṭak kōttuk kaḻuttilum araiyilum kaikaḷilum kālkaḷilum kaṭṭikkoṇṭārkaḷ; caṅkukaḷai mikka tiṟamaiyuṭaṉ ciṟiya vaṭṭaṅkaḷāka aṟuttuk kāppukaḷākavum kaṭakaṅkaḷākavum aṇintārkaḷ; vilaiyuyarnta paccai, civappuk kaṟkaḷaiyum muttukaḷaiyum pavaḻaṅkaḷaiyum pala vakai nakaikaḷākac ceytu payaṉpaṭuttiṉārkaḷ; poṉṉāṟceyyappaṭṭa maṇikaḷaiyum kōttu aṇintu vantārkaḷ.
ciṟpaccāṉṟu
tamiḻakattiṟku vaṭakkil uḷḷa āntira nāṭṭu amarāvati, jakkayyapēṭṭai, nākārccuṉamalai eṉṉum iṭaṅkaḷiṟkiṭaitta ciṟpaṅkaḷaikkoṇṭu akkāla (ki. mu. 200-ki. pi. 400) makkaḷiṉ nakai vakaikaḷai ōraḷavu aṟiyalām.
akkālap peṇṭir pala vaḷaivukaḷaik koṇṭa vaḷaiyalkaḷaiyum kāppukaḷaiyum kaṭakaṅkaḷaiyum aṇintiruntaṉar; malarnta tāmarai malaraip pōṉṟa tirukaik koṇṭa aṇiyāl kūntalai oppaṉai ceytaṉar; talaiyaic cuṟṟilum poṉṉāṟceyyappaṭṭa paṭṭaiyāṉa oru nakaiyai aṇintaṉar. appaṭṭaiyiliruntu toṅkalkaḷ cila neṟṟiyil toṅkaviṭappaṭṭaṉa. ammakaḷir tam kātukaḷil pū, ilai, vaṭṭam, mīṉ pōṉṟa pala vaṭivaṅkaḷaik koṇṭa aḻakiya kuṇṭalaṅkaḷai aṇintaṉar; cila kātaṇikaḷiliruntu muttuc caraṅkaḷ tōḷkaḷmītu puraṇṭaṉa. appeṇṭir, mēlē makarakkoṭi cetukkappaṭṭup pāmpukaḷ pōlac cuṟṟappaṭṭa kaṭakaṅkaḷait tarittaṉar; caṅkukaḷ, pavaḷaṅkaḷ, tantaṅkaḷ, irattiṉaṅkaḷ ākiyavaṟṟāl ceyyappaṭṭō, allatu orē keṭṭiyākavō, allatu pala vitamāṉa cantukaḷaik koṇṭō uḷḷa accaṅkilikaḷiliruntu pala vakaiyāṉa patakkaṅkaḷ toṅkiṉa. ammātaracikaḷ poṉṉālum veḷḷiyālum ceyyappaṭṭa iṭuppuppaṭṭai, utarapantam, oṭṭiyāṇam, caṉṉavīram eṉpavaṟṟai araiyil aṇintaṉar. āyiṉ, avarkaḷ viralkaḷil mōtiram kāṇappaṭavillai; mūkkaṇiyum illai.1
mēlē kūṟappaṭṭa nakaikaḷuṭpala, nam caṅkanūlkaḷiṟ kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.


peyarkkāraṇam
nakaikaḷ-aṇi, pūṇ, iḻai, kalam (kalaṉ) eṉap pala peyarkaḷaip peṟum. ivaṟṟuḷ ovvoru peyarum ovvoru kāraṇam paṟṟiyē vantatākum. aṇi-aṇiyappeṟum kāraṇam paṟṟi vanta peyar. itu, caṭṭai aṇital, āṭai aṇital pōla eḷiya muṟaiyil mālai pōla aṇiyap peṟum kaḻuttaṇikaḷaik kuṟikka vantatākalām; piṉṉark kālappōkkil ivvoru kuṟippai oḻittu ellā nakaikaṭkum potuvāṉa peyarāy amaintirukkalām.
pūṇ-ulakkaip pūṇ, taṭippūṇ eṉpaṉa, ulakkaiyiṉ talaiyilum taṭiyiṉ talaiyilum ceṟinta vaḷaiyaṅkaḷai uṇarttum. avvāṟē kaikaḷil ceṟinta muṟaiyil aṇiyappaṭṭatu mutalil pūṇ eṉappaṭṭatu pōlum! kāppu, kolucu, kaṭakam, kaṅkaṇam, mōtiram eṉpavai kai, viral pōṉṟa uṟuppukaḷil iṟukiya nilaiyil aṇiyap peṟuvaṉa ātalāl, `pūṇkaḷ eṉa mutaliṟpeyar peṟṟirukkalām. piṉṉark kālappōkkil ikkāraṇac ciṟappup peyar, pala aṇikaḷaiyum kāraṇap potup peyar nilaiyil niṉṟu kuṟikkat toṭaṅkiṉa pōlum!
iḻai-iḻaippu vēlaippāṭu koṇṭa nakai, iḻai eṉap peyar peṟṟatu. poṉṉaik kampiḷāka iḻaittuc ceyyappaṭṭa nakai iḻai eṉappaṭṭatu pōlum! `kalliḻaitta nakai eṉpatu ikkāla vaḻakkilum uḷḷatēyākum. eṉavē, poṉ vaṭavaṅkaḷum kal iḻaittuc ceyyappaṭṭa nakaikaḷum `iḻai eṉap peyar peṟṟirukkalām. piṉpu kālap pōkkil `iḻai eṉpatu ellā nakaikaḷaiyum kuṟikkalāyiṟṟup pōlum!
maṇikaḷaip poṉṉil iḻaittu aṇi (aḻaku) ceyyap peṟṟa `aṇiyiḻai eṉavum, oḷi poruntiya iḻai `oḷiyiḻai eṉavum, oḷi viḷaṅkit tōṉṟiya iḻai `ilaṅkiḻai eṉavum, cem poṉṉālum cemmaṇikaḷālum āṉa iḻai `cēyiḻai eṉavum, pacumpoṉṉālum paciya maṇikaḷālum āṉa iḻai `pāciḻai eṉavum, poṉṉālum maṇiyālum vēlaippāṭṭālum māṇpuṟṟu viḷaṅkiya iḻai `māṇiḻai eṉavum, iḻaikaḷuḷ ārāyntu eṭukkappaṭṭatu `āyiḻai eṉavum peyar peṟṟaṉa eṉak koḷvatu poruttamākum. ippala peyarkaḷum caṅkap pākkaḷil iṭam peṟṟuḷḷaṉa.
kalam (kalaṉ)-kalam allatu kalaṉ eṅṅaṉam nakaiyaik kuṟittatu eṉpatu ippōtu aṟiya iyalavillai. itu, `kal eṉṉum ōcaiyuṇṭākkum cataṅkai, cilampu, pōṉṟa kālaṇikaḷukku mutaliṟpeyarākip piṉpu kālap pōkkil nakaikaḷukkup potup peyarāyamaintatō, eṉṉavō teriyavillai.
toṭi-kaikaḷilum tōḷilum toṭuttukkoṇṭa aṇi `toṭi eṉappaṭṭateṉpatu muṉpē kūṟappaṭṭataṉṟō? oḷi poruntiya toṭi `oṇṭoṭi eṉavum, toṭikaḷuḷ ciṟantatāka ārāyntu aṇiyappeṟṟatu āytoṭi eṉavum, ceṟintu iṟuka aṇiyappeṟṟatu `ceṟitoṭi eṉavum, pacumpoṉṉāl allatu paciya maṇikaḷāl ā ṉatoṭi `paintoṭi eṉavum peyar peṟṟaṉa. ippala peyarkaḷaiyum caṅkanūlkaḷiṟ kāṇalām.
iṅṅaṉam pala peyarkaḷait tāṅkiya ittoṭi, kaivaḷaiyākavum, tōḷ vaḷaiyākavum payaṉpaṭṭatu. aracar, vīrar pōṉṟavar aṇintatoṭi `vīravaḷai eṉappaṭṭatu. peṇkaḷ aṇinta muṉkai vaḷai `toṭi eṉappaṭṭatu. iḷampeṇkaḷ aṇinta muṉkai vaḷai `kuṟuntoṭi eṉappaṭṭatu. tōḷ vaḷaiyum `toṭi eṉappeyar peṟṟatu.
kuḻai-itu taḷiriliruntu (kuḻaiyiliruntu) piṟanta peyar. makaramīṉ vaṭivattil amaintatu `makarakkuḻai eṉappaṭṭatu. poṉṉāṟceyyappaṭṭa kuḻai `polaṅkuḻai eṉṟum, oḷi poruntiya kuḻai `oṇkuḻai eṉṟum, poliviḷaiyuṭaiya kuḻai pūṅkuḻai eṉṟum, periya oḷi oḻukiṉa kuḻai `vār kuḻai eṉṟum, tāḷuruvi eṉṉam oru vakaik kuḻai `ciṟukuḻai eṉṟum peyar peṟṟaṉa.
vaḷai-vaḷainta, kōṇalāṉa nakai, `vaḷai eṉappaṭṭatu. itu caṅku, āmai ōṭu, pittaḷai, veḷḷi, poṉ mutaliyavaṟṟāl ceyyappaṭṭatu; iṉṟum ceyyappaṭukiṉṟatu. ikkālattil kaṇṇāṭi koṇṭum `piḷāṭikku eṉṉum kalavaip poruḷ koṇṭum ceyyappaṭukiṉṟatu. kāppu eṉpatum ivvakaiyaic cērntatēyākum.1
iṅṅaṉam ovvoru nakaiyum oru kāraṇam paṟṟiyē peyariṭappaṭṭatu. inta aṇikaḷ caṅkakālattil peru vaḻakkil iruntaṉa eṉṟu caṅka nūṟpāṭalkaḷ kūṟukiṉṟaṉa. annūlkaḷiṟ kuṟikkappaṭṭuḷḷa aṇikaḷuḷ kīḻ varuvaṉa kuṟikkattaruvaṉavākum.2
kuṟuntokaiyil ariyār cilampu (7, 369), toku vaḷaiyalkaḷ (tokutiyāṉa vaḷaiyalkaḷ) (15), caṅka vaḷaiyalkaḷ (11, 23), poṉṉālāṉa talaiyaṇikaḷ (21), uruṇṭaiyāṉa poṟkācukaḷ kōkkap peṟṟa kācu mālai (67), pūttoḻil amainta kuḻaikaḷ (159), toṭi (243), poṟkālaṇi (148), poṉṉālum maṇiyālum ceyyappaṭṭa iṭaiyaṇi (mēkalai allatu kāñci-264) eṉpavai aṇikaḷeṉak kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa. poṉṉai uraittu ataṉ māṟṟai aṟitaṟkup payaṉ paṭṭa kal, `kaṭṭaḷaikkal eṉappaṭṭatu (192).
naṟṟiṇaiyil mēṟcollappaṭṭa aṇikaḷuṭaṉ vēṟu cilavum kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa. āṭavarum ciṟuvarum toṭi aṇintiruntaṉar (48, 166). viral iḻai (mōtiram, 85), vāḻaippūppōlak kuvintuḷḷa oravakai mōtiram (188), curitakam eṉṉum talaiyaṇi (86), piḷḷaikaḷiṉ iṭaiyaṇiyāṉa kiṇkiṇi (269), maṇikaḷ patitta poṉ nakaikaḷ (304) mutaliyaṉa kuṟikkappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.
akanāṉūṟṟil mēlē kūṟappaṭṭavaṟṟuḷ pala, iṭam peṟṟuḷḷaṉa. kalaṉ, pūṇ, iḻai eṉap porup peyarāl pala aṇikaḷ kuṟikkappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa. ivai ovvoru tokai nūliṉ pākkaḷilum kāṇappaṭukiṉṟaṉa.
kalittokaiyil kaṇṇi (32), poṟpū mālai, talaiyaṇi (54), kaṉaṅkuḻai, (57), polaṅkuḻai (58), pūkkuḻai (63), makarakkuḻai (92), varikkuḻai (104), nupuram (83), cataṅkai, taṇṭai (74), iṭapak kuṟi poṟitta tāyittu (82), poṉmaṇivaṭam, pavaḷavaṭam, vayantakam (79), vallikai, pullikai, kaṉṉacāmarai, teyvavutti, mukkaṇṭaṉ kaṭṭuvaṭam, kaṇṭikai (96) ākiya aṇikaḷ putiyaṉavākak kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.
paripāṭalil kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷa aṇikaḷuḷ toyyakam (talaippāḷai), makara valayam eṉṟa talaikkōlam (10), pavaḷavaḷai, poṟpū mālai, muñcam (ciṟuvar talaiyaṇi) (14), muttup paralaiyuṭaiya poṟcilampu (21) eṉpaṉa putiya aṇikaḷākum.
patiṟṟuppattu-aracaṉ, vīrakkaḻal, pōrttuṟaikkuriya poṉ mālai ākiyavaṟṟaip piṟa aṇikaḷōṭu aṇintiruntāṉ (40, 56). poṉṉari mālaikaḷaip pāṭiṉiyarum viṟaliyarum paricilākap peṟṟaṉar (22, 54).
puṟanāṉūṟu-naḷḷi eṉṟa ciṟṟaracaṉ talaiyil nīla maṇiḷaiyum, kaḻuttil muttu mālaiyaiyum, kaiyiṟ kaṭakattaiyum aṇintiruntāṉ (150). itaṉai nōkkap pēraracar mēlum pala aṇikaḷai aṇintirukkalām eṉṟu koḷḷutal poruttamākum. vēḷvikkuriya maṉaivimār `cālakam eṉṟa aṇiyai aṇintiruntaṉar. poṉṉāṟceyyappaṭṭa talaimālai iruntatu (353).
cilappatikāram-cilappatikārattil mātaviyiṉ aṇikaḷ kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa (kātai 6; aṭi, 83-108) avai kāl viral aṇikaḷ, pariyakam-nupuram-pāṭakam, cataṅkai-ariyakam eṉṉum kālaṇikaḷ, toṇṭaiyaṇi, muppattiraṇṭu muttuk kōvaikaḷaik koṇṭa mēkalai, māṇikkavaḷai muttu vaḷaiyākiya tōḷ vaḷaikaḷ, māṇikkamum vayiraṅkaḷum aḻuttappeṟṟa kaṭakam, cempoṉvaḷai-navarattiṉavaḷai-caṅkavaḷai-pavaḻavaḷai eṉṟa muṉkai vaḷaiyalkaḷ, māṇikkam-marakatam-vayiram ākiyavaṟṟāl amaintu viralkaḷai maṟaikkum kaiyaṇi, vīraccaṅkili nērñcaṅkili-ñāṇ, vēlaip pāṭamainta cavaṭi, carappaḷi muttu mālai eṉṉum kaḻuttaṇikaḷ, mutuku maṟaiya viṭum piṉ tāli, intira nīlak kaṟkaḷiṭaiyē vayiraṅkaḷ patitta nīlakkutampai (kātaṇi), cītēviyār-valampuri caṅku-pūrappāḷai-teṉ palli-vaṭapalli eṉpavai koṇṭa talaikkōlam eṉpaṉa.
iṉip pattuppāṭṭuḷ kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷa aṇikaḷaip paṟṟiya vivaraṅkaḷaik kāṇpōm:
II
pattuppāṭṭil aṇikaḷ
talai aṇikaḷ
muṭi : tāmam, mukuṭam, patumam, kōṭakam, kimpuri ākiya aintum muṭiyuṟuppukaḷ eṉat tivākaramum piṅkalantaiyum kūṟukiṉṟaṉa. ivvaintu uṟuppukaḷum oruṅkē amaiyap peṟṟa vilai matippaṟṟa-vēlaippāṭu niṟainta-muṭiyai murukapperumāṉ aṇintiruntāṉ eṉṟu tirumurukāṟṟup paṭai kūṟukiṟatu (aṭi, 83, 84, urai).
tamiḻaracaṉ pācaṟaiyil irunta pōtum iravu nērattilum talaiyil muṭi puṉaintiruntāṉ eṉṟu mullaippāṭṭu (aṭi, 76) moḻikiṉṟatu. itaṉāl cēra cōḻa pāṇṭiya maṉṉar muṭiyaṇintiruntaṉar eṉpatu terikiṟatu. tolkāppiyarum ittamiḻ neṭunila maṉṉarkku muṭi uriyateṉṟum, kuṟunila maṉṉarkku muṭi uriyataṉṟu eṉṟum kūṟiyuḷḷār (marapiyal, nūṟpā, 71, 83). maṉṉaṟku muṭimutaṟ kalaṅkaḷ camaippēṉ (cilampu, kātai, 16; aṭi, 114) eṉṟu pāṇṭiyaṉuṭaiya araṇmaṉaip poṟkollaṉ kōvalaṉiṭam kūṟiyatum kāṇka.
talaikkōlam: murukapperumāṉ eḻuntaruḷiyuḷḷa tirupparaṅkuṉṟattuc cōlaiyil viḷaiyāṭik koṇṭirunta cūrara makaḷir (teyvamakaḷir), cītēvi eṉṉum talaikkōlattuṭaṉē valampuri vaṭivākac ceyta talaikkōlattaiyum talaiyil vaittu, neṟṟiyiṉkaṇ cuṟāviṉatu aṅkānta vāyākap paṇṇiṉa talaikkōlam taṅkap paṇṇiṉar.
	teyva vuttiyoṭu valampuri vayiṉvaittut
tilakan taiiya tēṅkamaḻ tirunutal
makarap pakuvāy tāḻamaṇ ṇuṟuttu
									(muruku. aṭi, 23-25)
viṟali, taṉ oppaṉai mikunta kūntal aḻaku peṟattakka muṟaiyil poṉmālai aṇintiruntāḷ (pe. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 485-486).
kātaṇikaḷ
murukap perumāṉ polaṅkuḻaiyai aṇintiruntāṉ (muruku. aṭi, 86). viṟali pūṅkuḻai (poliviṉaiyuṭaiya makarak kuḻaiyai) aṇintiruntāḷ (po. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 30). āyar makaḷ kātukaḷil ciṟukuḻai (`tāḷuruvi eṉṉum kātaṇi) acaintatu (pe. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 161). marutanilattu makaḷir kātukaḷil polaṅkuḻai polintatu (aṭi, 311-312). maturai mānakarac celvamakaḷir oṇkuḻai aṇintiruntaṉar (ma. kā. 448). pāṇṭimātēviyarum oṇkuḻai aṇintiruntaṉar (ma. kā. aṭi, 709). pāṇṭi nāṭṭuc celvamakaḷir pūṅkuḻai (poliviṉaiyuṭaiya kuḻaiyait) tarittiruntaṉar (ne. vāṭai, aṭi, 38). pāṇṭimātēvi `neṭunīr vārkuḻai (periya oḷi oḻukiṉa makarak kuḻaiyai) aṇintiruntāḷ (aṭi, 139).
kaiyaṇikaḷ
toṭi : āṭavar piṉ kaiyil vīrattiṟku aṟikuṟiyāka aṇintatu toṭi (vīravaḷai) eṉappaṭṭatu. murukapperumāṉ `toṭiyaṇi tōḷaṉ (muruku. aṭi, 113-114, 212) eṉappaṭṭāṉ. cōḻaṉ oruvaṉ vāṉattil toṅkikkoṇṭirunta (mikavum uyaramāṉa) eyilai aḻittāṉ. avaṉ vīravaḷaiyai aṇintiruntāṉ. avaṉ tūṅkeyil eṟinta toṭittōṭ cempiyaṉ (ci. pā. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 81-82) eṉappaṭṭāṉ. tirukkōvalūrai āṇṭa malaiyamāṉ tirumuṭikkāri, kaḻal toṭit taṭakkaik kāri eṉappaṭṭāṉ (aṭi, 95). pāṇṭiyaṉ talaiyālaṅkāṉattuc ceruveṉṟa neṭuñceḻiyaṉ, valikeḻu taṭakkait toṭiyoṭu (ma. kā. aṭi, 34, 720) viḷaṅkiṉāṉ. ceṅkaṇmāttu vēḷ naṉṉaṉ cēy naṉṉaṉ eṉṟa kuṟunilamaṉṉaṉum toṭi aṇintiruntāṉ eṉṟu kūttarāṟṟuppaṭai kūṟukiṉṟatu (malai. aṭi, 577).
iṉi makaḷir toṭiyaṇintiruntamai paṟṟiya vivaraṅkaḷaik kāṇpōm:
pēymakaḷ toṭiyaṇintiruntāḷ (muruku. aṭi, 54). viṟali taṉ muṉ kaiyil toṭi tarittiruntāḷ (ci. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 14). ōymāṉāṭṭu uḻavar makaḷ toṭi aṇintiruntāḷ (aṭi, 192). toṇṭai nāṭṭup paṭṭiṉattu (māmalla purattu)c celvac ciṟumiyar kuṟuntoṭi tarittiruntaṉar (pe. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 334). aracaṉ taṅkiyirunta pāṭi vīṭṭup paṇippeṇṭir muṉ kaiyil kuṟuntoṭi aṇintiruntaṉar (mu. pā. aṭi, 45). viṟaliyar kuṟuntoṭi paricu peṟṟaṉar (ma. kā. aṭi, 217-218). maturai mānakarap parantaiyar āykōl avirtoṭi viḷaṅka vīci (ma. kā. aṭi, 563) naṭantaṉar. itaṟku, `aḻakiya tiraṭciyaiyuṭaiya viḷaṅkukiṉṟa toṭi eṉpatu nacciṉārkkiṉiyar urai. apparattaiyar, `āypoṉ avirtoṭip pāciḻai makaḷir (ma. kā. aṭi, 579) eṉappaṭṭaṉar. pāṇṭimā tēviyar `aytoṭi-naṉku ārāyntu ceyyappaṭṭa toṭi eṉpatu nacciṉārkkiṉiyar urai. `tskid¥ óªbjho kfË®’ v‹gJ F¿Šá¥gh£L¤ bjhluhF« (mo, 223-224)., `pūntoṭi-polivu peṟṟa toṭi eṉpatu nacciṉārkkiṉiyar urai. naṉṉaṉaik kaṇṭu paricil peṟac ceṉṟa viṟaliyar `ceṟitoṭi viṟaliyar eṉappaṭṭaṉar (malai. aṭi. 201).
cōḻap pēraracaṉāṉa karikālaṉuṭaiya putalvar toṭi aṇintiruntaṉar. ciṟuvar aṇintirunta toṭi vīravaḷai aṉṟu. avarkaḷ `poṟṟoṭip putalvar eṉappaṭṭaṉar (pa. pālai, aṭi, 295).
kaṭakam : taṉ mātēviyaip pirintu pōrkkaḷam ceṉṟirunta vēntaṉ kaiyil kaṭakattai aṇintiruntāṉ eṉṟu mullaippāṭṭu (aṭi, 76) moḻikiṉṟatu. kaṭakam-kaṅkaṇam (kṣacayaunaṭanava) eṉpatu, `kaṭakam ceṟinta kai eṉavarum maṇimēkalaiyaṭiyāl (kātai 6; aṭi, 114) aṟiyappaṭum.
vantikai :  itu kaiyil tōḷiṉkīḻ aṇiyappaṭum aṇi vakai. itu `kai vanti eṉappaṭum. ippoḻutu `vaṅki eṉa maruvi vaḻaṅkukiṟatu. maturaic celvamakaḷir itaṉai aṇintiruntaṉar eṉṟu maturaik kāñci moḻikiṉṟatu (aṭi, 415).
vaḷai
kiṇaimakaḷ, vaḷaikkaik kiṇaimakaḷ eṉappaṭṭāḷ (ci. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 136). toṇṭai nāṭṭu maṟaiyavaṉ maṉaivi `vaḷaikkai makaṭūu eṉappaṭṭāḷ (pe. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 304). pāṇṭimātēvi caṅkuvaḷai aṇintiruntāḷ.
	polampoṭi tiṉṟa mayirvār muṉkai
valampuri vaḷai
				(neṭu. aṭi, 141-142)
`valampurivaḷai-valampuri caṅkai aṟuttuc ceyyappaṭṭa vaḷai eṉpatu nacciṉārkkiṉiyar urai. kuṟiñci nilattalaivi elvaḷai (oḷiporuntiya vaḷai) tarittiruntāḷ (ku. pā. aṭi, 167). naṉṉaṉaik kāṇac ceṉṟa kūttaruṭaṉ irunta viṟaliyar ilaṅkuvaḷai viṟaliyar (malai, aṭi, 46) eṉappaṭṭaṉar. ivviṟaliyarē mēl ceṟitoṭi viṟaliyar (malai, 201) eṉappaṭṭaṉar. eṉavē, ivviṟaliyar tam kaikiḷil vaḷaikaḷaiyum toṭiyaiyum aṇintiruntaṉar eṉpatu terikiṟatu. eṉavē, muṉpu kūṟiyavāṟu toṭi eṉpatu kaiyiṟ ceṟintuḷḷa ikkālak kolucu pōṉṟa aṇi eṉak koḷvatē poruttamākum.
viralaṇi : talaiyālaṅkāṉattuc ceruveṉṟa pāṇṭiyaṉ neṭuñceḻiyaṉ,
polañceyap polinta nalampeṟu viḷakkam
					(ma. kā. aṭi, 719)
aṇintiruntāṉ. `poṉṉāṟ ceykaiyiṉālē polivu peṟṟa maṇikaḷ aḻuttiṉa mōtiram eṉṟu ittoṭarkku nacciṉārkkiṉiyar poruḷ kūṟiyuḷḷār pāṇṭimātēviṉ mōtiram,
vāḷaip pakuvāy kaṭuppa vaṇakkuṟuttuc
cevviral koḷīiya ceṅkēḻ viḷakkam
eṉṟu neṭunalvāṭaiyil (aṭi, 143-144) pēcappaṭṭuḷḷatu. itaṟku, `vāḷaiyiṉatu pakutta vāyai okka muṭakkattai uṇṭākkic civanta viraliṭattēyiṭṭa civanta niṟattaiyuṭaiya `muṭakku eṉṉum mōtiram eṉṟu nacciṉārkkiṉiyar urai varaintuḷḷār.
vāḷaip pakuvāy vaṇakkuṟu mōtiram
eṉa varum cilappatikāra aṭikku (kātai 6; aṭi, 95), `muṭakku-mōtiram eṉṟu arumpatavuraiyāciriyar urai varaintuḷḷamaiyum, `neḷi eṉṟu aṭiyārkku nallār varaintiruttalum iṅku niṉaittaṟpālaṉ.
iṭai aṇikaḷ
kuṟumpoṟi: murukap perumāṉ kuṟamakaḷiroṭu kuravaik kūṭuttāṭukaiyil araiyil kuṟumpoṟi aṇintiruppaṉ eṉṟu tirumurukāṟṟuppaṭai terivikkiṟatu.
kuṟumpoṟik koṇṭa naṟuntaṇ cāyal
maruṅku  (muruku. aṭi, 213-214).
`kuṟumpoṟi-utarapantam eṉpatu nacciṉārkkiṉiyar urai. utaram-vayiṟu; utarapantam-vayiṟṟaip poruntiyuḷḷa aṇi.
cilkāḻ: tirupparaṅkuṉṟattuc cōlaiyil viḷaiyāṭiya cūrara makaḷir, palkācu niraitta cilkāḻ aṇintiruntaṉar eṉṟu tirumurukāṟṟuppaṭai (aṭi, 16) kūṟukiṟatu. ittoṭarkku nacciṉārkkiṉiyar, `pala maṇikaḷ kōtta ēḻu vaṭamākiya mēkalai eṉapporuḷ kūṟiyuḷḷār. avarē, tam kūṟṟukkuk kīḻ varum veṇpāvai mēṟkōḷākak kāṭṭiyuḷḷār.
eṇkōvai kāñci, eḻukōvai mēkalai,
paṇkoḷ kalāpam patiṉāṟu,-kaṇkoḷ
parumam patiṉeṭṭu, muppat tiraṇṭu
viricikai eṉṟuṇaraṟ pāṟṟu.
parumam: tiruvāvinaṉkuṭiyil murukaṉaip pukaḻntēttiya kantaruva makaḷir (pāṭiṉiyar) `iṉṉakaip parumam (muruku. aṭi, 145-146) eṉṉum aṇiyai araiyil aṇintiruntaṉar. itaṟku nacciṉārkkiṉiy, `kaṇṇukkiṉiya oḷiyiṉaiyuṭaiya patiṇeṉkōvaiyatākiya mēkalai,1 eṉap poruḷ kūṟiyuḷḷār.
palkāḻ: viṟali, vaṇṭirup paṉṉa palkāḻ2 (po. ā. paṭai aṭi, 39) aṇintiruntāḷ. `pala vaṇṭiṉaṅkaḷiṉ iruppai otta pala maṇikaḷ kōtta vaṭaṅkaḷaiyuṭaiya mēkalai eṉpatu nacciṉārkkiṉiyar urai.
paiṅkāḻ: toṇṭai nāṭṭup paṭṭiṉattaip (piṟkāla māmallapurattai)c cērnta celvamakaḷir paiṅkāḻ araiyil aṇintiruntaṉar eṉṟu perum pāṇāṟṟuppaṭai (aṭi, 329) kūṟukiṟatu. `paiṅkāḻ-paciya maṇikaḷ kōtta vaṭaṅkaḷ eṉpatu nacciṉārkkiṉiyar urai.
kālaṇikaḷ
cūrara maṅkaiyar kālkaḷil kiṇkiṇi aṇintiruntaṉar eṉṟu tirumurukāṟṟuppaṭai (aṭi, 13) kūṟukiṟatu. `kiṇkiṇi-ciṟu cataṅkai eṉpatu nacciṉārkkiṉiyar urai.
toṇṭai nāṭṭup paṭṭiṉattu (ikkāla māmallapurattu)c celva makaḷir `tamaṉiyap poṟcilampu aṇintiruntaṉar. itaṟku nacciṉārkkiṉiyar, `poṟpūṇ kaḷaiyum poṟcilampaiyum aṇintiruntaṉar eṉṟu poruḷ kūṟiyuḷḷār. itaṉāl, accelva makaḷir poṟcilampaiyum, poṟkāppu, poṟkolucu mutaliya kālaṇikaḷaiyum aṇintiruntaṉar eṉpatu terikiṟatu.1
maturai nakarac celvamakaḷir `teḷḷarip poṟ cilampu aṇintiruntaṉar (ma. kā. aṭi, 444). itaṟku nacciṉārkkiṉiyar, `teḷḷiya uḷḷiṉ maṇikaḷaiyuṭaiya poṟcilampukaḷ eṉṟu poruḷ varaintuḷḷār. ivai, pāṇṭimātēviyiṉ muttupparalkaḷaik koṇṭa cilampaiyum kaṇṇakiyiṉ māṇikkapparalkaḷaiyuṭaiya cilampaiyum pōṉṟavai.
cōḻanāṭṭuk kuṟumpallūrkaḷil vāḻnta celvar viṭṭuc ciṟuvarkaḷ, `poṟkāṟputalvar (pa. pālai, aṭi, 24) eṉappaṭṭārkaḷ. itaṟku nacciṉārkkiṉiyar, `pūṇ aṇinta tāḷiṉaiyuṭaiya ciṟār eṉṟu poruḷ kūṟiyuḷḷār. eṉavē, celvar vīṭṭuc ciṟuvarkaḷ kālkaḷil poṟkiṇkiṇi, poṟkāppu mutaliya kālaṇikaḷai aṇintārkaḷ eṉpatu uṇarappaṭum.


kaḻuttaṇikaḷ
kaḻuttil toṅkaviṭappaṭṭu mārpai aṇi ceyyum aṇikaḷaik `kaḻuttaṇikaḷ allatu `mārpaṇikaḷ eṉṟu collalām.
muttu mālai : kaḻuttaṇikaḷuḷ muttu mālai oṉṟu. pāṭiṉi muttu mālaiyai aṇintiruntāḷ (po. M., paṭai, aṭi, 162). maturai nakarattu makaḷir muttu mālai aṇintiruntaṉar (ma. kā. aṭi, 680-681). pāṇṭiyaṉ talaiyālaṅkāṉattuc ceruveṉṟa neṭuñceḻiyaṉ muttumālaiyait tarittiruntāṉ (ma. kā. aṭi, 715). pāṇṭimātēvi muttāṟceyyappaṭṭa kacciṉai2 mārpil aṇintiruntāḷ (neṭu, aṭi, 136).
poṉṉari mālai: karikālaṉ `nūliṉ valavānuṇaṅkaril mālaiyaip (po. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 161) pāṭiṉikkup paricaḷippāṉ eṉṟu pulavar kūṟiyuḷḷār. `nūlāṟ kaṭṭāta nuṇmaiyaiyum piṇakkattaiyum uṭaiya poṉṉari mālai eṉṟu nacciṉārkkiṉiyar itaṟku urai vakuttuḷḷār. poṟkampikaḷ koṇṭu nuṇmaiyākavum nerukkamākavum piṉṉappaṭṭa poṉṉari mālai eṉpatu itaṉ poruḷ. ittakaiya poṉṉari mālaiyai murukap perumāṉatu ūrtiyāṉa piṇimukam eṉṉum yāṉaiyum aṇintiruntatu eṉṟu tirumurukāṟṟuppaṭai terivikkiṟatu (aṭi, 79). murukap perumāṉatu mārpil poṉmālai polivuṟṟatu eṉṟu tirumurukāṟṟuppaṭai (aṭi, 104, urai) terivikkiṉṟatu.
muttu mālaiyum poṉṉari mālaiyum kaḻuttaiyum mārpaiyum aṇi ceytāṟpōlavē vēṟu cila aṇivakaikaḷum aṇi ceytaṉa eṉpatu pala iṭaṅkaḷil kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷa pūṇ, iḻai, kalam allatu kalaṉ eṉṉum coṟkaḷāl terikiṟatu. āyiṉ, avai yāvai eṉpatu iṉṟu viḷaṅkumāṟillai.
cūrara makaḷir `nuṇpūṇ ākan tiḷaippa (muruku. aṭi, 32) iruntaṉar. nuṇṇiya vēlaippāṭamainta pūṇkaḷ mārpil viḷaṅka iruntaṉar eṉpatu maṭṭumē ittoṭarāl aṟiyappaṭukiṉṟatē tavira, ākattai aḻaku ceyta appūṇkaḷ iṉṉavai eṉpatu aṟiya iyalavillai. pāṇṭi mātēvi mārpil aṇintiruntāṟpōṉṟa muttukkaccum, mātavi kaḻuttil aṇintirunta vīraccaṅkili, nērñcaṅkili, ñāṇ, cavaṭi, carappaḷi, muttu mālai pōṉṟa kaḻuttaṇikaḷum `ākattil tiḷaitta nuṇpūṇkaḷ eṉṉalām.
 `pūṇakat toṭuṅkiya vemmulai
eṉpatu ciṟupāṇāṟṟuppaṭai (aṭi, 26) ākum. itu, viṟaliyiṉ mārpaṇikaḷaik kuṟikkiṉṟatu.
maturai nakarap parattaiyar, `nuṇpūṇ ākam vaṭukkoḷa muyaṅkiṉar eṉṟu maturaikkāñci (aṭi, 569) moḻikiṉṟatu. `pūṇ-pūṇkaḷ eṉpatu nacciṉārkkiṉiyar urai.
 maintiṟai koṇṭa malarntēt takalattut
toṉṟupaṭu naṟuntār pūṇoṭu poliya
eṉpaṉa kuṟiñcippāṭṭu aṭikaḷ (121-122) ivvaṭikaḷ kuṟiñci nilattalaivaṉuṭaiya mārpil `toṉṟu toṭṭu varukiṉṟa pēraṇikaḷaik kuṟikkiṉṟaṉa.
 karikālaṉ `oṇpūṇ aṇintavaṉ (pa. pālai, aṭi, 297). `oṇpūṇ-oḷḷiya pēraṇikalaṅkaḷ eṉpatu nacciṉārkkiṉiyar urai. ippēraṇikalaṅkaḷuḷ mārpaṇikaḷaiyum koḷḷalām.
naṉṉaṉ, `perumpūṇ naṉṉaṉ (malai. aṭi, 63-64). `perumpūṇ-pēraṇikalaṅkaḷ eṉṟu nacciṉārkkiṉiyar urai kūṟiyuḷḷār.
 aimperuṅkuḻuviṉar polampūṇ aivar (ma. kā. aṭi, 775) eṉappaṭṭaṉar. iṅkum `pūṇ-poṉṉāṟ ceyta pēraṇikalaṅkaḷ eṉṟē nacciṉārkkiṉiyar urai kūṟiyuḷḷār.
	 maturaic celva makaḷirai, pūṇoṭu
teḷḷarip poṟcilampu olippa oḷḷaḻal
tāvaṟa viḷaṅkiya āypoṉ aviriḻai
aṇaṅkuvīḻ vaṉṉa pūntoṭi makaḷir
eṉṟu maturaikkāñci (aṭi, 443-446) moḻikiṉṟatu. ivvaṭikaḷil ammakaḷiruṭaiya kālaṇiyākiya cilampum, kaiyaṇiyākiya toṭiyum taṉittaṉiyē kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa; pūṇ eṉṟum iḻai eṉṟum iruvēṟu nakaivakaikaḷum kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa. eṉavē, iḻai vēṟu, kālaṇi vēṟu, kaiyaṇi vēṟu, pūṇ vēṟu eṉpatu ivvaṭikaḷāl pulaṉākiṉṟatu allavā? āyiṉum, pūṇkaḷ ivai, iḻaikaḷ ivai eṉa varaiyaṟuttuk kūṟac cāṉṟu kiṭṭavillai.
umaṇaruṭaiya putalvar, `kiḷarpūṇ putalvar eṉap paṭṭaṉar (pe. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 61). iṅkup `pūṇ eṉpatu nakai eṉṉum potupporuḷaiyē uṇarttukiṟatu.
toṇṭai nāṭṭu eyiṉar maṇṇaik kiḷaṟak kaikkoṇṭirunta kōliṉ talaiyil pūṇ iruntatu (pe. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 90-92). iḷantiraiyaṉuṭaiya yāṉaik kompil pūṇ iruntatu (pe. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 436-437). pūṇ eṉpatu iṟukkamākap pōṭappaṭuvatu. makkaḷ kaikaḷil kāppum iṟukkamākap pōṭappaṭuvatēyākum. iṅṅaṉamē kaḻuttil aṭṭikaiyum iṟukkamākap pōṭappaṭuvatu. ittakaiya kuṟippiṭṭa nakaikaḷukku mutalil vaḻaṅkappaṭṭa `pūṇ eṉṉum col, kālappōkkil taṉ poruḷil nekiḻntu vēṟu aṇikaḷukkum vaḻaṅkappaṭṭatātal vēṇṭum eṉak koḷvatē iṅkup poruttamākum.
`ākam, mārpu eṉṉum coṟkaḷōṭu varum `pūṇ eṉṉum col mārpaṇikaḷaik kuṟippatu eṉṟum ivai yaṉṟip potuppaṭa varum `pūṇ eṉṉum col potuvāka ellā aṇikaḷaiyum kuṟikkap payaṉpaṭṭirukkalām eṉṟum koḷvatē īṇṭaikkup poruttamākum.
mātaṇi : kaḻuttaṇiyiliruntu mārpai aṇi ceyyum patakkam `matāṇi eṉappaṭṭatu. maturai nakar vāḻvaracikaḷ matāṇi aṇintiruntārkaḷ (ma. kā. aṭi, 461).
iḻai: `iḻai puṉainar (ma. kā. aṭi, 512) eṉṉum toṭarukku nacciṉārkkiṉiyar, `iḻaikkappaṭṭa nakaiyākac ceypavar eṉṟu poruḷ kūṟiyuḷḷār. poṉṉaik kampikaḷāka iḻaittuc ceyyum caraṭu pōṉṟavaiyum, kalliḻaittup poṉṉil patittuc ceyyappaṭuvaṉavum `iḻai eṉappaṭṭaṉa pōlum!
1. cūraramakaḷir cāmpūnatam eṉṟa uyarnta poṉṉālāṉa iḻaiyai (aviriḻai) aṇintiruntaṉar (muruku. aṭi, 18).
2. kāṭukiḻāḷ (turkkai) eṉappaṭṭa `paḻaiyōḷ iḻai aṇintiruntāḷ (muruku. aṭi, 259). kāṭu kiḻāḷiṉ tiruṉikku iḻai aṇiyappaṭṭu vaḻipaṭappaṭṭatu eṉpatu itaṉ karuttu.1
3. maturai nakara makaḷir kālaiyil eḻuntu, `oṇ poṉ aviriḻai teḻippa iyaṅkiṉar (ma. kā. aṭi, 666). ittoṭarukku nacciṉārkkiṉiyar, `oḷḷiya poṉṉāṟceytu viḷaṅkum cilampu mutaliyaṉa olippa iyaṅkiṉar eṉṟu poruḷ kūṟiyuḷḷār.
4. māṇiḻai (ma. kā. aṭi, 680) eṉpataṟku nacciṉārkkiṉiyar `māṭcimaippaṭṭa pēraṇikalaṅkaḷ eṉṟu poruḷ kūṟiyuḷḷār.
5. pāṇṭimātēviyar, `tamaṉiyam vaḷaiiya tāvil viḷaṅkiḻai (ma. kā. aṭi, 704) aṇintiruntaṉar. itaṟkup poṉ naṭu aḻuttiṉa maṇikaḷaic cūḻnta pēraṇikalaṅkaḷ eṉṟu nacciṉārkkiṉiyar urai kūṟiyuḷḷār.
6. pāṇṭiyaṉatu araṇmaṉaip paṇippeṇṭirum `ilaṅkiḻai1 aṇintiruntaṉar (ma. kā. aṭi, 779).
7. maturai nakarac celvamakaḷir, `aviriḻai tarittiruntaṉar (ma. kā. aṭi, 445).
8. makaḷir tam kātalaraikkūṭa iḻai puṉaintaṉar (ma. kā. aṭi, 551).
9. maturai nakarap parattaiyar `pāciḻai (pacum poṉṉāl āṉa allatu paccaikkaṟkaḷ patitta nakaikaḷai) aṇintiruntaṉar (ma. kā. aṭi, 579).
10. maturaiyil vāṇikam ceyta makaḷir, oḷḷiḻai (oḷḷiya aṇikalaṅkaḷait) tarittiruntaṉar (ma. kā. aṭi, 623).
11. cōḻanāṭṭuc celvamakaḷir `nēriḻaikaḷai aṇintiruntaṉar (pa. pālai, aṭi, 22).
12. paṭṭiṉappālai eṉṉam neṭumpaṭṭiṟkūṟappaṭṭuḷḷa talaimakaṉ, taṉ talaiviyai vayaṅkiḻai eṉṟu cuṭṭiyuḷḷāṉ (aṭi, 219).
13. karikālaṉ maṉaiviyar `muṟṟiḻai makaḷir eṉappaṭṭaṉar (pa. pālai, aṭi, 296). `muṟṟiḻai-meym muḻuvatum aṇinta aṇikalaṅkaḷ eṉpatu nacciṉārkkiṉiyar urai.
14. naṉṉaṉ, viṟaliyar aṇiya `viḷaṅkiḻai taravāṉ (malai. aṭi, 570) eṉṟu avaṉiṭam vaṟiya kūttaṉai vaḻippaṭuttiya kūttar talaivaṉ kūṟiṉāṉ.
kalam-kalaṉ
cōḻaṉ karikālaṉ araṇmaṉaiyil tēṟal polaṅ kalattil vārttup porunarkkut tarappaṭṭatu (po. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 86). polaṅkalam-poṟpāttiram. iṅṅaṉamē pāṇṭiyaṉ neṭuñceḻiyaṉ araṇmaṉaiyilum tēṟal vārkkap polaṅkalamē payaṉpaṭṭatu (ma. kā. aṭi, 779). ivviraṇṭu iṭaṅkaḷilum `kalam eṉṉum col `pāttiram eṉṉum poruḷil āḷappaṭṭuḷḷatu. āyiṉ, ikkalam eṉṉum col nakaiyaik kuṟikkavum āḷappaṭṭuḷḷatu. cila cāṉṟukaḷaik kīḻē kāṇka.
1. naṉkalañ cīppa eṉpatu maturaik kāñcit toṭar (aṭi, 685). `naṉkalam-nalla pūṇkaḷ eṉpatu urai.
2. kuṟiñci nilat talaivi,
	muttiṉum maṇiyiṉum poṉṉiṉum attuṇai
nērvaruṅ kuraiya kalam (ku. pā. aṭi, 13-14).
aṇintāḷ. `kalam-pūṇ eṉpatu nacciṉārkkiṉiyar urai.
3. kalampeṟu kaṇṇuḷar eṉṟu malaipaṭukaṭāttil (50) kūttar kuṟikkappaṭṭuḷḷaṉar. `pēraṇi kalaṅkaḷaip peṟum kūttar eṉpatu ittoṭarkku uraiyākum. kalam-pēraṇikalaṅkaḷ.
4. `naṉantalait tēettu naṉkalaṉ uymmār eṉpatu maturaik kāñciyil varum toṭar. `kalaṉ eṉpataṟkup `pēraṇikalaṅkaḷ eṉṟu nacciṉārkkiṉiyar urai kūṟiyuḷḷār.
5. maturai nakarak kaḷvar, `kalaṉacaiik koṭṭum kaṇmā ṟāṭavar (ma. kā. aṭi, 641-642) eṉappaṭṭaṉar. iṅkum `kalaṉ eṉpataṟkup `pēraṇikalaṅkaḷ eṉpatē poruḷākum.
paricu aṇikaḷ
caṅkakālat tamiḻvēntar tammai nāṭivanta pāṇar, kūttar, viṟaliyarkkup poṉṉakaikaḷ paricaḷittaṉar; avaṟṟōṭu ciṟappākac cila nakaikaḷai vaḻaṅkiṉar.
1. karikāl vaḷavaṉ porunaṉukkup poṟṟāmarai malaraiyum pāṭiṉikkup poṉṉari mālaiyaiyum vaḻaṅkuvāṉ eṉṟu paricil peṟṟu mīṇṭa porunaṉ kūṟiṉāṉ (aṭi, 159-162).
2. iḷantiraiyaṉ pāṇaṉukkup poṟṟāmaraiyum viṟalikkuk kūntalaṇiyākap poṉmālaiyaiyum vaḻaṅkiṉāṉ (pe. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 481, 485-486).
3. naṉṉaṉ eṉṟa ciṟṟaracaṉ kūttarkkup poṟṟāmaraiyaiyum viṟaliyarkku iḻaikaḷaiyum (pēraṇikalaṅkaḷaiyum) paricaḷittāṉ (malai, aṭi, 569-570).
4. pāṇṭiyaṉ neṭuñceḻiyaṉ vīrarkkup poṉṉāṟ ceyta tumpaip pūvaip (polampūn tumpai) paricaḷittāṉ (ma. kā. aṭi, 737).
ivaṟṟuḷ poṉṉarimalaiyum iḻaikaḷum muṉpē aṇikaḷ varicaiyuḷ iṭam peṟṟavai. aṅku iṭam peṟātavai poṟṟāmaraiyum polampūntumpaiyumēyākum. ittakaiya paricup poruḷkaḷ aṇiyattakkavai ātaliṉ, aṇikaḷ varicaiyil iṭam peṟṟaṉa.
yāṉai-kutirai aṇikaḷ
murukapperumāṉuṭaiya yāṉai poṉṉari malaiyaiyum neṟṟippaṭṭattaiyum aṇintiruntatu (muruku. aṭi, 79). naṉṉaṉuṭaiya kutiraikaḷukku aṇiyap paṭṭiruntavaṟṟuḷ poṉṉāṟceyta kalaṉai (cēṇam) eṉpatu oṉṟu (malai. aṭi, 574).
kaḻal-kaḻaṅku
kaḻal: murukapperumāṉaip pōla vēṭam aṇinta vēlaṉ kālil kaḻalai (vīrakkaḻalai) aṇintiruntāṉ (muruku, aṭi, 208). iḷantiraiyaṉ vīrakkaḻalai aṇintiruntāṉ (pe. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 102-103). pāṇṭi nāṭṭu vīrar talaiyil poṟpūvum kālil vīrakkaḻalum tarittiruntaṉar (ma. kā. aṭi, 395-396) maturai nakarac celvar vīrakkaḻarai aṇintiruntaṉar (ma. kā. aṭi, 436). kuṟiñci nilattalaivaṉ taṉ kālil kaḻalait tarittiruntāṉ (ku. pā. aṭi, 126-127).
kaḻaṅku: toṇṭai nāṭṭup paṭṭiṉattuc celvac ciṟumiyar poṟkaḻaṅkukaḷai (poṉṉāṟceyta kaḻaṟcik kāykaḷai)k koṇṭu viḷaiyāṭiṉar (pe. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 334-335).
poṉ vakai
pattuppāṭṭuḷ poṉ vakaikaḷ cila veḷippaṭaiyākak kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa. cāta rūpam, kiḷicciṟai, āṭakam, cāmpūnatam eṉap poṉ nālvakaippaṭum (cilampu, kātai, 14; aṭi, 201-203). tāṉ kiṭaikkum iṭattiṟku ēṟpap poṉ peyar peṟum eṉpatai nam muṉṉōr kaṇṭaṟintaṉar. `cātakumpā eṉṉum malaiyilkiṭaitta poṉ `cātakumpā eṉap peyar peṟṟatu. itaṉ niṟam tāmarai itaḻiṉ niṟam pōṉṟatu. `jāmpu eṉṟa natiyiṟkiṭaitta poṉ `jāmpu natam eṉappaṭṭatu. cāmpu natam-iḷañcivappu (rōcāmalar) niṟam uṭaiyatu.1
1. poṉ vakaikaḷuḷ uyarntatu cāmpunatam eṉappaṭum (tiruvaḷḷuvamālai, 36). accāmpunatam koṇṭu ceyyap paṭṭa iḻaikaḷaic cūraramakaḷir aṇintiruntaṉar (muruku. aṭi, 18).
2. civanta nīrmaiyuṭaiya `kiḷicciṟai eṉṉum poṉṉāṟ ceyta pāvai,
cennīrp pacumpoṉ puṉainta pāvai (ma. kā. aṭi, 410) eṉappaṭṭatu. itu māṟṟu uyarntatu. vīṟuyar pacumpoṉ-māṟṟāl uyarcci peṟṟa paciya poṉ; āvatu kiḷicciṟai eṉpataṉāl (cilampu, 3, 165 urai) iḵtu uṇarappaṭum.
kaṭṭaḷaikkal
ippoṉ vakaikaḷai uraittu māṟṟuk kāṇap payaṉpaṭṭa uraikal kaṭṭaḷaikkal eṉappaṭṭatu.
perumaikkum ēṉaic ciṟumaikkum tattam
karumamē kaṭṭaḷaik kal
eṉpatu tirukkuṟaḷ. itu `kaṭṭaḷai eṉavum vaḻaṅkappaṭum.
poṉkāṇ kaṭṭaḷai kaṭuppa (pe. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 220).
itaṟkup `poṉṉai uraittu māṟṟukkāṇum urai kal eṉpatu nacciṉārkkiṉiyar urai.
III
maṇikaḷum maṇiyaṇikaḷum
oṉpatu vakai maṇikaḷ
vairam, muttu, marakatam, māṇikkam, nīlam, puṭparākam, vaiṭūriyam, kōmētakam, pavaḻam eṉpaṉa oṉpatu vakai maṇikaḷ eṉappaṭum. ivai mikka vilai matippu vāyntavai. ivaṟṟuḷ vairam, muttu, marakatam, māṇikkam eṉṉum nāṉkum talaimaṇikaḷ eṉṟum; nīlam, puṭparākam, vaiṭūriyam eṉṉum mūṉṟum iṭaimaṇikaḷ eṉṟum; pavaḻam, kōmētakam eṉṉum iraṇṭum kaṭaimaṇikaḷ eṉṟum collappaṭum.1 immaṇikaḷiṉ niṟam, ivai kiṭaikkum iṭaṅkaḷ, ivaipaṟṟiya makkaḷ karuttukaḷ ākiyavaṟṟai mutaṟkaṇ iṅkuk kāṇpōm.
1. vairam: ituvē oṉpatu vakai maṇikaḷilum matippu mikkatu; uṟuti vāyntatu. marakkariyē pallāyiram āṇṭukaḷ nilattiṉ aṭiyil aḻuttappaṭṭu vairamāy māṟiyatu eṉpatu viyappukkuriyataṉṟō? itu veṇmai, cemmai, poṉmai, karumai eṉa niṟattāl nāṉku vakaippaṭum. iḵtu intiyāvilum teṉṉamerikkāvilum āppirikkāvilum kiṭaikkiṉṟatu. intiya vairam pala nūṟṟāṇṭukaḷākap pukaḻ peṟṟatu. `kōl koṇṭā vayiram mikka pukaḻ vāyntatu. kuṟṟamaṟṟa vairattai aṇipavar kutirai vēḷvi ceyvatāl uṇṭākum payaṉaip peṟuvar eṉṟum, uyarnta vairattaik kuṟainta vilai kūṟupavaṉum maṭṭamāṉa vairattiṟku uyarnta vilai colpavaṉum pala tuṉpaṅkaḷai aṭaivar eṉṟum nūlkaḷ kūṟum.
2. muttu: itu vairattai aṭuttuc ciṟappuṭaiyatākum. paṇṭait tamiḻakattuk kiḻakkuk karaiyil pāṇṭi nāṭṭuk kapāṭapuramum piṟkālattil koṟkaiyum muttukkup peyar peṟṟa iṭaṅkaḷāyiruntaṉa. tamiḻaka muttukaḷ mēṉāṭukaḷukkup peritum ēṟṟumatiyāyiṉa. cippi eṉṉum kaṭalvāḻ uyiriṉāl uṇṭākkappaṭum muttut tamiḻakattum cīṉāvilum jappāṉilum pāracīka vaḷaikuṭāvilum1 amerikkāvilum iṉṟu eṭukkappaṭukiṟatu. muttut tūymaikku aṟikuṟi. aḵtu eppoḻutum aṇiyattakuvatu. pēraracar palar muttai urukki uṇavōṭu kalantu uṇṭaṉar; tam āṭaikaḷai muttukaḷāl aṇi ceytaṉar; tam mitiyaṭikaḷilum muttukaḷaip payaṉpaṭuttiṉar. intiyāvil pala aṇikaḷ muttukaḷaik koṇṭē ceyyappaṭṭaṉa. aracar, pulavarkkum pōr vīrarkkum piṟarkkum muttu mālaikaḷaip paricaḷittaṉar.
3. marakatam: itaṉ niṟam pacumai. ataṉāl, itu `paccaikkal eṉṟum collappaṭum. marakata liṅkaṅkaḷ namatu tamiḻ nāṭṭuk kōvilkaḷ cilavaṟṟil pūcaiyil uḷḷaṉa. ivai oḷik katirkaḷuṭaṉ meṉmait taṉmaiyum uṭaiyavai. marakatam intiyā, raṣiyā, teṉṉamerikkā, vaṭavamerikkā, airōppāvil ālp malaippakuti, nārvē, ātirēli yāvil niyūcauttu vēl ākiya nāṭukaḷilum iṭaṅkaḷilum kiṭaikkiṟatu; intiyāvil jeyppūr marakatam uyarntatu. marakatam, taṉṉai aṇipavarkkuc celvattaiyum pēccu vaṉmaiyaiyum uṇṭākkum; piḷḷaip pēṟṟil tāykku nalam viḷaikkum; kaṇṇukku nalam ceyyum; kaṟput tavaṟiyavaḷiṭam uḷḷa marakatam pala tuṇṭukaḷāka veṭikkum eṉṟu makkaḷ nampiṉārkaḷ.
4. māṇikkam: itu cenniṟam uḷḷatu. itu `patumarākam eṉṟum peyar peṟum. itu nāṉku vakaippaṭum. māṇikkattiṟkup paṇṭutoṭṭē peyar pōṉa iṭam parmā. caiyām, intōcīṉam, āpkāṉitāṉam, kācumīr eṉṉum iṭaṅkaḷilum māṇikkak kaṟkaḷ kiṭaikkiṉṟaṉa. māṇikkam teyvika āṟṟalaiyum takutiyaiyum taruvatu eṉpatu makkaḷ nampikkai.
5. nīlam: iḵtu eṭṭu vakaippaṭum eṉṟu kauṭilyar kūṟiyuḷḷār. `iruḷait teḷiya vaittālaṉaiya nīlamaṇi eṉṟu itaṉai iḷaṅkōvaṭikaḷ kūṟiyuḷḷār. intiyāviṉ teṉpakutiyiliruntu nīlamum paccaiyum ulakameṅkum aṉuppappaṭṭaṉavām. itu taṉṉai aṇintavarkku uyarnta naṉmai allatu tīmaiyai aḷikka vallatu eṉpatu makkaḷ nampikkai.
6. puṭparākam: itu poṉ pōṉṟa mañcaḷ niṟamuṭaiyatu. itaṉ mañcaṭpaṭikaṅkaḷ nakaikaḷil mikutiyākap payaṉpaṭukiṉṟatu. pirēcil nāṭṭu malaiccarivukaḷilum, kiḻakkuc caipīriyāvilum, niyūcauttu vēlsilum, vaṭakku naijīriyā, ṭāmēṉiyā eṉṉum iṭaṅkaḷilum puṭparākak kaṟkaḷ kiṭaikkiṉṟaṉa. pirēcil nāṭṭiṟ kiṭaippaṉavē mikavuyarnta kaṟkaḷām. `puṭparākam taṅkaniṟamuṭaiyatu, vaṭṭavaṭivamāṉatu; nerupputtuṇṭu pōṉṟa oḷiyuṭaiyatu; kaṇṭōr maṉattaik kavarvatu, eṉṟu āṅkīra muṉivar moḻintuḷḷār. itaṉait toṭarntu aṇiyum malaṭiyum tāyāvāḷ; itu taṉṉai aṇintavarkkup pukaḻ, naṭpu, makiḻcci, āyuḷ nīṭṭi ākiyavaṟṟai uṇṭākkum eṉpatu makkaḷ nampikkai.
7. vaiṭūriyam: itu paḻuppuniṟa oḷiyum veṇmaiyāṉa oḷiyum uṭaiyatu; tēṉtuḷi pōṉṟa uruvamuṭaiyatu. iḵtu airōppāvil raiṉ āṟṟiṉ kiḷaiyāṟāṉa nāhi (cūyāna) yiṉ karaiyil pala nūṟṟāṇṭukaḷākak kiṭaittu varukiṟatu; teṉṉamerikkāvil uḷḷa pirēcil, urukuvē eṉṉum nāṭukaḷil mikutiyākak kiṭaikkiṟatu; iṅkilāntu, kāṭṭulāntu nāṭukaḷilum kiṭaikkiṟatu; vaṭavamerikkāvil cila iṭaṅkaḷilum kiṭaikkiṟatu.
itu vaḷattait tarum; viṭam toṭṭa kaiyil iruppiṉ poṭiyāyviṭum; kuḷikkum nīril iṭappeṟiṉ, annīr uṭaṟkaṭṭikaḷai nīkkum eṉpatu makkaḷ nampikkai. pāracīka maṉṉar itaṉai aṇintu vantaṉar. cevvintiyar itaṉaic ciṟappuṭaiyatāka matikkiṉṟaṉar; `nāṭkālaiyil itaṉaip pārppavar annāḷai naṉ muṟaiyiṟkaḻippar; itu taṉṉai aṇintiruppavarkkup pōril veṟṟiyaiyum aṉaivarālum virumpappaṭum nilaiyaiyum uṇṭākkum, eṉṟu kūṟukiṉṟaṉar.
8. kōmētakam: itu pacuviṉ ciṟunīr niṟattaip peṟṟiruppatāl, `kōmētakam eṉap peyar peṟṟatu. itu mañcaḷum civappum kalantatu pōṉṟa niṟamuṭaiyatu. itu karuṅkaṟpāṟaikaḷil kāṇappaṭukiṟatu. itu pirēcil nāṭṭilum yūral malaikaḷilum, ayarlāntu, kāṭṭulāntu, vaṭavamorikkā mutaliya nāṭukaḷilum kiṭaikkiṉṟatu. itu niṟattil urukkiya neyttuḷi, tēṉ tuḷi, pacuviṉ ciṟunīr ākiyavaṟṟai ottiruppatu. itupala iṭaṅkaḷiṟ puṭparākak kalluṭaṉ kiṭaikkiṟatu. itait toṭarntu aṇintāl, malaṭiyum tāymai aṭaivāḷ; itaṉai aṇintavarkkup pukaḻ, naṭpu, makiḻcci, āyuḷ nīṭṭippu ākiyavai uṇṭākum eṉpatu makkaḷ nampikkaiyākum.
9. pavaḻam: itu muttaippōṉṟa kaṭalpaṭu poruḷākum. itu kaṭalil vāḻum oru vakaip pūccikaḷāl uṇṭāvatu. iḵtu uṟutiyāṉatu. itu civappākavum ceṭi koṭikaḷākiya putar pōlavum iruppatu. iḵtu arumpāṭu paṭṭu veṭṭiyeṭukkappaṭum. iḵtu intiyāviṟku mēṟkil uḷḷa ilaṭcattīvukaḷ, mālattīvukaḷaic cuṟṟilum, irāmēcuvarat tīvukku aṇmaiyilum, pacupikkup peruṅkaṭalil uḷḷa tīvukaḷaic cuṟṟilum, ātirēliyāviṟku vaṭakiḻakkilum vaṭa mēṟkilum naṭuttaraik kaṭalilum cappāṉ kaṭalilum, ayarlāntukkarukilum kiṭaikkiṟatu. naṭuttaraik kaṭaliṟ kiṭaikkum civanta pavaḷam mika uyarvāṉatu. iḵtu iraṇṭāyiram āṇṭukaḷukku muṉpē vāṇikac ciṟappaip peṟṟatu. tamiḻar ippavaḻattait tūymaiyuṭaiyateṉa matittaṉar. airōppiyar itaikkoṇṭu nakaikaḷaic ceytaṉar; itu piḷḷaikaḷait tīmaiyiliruntu kākka vallateṉṟu nampiṉar; itaṉaip piḷḷaikaṭku aṇivittaṉar; iṉṟum aṇivikkiṉṟaṉar. ittāli, cīṉam, āppirikkā, teṉṉamerikkā, intiyā eṉṉum nāṭukaḷil peṇṭir pavaḷa mālaikaḷai viruppattōṭu aṇikiṉṟaṉar.1
mēlē kūṟappaṭṭa oṉpatu vakai maṇikaḷum avaṟṟiṉ vakaiyum ki. mu. nāṉkām nūṟṟāṇṭiṉ piṟpātiyil cantirakupta mauriyaṉ kālattil (ki. pi. 325-301) vāḻnta kauṭilyarāl teḷivākak kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa. cilappatikāra nikaḻcci ilaṅkaik kayavāku maṉṉaṉ kālattil (ki. pi. 114-136) naṭaipeṟṟatu. akkālattavarē iḷaṅkōvaṭikaḷum ceṅkuṭṭuvaṉum. eṉavē, iḷaṅkōvaṭikaḷ kālam ēṟattāḻak ki. pi. 114-36 eṉṉalām; aḵtāvatu, kauṭilyarukku ēṟattāḻa nāṉūṟu āṇṭukaḷ piṟpaṭṭatākalām.
avar pāṇṭiyaṉ talainakarāṉa pīṭu mikka māṭa maturaiyiṉ kaṭaitteruvil irunta navamaṇikaḷaiyum avaṟṟiṉ akkāla vakaikaḷaiyum, kuṇaṅkaḷaiyum kuṟṟaṅkaḷaiyum aḻakuṟak kūṟiyuḷḷār. avar 1. vayiram, 2. marakatam, 3. māṇikkam, 4. puṭparākam, 5. vayiṭūriyam, 6. nīlam, 7. kōmētakam, 8. muttu, 9. pavaḷam ākiyavaṟṟai immuṟaiyē kūṟiyuḷḷār. avar coṟkaḷaik kīḻē kāṇka:
	kāka pātamum kaḷaṅkamum vintuvum
ēkaiyum nīṅki iyalpiṟ kuṉṟā
nūlavar noṭinta nuḻainuṇ kōṭi
nālvakai varuṇattu nalaṅkōḻ oḷiyavum,
ēkaiyum mālaiyim iruḷoṭu tuṟanta
pācār mēṉip pacuṅkatir oḷiyavum,
patumamum nīlamum vintamum paṭitamum
vitimuṟai piḻaiyā viḷaṅkiya cātiyum,
pūca vuruvil polanteḷit taṉaiyavum,
tītaṟu katiroḷit teṇmaṭ ṭuruvamum,
iruḷteḷit taṉaiyavum, iruvē ṟuruvavum,
orumait tōṟṟattu aivēṟu vaṉappiṉ
ilaṅkukatil viṭūum nalaṅkeḻu maṇikaḷum,
kāṟṟiṉum maṇṇiṉum kalliṉum nīriṉum
tōṟṟiya kuṟṟam tukaḷaṟat tuṇintavum
cantira kuruvē aṅkā rakaṉeṉa
vanta nīrmaiya vaṭṭat tokutiyum
karuppat tuḷaiyavum kalliṭai muṭaṅkalum
tirukku nīṅkiya ceṅkoṭi valliyum,
			ūrkāṇ kātai, aṭi, 180-198
aṭiyārkku nallār ivvaṭikaṭkut teḷivāṉa viḷakkavurai tantuḷḷār.
cilappatikāram oruvaṉ varalāṟu kūṟum periya kāppiyam. atil nāṭu, nakaram, aṇikaḷ, kaṭaitteru mutaliya ellāc ceytikaḷaip paṟṟiyum virivākak kūṟa vāyppuṇṭu. attakaiya vāyppu akapporuḷ paṟṟiya taṉippāṭalkaḷil illai. mēlum, akapporuṭ pāṭalkaḷ kuṟiñci, pālai, mullai, marutam, neytal eṉṉum nilaṅkaḷaip paṟṟiyum annilamakkaḷiṉ ilvāḻkkai paṟṟiyumē ciṟappākap pēcupavai; avai nakaravāḻvaic cittirippavai alla. nakara vāḻvilē tāṉ nākarikam mikutiyākak kāṇappaṭum. aṅkutāṉ uṇavu, uṭai, aṇi mutaliyaṉa paṟṟiya vivaraṅkaḷ mikutiyākap pēcappaṭum.
aivakai nilaṅkaḷilum aṇikaḷ cila uṇṭu. āyiṉum, avaṟṟai virivākap pēcap pulavarkku vāyppillai; eṉavē, ciṟcila iṭaṅkaḷil cuṭṭic celvataik kāṇalām. avaṟṟuḷḷum oṉpatu maṇikaḷaik kuṟikkum iṭaṅkaḷ mikac cilavēyākum. avaṟṟuṭcilavaṟṟaik kīḻē kāṇka:
aiṅkuṟunūṟṟil nīlamaṇi (233), maṇippūṇ (232, 234) muttu (105, 185, 193, 195) eṉpaṉa kuṟikkappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.
kuṟuntokaiyil nīlam (86, 155), poṉṉoṭu maṇi miṭainakai (274), muttu (51, 104), pavaḻam ākiyavai pēcappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.
naṟṟiṇaiyil muttu (23) iṭam peṟṟuḷḷatu. kuṇṭalam, ūcal, elvaḷai, kāḻ, (kāñci allatu mēkalai eṉṟa iṭaiyaṇi) ākiya ivai kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa (66, 239, 286). ivai kaṟkaḷ patikkappeṟṟa nakaikaḷāyirukkalām.
akanāṉūṟṟil pavaḻam (14, 243), nīlam (14, 304, 374), pavaḻac ceppu (25), tirumaṇi oḷirum pūṇ (32), muttu (108), nūliṟkōkkappeṟṟa muttumālai (289), palavaṭaṅkaḷaik koṇṭa mēkalai (385) eṉpavai kuṟikkappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.
kalittokaiyil muttu (4), mēkalai (54), talaikkōlam (54), nīlamaṇi mālai, pala maṇikaḷ koṇṭa mūṉṟuvaṭam, pavaḻam (85) māṇikkak kaṟkaḷaik koṇṭa muttuvaṭam ākiyavai kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa. mēkalaiyilum talaikkōlattilum pala vakai maṇikaḷ patittal marapu.
paripāṭalil muttu vaṭam (6), pavaḻavaḷai (11), aḻal puṉai aviriḻai (irattiṉaṅkaḷ patitta) oḷi viḷaṅkum nakaikaḷ (21), muttup paralkaḷ iṭappeṟṟa poṟ cilampu (21), mēkalai (22) eṉpavai pēcappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.
patiṟṟuppattil muttu mālai (11) kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷatu. kātaṇikaḷum kaḻuttaṇikaḷum piṟavum piṟa nūlkaḷil pēcappaṭṭavāṟē pēcappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa. avvaṇikaḷuḷ cilavō palavō maṇikaḷ patikkappeṟṟaṉa nakaikaḷ ākalām eṉakkōṭal poruttamākum.
puṟanāṉūṟṟil naḷḷi eṉṟa vaḷḷaliṉ talaiyil nīlamaṇi iruntatu; mārpil muttu vaṭam toṅkiyatu; kaiyil kaṭakam iruntatu (150), viccikkō eṉṟa ciṟṟaracaṉ maṇikaḷ patitta vaḷainta nakaiyai aṇintiruntāṉ (200). vīraṉ oruvaṉ pala vakai maṇikaḷ viraviya mālaiyait tarittiruntāṉ (291). puṟanāṉūṟṟil vayiram, pavaḻam (218), nīlam (56, 147), māṇikkam (172, 318), muttu (19), maṇiyāram (365) eṉpaṉa iṭam peṟṟuḷḷaṉa.
caṅkakāla aṇikaḷiṉ, peyarkaḷai mikutiyākak kūṟattakum nūl cilappatikāramēyākum. atil mātavi aṇinta aṇikaḷ teḷivāyk kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa. avaṟṟuṭpala, kal patitta nakaikaḷēyākum. kaṇṇaki teyvattiṉ kātil vayirattōṭu iruntateṉṟu ceṅkuṭṭuvaṉ kūṟiyuḷḷāṉ (29:9). marakatamaṇiyuṭaṉ vayiram vaittup patikkappeṟṟa palakaimītu cempavaḷattūṇ niṟuttappaṭṭatu (5:149-150). oṉpatu maṇikaḷaip paṟṟip pēcum cilappatikāram eḻunta kālattil ammaṇikaḷ tamiḻ aracar mutaliyōrait takkavāṟu aṇi ceytaṉa eṉpatil aiyamillai.
maṇimēkalai eṉṉum maṟṟoru peruṅkāppiyattil nīlam (4:24), māṇikkam (2:72). pavaḻam (18:160), pavaḻattūṇ (17:45), muttu (4:100), muttu mālai (1:49) eṉpaṉa iṭam peṟṟuḷḷaṉa.
caṅkanūlkaḷaip paṭikkumpōtu, pēraracar, ciṟṟaracar, celvar eṉpavarē immaṇikaḷaip peritum payaṉpaṭuttiṉar eṉpatum, apperumakkaḷ pulavar, pāṇar, kūttar, viṟaliyar eṉṟa muttamiḻ vāṇarkkum, veṟṟi peṟṟa pōr vīrarkkum, tāṉaittalaivarkaḷukkum immaṇikaḷālāṉa aṇikalaṅkaḷaip paricilāy vaḻaṅki makiḻntaṉar eṉpatum aṟiyappaṭum.
maṇikaḷ paṟṟi itukāṟum kūṟappaṭṭa ceytikaḷai uḷaṅkoṇṭu, pattuppāṭṭuḷ kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷa maṇikaḷaip paṟṟiya ceytikaḷaik kāṇpōm:
maṇikaḷ
nīlamaṇi pōlum pūviṉaiyuṭaiya kāyā
				(po. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 201)
nīlamaṇi pōṉṟa ciccilippaṟavai
(ci. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 181)
nīlamaṇi pōṉṟa mayil tōkai 				(   264)
eṉa ippattuppāṭṭuḷ pala iṭaṅkaḷil varum cāṉṟukaḷ nīlamaṇikaḷ iruntamaiyai uṇarttukiṉṟaṉa.
 parūukkā ḻāram corinta muttamoṭu
poṉcuṭu neruppiṉ nilamuk keṉṉa
ammeṉ kurumpaik kāypaṭuvu piṟavum
				(ma. kā. aṭi, 681-684).
mūṉṟām aṭiyiṉ īṟṟil uḷḷa `piṟavum eṉpataṟku nacciṉārkkiṉiyar, `muttu oḻinta māṇikkamum marakatamum poṉṉum maṇikaḷum eṉap poruḷ kūṟiyuḷḷār. iṅku `maṇi eṉpatu nīlamaṇi pōlum!
3. `vaṭamalaip piṟanta maṇiyum poṉṉum eṉpatu paṭṭiṉappālai aṭi (187). iṅku `maṇi-māṇikkam eṉpatu nacciṉārkkiṉiyar uraiyākum.
naṉṉaṉuṭaiya malaināṭṭup poruḷkaḷuḷ `palavuṟu tirumaṇi oṉṟākum (malai, 516). `pala vilai peṟṟa aḻakiya māṇikkam, eṉpatu urai.
māṇikkam oḻukiṉālotta oḷḷiya ceṅkaḻunīr mālaiyai maturai nakarac celvar aṇintiruntaṉar (ma. kā. aṭi, 438-439).
4. avarai pavaḻam pōlap pūttatu (ci. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 164). pūmpukār nakarac celvamakaḷir pavaḻam pōlum niṟattiṉar (pa. pālai, aṭi, 148),
pavaḻattiṉ piṟappiṭam kīḻkkaṭalākum.
			(pa. mālai, aṭi, 189)
pavaḻattiṟkut `tukir eṉṟum peyaruṇṭu.
			(pa. pālai, aṭi, 189)
1. pāṇṭiyaṉ talaiyālaṅkāṉattuc ceru veṉṟa neṭuñceḻiyaṉ maṉaiviyar, `ōṭṭaṟṟa poṉ naṭu aḻuttiṉa maṇikaḷaic cūḻntu viḷaṅkukiṉṟa pēraṇi kalaṅkaḷai aṇintiruntaṉar (ma. kā. aṭi, 704).
2. muttiṉum maṇiyiṉum poṉṉiṉum attuṇai
nērvaruṅ kuraiya kalam (ku. pā. aṭi, 13-14)
eṉavarum aṭikaḷ, muttukaḷum maṇivakaikaḷum koṇṭa nakaikaḷ iruntamaiyai uṇarttukiṉṟaṉa.
3. `poṉṉil aḻuttiṉa nīlamaṇi pōlac ciṟiya mutukiṭattut tāḻntu kiṭanta kariya kūntal eṉa oru kuṟippuk kuṟiñcip pāṭṭil (aṭi, 58-60) vantuḷḷatu.
maṇikaḷ patitta mōtiram (ma. kā. aṭi, 719) marakatamaṇikaḷ kōtta mēkalai (pe. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 329), maṇipparalkaḷaiyuṭaiya cilampukaḷ (ma. kā. aṭi, 441) pōṉṟa maṇikaḷāl āṉavaiyum maṇikaḷ patittavaiyum muṉṉark kūṟappaṭṭa aṇivakaikaḷuḷ uḷḷaṉa eṉpatum iṅku aṟiyattakum, avai muṟpakutiyiṟ kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.
itukāṟum kūṟappaṭṭa cāṉṟukaḷāl, caṅkakālat tamiḻar oṉpatu maṇikaḷuṭpala maṇikaḷai naṉku aṟintavar eṉpatum payaṉpaṭuttiṉavar eṉpatum teḷivātal kāṇalām.
piṟcērkkai
piṟkālac cōḻappēraracaruḷ talaiciṟantavaṉ mutalām irācarācaṉ. avaṉ kālattil (ki. pi. 985-1012) uṇṭākkappaṭṭa tañcai irāca rācēccarattu ammaṉukkup pala nakaikaḷ ceyyappaṭṭaṉa. avaṟṟiṉ peyarkaḷaiyum avai evaṟṟāṟ ceyyappaṭṭaṉa eṉpataiyum iṅku aṟital nalamākum. inta aṟivu namakku iḻai, pūṇ, kalaṉ eṉpavaṟṟai oruvāṟ uṇarttalām. iccōḻar kāla nakaikaḷ tiṭīreṉṟu cōḻarkālattil uṇṭāṉavaiyalla. ivai caṅkakāla mutal vāḻaiyaṭi vāḻaiyāy iruntu vanta nakai vakaikaḷēyākalām.

23. maṇapporuḷkaḷ
mallikai mullai mutaliya pala vakai malarkaḷ naṟumaṇam uḷḷavai. iṅṅaṉamē, cātikkāy, takkōlakkāy mutaliya cila kāykaḷum maṇamuḷḷavai. akil, cantaṉam eṉṉum maraṅkaḷiṉ kaṭṭaikaḷum naṟumaṇam uḷḷavai. kattūri, puḻuku eṉpavai vilaṅkukaḷiliruntu kiṭaikkum maṇapporuḷkaḷ, paṇṭaittamiḻar immalarkaḷaiyum, kāykaḷaiyum, marakkaṭṭaikaḷaiyum, kattūri puḻuku eṉpavaṟṟaiyum naṟumaṇattiṟkup payaṉpaṭuttiṉar eṉpatu pattuppāṭṭāl terikiṟatu. ivai paṟṟiya vivaraṅkaḷai iṅkuk kāṇpōm:
malarkaḷ
kuṟiñci nilamākiya malaināṭṭil toṇṇūṟṟukku mēṟpaṭṭa malarkaḷiṉ peyarkaḷ kuṟiñcip pāṭṭiṟ kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa. appeyarkaḷaik kīḻē kāṇka:
kōṭaṟpū, āmpaṟpū, aṉiccappū, ceṅkaḻunīrppū, kuṟiñcippū, veṭcippū, ceṅkoṭu vērippū, tēmāmpū, cemmaṇippū, perumūṅkiṟpū, vilvappū, eṟuḻampū, marāmarappū, kūvirappū, vaṭavaṉappū, vākaṉappū, veṭpālaippū, pañcāykkōrai, veṇkākkaṇampū, karuviḷampū, payiṉippū, vāṉippū, kuravampū, paccilaippū, makiḻampū, kāyāmpū, āvirampū, ciṟumūṅkiṟpū, cūraippū, ciṟupūḷai, kuṉṟippū, murukkilai, marutappū, kōṅkampū, mañcāṭippū, tilakappū, pātirippū, ceruntippū, puṉalippū, caṇpakappū, nāṟu karantai, kāṭṭumallikaippū, māmpū, tillaippū, pālaippū, (kalliṟpaṭarnta) mullaippū, kañcaṅkullaippū, piṭavampū, ceṅkaruṅkālippū, vāḻaippū, vaḷḷippū, neytaṟpū, teṅkiṟpāḷai, cemmullaippū, tāmaraippū, ñāḻaṟpū, mauvaṟpū, kokuṭippū, pavaḻamallaikaippū, cātippū, karuntāmakkoṭippū, veṇkōṭaṟpū, tāḻampū, curapuṉṉaippū, kāñcippū, karuṅkuvaḷaippū, ōmaippū, maravampū, taṇakkampū, iṇṭampū, ilavampū, koṉṟaippū, aṭumpampū, āttippū, avaraippū, pakaṉṟaippū, palācampū, acōkampū, vañcippū, piccippū, karunoccippū, tumpaippū, tuḻāyppū, tōṉṟippū, nantiyāvaṭṭappū, naṟaikkoṭi, puṉṉākappū, paruttippū, pīrkkampū, kurukkattippū, cantaṉappū, akiṟpū, puṉṉaippū, nārattampū, nākappū, iruvāṭcippū, kuruntampū, vēṅkaippū, malaiyerukkampū, cempū.
immalarkaḷuḷ malaiyiṟpūttavai cila; nilattiṟ pūttavai cila. kompukaḷiṟpūttavai cila; cuṉaikaḷiṟ pūttavai cila. ivaṟṟiṉ niṟaṅkaḷum palavakaip paṭṭavai.
tiṉaikkollaikaḷaik kāttu vanta kuṟiñci nila makaḷir, immalarkaḷaip paṟittu ivaṟṟiṉ puṟavitaḻkaḷai nīkkiviṭṭut tamakkuriya taḻaikaḷai amaittu aṇintu koṇṭaṉar; palaniṟa malarkaḷait toṭuttu mālaikaḷāka aṇintu iṉpuṟṟaṉar (aṭi, 61-104).
cūraramakaḷir veṭcippūkkaḷai viṭupūvākat talaiyiṟ tūvi avaṟṟiṟku naṭuvē kuvaḷai itaḻkaḷaik kiḷḷiyiṭṭut talaiyaṇikaḷai aṇintaṉar (tirumuruku. aṭi, 21-25). ceṅkaṭampiṉ malarkaḷ tēruruḷaikaḷaip pōṉṟa vaṭiviṉai uṭaiyaṉa. murukaṉ ammalarkaḷālākiya mālaiyai aṇivāṉ (aṭi, 10-11).
murukaṉaippōla vēlēnti veṟiyāṭṭayarnta vēlaṉ, cātikkāy, takkōlakkāy, kāṭṭu mallikai malar, veṇṭāḷi malar ākiya ivaṟṟai viravik kaṭṭiya mālaiyta talaiyil aṇintāṉ (aṭi, 190-193). kuravaiyāṭiya kuṟamakaḷir itaḻ paṟittukkaṭṭiṉa mālaiyait talaiyil aṇintiruntaṉar; kañcaṅkullaip pūvaik kūntalil aṇintiruntaṉar; ilaiyaiyuṭaiya naṟiya pūṅkottukaḷaiyum cevviya kāliṉaiyuṭai marāttiṭattaṉavākiya veḷḷiya kottu kaḷaiyum ilaiyait talaiyilē aṇinta kañcaṅkullai yiṉaiyum toṭutta taḻaiyuṭaiyai iṭaiyil aṇin tiruntaṉar (aṭi, 200-203).
mullai nilattil mullai, taḷavam, tōṉṟi, tēṟṟā, koṉṟai, kāyā eṉṉum malarkaḷ pūkkum. mullai nila makkaḷ immalarkaḷai virumpip payaṉpaṭuttiṉārkaḷ (po. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 199-220). neytal nilattumakkaḷ neytaṟpūmālaiyai aṇintārkaḷ (aṭi, 218-219). ōymāṉāṭṭaiyāṇṭa nalliyakkōṭaṉ taḷir viraviṉa mālaiyai aṇintiruntāṉ (ci. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 267-9). toṇṭai nāṭṭu umaṇar, taḻai viraviṉa mālaiyai aṇintiruntaṉar (pe. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 60). tamiḻaracar, veṭci, karantai, vañci, kāñci, uḻiñai, nocci, tumpai, vākai eṉṉum pōrttuṟaikaḷil īṭupaṭum poḻutu muṟaiyē veṭci, karantai, vañci, kāñci, uḻiñai, nocci, tumpai, vākai malar mālaikaḷaic cūṭutal marapu (aṭi, 101-102). iṭaimakaṉ kāṭṭu maraṅkaḷilum koṭikaḷilum malarnta pala pūkkaḷ kalantu neruṅkiya kalampakam ākiya mālaiyai aṇintiruntāṉ (aṭi, 172-4). uḻavar neytaṟpūkkaḷai allatu muḷḷip pūkkaḷait taṇṭāṉ kōrai nārāṟkaṭṭi mālaiyāy aṇintaṉar (aṭi, 213-218).
teyvattiṉ muṉpu ceṉṟu kōvilil viricci kēṭpavar, mullai malarkaḷaiyum nellaiyum tūvutal vaḻakkam (mullaippāṭṭu, aṭi, 8-11). maturai nakara vāḻvaraciyar iravu nēraṅkaḷil ceṅkaḻunīr mālaiyai aṇintiruntaṉar (ma. kā. aṭi, 550-551); parattaiyar pala niṟap pūkkaḷai nerukkamākap puṉaintu talaiyiṟcūṭik koṇṭaṉar (aṭi, 566-568). pāṇṭi nāṭṭu iṭaiyar kāntaṉ itaḻkaḷāṟkaṭṭiṉa kaṇṇiyai aṇintaṉar (neṭunal. aṭi, 5-6). maturaiyil irunta milēccar (veḷi nāṭṭavar) taḻai viraviṉa mālaiyai aṇintaṉar (aṭi, 31-32).
kuṟiñcinilat talaivaṉ palaniṟa malarkaḷait toṭuttut talaimālaiyāy aṇintukoḷṭāṉ; pitti malarkaḷait toṭuttu mālaiyāy aṇintukoṇṭāṉ; taṉ oru kātil acōkantaḷiraic cerukikkoṇṭāṉ (ku. pāṭṭu, aṭi, 114-120). kāvirippūmpaṭṭiṉattup paratavar piḷḷaikaḷ maṇaliṟpaṭarnta aṭumpiṉ pūvait talaiyiṟkaṭṭiṉārkaḷ; nīril niṉṟa āmpaṟpūvaic cūṭiṉārkaḷ (pa. pālai, aṭi, 61-66); paratavar veṇṭāḷippūmālaiyai aṇintaṉar; maṭalaiyuṭaiya tāmapūvaic cūṭiṉar (aṭi, 84-88). kūttar marāmarattup pūkkaḷaiyum `yā marattup pūkkaḷaiyum taḷirkaḷōṭu nāriṟkaṭṭi mālaiyāy aṇintaṉar (malaipaṭu. aṭi, 428-431). valaiyar makaḷir, pakaṉṟaippūvāṟ ceyta uṇṇiyai aṇintaṉar (aṭi, 459). maturaik kaṭait tēruvil viṭupūkkaḷum malar mālaikaḷum viṟkappaṭṭaṉa (ma. kā. aṭi, 397-398). kōvil vaḻipāṭṭiṟkum pūkkaḷam mālaikaḷum payaṉpaṭṭaṉa.
cuṇṇam-cāntu-pukai
maturaiyil navamaṇikaḷ, poṉ, cantaṉam, karuppūram mutaliyavaṟṟaip puḻukilum paṉinīrilum naṉaiya vaittu iṭittuc cuṇṇam tayārikkappaṭṭatu (ma. kā. aṭi, 399). celvamakaḷir tamatu kūntalil naṟiya mayirccāntaip pūciṉar; kattūriyaiyum cantaṉattaiyum araittup payaṉpaṭuttiṉar; tām uṭukka eṭutta kaliṅkaṅkaḷukku akiṟpukaiyai ūṭṭiṉar (aṭi, 552-554). kuṟṟēval viṉaiñar vaḷamaṉaikaḷil cāntaraikkum ammiyil kattūri mutaliya maṇapporuḷkaḷai iṭṭuc cāntāka araittaṉar. celva makaḷir accāntiṉaip payaṉpaṭuttiṉar; cantaṉa viṟakil neruppai uṇṭākki atil akiloṭu veḷḷiya kaṇṭa carukkaraiyaiyum kūṭṭip pukaittaṉar. cantaṉakkal vaṭanāṭṭiliruntu koṇṭu vantu viṟakappaṭṭatu (neṭunal. aṭi, 49-56).
kuṟiñci nilattalaivaṉ, taṉ talaiyil kuḷirnta naṟiya mayirccāntai maṇakkumpaṭi pūcikkoṇṭāṉ; piṉṉar akiṟpukaiyai ūṭṭi ataṉai ularavaittāṉ; piṉpu akiliṉ neyyai ataṟkup pūciṉāṉ; pala niṟaṅkaḷaiyuṭaiya malarkaḷait taṉ kuñciyiṟcūṭiṉāṉ (ku. pāṭṭu, aṭi, 108-115).
muṭivurai
caṅkakālat tamiḻ makkaḷ malarkaḷaiyum, koḻuntu ilaikaḷaiyum, cātikkāy pōṉṟa maṇamuḷḷa kāykaḷaiyum payaṉpaṭuttiṉārkaḷ; kattūri, puḻuku, paṉinīr, cantaṉam, akil eṉpavaṟṟaiyum payaṉpaṭuttiṉārkaḷ eṉṉum vivaraṅkaḷai itukāṟum kūṟiyavai koṇṭu aṟiyalām.
24. ilvāḻkkai
aracar ilvāḻkkai
tamiḻaracarāṉa cēra cōḻa pāṇṭiyar, tammuḷ peṇ koṭuttalum vāṅkalum uṇṭu; tam āṭcikku uṭpaṭṭa ciṟṟaracariṭam uṭpaṭāta ciṟṟaracariṭamum makaḷ koṇṭaṉar; vēḷāḷar talaivarāṉa vēḷiriṭam peṇ koṇṭaṉar. uruvap paḵṟēr iḷañcēṭceṉṉi, aḻuntūr vēḷ makaḷai maṇantāṉ. avaṉ makaṉāṉa karikālaṉ, nāṅkūr vēḷiṉ makaḷai maṇantāṉ. (tol poruḷ. nūṟpā, 30, nac. urai). maṇimēkalaiyiṉ kālattil vāḻnta neṭumuṭikkiḷḷi, pāṇa aracaṉ makaḷāṉa cīrtti eṉpavaḷai maṇantāṉ (maṇi mēkalai, kātai, 19; aṭi, 51-55). karikālaṉ iṟantāṉ; avaṉ peṇṭir iḻai kaḷaintaṉar (puṟam. 224) eṉpatāl, avaṉ palarai maṇantāṉ eṉpatu terikiṟatu.
ivvāṟē pāṇṭiyaṉ neṭuñceḻiyaṉum maṉaiviyar palarai maṇantavaṉ eṉpatu, āytoṭi makaḷir naṟuntōḷ puṇarntu (ma. kā. aṭi, 712) eṉṉum māṅkuṭi marutaṉār vākkāl pulappaṭukiṟatu. avvaraca mātēviyar iḷaveyil tōṉṟiṉāṟpōlap puṇarcciyāṟpeṟṟa poliviṉai yuṭaiyavar; pēraṇi kalaṅkaḷai aṇintavar; kaṟpu mēmpaṭap polivu peṟṟavar; mayil pōṉṟa cāyalaiyuṭaiyavar; māntaḷir mēṉiyar. pāṇṭiyaṉ ittakaiya nalaṅkaḷaip peṟṟa aracamātēviyaruṭaṉ ilvāḻkkai naṭattiṉāṉ. avaṉatu kaṭṭilaic cuṟṟilum maṇamikunta mālaikaḷ toṅkaviṭap paṭṭiruntaṉa. (aṭi, 713, urai).
avaṉ kālaiyil eḻuntu kālaikkaṭaṉkaḷai muṭittu, nīrāṭi, iṟaivaḻipāṭu ceytāṉ; maṉaiviyar uṭaṉiruntu utava āṭaiyaṇikaḷai aṇintāṉ; piṉpu nāḷōlakka maṇṭapam ceṉṟu araciyal aluvalkaḷaik kavaṉittāṉ (ma. kā. aṭi, 702-724).
aracaṉ maṉaiviyaruḷ mutal maṉaivi kōpperuntēvi eṉappaṭṭāḷ. avaḷē aracaṉuṭaṉ kolu vīṟṟiruttal marapu. avaḷukkuc cevilittāyarum cēṭiyarum iruntaṉar (neṭunal. 151-3). aracaṉukku arukil iruntu matuvaip poṟ kiṇṇattil vārttutara aḻakiya paṇippeṇṭir iruntaṉar (ma. kā. aṭi, 779-781).
maṉṉaṉ pōr mutaliyavaṟṟikkākat taṉṉaip pirintu ceṉṟa pōtu mātēvi avaṉ pirivāl uṇṭāṉa tuyarai aṭakkikkoṇṭu araṇmaṉaiyuḷ iruttal mullai oḻukkam (kaṟpuṭaiya maṉaiviyiṉ oḻukkam) eṉappaṭṭatu. pāṇṭiyaṉ neṭuñceḻiyaṉ maṉaivi, kaṇavaṉ irunta pōtu pūttoḻil amainta tukilai uṭuttāḷ; avaṉ illāta pōtu ēṟpaṭṭa kavalaiyāl, nūlāṟceyta puṭavaiyai aṇintiruntāḷ; nakaikaḷai aṇiyavillai. cevilittāyarum cēṭiyarum avaḷukku aṭikkaṭi āṟutal moḻikaḷaik kūṟiṉar. āyiṉum, kōpperuntēviyiṉ maṉakkavalai kuṟaiyavillai. avaḷ taṉ tantakkaṭṭiliṉ mēṟkūraiyil tīṭṭappaṭṭirunta ōviyattaip pārttāḷ; cantiraṉai viṭṭup piriyāta urōkiṇiyākiya viṇmīṉai avvōviyattiṟkaṇṭāḷ; tāṉ atu pōlat taṉ kaṇavaṉōṭu eṉṟum cērntirukka iyalavillaiyē eṉṟu eṇṇip perumūccu viṭṭāḷ (neṭunal. aṭi, 145-163).
pāṇṭimātēvi taṉ kaṇavaṉāṉa pāṇṭiyaṉ neṭuñceḻiyaṉ enta aḷavu uṇmaiyaṉpuṭaṉ nēcittāḷ eṉpatu mēṟkūṟappaṭṭa ceytiyiliruntu naṉkaṟiyalāmaṉṟō? iḵtu avartam ilvāḻkkaic ciṟappiṉai naṉku eṭuttukkāṭṭuvatākum.
maṉṉaṉāṉa kaṇavaṉ eppoḻutu varuvāṉ eṉpatai aṟiya araṇmaṉai mutupeṇṭir nellum mullaimalarum eṭuttuc ceṉṟu kōvilil tūvi, naṟcol kēṭṭu niṉṟaṉar. avvamayam āy makaḷ, tāyaip pirinta kaṉṟukaḷai nōkki, iṉṉē varukuvar num tāyar, eṉṟu kūṟiṉāḷ. ataṉai naṟcollākak koṇṭa mutupeṇṭir, aracamātēviyiṭam ataṉait terivittu, makiḻntaṉar (mu. pā. aṭi, 8-20). paṇippoṇṭir aracamātēviyiṉ aṭiyai varuṭi avaḷai uṟaṅkuvittaṉar (neṭunal. aṭi, 151).
nalliyakkōṭaṉaic cevvari poruntiṉa maiyuṇṭa kaṇṇiṉaiyuṭaiya avaṉ maṉaiviyar pukaḻntu pēciṉar. avar uḷamārap pukaḻntu pēcumaḷaviṟku avaṉ uṇmaik kaṇavaṉāy naṭantukoṇṭāṉ eṉpatu itaṉāṟpulaṉākum (ci. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 215).
pōrukkup pirinta kaṇavaṉ pirivāl tuṉpuṟṟu vāṭiya talaivi, tuyil tuṟantāḷ; tuyar uḻantāḷ; ampu paṭṭa mayil pōla naṭuṅkiṉāḷ. uṭal melivāl iḻai nekiḻntatu; iṅṅaṉam eḻunilai māṭattil kaṇavaṉ varavai etirnōkki vaṭikkiṭantāḷ (mu. pā. aṭi, 80-88).
ittakaiya aracamātēviyar tam kaṇavariṭam mikka aṉpukoṇṭaṭiruntaṉar eṉpataik kūṟavum vēṇṭumō? ivarkaḷaip pōlavē ammaṉṉarkaḷum taṅkaḷ maṉaiviyarai mika virumpiyatālētāṉ pōr muṭintatum avarkaḷai nōkki viraintārkaḷ. ivaṟṟaikkoṇṭu avarkaḷatu ilvāḻkkaic ciṟappiṉai iṉitiṉ uṇaralām.
karikālaṉ mārpiṉmītu avaṉuṭaiya piḷḷaikaḷ viḷaiyāṭi avaṉ mārpiṟpūciyirunta cantaṉattaik kalaittu viṭṭaṉa. avaṉ maṉaiviyar avaṉatu mārpait taḻuviyataṉāl avaṉ mārpiṟpūciyirunta cantaṉam aḻintuviṭṭatu (pa. pālai. aṭi, 295-7). ivviru nikaḻccikaḷālum karikālaṉatu ilvāḻkkaic ciṟappiṉai naṉkaṟiyalām.
antaṇar ilvāḻkkai
toṇṭai nāṭṭuk kaṭaṟṟuṟaippaṭṭiṉattiṟku aṇmaiyil maṟaiyavar uṟaipati iruntatu. appatiyil maṟaiyil valla antaṇar vāḻntaṉar. avarkaḷ illaṅkaḷ tūymaiyāy iruntaṉa. ammaṟaiyavar maṉaiviyar aruntatiyaṉṉa kaṟpiṉar; nalla tōṟṟattaiyuṭaiyavar; vaḷaiyalai aṇintavar; kaṇavaṉmār ākuti ceytaṟku ēṟṟa `irācāṉṉam7 eṉpatait tayārittaṉar; tām tamakkeṉṟu tayāritta uṇavupporuḷkaḷai pāṇar mutaliya viruntiṉarkkum uvappōṭu paṭaittaṉar (pe. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 297-310). ammakaḷir `aruntatiyaṉṉa kaṟpiṉar eṉpatiliruntē avarkaḷatu illaṟac ciṟappai eḷitil uṇaralām. ilvāḻkkai kaṭamaikaḷuṭciṟantatu viruntōmpal. ammakaḷir atilum ciṟantu viḷaṅkiṉar.
vaṇikar ilvāḻkkai
uppu vaṇikar tam maṉaivi makkaḷuṭaṉē uppu vaṇṭikaḷiṟceṉṟu uppu vāṇikam ceytaṉar. uppu vaṇikaṉ maṉaiviyē uppu vaṇṭiyai ōṭṭiṉāḷ. vaṇikaṉ tuṇai erutukaḷai ōṭṭikkoṇṭu vaṇṭikkuppiṉ ceṉṟāṉ (pe. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 58-65).
ittakaiya pirayāṇa vāḻkkaiyilum avarkaḷ illaṟam ciṟantiruntatu eṉpatai, maṉaivi vaṇṭi ōṭṭiṉāḷ eṉpatiliruntē iṉituṇaralām.
kāvirippūmpaṭṭiṉattu vaṇikar, tēvarkaḷai vaḻipaṭṭaṉar; vēḷvikaḷ ceytu avaṟṟāl āvutikaḷait tēvar nukarac ceytaṉar; pacukkaḷaiyum erutukaḷaiyum pātukāttaṉar; antaṇarkku uṇṭākum pukaḻkaḷai nilaipeṟacceytaṉar; periya puṇṇiyaṅkaḷaic ceytaṉar; avaṟṟaic ceyyamāṭṭātārkkut tāṉam paṇṇiṉar. `avarkaḷ kuḷirnta aruḷuṭaṉē vāḻum il vāḻkkaiyai uṭaiyavarkaḷ; naṉṉeñciṉarkaḷ, eṉṟu avarkaḷai māṅkuṭi marutaṉār pārāṭṭiyuḷḷār (ma. kā. aṭi, 200-207).
kaḷavu-kaṟpu
malaiyum malaicārnta iṭamumākiya kuṟiñci nilattil kāṉavar makaḷir tiṉaippuṉattaik kāval kāppatu vaḻakkam. ammakaḷir pūppaṟittu viḷaiyāṭuvar; cuṉaiyil kutittu nīrāṭuvar. aṅkut tiṭīreṉat tōṉṟiya iḷaiñaṉ kāṉavar makaḷiruḷ talaiviyāyiṉāḷ virumpiya malarkaḷaip paṟittut taruvāṉ; allatu cuṉainīriliruntu tavikkum avaḷaik karai cērttuk kāppāṉ; allatu mataṅkoṇṭa yāṉaiyiṉ tākkutaliliruntu avaḷaik kāppāṉ. iṅṅaṉam taṉakku utavi ceyta talaivaṉait talaivi virumpuvāḷ. aṉṟu mutal avarkaḷiṭaiyē kātal vāḻvu toṭaṅkum. ivvāḻvukkut talaiviyiṉ uyirttōḻi uṟṟa tuṇaiyāvāḷ. talaivaṉ talaiviyaip palar aṟiya maṇappatāka vākkaḷippāṉ.
talaivaṉ cila nāḷ varai vārāmaiyāl, talaivi kavalaiyāl melivāḷ. uṇmaik kāraṇattai uṇarāta cevilittāyum naṟṟāyum cēriyiṉ mutupeṇṭākiya kuṟi colpavaḷai vīṭṭil aḻaittu vantu, muṟattil piṭi nellaiyiṭṭu, etiril talaimakaḷai niṟuttuvar. uṭaṉē teyvattiṟku vaḻipāṭu ceyyappaṭum. kuṟi colpavaḷ appiṭi nellai nannāṉkāka eṇṇi eñciyavai oṉṟu, iraṇṭu, mūṉṟu aḷavum murukaṉāl nērnta kuṟai eṉṟum, nāṉkāyiṉ, vēṟoru nōy eṉṟum kūṟuvāḷ. iḵtu oru vakaik kuṟiyākum. itu `kaṭṭuk kēṭṭal eṉappaṭum (naṟṟiṇai, cey. 288). aṭuttapaṭi kaḻaṅku pārttal naṭaipeṟum. vēlaṉ eṉpavaṉ murukaṉaippōla vēṭampūṇṭu āṭum malaināṭṭup pūcāri. avaṉ vīṭṭiṉ ōriṭattil murukaṉai eḻuntaruḷac ceytu, akkaṭavuḷ muṉ kaḻaṟṟik kāykaḷai iṭuvāṉ. avaṉ taṉ talaiyil īṭai aṇintiruppāṉ; pala kaṇukkaḷaiyuṭaiya kōlai ēntiyiruppāṉ; akkaṇukkaḷil ciṟu paikaḷaik kaṭṭiyiruppāṉ. avaṉ akkōlāl kaḻaṟcikkāykaḷai vāriyeṭukkum pōtu avaṉ uḷḷattiṟpaṭṭataik kuṟiyākak kūṟuvāṉ. itu `kaḻaṅku pārttal eṉappaṭum (naṟṟiṇai, cey. 47).
ivviruvakaic cōtaṉaikaḷaiyayum nikaḻttiya piṟakum talaiviyiṉ uṭal iḷaipput tīrāmaiyiṉ, ceviliyum naṟṟāyum ceyvakai aṟiyātu varuntuvar. avvamayam tōḻi taṉ tāyāṉa ceviliyiṭam, aṉṉāy, muttālum poṉṉālum māṇikkattatālum ceyyappaṭṭa pūṇkaḷ keṭumāyiṉ, piṉṉum avaṟṟaip poruttac ceyyalām. āyiṉ, oruvaruṭaiya kuṇaṅkaḷiṉ amaitiyum mēmpāṭum oḻukkamum paḻaiya taṉmai keṭiṉ, akkēṭṭai nīkki avaṟṟai muṉpu pōla niṟuttutal teyva iruṭikaṭkum iyaluvataṉṟu.
eṉ tantaiyatu ariya kāvalaik kaṭantu yāṉum talaivaṉum perumaiyum uraṉum accamum nāṇamum nuṇukiya nilaiyāṟpiṟanta maṉṟal (kātal maṇam) paṟṟi nam yāykku aṟivuṟuttalāl namakkup pukaḻēyaṉṟip paḻiyillai. iṅṅaṉam aṟattoṭu niṉṟa piṉpu talaivarkkē nammai maṇam ceytu koṭāviṭiṉum, nām uyir pōmaḷavum ivvaruttattaip poṟuttirukka, namakku maṟu piṟappiṉum ikkūṭṭam kūṭuva toṉṟāyiruntatu, eṉṟu talaivi eṉṉiṭam moḻintāḷ, eṉṟu kūṟit talaivi talaivaṉaic cantitta cūḻnilaiyaiyum kātal vaḷarnta nilaiyaiyum eṭutturaippāḷ (ku. pā. aṭi, 1-26).
cevili itaṉai naṟṟāykku uraippāḷ. naṟṟāy taṉ kaṇavaṉukkum piḷḷaikaḷukkum uraippāḷ. makaḷ viruppappaṭi tirumaṇam naṭaipeṟum.
talaivaṉ, talaivi, tōḻi, pāṅkaṉ eṉṉum nālvarkku maṭṭum terintirukkum varaiyil itu kaḷavu maṇam eṉappaṭum. palar aṟiya maṇam nikaḻntu talaivaṉum talaiviyum maṇavāḻkkai naṭattutal kaṟpu maṇam eṉap peyar peṟum. kaḷavu maṇanikaḻccikaḷum kuṟamakaḷir ceyalkaḷum kuṟiñcippāṭṭil aḻakuṟak kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.
ikkaḷavu maṇam maṉita camutāyattiṉ paṇṭaiya maṇamuṟaiyaik kūṟuvatākum. caṅkakālattu ovvōr iḷaiñaṉum peṇṇum kaḷavumaṇam nikaḻttiya piṉpē kātal maṇam ceytukoṇṭaṉar eṉak karututal tavaṟu. kaḷavu maṇattiṟku nakaraṅkaḷil vacatiyillai; kirāmaṅkaḷilum peruvaḻakkil iruntateṉṟu kūṟa iyalātu. tamiḻc camutāyattiṉ toṉmai vāynta maṇamuṟaiyai aṭippaṭai yākakkoṇṭu caṅkakālap pulavarkaḷ taṅkaḷ kālattil iruntataiyum illātataiyum cērttu akappāṭalkaḷaic ceytaṉar eṉṟu kōṭalē aṟiviṟkum ārāyccikkum poruttamākum. itaṉālētāṉ tolkāppiyar,
nāṭaka vaḻakkiṉum ulakiyal vaḻakkiṉum
pāṭal cāṉṟa pulaṉeṟi vaḻakkam
eṉṟu itaṉaik kūṟalāyiṉar (tol. poruḷ. nūṟpā, 53).
kalaivāṇar ilvāḻkkai
pāṇaṉ, icaikkaruvikaḷai icaittup pāṭupavaṉ. avaṉ maṉaiviyāṉa viṟali, āṭal pāṭalkaḷil tērntavaḷ. avaḷ ciṟanta aḻaki; `mullai cāṉṟa kaṟpiṉ melliyal (ci. a. paṭai, aṭi, 30). avaḷ taṉ kaṇavaṉuṭaṉ kāṭum malaiyum kaṭantu ceṉṟu, vaḷḷalkaḷaik kaṇṭu, naṭaṉamāṭiṉāḷ; pāṇaṉ icaik karuvikaḷai icaittup pāṭiṉāṉ. iruvarum vaḷḷalkaḷ pāl iyainta paricil peṟṟu vāḻkkaiyai naṭattiṉar. pāṇar, kūttar, viṟaliyar, porur vāḻkkai kalai vāḻkkai yākum. kaṇavaṉum maṉaiviyum oṟṟumaiyāy iruntu viḻākkaḷilum tam kalaittiṟaṉaik kāṭṭip poruḷ peṟṟaṉar (po. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 1-2). avarkaḷ ilvāḻkkai nēriya muṟaiyil naṭaipeṟṟatālētāṉ avarkaḷāl icai, naṭaṉam, nāṭakam eṉṉum kalaikaḷ caṅka kālattil naṉku vaḷarkkappaṭṭaṉa.
pērūrkaḷil celvar maṉaikaḷil cevilittāyar iruntu piḷḷaikaḷai vaḷarttaṉar; piḷḷaikaḷaic ciṟutēr uruṭṭi viḷaiyāṭac ceytaṉar; amaḷiyil uṟaṅkac ceytaṉar (pe. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 247-253).
maturai makkaḷ ilvāḻkkai
pīṭumikka māṭamaturaiyil mālaikkālattil kōvilkaḷil vaḻipāṭu naṭaipeṟṟatu. māṭamakaḷir tam maṉaikaḷiṉ nilāmuṟṟaṅkaḷil iruntapaṭiyē teyvaṅkaḷai vaṇaṅkiṉar. illakkiḻattiyar cilar tam kaṇavarai aḻaittuk koṇṭum tāmaraip pūvaip piṭittāṟpōlat tam piḷḷaikaḷai eṭuttukkoṇṭum pūcaikku vēṇṭum pū, tūpaṅkaḷ ākiyavaṟṟai eṭuttuk koṇṭum peṟattap paḷḷiyai aṭaintaṉar; cilar antaṇar paḷḷiyai aṭaintaṉar; vēṟu cilar camaṇap paḷḷiyai aṭaintu aṟavurai kēṭṭaṉar (ma. kā. aṭi, 444-488).
kulamakaḷir, palar, anti nērattil naṟiya ceṅkaḻunīr malarkaḷai mālaiyākakkaṭṭiṉar; tam kūntalukku mayirc cāntiṉai araittup pūciṉar; piṉpu accāntu pōkumpaṭi kūntalai alaittuk kaḻuvi nīrāṭiṉar; melliya nūlāṟceyta kaliṅkattiṟku maṇakkum akiṟ pukaiyai ūṭṭiṉar; cantaṉattaiyum kattūriyaiyum araittu mārpiṟ pūcikkoṇṭaṉar; aṇikaḷai aṇintaṉar; neṭiya oḷiyaittarum viḷakkiṉai ēṟṟiṉar (ma. kā. aṭi, 550-6).
piḷḷai peṟṟa tāyar ciṟitu kālam vaḷaiyalai aṇiyār (malaipaṭu. aṭi, 253). makaḷir tam kaṟpiṉ mikuti pōṉṟa mullai malarkaḷaic cūṭutal iyalpu (ci. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 28-30).
piḷḷaikaḷ pēy mutaliyavaṟṟāl paṟṟappaṭātirukka vīṭṭil vēppilaiyaik kaṭṭutal marapu (pe. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 59).
maṉaiviyar tam kaṇavar maṉamakiḻap piḷḷaikaḷaip peṟṟu nakilkaḷil pāl curappataṟkākak kuḷattu nīril nīrāṭiṉar; mutaṟcūl koṇṭa makaḷir iṭukkaṇ iṉṟip putalvaraip payattal vēṇṭum eṉṟu teyvattaip paravik kuṟai tīrntaṉar. mikka cuṟṟattāruṭaṉ celvattaiyuṭaiya maṉai makaḷir yāḻeṭuttuc cevvaḻi eṉṉum paṇṇai vācittaṉar. cēri maṉṟukaḷil murukaṉai niṉaintu āṭavarum peṇṭirum kuravaik kūttāṭiṉar (ma. kā. ṭi, 609-615). kulamakaḷir viḷakkēṟṟi nellaiyum malaraiyum tūvi illuṟai teyvattai vaṇaṅkiṉar (neṭunal. aṭi, 43).
mēlē kūṟappaṭṭa ceytikaḷ aṉaittum maturai makkaḷiṉ ciṟanta ilvāḻkkaiyaip paṭam piṭittuk kāṭṭuvaṉavākum.
kiṇai makaṉ ilvāḻkkai
kiṇai vācippavaṉ vaṟiyavaṉ. avaṉ maṉaivi paciyāl varuntiṉāḷ; camaikka uṇavupporuḷkaḷ illai. ataṉāl avaḷ kuppaik kīraiyait taṉ nakaṅkaḷāl kiḷḷiṉāḷ; vīṭṭil uppiṉmaiyāl, ataṉai uppiṉṟiyē vēkavaittāḷ; ataṉait taṉ vīṭṭār uṇpatai veḷiyār pārttāl iḻivākak karutuvar eṉṟa eṇṇattāl, vīṭṭuk katavait tāḻiṭṭāḷ; piṉpu taṉ viṭṭāruṭaṉ tāṉum iruntu uṇṭāḷ eṉṟu ciṟupāṇāṟṟuppaṭai ceppukiṟatu (aṭi, 136-139). uḷḷataik koṇṭu uvappuṭaṉ kuṭumpam naṭattuvatē ilvāḻkkaikku aḻaku eṉpatai inta nikaḻcci uṇarttukiṟataṉṟō?
viruntaḷikkum paṇpu
ilvāḻkkai naṭattum kaṇavaṉum maṉaiviyum tam uṟṟār uṟaviṉaraik kākkak kaṭamaippaṭṭavar; avaruṭaṉ nillātu, tam illam nāṭi varum piṟaraiyum uṇṭiyālum uṟaiyuḷālum upacarittal avartam kaṭamai eṉṟu aṟanūlkaḷ aṟaikiṉṟaṉa. ippaṇiyaik kaṇavaṉ allatu maṉaivi maṭṭum virumpic ceytal iyalātu; iruvarum maṉam oṉṟupaṭṭālē ceytal iyalum. iruvaruḷ oruvar māṟupaṭiṉum viruntu naṉmuṟaiyil naṭaipeṟātu. eṉavē, viruntu pōṟṟum kaṇavaṉum maṉaiviyum otta uṇarcciyuṭaiyavarāyiruttal iṉṟiyamaiyātatu. ākavē, viruntu naṭaipeṟum illattil uḷḷa kaṇavaṉum maṉaiviyum maṉam ottu vāḻkiṉṟaṉar eṉpatu karuttākum. aḵtāvatu, avarkaḷatu ilvāḻkkai cemmaiyuṟa naṭaipeṟukiṉṟatu eṉpatu poruḷākum.
tam uṟṟār uṟaviṉaraiyē aṉṟip pulavar, pāṇar, porunar, kūttar, viṟaliyar pōṉṟa kalaivāṇaraiyum varavēṟṟu uṇṭiyum uṟaiyuḷum tantu upacarittalaic caṅkakālat tamiḻ makkaḷ taṅkaḷ ciṟanta kaṭamaiyākak karutiṉārkaḷ eṉpatai āṟṟuppaṭai nūlkaḷ meyppikkiṉṟaṉa. kuṟiñci, pālai, mullai, marutam, neytal ākiya aintu nilaṅkaḷil vāḻnta eḷiyarum celvarum pērūr makkaḷum ciṟṟaracarum pēraracarum pāṇar mutaliyōrai iṉmukattuṭaṉ varavēṟṟu uṇṭiyum uṟaiyuḷum vaḻaṅkiṉar; malaiyaik kāval kātta vīrarkaḷ, karuppañcālaiyil paṇipurintavar. neṟkaḷaṅkaḷil vēlai ceytu vanta uḻavar pōṉṟārum paḻaṅkaḷ, karuppañ cāṟu, uṇavu pōṉṟavaṟṟai maṉamuvantu utaviṉamai koṇṭu, avartam viruntu pōṟṟum cīriya paṇpiṉ uyarviṉai nām naṉkuṇaralām.
iṅṅaṉam viruntiṉarai upacarittavar paṭṭiyalaik kīḻē kāṇka:
ciṟupāṇāṟṟuppaṭai

						178-185; 425)

kōvalar (pulvēy kurampaik
			kōvalar)		(aṭi, 434-443)
