ivaruṭperumpālār eḷiya vāḻkkai vāḻntaṉar; poruḷ vacatiyaṟṟavar; vaṟiya eyiṉar; pullariciyait tokuttavar. attakaiyavarum makiḻcciyōṭu viruntiṉarai varavēṟṟu upacarittaṉar eṉpatu viyappukkuriyatākum. iḵtu avartam ilvāḻkkaic ciṟappiṉai eṭutturaikkum cāṉṟākum.
ōymāṉāṭṭu uḻavar taṅkai, pāṇar mutaliyōrait taṉ piḷḷaikaḷaik koṇṭu uṟavu muṟai kūṟi, avar pōkkait taṭuttu upacarittu uṇavu paṭaittāḷ (ci. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 190-5). naṉṉaṉatu malaiyaṭivārattil irunta kāṉavar ciṟu kuṭicaiyil ovvoru vīṭṭuk kuṟamakaḷum kūttarait taṉ piḷḷaikaḷaik koṇṭu uṟavu muṟai kūṟit taṭuttu uṇavu vaḻaṅkiṉāḷ (malaipaṭu. aṭi, 182-5). uḻavar taṅkaikkum kuṟamakaḷirkkum viruntu pēṇutalil irunta aḷavaṟṟa ārvattaik kāṇka!
muṉpu kūṟiyāṅkuk kaṇavaṉum maṉaiviyum ciṟanta maṉavoṟṟumaiyōṭu vāḻāviṭil, vaṟiyavarāṉa eyiṉar, kōvalar, valaiyar pōṉṟār viruntiṉaraittam illattil varavēṟṟu viruntaḷittu upacarittal iyalāta ceyalākum. mēlē kūṟappaṭṭa tamiḻakattup pala nilamakkaḷum mikka makiḻcciyōṭum uḷḷa niṟaivōṭum pāṇar mutaliyōrai uṇṭiyālum uṟaiyuḷālum upacaritta ceyal, avartam illaṟavāḻkkaic ciṟappiṉaic cīriya muṟaiyil eṭuttiyampuvatākum.
25. viḷaiyāṭṭukaḷ
kuṟuntokai, naṟṟiṇai, akanāṉūṟu, kalit tokai eṉṉum akapporuḷ nūlkaḷil makaḷir viḷaiyāṭṭukaḷ palavum maintar viḷaiyāṭṭukaḷ cilavum iṭampeṟa vacatiyuṇṭu. pattuppāṭṭuḷ aintu pāṭalkaḷ āṟṟuppaṭaiyai nōkkamākak koṇṭavai; mullaip pāṭṭum neṭunalvāṭaiyum pōraip paṟṟiyavai. maturaikkāñciyum paṭṭiṉappālaiyum nakaracciṟappiṉai mikutiyākak kūṟuvaṉa. kuṟiñcippāṭṭu oṉṟē muḻumaiyum akapporuḷaip paṟṟiyatu. eṉavē, ippāṭalkaḷuḷ viḷaiyāṭṭukaḷaip paṟṟiya ceytikaḷ cilavē kuṟikkappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa. mutaṟkaṇ kuṟuntokai mutaliya nūlkaḷil kuṟikkappaṭṭuḷḷa viḷaiyāṭṭukaḷai iṅku aṟivōm.
kuṟuntokaiyil viḷaiyāṭṭukaḷ
peṇṭiruṭcilar pūntātukaḷaikkoṇṭu pāvai ceytu viḷaiyāṭiṉar. ivvāṟu viḷaiyāṭiya ciṟumiyar kūṭṭam `ōra āyam eṉappaṭṭatu (48, 278). pañcāyk kōraiyiṉāṟceyta pāvaiyaic ciṟumi, taṉ makaveṉak karuti viḷaiyāṭiṉāḷ (114); neytal nilap peṇṭir, uppaṅkaḻikku arukil malarnta malarkaḷaip paṟittu viḷaiyāṭiṉar; kaṭal alaiyiṉkaṇ viḷaiyāṭiṉar (144); pāvaikkup pala vakai oppaṉai ceytu viḷaiyāṭiṉar (195).
naṟṟiṇaiyil viḷaiyāṭṭukaḷ
pālai nilacciṟuvar kaṭṭaḷaikkal pōṉṟa araṅkai vaṭṭiṉāl kīṟi, nellikkāyai vaṭṭākak koṇṭu pāṇṭil āṭiṉar (3). celvar vīṭṭuc ciṟuvar, ciṟiya paṟai oṉṟait tōḷil māṭṭiyiruntaṉar. ataṉ kaṇṇil kuruvi eḻutappaṭṭiruntatu. avarkaḷ ciṟiya kōlaikkoṇṭu akkuruviyai aṭittu ōcaippaṭuttiṉar (58). peṇkaḷ pañcāyk kōraiyiṉāl pāvai ceytu viḷaiyāṭiṉar (68); āṟṟu niril viḷaiyāṭiṉar (68); paṉai nāriṉālē tiritta kayiṟṟai marakkiḷaiyil piṇittut toṅkaviṭṭa ūñcalil āṭiṉar (90); vēṅkai marakkiḷaiyil kayiṟṟiṉāl kaṭṭappaṭṭa ūñcalil āṭiṉar (222, 368). ciṟumiyar, ciṟṟil amaittu viḷaiyāṭiṉar (123). acciṟumiyar pañcāyk kōraiyaik koṇṭu ceyta pāvai `īṉāppāvai (127) eṉappaṭṭatu; vaṇṭal maṇṇaikkoṇṭu iḻaitta pāvai `vaṇṭaṟ pāvai eṉappaṭṭatu (191). makaḷir kaippantum kāṟpantum viḷaiyāṭiṉar (104, 324). ciṟuvar, tēr uruṭṭi viḷaiyāṭiṉar (250).
kalittokaiyil viḷaiyāṭṭukaḷ
ciṟumiyar ciṟṟil iḻaittaṉar; varippantu āṭiṉar (51, 57); marappāṉaiyum marappāvaiyum vaittu viḷaiyāṭiṉar (59); `kuḻamakaṉ eṉṟa oruvakai marappāvaiyai vaittum viḷaiyāṭiṉar (66). iṅṅaṉam viḷaiyāṭiya ciṟumiyar, `ōrai makaḷir eṉappaṭṭaṉar (75). ōrai eṉpatu makaḷir viḷaiyāṭṭu. icciṟumiyar taṇṭāṉ kōraiyaip paṟittuk kiḻittup pāvaiyākkiyum viḷaiyāṭiṉar (76). ciṟur marayāṉaiyai vaittu viḷaiyāṭiṉar (80). celvacciṟuvar, periya maṇikaḷ patitta ciṟiya tēril irukka, cēṭiyar attērai iḻuttuc ceṉṟaṉar (83). ēḻaicciṟuvar paṉaṅ kurumpaiyaik koṭiyāṟkaṭṭi iḻuttu viḷaiyāṭiṉar (83). mullai nilac ciṟumiyar pākaṟkoṭiyum mullaik koṭiyum paṭarnta tōṭṭattil ciṟṟil iḻaittu viḷaiyāṭiṉar (111). ammakaḷir piṭavam, taḷavam, tōṉṟi, koṉṟai mutaliya malarkaḷaik koṇṭu taḻaiyum pāvaiyum ceytu viḷaiyāṭiṉar (102); mullaippūvum tam kūntaliṟcūṭik kāṭṭāṟṟu maṇal niṟainta kuḷirnta cōlaiyil viḷaiyāṭiṉar (113). kuṟiñci nilappeṇ ūcalāṭiṉāḷ (37). neytal nilacciṟumi cuṟāmīṉ kompāl ceyta palakaiyil tāḻaiyiṉ viḻutāl tiritta kayiṟu kōtta ūñcalil āṭiṉāḷ (113).
pattuppāṭṭil viḷaiyāṭṭukaḷ
iḷamakaḷir pāvai ceytu viḷaiyāṭiṉar; nūlāl varintu puṉaiyappaṭṭa pantai eṟintum aṭittum viḷaiyāṭiṉar (tirumuruku. aṭi, 68). cōḻa nāṭṭu uḻavar makaḷir, neytal nilattu maṇaṟkuṉṟukaḷil vaṇṭal iḻaittu viḷaiyāṭiṉar (po. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 187). vaṇṭal-maṇaṟciṟṟil. toṇṭai nāṭṭu marutanilap pērūrkaḷil ciṟuvar piṟarāl ēṟappaṭāta ciṟiya tērkaḷai uruṭṭi viḷaiyāṭiṉar (pe. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 248-249). toṇṭai nāṭṭut tuṟaimuka nakarattuc celvac ciṟumiyar tamatu vaḷamaṉaiyiṉ mēl māṭattil nūliṉāl varintu kaṭṭappaṭṭa pantai aṭittu viḷaiyāṭiṉar (aṭi, 331-333). veṇmaṇalilē amarntu poṉṉāl ceyta kaḻalaikkoṇṭu viḷaiyāṭiṉar (aṭi, 334-5). kuṭṭaṅkaḷil nīrāṭuvōr tam kaiyai mēlē kūppi muḻuki nīriṉ āḻattaik kāṭṭutal marapu (pe. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 272-3).
maturai mānakaril ñāyiṟu maṟainta piṉpu mutal yāmattil vīrar cilar pōrppayiṟci koṇṭa yāṉaiyait tammait toṭarntu vantu piṭikkumpaṭi ēviṉar. atu tammaip piṉ toṭarnta pōtu ataṉ pōkkait taṭukkat tam maṭiyilirunta kappaṇaṅkaḷait taraiyil citaṟiviṭṭaṉar. `kappaṇam eṉpatu. āṉai neruñci muḷ pōla irumpāl ceyyappaṭṭa karuvi. yāṉai avaṟṟai mitikka añci niṉṟuviṭṭatu. iḵtu akkāla vīrarkaṭku oru viḷaiyāṭṭāy iruntatu. (ma. kā. aṭi, 594-599).
kuṟiñci nilamakaḷir cuṉaiyil nīrāṭiṉar; malai aruvikaḷil viḷaiyāṭiṉar; tam maṉattukku viruppamāṉa vaṟṟaip pāṭikkoṇṭē kūntalai ulartiṉar; kōṭaṟpū, āmpaṟpū, kuṟiñcippū, mutaliya toṇṇūṟṟukku mēṟpaṭṭa kuṟiñcinila malarkaḷaip paṟittaṉar; avaṟṟaip pāṟaiyilē kuvittaṉar; pala mālaikaḷākak kaṭṭit tam kariya muṭiyilē aḻakupeṟac cūṭik koṇṭaṉar (ku. pā. aṭi, 54-106). cōḻanāṭṭu ūrkaḷil ciṟuvar, kutirai pūṭṭāmal kaiyāl uruṭṭum mūṉṟu uruḷaikaḷaiyuṭaiya ciṟu tēriṉai vaittu viḷaiyāṭiṉar.
pūmpukār nakarattil mīṉavar piḷḷaikaḷ maṇalilē paṭarnta aṭampampūvait talaiyilē kaṭṭiyum, nīril niṉṟa āmpaṟpūvaip paṟittuc cūṭiyum, taṅkaḷ maṉṟilē āṭṭukkiṭāyp pōraiyum kavutārip pōraiyum kaṇṭu kaḷittārkaḷ (pa. pālai, aṭi, 61-77). kaṭaliṭaic ceṉṟu mīṉ piṭittu vāḻnta paratavar. uvā nāḷil mīṉ piṭikkac cellār; ataṟku māṟāka, āṭiyum pāṭiyum poḻutaik kaḻittaṉar. avarkaḷ taṅkaḷ makaḷirōṭu kūṭi maṇal muṟṟattil cuṟāviṉ kompai naṭṭu, veṇṭāḷi malar mālaiyiṉaiyum tāḻai malaraiyum cūṭip paṉaṅkaḷḷaiyum neṟkaḷḷaiyum uṇṭu viḷaiyāṭiṉārkaḷ; kāviri kaṭaloṭu kalakkum iṭattil kaṭalāṭiṉārkaḷ; uṭampiṟpaṭinta uppup pōkumpaṭi, kāviriyil nīrāṭiṉārkaḷ; naṇṭukaḷaip piṭittu viḷaiyāṭiṉārkaḷ.
pāvaikaḷaip paṇṇi viḷaiyāṭiṉārkaḷ; aimpoṟikaḷāl nukarum poruḷkaḷai nukarntu mayaṅkiṉārkaḷ; nīṅkāta viruppattuṭaṉē pakaṟpoḻutellām viḷaiyāṭiṉārkaḷ (aṭi, 90-103).
26. camayam
kuṟiñci nilattukkuriya kaṭavuḷ murukaṉ; mullai nilattukkuriya kaṭavuḷ māyōṉ; pālai nilattiṟkuriya kaṭavuḷ paḻaiyōḷ eṉappaṭṭa turkkai; maruta nilattukkuriya kaṭavuḷ vēntaṉ (intiraṉ); neytal nilattukkuriya kaṭavuḷ, varuṇaṉ. itu tolkāppiyar kūṟum ceytiyākum.1
muruka vaḻipāṭu
vēlum cēvalum murukaṉukkuriyavai. ivai iraṇṭum varalāṟṟuk kālattiṟku mika muṟpaṭṭa paḻaimai vāynta āticcanallūrp putaiporuḷkaḷukkiṭaiyiṟ kiṭaittuḷḷaṉa. vēlkaḷ irumpāl ceyyappaṭṭavai; cēvalkaḷ pittaḷaiyāl ceyyappaṭṭavai. ivaṟṟai nōkka, muruka vaṇakkam mikappaḻaiya kālattiliruntē tamiḻariṭam iruntu varuvatu eṉpatu teḷivākum.2
vaṭavintiyāvil civaṉ allatu uruttiraṉ kuṟiñci nilakkaṭavuḷākak karutappaṭṭāṉ. āyiṉum, tamiḻ nāṭṭil cēyōṉ eṉṉum murukaṉ kuṟiñci nilak kaṭavuḷākak karutappaṭṭāṉ. vaṭavar murukaṉukkuc cuppiramaṇiyaṉ eṉṟum kārttikēyaṉ eṉṟum peyar vaḻaṅkiṉar. vētakālattil cuppiramaṇiya vaṇakkam vaḻakkil illai. itikāca kālattil kārttikēyaṉ eṉṟa cuppiramaṇiyaṉatu piṟappaip paṟṟiya kuṟippukaḷ kāṇappaṭukiṉṟaṉa. aṅku avaṉ uruttiraṉ allatu akkiṉiyiṉ makaṉeṉak kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷāṉ. cuppiramaṇiya vaḻipāṭu civaṉ allatu uruttira vaḻipāṭṭu vaḷarcciyiṉ payaṉākum. avvaḷarcciyiṉ payaṉāyt teṉṉāṭṭavar tam paḻaiya kaṭavuḷāṉa murukaṉai vaṭanāṭṭuc cuppiramaṇiyaṉōṭu oṉṟupaṭutti avaṉai intiraṉukkum varuṇaṉukkum oppākak karutalāyiṉar.1
uruttiraṉ, varuṇaṉ eṉṟa vētakālak kaṭavuḷar peyarkaḷukku iṇaiyāṉavai, piṟa intō-jermāṉiya moḻikaḷiṟ kāṇappaṭavillai. eṉavē, akkaṭavuḷar tirāviṭar kaṭavuḷarāy iruntiruttal vēṇṭum. kaṭal teyvamāṉa varuṇaṉ, kaṭal ōram vāḻnta tirāviṭar kaṭavuḷākalām. āriya iruṭikaḷ akkaṭavuḷukkut taṅkaḷ vaḻipāṭṭil iṭam tantirukkalām. malaikkuriya kaṭavuḷāṉa uruttiraṉ tirāviṭar kaṭavuḷ āvāṉ. uruttiraṉ eṉpataṟkuc `civantavaṉ eṉpatu poruḷ. itu civaṉ eṉṉum tirāviṭap peyariṉ vaṭamoḻi ākkamākum. teṉṉāṭṭu malaikkaṭavuḷāṉa murukaṉ, koṟṟavaiyiṉ makaṉāvāṉ. maruta nilattukkuriya tirāviṭar kaṭavuḷ vētakāla intiraṉuṭaṉ aikkiyap paṭuttappaṭṭaṉaṉ pōlum! vētaṅkaḷ kūṟum kiruṣṇaṉ, tirāviṭaratu mullai nilakkaṭavuḷāṉa māyōṉ eṉpavaṉ āvaṉ.2
kālappōkkil koṟṟavai umaiyākkappaṭṭāḷ. ataṉāl, avaḷ makaṉāṉa murukaṉ umaiyiṉ makaṉākavum civaṉ makaṉākavum karutappaṭṭāṉ.3
`kārttikai mātar aṟuvarāl vaḷarkkappaṭṭamaiyāl cuppiramaṇayiṉ kārttikēyaṉ eṉappaṭṭāṉ, eṉṟu purāṇaṅkaḷ kūṟukiṉṟaṉa. kārttikēyaṉ eṉappaṭṭa cuppiramaṇiyaṉ, āṟu talaikaḷaiyum paṉṉiraṇṭu kaikaḷaiyum uṭaiyavaṉ eṉṟu purāṇaṅkaḷ kūṟukiṉṟaṉa. avaṉ tamiḻ murukaṉōṭu iṇaikkappaṭṭa kāraṇattāl, tirumurukāṟṟup paṭaiyil āṟu talaikaḷum paṉṉiru kaikaḷum avaṟṟukkuriya ceyalkaḷum pēcappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa. (aṭi, 91-118).
pāṭalipurattil ki. mu. 188il puṣyamittira cuṅkaṉ aracaṉāṉāṉ. cuṅkar āṭciyil vaitikar celvākkup peṟṟaṉar; irāmāyaṇa pārata nūlkaḷ tirutti eḻutappaṭṭaṉa; piramaṉ, viṣṇu, civaṉ ākiya mūvarum camanilaiyil vaikkappaṭṭaṉar. irāmaṉum kiruṣṇaṉum viṣṇuviṉ avatāraṅkaḷeṉak karutappaṭṭaṉar. oru cārār civaṉai uyarttiṉar; maṟṟoru cārār viṣṇuvai uyarttiṉar; kītai muṭivāṉa uruvam eṭuttatu. kiruṣṇaṉ viṣṇuviṉ avatāram eṉṟu karutappaṭṭāṉ; `pakavāṉ eṉṟu vaḻaṅkappaṭṭāṉ. avaṉaip paṟṟiya kataikaḷ potumakkaḷiṭam paraviṉa. ammatattaip piṉpaṟṟiyavar `pākavatar eṉappaṭṭaṉar.1 pakavāṉ varalāṟṟaik kūṟum nūl `pākavatam eṉappaṭṭatu. vaṭavintiyāvil uṇṭāṉa immāṟupāṭukaḷ teṉṉinti yāvilum paravutal iyalpēyaṉṟō?
murukaṉaip paṟṟiyavai
murukaṉ, pañcapūtaṅkaḷuḷ oṉṟāṉa tī, taṉ kaiyil ēṟpa, kārttikai mātar aṟuvarāl vaḷarkkappaṭṭavaṉ; āṟu uruvaṅkaḷaip peṟṟavaṉ; kallāliṉ kīḻirunta kaṭavuḷiṉ putalvaṉ; malaiyaraiyaṉ makaḷukku makaṉ; pakaivarkkuk kūṟṟuvaṉ; koṟṟavai ciṟuvaṉ; kāṭukiḻāḷ; makaṉ; tēvarpattalaivaṉ; villaiyum tāṉaiyaiyum uṭaiya talaivaṉ; mālai aṇinta mārpaṉ; ellā nūlkaḷaiyum aṟinta pulavaṉ; pōrttoḻilil oppaṟṟavaṉ; porukiṉṟa veṟṟiyaiyuṭaiya maḷḷaṉ; cāṉṟōr pukaḻntu kūṟum coṟkaḷiṉ caṭṭamāyiruppavaṉ; teyvayāṉai vaḷḷiyammaiyōrkkuk kaṇavaṉ; vīrar ēṟu; vēlēntiya peruñcelvaṉ; kiravuñca malaiyaip piḷanta kiḻavaṉ; vāṉaḷāviya mālaikaḷaiyuṭaiya kuṟiñci nilattukku urimaiyuṭaiyavaṉ; kalvi matattaiyuṭaiya yāṉai pōlvārkkuc ciṅka ēṟu pōṉṟavaṉ; perumpeyar murukaṉ; vīṭṭiṉpattai virumpi vantavarkku aruḷpuriyum aṇṇal; piṟarāl iṭukkaṇpaṭṭu vantavarkku aruḷ puriyum cēy; poṉṉāṟceyyap paṭṭa pēraṇikalaṅkaḷai mārpil aṇintavaṉ; irantu vantōrkku vēṇṭuvaṉa koṭuttu avaraip pātukāppavaṉ; tēvarum muṉivarum ēttum periya tiruppeyaraiyuṭaiya iyavuḷ (talaivaṉ allatu kaṭavuḷ); cūrapaṉmāviṉ cūlattai illaiyākkiṉa `matavali eṉṉum peyarai uṭaiyavaṉ. apperumāṉ porunaṉ (uvamikkappaṭupavaṉ); kuricil (talaivaṉ); taṉṉōṭu oppārillāta meyyaṟivai uṭaiyavaṉ. iṅṅaṉam palavāṟu murukap perumāḷaip pukaḻntu vaḻipaṭumpaṭi, vīṭupēṟṟaik kaṇṭa pulavaṉ, appēṟṟai avāvum pulavaṉukkuk kūṟiyuḷḷāṉ (tirumuruku. aṭi, 255-280).
malai nāṭṭil vaḻipāṭu
kuṟamakaḷ murukavaḻipāṭṭukkuriya iṭattait tūymaiyākki, aṅku murukaṟkariya kōḻikkoṭiyai nāṭṭiṉāḷ; akkoṭimītu neyyōṭu veṇciṟu kaṭukai appiṉāḷ; tāṉ vaḻipaṭaṟkuriya mantirattai mella uccarittu vaḻipaṭṭāḷ; aḻakiya malarkaḷai akkoṭi mītu tūviṉāḷ; iraṇṭu āṭaikaḷai uḷḷoṉṟum puṟam oṉṟumāka uṭuttāḷ; civanta nūlaik kaiyil kāppākak kaṭṭiṉāḷ; veḷḷiya poriyait tūviṉāḷ; āṭṭukkiṭāyiṉ kurutiyōṭu picainta tūya veḷḷariciyaic ciṟupaliyāka iṭṭāḷ; pala pirappukaḷai (nivētaṉapporuḷ) vaittāḷ; ciṟiya pacu mañcaḷōṭu naṟiya cantaṉam mutaliyavaṟṟaiyum teḷittāḷ; periya kuḷirnta cevvalari mālaiyaiyum piṟa kuḷirnta maṇamikka mālaikaḷaiyum acaiyat toṅkaviṭṭāḷ; `malaip pakkattu ūrkaḷiliruntu paciyum piṇiyum pakaiyum nīṅkuka, eṉṟu vāḻttiṉāḷ; cēvaṟkoṭikku naṟiya tūpaṅkāṭṭiṉāḷ; kuṟiñcippaṇṇil murukaṉaip pāṭiṉāḷ; appoḻutu aruvi ōcaiyōṭu palliyaṅkaḷiṉ oliyum olittaṉa. kuṟamakaḷ civanta niṟamuṭaiya pala pūkkaḷaiyum tūvik kurutiyaḷainta civanta tiṉaiyaip parappiṉāḷ; murukaṉ uvakkum vācciyaṅkaḷai vācikkap paṇṇiṉāḷ; maṉamuruki murukaṉai vaḻipaṭṭāḷ.
appoḻutu uṭaṉ iruntavar, avveṟiyāṭu kaḷam āravārippa ataṟku ēṟpaṉavaṟṟaip pāṭiṉar; kompukaḷ palavaṟṟaiyum cēravūtiṉar; maṇiyai olippittaṉar; murukaṉatu ūrtiyākiya `piṇimukam eṉṉum yāṉaiyai vāḻttiṉar; murukap perumāṉai vaḻipaṭṭaṉar (tirumuruku. aṭi, 227-248).
vēlaṉ veṟiyāṭṭu
murukaṉaippōla vēṭam pūṇṭu kaiyil vēlēnti āṭum malai nāṭup pūcāri `vēlaṉ eṉappaṭṭāṉ. avaṉ kuṟamakaḷatu nōy murukaṉāl vantateṉṟu aiyuṟiṉ, akkaṭavuḷait tirutti ceyya oru kaḷattai amaittup pūcaiyiṭṭu āṭippāṭi vaḻipaṭuvatu vaḻakkam. avaṉ iṅṅaṉam pūcaiyiṭṭu vaḻipāṭu ceytal `veṟiyāṭṭu eṉappaṭum. avaṉ āṭa, avaṉaip piṉpaṟṟik kāṉavarum āṭuvar. ittakaiya vēlaṉatu āṭal oṉṟu tirumurukāṟṟuppaṭaiyiṟ kīḻ varumāṟu kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷatu.
vēlaṉ cātikkāy, takkōlakkāy, kāṭṭu mallikai, veṇṭāḷi malar eṉpavai tammuḷ viravak kaṭṭiṉ kaṇṇiyai aṇintāḷ; civanta āṭaiyai aṇintāḷ; kātukaḷil acōkantaḷiraik koṇṭāṉ; kaccaiyaik kaṭṭik kaḻalai aṇintāṉ; veṭci mālaiyaic cūṭiṉāṉ. aṅku iruntavar kuḻalai ūtiṉar; kompai ūtiṉar; ciṟiya palliyaṅkaḷai eḻuppiṉar. vēlaṉ mayilēṟic cēvaṟkoṭiyai uyarttit toṭiyait tōḷil aṇintu, kuravaiyāṭik koṇṭirunta makaḷiroṭu kaikōttu āṭiṉāṉ.
kuṟavar mūṅkilil iruntu muṟṟiṉa tēṉāṟceyta kaḷ teḷivaic cuṟṟattuṭaṉ uṇṭu makiḻntu, toṇṭakap paṟaiyiṉ tāḷattiṟku ēṟpat taḻaiyaṇinta kuṟamakaḷirōṭu kūṭik kuravaik kūttāṭiṉar (tirumuruku. aṭi, 190-217).
piṟa ceytikaḷ
kuṟiñci nilattalaivaṉ talaiviyiṭam taṉ kātaluṟutiyai vaṟpuṟutta, `murukaṉ aṟiya niṉṉaip piriyēṉ; piriyiṉ, ayaṉ allatu ceytēṉāvēṉ, eṉṟu cūḷ ceytal vaḻakkam 
(ku. pāṭṭu, aṭi, 208-210).
kuṟiñci nilamakkaḷāl ceyyappaṭṭatāka mēlē kūṟappaṭṭa murukavaḻipāṭṭil vētaṅkaḷilō ākamaṅkaḷilō aṟivu peṟṟa purōkitar iṭam peṟavillai eṉpatu kavaṉittaṟkuriyatu. kuṟiñci nila makkaḷ, tāṅkaḷ toṉṟu toṭṭu vaḻipaṭṭuvanta muṟaiyilēyē vaḻipaṭṭu vantārkaḷ; attakaiya vaḻipāṭṭil taṅkaḷ kaṭavuḷ veḷippaṭuvāṉ eṉṟu nampiṉārkaḷ. akkaṭavuḷ avaruḷ oruvarmītu āvēcittu veḷippaṭutalē vaḻakkamāy iruntatu. ivvaḻakkam iṉṟum tamiḻariṭaiyē iruntu varukiṉṟatu. murukaṉāl āvēcikkappaṭṭavaṉ `vēlaṉ eṉappaṭṭāṉ.1
murukaṉ uḷḷa iṭaṅkaḷ
āṭṭukkiṭāyai aṟuttuk kōḻikkoṭiyai niṟutti, ūrār vaḻipaṭum iṭattilum, taṉ aṭiyavar toḻukiṉṟa iṭattilum, vēlaṉ amaitta veṟiyāṭu kaḷattilum, kāṭṭilum, poḻililum, āṟṟiṭaik kuṟaiyilum, āṟukaḷilum, kuḷaṅkaḷilum, palvēṟupaṭṭa ūrkaḷilum, nāṟcantiyilum, muccantiyilum, aiñcantiyilum, kaṭampamarattilum, ūr naṭuvil uḷḷa marattaṭiyilum, ampalattilum, ātīṇṭu kuṟṟiyaiyuṭaiya iṭattilum, kuṟamakaḷ vaḻipaṭum iṭattilum murukaṉ tōṉṟi aruḷ purivāṉ (tirumuruku. aṭi, 218-248).
murukap perumāṉ cūraramakaḷir āṭum cōlaikaḷ poruntiya tirupparaṅkuṉṟattil eḻuntaruḷiyuḷḷāṉ; āṟu mukaṅkaḷuṭaṉum paṉṉiraṇṭu kaikaḷuṭaṉum alaivāyil eḻuntaruḷiyuḷḷāṉ; viratattāl vaṟṟiya yākkaiyaiyuṭaiya muṉivarum kantiruvarum vaḻipaṭat tiru āvinaṉkuṭiyil kōyil koṇṭuḷḷāṉ; piramacārikaḷ tōttiraṅ kaḷaikkūṟa, īra āṭaiyuṭaṉ iruntu aruccakar vaḻipāṭu ceyyum ērakattil eḻuntaruḷiyuḷḷāṉ; kuṉṟutōṟum āṭalpurikiṉṟāṉ. itu tirumurukāṟṟuppaṭai kūṟum ceytiyākum.
tirumāl vaṇakkam
kāñci nakarattiṟku aṇmaiyil cūriyaṉ veḷiccam paṭāta aṭarnta cōlai iruntatu. accōlaiyil maṇal mikuti. ammaṇalil kuḻikaḷ iruntaṉa. akkuḻikaḷil nīr kāṇappaṭṭatu. annīril kurukkatti malarkaḷ viḻuntu kiṭantaṉa. makkaḷ appoḻilil taṅki viḷaiyāṭiṉārkaḷ. accōlaiyaiyaṭuttu āṟṟuttuṟai amaintiruntatu. makkaḷ aṅku iḷavēṉiṟcevviyai nukarntārkaḷ. aṅku, nīṇṭa pūṅkottukaḷai yuṭaiya kāntaḷaip peṟṟa aḻakiya pakkamalaiyil yāṉaikiṭantāṟ pōlap pāmpaṇaiyākiya paṭukkaiyilē perumāḷ paḷḷikoṇṭiruntāṉ. (pe. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 371-390). perumāḷ iṅṅaṉam paḷḷi koṇṭa tirukkōvil iṉṟu ciṟiya kāñcīpurattil uḷḷa yatōttakāri kōvilākum. coṉṉa vaṇṇam ceyta perumāḷ kōvil eṉṉum tamiḻppeyarum ataṟkuṇṭu. tirumāl piṟanta ōṇanāḷ maturaiyiṟkoṇṭāṭappaṭṭatu.1 annaṉṉāḷil maṟavar tammuṭ cērippōr purintaṉar (ma. kā. aṭi, 590-596).
civaperumāṉ
potiyamalai nāṭṭai āṇṭuvanta āyvēḷ taṉakku nīlanākam nalkiya uyarnta kaliṅkattai ālamarattaṭiyil amarnta teṉmukak kaṭavuḷukkuk koṭuttāṉ (ci. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 95-97). aimpūtaṅkaḷaiyum cērappaṭaitta maḻuvākiya vāḷaiyuṭaiya periyōṉ ēṉaiyōriṉ mutalvaṉ eṉṟu maturaikkāñci pukalkiṉṟatu.
nīru nilaṉun tīyum vaḷiyu
māka vicumpo ṭaintuṭaṉ iyaṟṟiya
maḻuvāḷ neṭiyōṉ talaiva ṉāka
			(ma. kā. aṭi, 453-455)
eṉpataṉāl civaperumāṉ, kaṭavuḷaruḷ mutaṉmaiyāṉavaṉ eṉṟa koḷkai akkālattil, iruntamai teḷivākum.
nutalviḻi nāṭṭat tiṟaiyōṉ mutalāp
pativāḻ catukkap pūtamī ṟāka             (kātai, aṭi, 54-55).
eṉṟu pautta kāviyamākiya maṇimēkalaiyilum civa pirāṉē kaṭavuḷaruḷ mutalvaṉāyk kuṟikkappaṭṭuḷḷāṉ. civaperumāṉ ālamar celvaṉāka vaḻipaṭappaṭṭāṉ eṉpatum terikiṟatu.
nakarattil camayanilai
kāvirippūmpaṭṭiṉattil murukaṉukkum kaṭavuḷar piṟarkkum kōvilkaḷ iruntaṉa. aṅkup palliyaṅkaḷ olikka, nāḷum vaḻipāṭu naṭaipeṟṟatu; kuḻal icaiyai uṇṭākka, yāḻ vācikka, muḻavu muḻaṅka, muracu olikka, pāṭumakaḷir pāṭat tiruviḻā naṭaipeṟṟatu. nakaramakkaḷ vaḻipāṭṭilum tiruviḻāvilum kalantukoṇṭārkaḷ (pa. pālai, aṭi, 145-158).
maturaiyil civaperumāṉ mutaliya kaṭavuḷarkkuk kōvilkaḷ iruntaṉa. kōvil viḻāvil ēḻām nāḷ ciṟantatu. ēḻām nāḷ antiyil kaṭavuḷ tīrttamāṭutal marapu. atu maturaiyil ciṟappākak koṇṭāṭappaṭṭatu (ma. kā. aṭi, 427-428, 453-455). tiruviḻāviṉ toṭakkam paṟaiyaṟaintu makkaḷukkut terivikkappaṭṭatu (aṭi, 361-2).
maturaiyil irunta ellām kōvilkaḷilum antik kālappūcai pala vāttiyaṅkaḷ olikkac ciṟappāka naṭaipeṟṟatu. avvamayam vāḻvaraciyar tam kaṇavaraiyum piḷḷaikaḷaiyum aḻaittukkoṇṭu pūcaikku vēṇṭiya malarkaḷaiyum pukaipporuḷkaḷaiyum ēnti, avaravar viruppappaṭi, pauttappaḷḷikkum antaṇar paḷḷikkum camaṇar paḷḷikkum ceṉṟaṉar. pauttap paḷḷiyil pautta pikkukaḷ iruntu aṟavurai kūṟiṉar; antaṇar paḷḷiyil vētāntaṅkaḷil valla antaṇamuṉivar iruntu aṟavurai vaḻaṅkiṉar; camaṇar paḷḷiyil camaṇa muṉivar iruntu aṟavurai āṟṟiṉar.
antaṇar paḷḷi, malaiyai uḷ veḷiyāka vāṅki iruppiṭam ākkiṉāṟpōṉṟa amaippuṭaiyatāy ōṅki uyarntu uṭpuṟam akaṉṟiruntatu. camaṇappaḷḷiyiṉ cuvarkaḷ cempāṟceyyappaṭṭavai pōla uṟutiyāyiruntaṉa. accuvarkaḷiṉmītu ōviyaṅkaḷ tīṭṭappaṭṭiruntaṉa. appaḷḷiyil naṟiya malarccōlai iruntatu. aṅku irunta camaṇa muṉivarkaḷ ciṟanta kalvimāṉkaḷ (ma. kā. aṭi, 461-488).
ōymāṉ nalliyakkōṭaṉatu talainakarāṉa `kiṭaṅkil eṉṟa nakaram, `cāṟayar mūtūr eṉappaṭṭatu (ci. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 2001). `viḻā naṭakkiṉṟa paḻaiya ūr eṉpatu ittoṭariṉ poruḷākum. kāñci mānakaram,
                        	                             palartoḻa
viḻavumēm paṭṭa paḻaviṟal mūtūr
eṉappaṭṭatu (pe. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 410-411).
`palacamayattārum toḻumpaṭi eṭutta viḻākkaḷāl ēṉaiya nakarkaḷiṉ mēlāṉa veṟṟiyaiyuṭaiya paḻaiya ūr eṉpatu nacciṉārkkiṉiyar urai. kāñci mānakar kalviyilum camayattuṟaiyilum piṟa nakaraṅkaḷaiviṭa uyarntatu eṉpatu varalāṟu kaṇṭa uṇmai. `nakarēṣū kāñci eṉpatu vaṭamoḻi vācakam. puttar kāñciyil aṟavupatēcam ceytār. avar iruntu upatēcitta iṭaṅkaḷil acōkaṉ tūpikaḷai amaittāṉ eṉṟu yuvāṉcuvāṅku eṉṟa cīṉa vaḻippōkkaṉ kūṟiyuḷḷāṉ.1
cantirakuptamauriyaṉ taṉ āṭciyait tuṟantu paṉṉīrāyiram tikampara camaṇaruṭaṉ kaṉṉaṭa nāṭṭuc ciravaṇapeḷakoḷāvukku (veḷḷaikkuḷattukku) vantu taṅkiyatākac camaṇa nūlkaḷ kūṟukiṉṟaṉa. akkālattiliruntu tamiḻakattilum camaṇam paraviyatākak koḷḷalām. ki. mu. mūṉṟām nūṟṟāṇṭaic cērnta pirāmik kalveṭṭukaḷ kaḻukumalai mutaliya malaikkukaikaḷil kāṇappaṭutal pautta camayam tamiḻakattil paraviyataik kuṟippatākum.2
kāvirippūmpaṭṭiṉam, kāñci, vañci ākiya nakaraṅkaḷil pala camayaṅkaḷ iruntaṉa eṉṟu maṇimēkalaiyum kūṟutal iṅku niṉaikkattakum. eṉavē, maturaiyil pautta, camaṇa, vaitika neṟikaḷ iruntāṟpōlak kāñciyilum pala camayaṅkaḷ tiraiyaṉ kālattil iruntirukkalām eṉṟu karututal poruttamākum. pala camayattār kōvilkaḷ iruntaṉa. eṉavē, kāñciyil avvaccamayattārukkuriya viḻākkaḷ naṭaipeṟṟaṉa eṉpatu tāṉē pōtarum.
iṭaiyaṟāta celva varuvāyiṉaiyuṭaiya akaṉṟa iṭattaiyuṭaiya periya ūrkaḷil viḻākkaḷ naṭantaṉa. viḻākkālaṅkaḷil ayalūrārkkum porunar pāṇar mutaliyōrkkum pērūrkaḷil cōṟu vaḻaṅkappaṭṭatu (po. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 1-2). malai nāṭṭu ūrkaḷil viḻāvaik kāṇa vantavarkku miṭāccōṟu varaiyātu vaḻaṅkappaṭṭatu (ku. pā. aṭi, 201-203).
kāvirippūmpaṭṭiṉattil kāḷi kōvilum iruntatu. akkōvil vāyilil pūtaṅkaḷ kāval iruntaṉa (pa. pālai, aṭi, 53-57). annakara vaṇikar tēvarkaḷai vaḻipaṭṭu yākaṅkaḷaic ceytaṉar; nāṉmaṟaiyōrai matittu naṭantaṉar (aṭi, 200-202).
nāṭṭil irunta ūrkaḷil ūrārkūṭum ampalaṅkaḷ iruntaṉa. aṅkut taṟi (neṭiya tūṇ) naṭappaṭṭu vaḻipaṭappaṭṭatu. ūr mātarār mālaiyil avviṭattait tūymai ceytu viḷakkēṟṟi, attaṟiyai malariṭṭu vaṇaṅkiṉar; ūr makkaḷ teyvam uṟainta attaṟiyai vaḻipaṭṭaṉar; viḻā iyaṟṟiṉar. avviḻāvil kūttar paṅku koṇṭaṉar (pa. pālai, aṭi, 246-255). ūrt tiruviḻāvil makaḷir pāṭiṉar, āṭiṉar; muḻavu kaṇṇuṟakkamiṉṟi muḻaṅkikkoṇṭiruntatu (malaipaṭu kaṭām, aṭi, 286).
camayam paṟṟiya piṟa ceytikaḷ
kāvirippūmpaṭṭiṉattuk kaṭaṟkaraiyil vāḻnta paratavar. valaikiṭantu ularnta maṇalaiyuṭaiya muṟṟattu maṉaiyil ciṉaiyaiyuṭaiya cuṟaviṉ kompai naṭṭu, ataṉiṭattē teyvattai ēṟṟi, vaḻipaṭṭaṉar; veṇṭāḷi malar mālaiyai aṇintu tāḻai malaraic cūṭip paṉaiyiṉ kaḷḷaipparukiyum neṟkaḷḷaip parukiyum viḷaiyāṭiṉar (pa. pālai, aṭi, 82-93).
viṟaliyar malaivāḻ teyvaṅkaḷaip paṇintu kuṟiñcip paṇṇil pala pākkaḷaip pāṭutal marapu. avarkaḷ mutaliṟkaṭavuḷai vāḻttiṉārkaḷ; piṉṉarē pala pāṭalkaḷaip pāṭiṉārkaḷ (malaipaṭu. aṭi, 360, 538-540). navira malaimītu kāriyuṇṭik kaṭavuḷ kōvil iruntatu. kūttar akkaṭavuḷai vaṇaṅkic ceṉṟaṉar (aṭi, 229-231). itaṉāl, malaimītu civapirāṉ kōvilum arukiyiruntamai aṟiyappaṭum.
pōril taṉṉāl iyaṉṟavaraiyil ciṟappuṟap pōr purintu uyir viṭṭa vīraṉatu uṭalaip putaitta allatu eritta iṭattil oru kallai naṭuvar; akkallil avaṉatu uruvattaiyum peyaraiyum, iṉṉa pōril ivvāṟu pōr purintu māṇṭāṉ eṉṟa vivarattaiyum poṟippar. akkal naṭukal eṉappaṭum. vīrar ciṟappākavum piṟar potuvākavum naṭukallai vaḻipaṭuvar. ittakaiya naṭukaṟkaḷ paṇṭait tamiḻakattil ovvoru nāṭṭilum iruntaṉa. ivvīra vaṇakkam tamiḻarkku vīrattaiyum nāṭṭuppaṟṟaiyum ūṭṭi vantatu eṉṉalām.
naṉṉaṉuṭaiya malaikaḷiṉ mītu ittakaiya naṭukaṟkaḷ iruntaṉa. avaṟṟuṭcila, marāmarattaṭiyil iruntaṉa. avvaḻiyiṟceṉṟa kūttar, yāḻ vācittu, naṭukal vīrarkaḷai vaḻipaṭṭuc ceṉṟaṉar (malaipaṭu. aṭi, 386-396).
kāṭṭil `cūr eṉṉum koṭunteyvam irunta teṉpataip paḻantamiḻar nampiṉar (ku. pāṭṭu, aṭi, 255).
tavam ceyyum vaḻakkam akkālattil iruntatu (po. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 91-92). mukkōl1 antaṇar kāviyāṭai uṭutta tuṟavikaḷ.1 ivarkaḷ tamiḻakattil iruntārkaḷ (mu. pāṭṭu, aṭi, 37).2
ivarkaḷ kalittokaiyil mukkōṟpakavar eṉap paṭṭārkaḷ. mukkōṟpakavar eṉpavar uṟiyilē taṅkiṉa kamaṇṭalattai uṭaiyavar; ari, ayaṉ, araṉ eṉṉum mūvarum oruvarē eṉpatai aṟivikkum aṭaiyāḷamāka mukkōlait tōḷilē vaittavar; kuṭaiyai uṭaiyavar; kāṭṭiṭattē pōtalai iyalpāṉa oḻukkamākak koṇṭavar (kalittokai, 9); piraṇavattai eppōtum niṉaintiruppavar (kali, 126).
talaivi orutti talaivaṉ oruvaṉōṭu uṭaṉpōkkai mēṟkoṇṭāḷ. avaḷait tēṭi vanta cevili, vaḻiyil mukkōṟpakavaraik kaṇṭu paṇintu, talaiviyaippaṟṟi vicārittāḷ. apperumakkaḷ tāṅkaḷ talaiviyaiyum talaivaṉaiyum kaṇṭatākak kūṟit talaivi talaivaṉuṭaṉ ceṉṟatu neṟippaṭṭatē eṉpataik kīḻ varumāṟu kūṟiṉārkaḷ.
maṇapporuḷkaḷ kūṭṭappeṟṟa cantaṉam malaiyiṭattē piṟantatu āyiṉum, pūcikkoḷpavarukku tāṉ payaṉait tarum; tāṉ vaḷarnta malaikkup payaṉait tārātu. muttukaḷ kaṭaliṟpiṟantavaiyāyiṉum, tammai aṇivārkkup payaṉpaṭumē tavirat tām piṟanta kaṭalukku oru payaṉaiyum tārā. ēḻu narampāl kūṭṭiya iṉimaiyāṉa ōcaikaḷ yāḻiṭattē piṟantavai āyiṉum, avai pāṭuvōrkkup payaṉ tarumē allātu yāḻukkup payaṉait tārā. ātalāl, uṉ makaḷ uṉ illattil piṟantu vaḷarntālum, peṟṟōriṉum ciṟanta kaṇavaṉai vaḻipaṭṭu avaṉ piṉṉē ceṉṟāḷ. iṅṅaṉam kaṟpup pūṇṭu nikaḻttum illaṟamē aṟaṅkaḷil talaiyāya aṟam. ivviruvarum maṟumaiyil nīṅkāmal tuṟakkattilē cellum vaḻiyum avvaḻipāṭēyākum (kali.9).
makkaḷ nellaiyum malarkaḷaiyum koṇṭu ceṉṟu ūrkkōvilil kaṭavuḷ tirumuṉpu vaittu niṟpārkaḷ. appoḻutu evarēṉum pēcuvataikkoṇṭu ataṉai naṟcol allatu tīya collākakkoṇṭu, tām karutiyatu naṭaipeṟum allatu naṭaipeṟātu eṉṟu muṭivu ceyvārkku (mullai. aṭi, 8-11). cōṟṟil āṭṭukkurutiyaiyō, vēṟu paliyiṭappaṭṭa uyiriṉ kurutiyaiyō kalantu kākkaikkup paliyiṭutal marapu (po. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 183-184). mērumalai teyvaṅkaḷ uṟaiyum malai eṉṟu nampi, tamiḻar ataṉaik `kaṭavuḷ mālvarai eṉṟaṉar (ci. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 205). ātittar paṉṉiruvar, uruttirar patiṉoruvar, vacukkaḷ eṇmar, maruttuvar iruvar, patiṉeṇkaṇaṅkaḷ, kantaruvar, cūraramakaḷir ākiyōraippaṟṟiyum tamiḻar aṟintiruntaṉar eṉpatu tirumurukāṟṟuppaṭaiyāl terikiṟatu (aṭi, 167-168).
murukaṉ piṟappu, murukaṉ cūraṉaik koṉṟamai, murukaṉ kiravuñca malaiyaip piḷantamai, tirumāl mūṉṟaṭi maṇ kēṭṭu ulakaḷantamai, tirumāl acurarai veṉṟamai, nalliyakkōṭaṉ vēṇṭa murukaṉ oru kiṇaṟṟil irunta malarai vēlāka māṟṟit tantamai pōṉṟa camayat toṭarpāṉa kataikaḷ cila pattup pāṭṭil vantuḷḷaṉa; aruccuṉaṉ kāṇṭava vaṉattai erittamaiyum, pāratappōr paṟṟiya ceytikaḷum iṭam peṟṟuḷḷaṉa.
muṭivurai
vaṭanāṭṭiliruntu ēṟattāḻak ki. mu. mūṉṟām nūṟṟāṇṭil camaṇamum pauttamum tamiḻakattiṟku vantaṉa. avaṟṟukku muṉṉarē vētaneṟi tamiḻakattiṟpukuntu paravat toṭaṅkiyatu eṉpatu tolkāppiyattāl terikiṟatu. ivaṟṟōṭu caivamum vaiṇamum innāṭṭil caṅkakālattiṟ paraviyiruntaṉa eṉpatu mēlē kūṟappaṭṭa cāṉṟukaḷāl teḷivākum.
27. aḻakukkalaikaḷ
1. ōviyakkalai
muṉṉurai
nām kaṇṇāl kāṇum poruḷkaḷaic cittirittu eḻutum kalaiyē ōviyakkalai. paṇṭai maṉitaṉ tāṉ pārttavaṟṟaiyē paṭamāka eḻutikkāṭṭiṉāṉ; piṉpu aṟivu vaḷaravaḷara, taṉ maṉattāṟpala uruvaṅkaḷaiyum kāṭcikaḷaiyum muṭivu ceytu, avaṟṟaip paṭaṅkaḷāka varaintāṉ; eṇṇum āṟṟalil ciṟanta pulavar perumakkaḷuṭaiya karuttōviyaṅ kaḷukku uruvaṅkaḷai amaittāṉ. ivvāṟu kāṇum poruḷiliruntu eṇṇum poruḷkaḷ ceytikaḷ varaiyilum uruvam tarum muṟai ōviyaṅkalaiyil vaḷarcci peṟṟatu. paḻaiya makkaḷ vāḻnta kukaikaḷil ciṟuciṟu ōviyaṅkaḷ iṉṟum kāṇappaṭukiṉṟaṉa. itaṉai nōkka, vīṭu kaṭṭa aṟiyāta maṉitaṉ kukaiyil vāḻnta pōtē ōviyakkalai tōṉṟiyatu eṉṟu kūṟalām.
ēṟattāḻa aiyāyiram āṇṭukaḷukku muṟpaṭṭa cintu veḷip poruḷkaḷil ōviyam tīṭṭappeṟṟa maṭpāṇṭaṅkaḷ palavākum; tāyittukaḷ palavākum. ivvāṟē cumēriyar, ekiptiyar putaiporuḷkaḷilum ōviyaṅkaḷ kāṇappaṭu kiṉṟaṉa. eṉavē, ōviyam varaiyum paḻakkam maṉitaṉukkut toṭakkattiliruntē vaḷarntu vantirukkiṟatu eṉṟu kūṟutal poruttamākum.
caṅka kālattil
iṉṟuḷḷa tamiḻnūlkaḷuḷ kālattāl muṟpaṭṭatu tolkāppiyam eṉṉum ilakkaṇa nūl. pōril viḻuppuṇ paṭṭu vīrarkaḷ iṟanta iṭattil-allatu avarkaḷaip putaitta iṭattil-allatu avarkaḷatu uṭaṟcāmpalai aṭakkam ceyta iṭattil-oru kal naṭappaṭum; akkallil iṟanta vīraṉatu uruvam cetukkappaṭum; piṉṉar ataṟkup pūcai naṭattappaṭum. ataṟku `naṭukal eṉpatu peyar. atu vīrarālum iṟantavaṉ marapiṉarālum toḻappaṭum. kallil ivvāṟu ōr uruvam cetukkappaṭutaṟku muṉpu avvuruvattai ōviyamāka varaintukoḷḷutalē vaḻakkamākum. anta ōviyattil utavikoṇṭēṭa, kallil uruvam cetukkappaṭum. eṉavē, tolkāppiyar kālattilēyē (ēṟattāḻa 2300 āṇṭukaḷukku muṉpē) ōviyam tīṭṭum vaḻakkam tamiḻariṭam iruntu vantatu eṉpatu teḷivākum.
caṅkakāla naṭaṉamakaḷir naṭaṉakkalaikkākap palvēṟu kalaikaḷaiyum kaṟṟaṉar; avaṟṟuḷ ōviyakkalai oṉṟu eṉṟu maṇimēkalai ceppukiṉṟatu.
	nāṭaka makaḷirkku naṉkaṉam vakutta
ōviyac cennūl urainūṟ kiṭakkaiyum
kaṟṟuttuṟai pōkiya poṟṟoṭi naṅkai.
				-maṇi. kātai 2: 30-32.
ivvaṭikaḷai nōkka, ōviyakkalai paṟṟiya ciṟanta nūl oṉṟu caṅkakālattil iruntatu eṉpatu teḷivākalām. mātaviyiṉ naṭaṉa araṅkēṟṟam nikaḻnta araṅkiṉ mēṟ kūraiyil kaṇkavar ōviyaṅkaḷ pala tīṭṭappaṭṭiruntaṉa. akkūrai ōviyavitāṉam eṉappeyar peṟṟatu. (cilap. 95:128). ulōkaṅkaḷālāṉa kēṭayaṅkaḷil kaṇṇaik kavarum ōviyaṅkaḷ tīṭṭappaṭṭiruntaṉa eṉṟu cilappatikāram ceppukiṟatu.
celvar vāḻum vaḷamaṉaic cuvarkaḷiṉmītum māṭaṅkaḷiṉ mītum tēvar mutal ellā uyirkaḷaiyum kuṟikkattakka ōviyaṅkaḷ tīṭṭappaṭṭiruntaṉa eṉṉum ceyti maṇimēkalaiyil kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷatu.
vampa mākkaḷ kampalai mutūrc
cuṭumaṇ ōṅkiya neṭunilai maṉaitoṟum
maiyaṟu paṭivattu vāṉavar mutalā
evvakai yuyirkaḷum uvamaṅ kāṭṭi
veṇcutai viḷakkattu vittakar iyaṟṟiya
kaṇkavar ōviyam kaṇṭuniṟ kunarum.
				-kātai, 3 : 126-131.
maturaiyai aṭutta tirupparaṅkuṉṟattil murukap perumāṉ tirukkōyilil maṇṭapaṅkaḷ pala iruntaṉa. avaṟṟil purāṇa itikācak kataikaḷ pala ōviyaṅkaḷākak kāṭciyaḷittaṉa. avaṟṟuḷ katiravaṉ, tiṅkaḷ, kōḷkaḷ, irati, maṉmataṉ, intiraṉ, akalikai, pūṉai, kautamaṉ eṉṉum uyartiṇai-aḵṟiṇaip poruḷkaḷaik kuṟikkum ōviyaṅkaḷ eḻutappaṭṭiruntaṉa eṉap paripāṭāl pakarkiṉṟatu. (pāṭal, 19 : aṭi, 46-53).
kātalaṉ tāṉ virumpiya peṇṇai maṇakka iyalāta nilaiyil oru tuṇiyil avaḷ uruvattai ōviyamāka varaintukoṇṭu maṭal ēṟutal vaḻakkam eṉṟu akapporuḷ nūlkaḷ kūṟukiṉṟaṉa.
ōviyaṅkaḷai amaittu āṭai neytal caṅkakālat tamiḻakattil vaḻakkamāyiruntatu. āṭaikaḷil ōviyaṅkaḷai amaittal eḷitāṉa ceyalaṉṟu. aṅṅaṉam amaittavar mikacciṟanta ōviyattiṟaṉ vāyntavarāy iruttal vēṇṭum allavā? kāvirippūmpaṭṭiṉattil irunta uvavaṉam, ciṟanta ōviyarāl ōviyam amaittu neyyappaṭṭa āṭai pōlak kāṭciyaḷittatu eṉṟu maṇimēkalai āciriyar kuṟittuḷḷār.
	vittakar iyaṟṟiya viḷaṅkiya kaiviṉaic
cittirac ceykaip paṭāmpōrt tatuvē
ōppat tōṉṟiya uvavaṉam
				-kātai, 3 : 167-169.
ivvāṟu āṭaikaḷilum cuvarkaḷilum maṇṭapak kūraikaḷilum kēṭayaṅkaḷiṉ mītum kaṇkavar ōviyaṅkaḷait tīṭṭa vallavar mikacciṟanta ōviyarāy irukka vēṇṭum allavā?
caṅkakālattil ōviyakkalai ciṟanta muṟaiyil vaḷarcci peṟṟiruntatu eṉpatai itukāṟum kūṟiya vivaraṅkaḷaik koṇṭu naṉku teḷiyalām.1
pattuppāṭṭuḷ ōviyakkalaiyaippaṟṟiya kuṟippukaḷ mikaccilavē vantuḷḷaṉa. avaṟṟaik kīḻē kāṇpōm:
ōvu-ōvam
ōvukaṇ ṭaṉṉa aruperu niyamam (ma. kā. aṭi, 365).
ōvat taṉṉa uṇṭuṟai; (ci. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 70).
eṉṉum aṭikaḷai nōkkac cittiram eṉṟa poruḷil ōvu eṉpatum ōvam eṉpatum payiṉṟuḷḷamai aṟiyappaṭum.
ōviyavakaivaṇṇaṅkaḷaik koṇṭu tīṭṭappaṭāta ōviyam (Sketch) puṉaiyā ōviyam eṉappaṭṭatu. `pāṇṭiyaṉ pōrukkucceṉṟa piṉpu avaṉ pirivāl vāṭit taṉṉai aṇi ceytukoḷḷāta racamātēvi, puṉaiyā ōviyam pōlak kāṇappaṭṭāḷ, eṉṟu neṭunalvāṭai vaṟukiṟatu (aṭi, 145-147).
cōḻanāṭṭu nīrttuṟai ōviyattaip pōṉṟiruntatu eṉṟu ciṟupāṇāṟṟuppaṭai kūṟukiṟatu (aṭi, 70). vaṇṇaṅkaḷāl muṟṟuppeṟṟa ōviyam kaṇṇaik kavarvatu pōla nīrttuṟaiyum pūntātu paravik kaṇkavar vaṉappiṉaip peṟṟiruntatu eṉpatu karuttām.
iṉimaiyum teyvattaṉmaiyum
ōviyaṅkaḷaik kaṇṭāṟpōṉṟu kaṇṇukku iṉimaiyaiyuṭaiya `nāḷaṅkāṭi allaṅkāṭi eṉṉum iraṇṭu kaṭaitterukkaḷ maturaiyil iruntaṉa eṉṟu maturaikkāñci moḻikiṉṟatu (aṭi, 365). ōviyaṅkaḷ kaṇṇukku iṉimai taruvaṉa eṉpatu tamiḻ makkaḷ karuttāl teḷiyalām. kaṇṇukku iṉimai tarum ōviyaṅkaḷ tamiḻakattil varaiyappaṭṭaṉa. eṉpatāl, caṅkakāla ōviyakkalaiyiṉ uyarvai oruvāṟu aṟiyalām. ataṉāṟpōlum akkāla ōviyaṉ `vallōṉ (Expert) eṉappaṭṭāṉ (ma. kā. aṭi, 723).
`pāṇṭiyaṉ neṭuñceḻiyaṉ kālaiyil eḻuntāṉ; vallōṉ eḻutiya pāvaiyil teyvattaṉmai nikaḻntāṟpōṉṟa vaṭiviṉai uṭaiyavaṉāyiruntāṉ; eṉṟu māṅkuṭi marutaṉār kūṟiyuḷḷār (ma. kā. aṭi, 723-24). eṉavē, vallōṉ eḻutiya pāvai ōviyattil teyvattaṉmai nikaḻum eṉpatu tamiḻar nampikkai eṉpatu terikiṟatu. maṇimēkalaik kāviyattil kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷa kantiṟpāvai itaṟku ēṟṟa cāṉṟākum (maṇi. kātai, 21 : aṭi, 1157-7, 120-27, 131-3). ittakaiya vallōr pala vakaippaṭṭa nuṇṇiya toḻilkaḷaiyum oppukkāṭṭi eḻutavalla kūriya aṟiviṉaiyuṭaiyavar. avarkaḷ nōkkiṉār kaṇṇiṭattē tam toḻilai niṟuttum tiṟamai vāyntavar. ataṉāl avarkaḷ `kaṇṇuḷ viṉaiñar eṉappaṭṭaṉar (ma. kā. aṭi, 516-518; urai).
kaṭṭiṟcurai ōviyam
pāṇṭimātēviyiṉ vēlaippāṭu niṟainta tantak kaṭṭiliṉ mēṟkūraiyil ōviyaṅkaḷ eḻutappaṭṭiruntaṉa; mēṭarāci mutaliya irācikaḷ varaiyappaṭṭiruntaṉa; tiṅkaḷum urōkiṇiyum eḻutappaṭṭiruntaṉa. tiṅkaḷōṭu cērntu urōkiṇi iruppatu pōlap paṭam varaiyappaṭṭiruntatu. urōkiṇi taṉ kaṇavaṉākiya tiṅkaḷai viṭṭup piriyātiruppatu pōlat tāṉum taṉ kaṇavaṉai viṭṭup piriyātirukka iyalavillaiyē eṉṟu eṇṇip pāṇṭimātēvi perumūccu viṭṭāḷ eṉṟu neṭunalvāṭai iyampukiṟatu (aṭi, 159-163). araṇmaṉaiyuḷ eḻutappaṭṭa inta ōviyaṅkaḷ mikacciṟanta ōviyarāl eḻutappaṭṭaṉavātal vēṇṭum eṉpatil aiyamillai aṉṟō?
paḷḷi, kōvil ōviyaṅkaḷ
maturaiyil irunta amaṇappaḷḷic cuvarkaḷiṉmītu accamayat toṭarpāṉa ōviyaṅkaḷ varaiyappaṭṭiruntaṉa (ma. kā. aṭi, 485).
kāvirippūmpaṭṭiṉattil irunta kōviṟcuvarkaḷ veṇmai niṟattaṉa. avaṟṟiṉ cuvarkaḷil vēṟupaṭṭa toḻilkaḷaiyuṭaiya (pala nikaḻccikaḷai uṇarttum) ōviyaṅkaḷ tīṭṭappaṭṭiruntaṉa eṉṟu paṭṭiṉappālai pakarkiṉṟatu (aṭi, 49-50).
ōviyattiṉ ciṟappu
ōviyaṉ taṉ kaittiṟaṉ muḻumaiyaiyum kāṭṭi oru maṅkaiyiṉ uruvattai ōviyamāka varaikiṉṟāṉ. avaṉ ammaṅkaiyiṉ nakilai aḻukupeṟattīṭṭi muṭikkiṉṟāṉ. anta ōviyattil uḷḷa nakiliṉ aḻakait taṉṉiṭattē peṟṟa nakilai uṭaiyavar naṉṉaṉuṭaiya maṉaivimār eṉṟu neṭunalvāṭai kūṟukiṟatu (aṭi, 57). itaṉāl, ōviyattiṉ ciṟappaiyum ataṉai varainta ōviyaṉatu ōviyappulamai mutircciyaiyum nām naṉku uṇaralāmaṉṟō?
muṭivurai
`vaṇṇaṅkaḷaikkoṇṭu eḻutappaṭāta ōviyam puṉaiyā ōviyam eṉappaṭṭatu. kaṇṇaikkavarattakka nīrttuṟai, kaṭaitteru mutaliyavaṟṟukku vallōṉ varain ōviyaṅkaḷ uvamai kūṟappaṭṭaṉa. araca mātēviyiṉ kaṭṭiliṉ mēṟkūraiyilum kōviṟcuvarkaḷiṉmītum ōviyaṅkaḷ tīṭṭappaṭṭiruntaṉa. ōviyaṉ `vallōṉ eṉṟum, `kaṇṇuḷ viṉaiñaṉ eṉṟum peyar peṟṟāṉ, eṉṉum vivaraṅkaḷai mēlē kūṟappaṭṭa ceytiyiliruntu nām naṉkuṇaralām.
ōviyaṅkalaiyai niṉaivūṭṭum ūrkaḷ
ōviyam tamiḻccol: cittiram-vaṭacol. ippeyarkaḷaik koṇṭa ūrkaḷ cila tamiḻakattil uṇṭu. avaṟṟaik kīḻē kāṇka:

ōvarūr						tañcai			tiruttuṟaippūṇṭi
							(ōvam-ōvar)

2. ciṟpakkalai
muṉṉurai
maṇ, maram, ceṅkal, kal, ulōkam, tantam, meḻuku, arakku mutaliyavaṟṟaikkoṇṭu uruvaṅkaḷ amaikkum kalaiyē `ciṟpakkalai eṉpatu.
vaḻuvaṟu maraṉum maṇṇuṅ kallum
eḻutiya pāvai.................
			-kātai, 21; aṭi, 115-116
maṇṇiṉum kalliṉum marattiṉum cuvariṉum
kaṇṇiya teyvatam kāṭṭunar vakukka
			-kātai, 21; aṭi, 125-126.
eṉa varum maṇimēkalai aṭikaḷ kavaṉikkattakkavai.
caṅkakālattil
vīrakkal pāvai mutaliyaṉa
ēṟattāḻak ki. mu. 300il iyaṟṟappaṭṭa tol kāppiyam eṉṉum paḻam pērilakkaṇa nūlil ciṟpakkalai paṟṟiya kuṟippuk kāṇappaṭukiṉṟatu. pōril viḻuppuṇ paṭṭu iṟanta vīraṉukkuk kal naṭuvatu paḻantamiḻar vaḻakkam. māṇṭa vīraṉatu uruvam akkallil poṟikkap peṟum. iṅṅaṉam vīrarkkuk kal naṭutal tolkāppiyar kālattil tiṭīreṉa eḻuntataṉṟu; avarukku muṉpē toṉṟu toṭṭu vanta paḻakkamākum. eṉavē, ciṟpakkalai tamiḻakattil pala nūṟṟāṇṭukaḷukku muṉṉarē tōṉṟiya kalai eṉpatu aiyamaṟa viḷaṅkum uṇmaiyākum.
ki. pi. 2ām nūṟṟāṇṭil iyaṟṟappaṭṭa cilappatikārattil kaṇṇaki eṉṉum pattiṉikku uruvam poṟitta varalāṟu kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷatu.
kolli malaiyiṉ oru pakutiyil cetukkappeṟṟa pāvai oṉṟu iruntatu. atu `kollip pāvai eṉappaṭṭatu (kuṟuntokai, 89, 100). pāṟaiyil uruvam cetukkum ciṟpakkalai aṟivu akkālattil iruntatu eṉpataṟku itu ciṟanta eṭuttukkāṭṭākum aṉṟō?
nīriṉ aṭiyil maṇṭiya poṭimaṇ `vaṇṭal eṉappaṭum. appoṭi maṇṇaikkoṇṭu pāvai ceytu viḷaiyāṭutal caṅkakālat tamiḻcciṟumiyar vaḻakkamākum. vaṇṭal koṇṭu ceyta pāvai vaṇṭaṟpāvai eṉappaṭṭatu (aiṅkuṟunūṟu, 124; naṟṟiṇai, 191). makaḷir pañcāykkōraiyāl pāvai ceytu viḷaiyāṭutalum vaḻakkam (kuṟuntokai, 276). taṇṭāṉ kōraiyaip paṟittuk kiḻittup pāvaiyākkutalum vaḻakkam (kali. 76). ciṟumiyar marappāṉai, marappāvai ākiyavaṟṟai vaittu viḷaiyāṭiṉar (kali. 59). maṇ, kōrai, maram ivaṟṟāl ciṟpa uruvaṅkaḷ amaikkum vaḻakkam akkālattil iruntatu eṉpatu mēṟkūṟiyavaṟṟāl teḷivākum.
maturai nakarap perunteru oṉṟil aṇinilai māṭam oṉṟiruntatu. ammāṭattil pala uruvaṅkaḷ cutaiyāl ceyyappaṭṭiruntaṉa. avaṟṟuḷ vēṅkaiyiṉ uruvam oṉṟu. atu `kaipuṉai kiḷarvēṅkai eṉappaṭṭatu. avvaḻiyē ceṉṟa peṇ yāṉai ataṉai mey vēṅkai eṉṟu eṇṇi accamuṟṟup pākaṉukku aṭaṅkāmal alaiyattoṭaṅkiyatu. itaṉai nōkka, akkālac ciṟpattoḻiliṉ ciṟappai nām naṉkuṇaralām. (paripāṭal, 10; aṭi, 41-46).
kāvirippūmpaṭṭiṉattil tūṇil pāvai oṉṟu iruntatu. atu `kantiṟpāvai eṉap peyar peṟṟatu. atu varuvatu uraikkum āṟṟal uṭaiyatu eṉṟu maṇimēkalai kūṟukiṉṟatu (kātai, 21).
mukkaṇṇaṉāṉa civaperumāṉ kōvil puṟanāṉūṟṟil kuṟikkappaṭukiṟatu (ce. 6). palarāmaṉ, kaṇṇaṉ, civaṉ, murukaṉ eṉpavar nāṟperun teyvaṅkaḷeṉa vaḻaṅkap paṭṭuḷḷaṉar (puṟam. 56).
kāvirippūmpaṭṭiṉattil civaṉ kōvil, murukaṉ kōvil, palarāmaṉ kōvil, tirumāl kōvil, catukkap pūtattiṉ kōvil, koṟṟavai kōvil, puttar kōvil, arukar kōvil eṉappala kōvilkaḷ iruntaṉa eṉac cilappatikāram ceppukiṟatu. cūriyaṉ, cantiraṉ, veḷḷai yāṉai, intiraṉatu vaccirāyutam ākiyavaṟṟukkum kōvilkaḷ iruntaṉa eṉṟu akkāviyamē kūṟukiṉṟatu. akkōvilkaḷil vaḻipāṭṭukkuriya tiruvuruvaṅkaḷ cutaiyālum marattālum kallālum ceyyappaṭṭiruttal vēṇṭum eṉṟu koḷvatu poruttamākum.
māṅkāṭṭu maṟaiyavaṉ tiruvēṅkaṭamalaiyil tirumālatu niṉṟakōlattaiyum tiruvaraṅkattil kiṭanta kōlattaiyum kaṇmaṇi kuḷirppak kaṇṭatākac cilappatikārattil ciṟappittuk kūṟuvatāl, apperumāṉ urucavaccilaikaḷ cilappatikāra kālattil (ki. pi. 2ām nūṟṟāṇṭil) ciṟanta vēlaippāṭu koṇṭaṉavāy iruntiruttal vēṇṭumallavā?
catukkappūtam
kāvirippūmpaṭṭiṉattil nāṉku terukkaḷ cantikkum iṭattil periya pūtattiṉ kōvil oṉṟu iruntatu. catukkattil amainta appūtattiṉ kōvil, catukkappūtam eḻuntaruḷiya kōvil eṉap peyar peṟṟatu. atu mucukuntaṉ eṉṟa cōḻa maṉṉaṉāl niṟuvappaṭṭatu. appūtam poykkari pukalvōraiyum, puṟaṅkūṟuvōraiyum, oḻukkaṅkeṭṭa varaiyum, piṟar poruḷaik kavarpavaraiyum, aṟaneṟi tavaṟum amaiccaraiyum taṉ kaippācattāl piṇittup puṭaittuk kollum eṉṟu cilappatikāram kūṟukiṟatu. attakaiya pūtattiṉ kallāl āṉa uruvaccilai oṉṟu koccikku vaṭakkē eṭṭukkal tolaivil uḷḷa aḻintupaṭṭa paḻaiya vañci mānakarap pakutiyil akaḻntu eṭukkappaṭṭatu. atu mikapperiya uruvam; ciṟanta vēlaippāṭu koṇṭatu.1 ataṉaip pōṉṟa uruvaccilaiyē pūmpukār nakarattilum iruntirukka vēṇṭum eṉṟu karututal poruttamākum. ellā makkaḷum catukkap pūtattai vaṇaṅki vantārkaḷ.
pattup pāṭṭil
murukapperumāṉ tirupparaṅkuṉṟam, tiruccīralai vāy, tiruvāvinaṉkuṭi, tiruvērakam ākiya nāṉku iṭaṅkaḷilum kōyil koṇṭiruntāṉ eṉṟu tirumurukāṟṟuppaṭai terivikkiṉṟatu. eṉavē, akkōvilkaḷil murukaṉ tiruvuruvaṅkaḷ iruntamai teḷivākum.
maturaiyil civaperumāṉ, tirumāl, puttar, arukar kōyilkaḷ iruntaṉa. akkaṭavuḷarai makkaḷ vaḻipaṭṭārkaḷ. kōyilkaḷil viḻākkaḷ naṭaipeṟṟaṉa eṉṟu maturaikkāñci moḻikiṉṟatu (aṭi, 444-464, 467-488). akkōyil kaḷilellām vaḻipāṭṭiṟkuriya kaṭavuḷar tiruvuruvaṅkaḷ iruntaṉa eṉpatu kūṟāmalē amaiyum. eṉavē, attiruvuru vaṅkaḷai amaikkum ciṟpakkalaittiṟaṉ tamiḻarkku iruntatu eṉpatu teḷivākum.
pāṇṭiyaṉatu araṇmaṉai vāyiliṉ mēl nilaiyil kacalaṭcumiyiṉ uruvam amaikkappaṭṭiruntatu (neṭunal vāṭai, aṭi, 81-86). vāyil nilai perumpālum uṟuti vāynta marattāṟceyyappaṭṭiruttal vēṇṭum. mēl nilaiyiṉ naṭuppakutiyil ilakkumiyiṉ uruvam amaikkappaṭṭatu. ataṉ iru puṟaṅkaḷilum peṇ yāṉaikaḷ tutikkaikaḷai ilakkumiyiṉ talaikkumēl uyarttic ceṅkaḻunīr malarkaḷai ilakkumiyiṉmītu corital pōlac cetukkappaṭṭiruntaṉa. iṅṅaṉam tirumakaḷ iraṇṭu yāṉaikaḷiṉ iṭaiyil vīṟṟiruttal iṉṟuḷḷa kōvilkaḷilum kāṇalām. pala paḻaiya kōvilkaḷil ikkāṭci cutaiyāl amaikkap paṭṭuḷḷatu.
tolkāppiyattil kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷa naṭukal vaṇakkam iraṇṭiṭaṅkaḷil malaipaṭukaṭāttil kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷatu. naṉṉaṉuṭaiya malaikaḷiṉmītu naṭukaṟkaḷ iruntaṉa. avai makkaḷāl vaḻipaṭappaṭṭaṉa (aṭi, 388-396).
pāvai taṉ kaiyilē takaḻiyai ēntiyuḷḷa nilaiyil ulōkam koṇṭu amaikkappaṭṭa (yavaṉar ceyta) pāvai viḷakkukaḷ tamiḻakattil mikutiyāy iruntaṉa. ulōkaṅkaḷai urukki vēṇṭum uruvaṅkaḷai amaikkum tiṟaṉ akkālattil iruntamaiyālētāṉ kaṭavuḷar tirumēṉikaḷ ulōkaṅkaḷil ceyyappaṭṭaṉa. ulōka uruvaṅkaḷ ūr valattiṟku (ikkālattiluḷḷavai pōla)p payaṉpaṭṭirukkalām.
3. icaikkalai
icaiyiṉ ciṟappu
icai eṉṉum col, `icaivippatu-taṉ vayappaṭuttuvatu eṉap poruḷpaṭum. icai, kal maṉattaiyum karainturukac ceyyum peṟṟi vāyntatu. kaṟṟōrum maṟṟōrum icaiyiṉ vayappaṭṭē niṟpar; aṉpaip perukki āruyirai vaḷarppatu icai. icaiyaik kēṭṭu iṉpuṟāta uyirkaḷ illaiyeṉṟē kūṟalām. vilaṅkukaḷ, paṟavaikaḷ, ceṭikaḷ, pāmpukaḷ mutaliya uyirkaḷ icaiyāl iṉpamaṭaikiṉṟaṉa. pāl vēṇṭi aḻum pacuṅkuḻaviyum icai vayappaṭṭup pālaiyum paciyaiyum maṟantu kaṇkaḷ ceruka makiḻcci aṭaikiṉṟatu. icaiyiṉ vayappaṭātār aṉpiṉ vayap paṭātār eṉṟē kūṟutal amaiyum. icai vāḻkkaiyil iṉpattai aḷikkum. icaiyiṉ arumaiyaiyum perumaiyaiyum ōrntē tamiḻar icaittamiḻai muttamiḻuḷ naṭu nāyakamāy vaittuḷḷaṉar. tamiḻ ilakkiya nūlkaḷ icaittamiḻil irukkiṉṟaṉa.
paṇṭait tamiḻakattil iyaṟṟappaṭṭa nūlkaḷil perumpālāṉa ceyyuḷ vaṭivilēyē amaintavai. piṟkālattil tōṉṟiya kalveṭṭukḷa, ceppēṭukaḷ palavum aṅṅaṉamē amaintuḷḷaṉa. avaṟṟiṟkum piṟpaṭat tōṉṟiya vaṭitavaṭivil amaintuḷḷa cīṭṭuk kavikaḷum mikkiruttalaik kāṇa, ēṟattāḻap patiṉeṭṭām nūṟṟāṇṭu varaiyil tamiḻakattil icait tamiḻ nūlkaḷē mikkiruntaṉa eṉṟu kūṟuvatu poruntum.
tamiḻappiḷḷaikaḷ taṅkaḷ kuḻantaipparuvattil tālāṭṭuppākkaḷaiyum ūcaṟpākkaḷaiyum kēṭṭārkaḷ; viḷaiyāṭum paruvattil pantu viḷaiyāṭum pāṭalkaḷ (kantukavari), ammāṉai, poṟcuṇṇam, cāḻal, teḷḷēṇam, unti paṟattal, tōḷnōkkam mutaliya āṭalkaḷukkuriya pāṭalkaḷaip pāṭi makiḻntārkaḷ; maṇattil maṅkala vāḻttup pāṭalaip pāṭiṉārkaḷ; ulakkai koṇṭu kuṟṟum toḻilukkuriya pāṭṭu vaḷḷaippāṭṭu eṉṉum peyar peṟṟatu. ēṟṟam koṇṭu nīr iṟaippavar pāṭiya ēṟṟappāṭṭu mutaliya uḻaipput terikiṟatu. aṉaittiṟkum pāṭalkaḷ iruntaṉa eṉpatu terikiṟatu. tamiḻaṉ iṟanta piṉṉarum pāṭṭu avaṉai viṭavillai; palavakaic cantaṅkaḷil oppārippākkaḷ iṉṟum pāṭappaṭuvataik kēṭkalām. iṅṅaṉam paḻantamiḻar tam piṟappu mutal iṟappu varai icaiyilēyē vāḻntu vantaṉar eṉṟu kūṟutal poruntum.
caṅkakālattil
tamiḻppaṇkaḷ ēḻu avai kural, tuttam, kaikkiḷai, uḻai, iḷi, viḷari, tāram eṉappeyar peṟṟaṉa. ivaṟṟiliruntu piṟappaṉa `tiṟaṅkaḷ eṉappaṭṭaṉa. paṇkaḷum tiṟaṅkaḷum pala kiḷaikaḷāy iyaṅkum vakaikaḷil eṇṇiṟanta icai vakaikaḷ kaṇṭaṟiyappaṭṭaṉa. tamiḻpperumpaṇkaḷ kuṟiñcippaṇ, mullaippaṇ, pālaippaṇ, marutappaṇ, neytaṟpaṇ eṉṉum aintu. ivaṟṟiṉ vakaippaṭṭa paṇkaḷ pala. avaṟṟuḷ pakaṟpaṇkaḷ, iravuppaṇkaḷ, kālai mālaip paṇkaḷ eṉa avvappoḻutiṟkamainta paṇkaḷum vaḻakkil iruntaṉa.
paḻaiya maṉitaṉ uṇarccip perukkāl pāṭiṉāṉ. koṇṭar, cavarar mutaliya anākarika makkaḷiṭam pāṭṭu mutaṉmai peṟṟiruppatai iṉṟum kāṇalām. eṉavē, maṉita uḷḷattiṟkup pāṭṭu amutamāyp payaṉpaṭṭatu. payaṉpaṭṭu varukiṟatu eṉpatu teḷivu. inta uṇmaiyai uṇarntu kuṟiñci mutaliya nilaṅkaḷukku uriya karupporuḷkaḷaik kūṟa vanta tolkāppiyar mutaliya tollāciriyarkaḷ icaikkaruvi kaḷaiyum paṇkaḷaiyum cērttuk kūṟiṉārkaḷ. tol kāppiyam-akattiṇaiyiyal ivaipaṟṟiya vivaraṅ kaḷaik kāṇalām. kuṟiñci nilamakkaḷ, iṟai vaḻipāṭṭil iṉimaiyāyp pāṭik koṇṭu kuṉṟakkuravai āṭiṉārkaḷ; koṟṟavaiyai vaḻipaṭap pālai nilamakkaḷ icaikkaruvikaḷaiyum payaṉpaṭutti vēṭṭuva vari pāṭiṉārkaḷ. mullainila āycciyar tām āṭiya āycciyar kuravaiyil mullai nilattiṟkuriya icaikkaruvikaḷaiyum paṇkaḷaiyum payaṉpaṭuttiṉar. marutayāḻum marutappaṇṇum marutanilattiṟkuriyavai. neytal yāḻum neytaṟpaṇṇum neytal nilattiṟku uriyavai.1
icaikkaruvikaḷ
icaikkaruvikaḷ `iyaṅkaḷ eṉappaṭṭaṉa. ciṟiya pala icaikkaruvikaḷ `kuṟumpalliyaṅkaḷ eṉappaṭṭaṉa. periya pala icaikkaruvikaḷ `neṭumpalliyaṅkaḷ eṉap peyar peṟṟaṉa. ivai tōṟkaruvi, tuḷaikkaruvi, narampukkaruvi, kañcakkaruvi eṉa nālvakaippaṭum. muḻavu, uṭukkai mutaliyaṉa, tōṟkaruvikaḷ; kuḻal, vaṅkiyam pōṉṟavai, tuḷaikkaruvikaḷ; yāḻ, narampukkaruvi; pittaḷai ulōkattāl āṉa tāḷavakai, kañcak karuviyākum.
icaikkaruvikaḷuḷ mika iṉiya ōcaiyuṭaiyavai kuḻalum yāḻumēyākum. mullai nilattu āyaṉ ciṟiya mūṅkiṟkaḻiyait tērnteṭuttuk kaṭaikkoḷḷiyāl atil tuḷaikaḷ ceytu, attuḷaikaḷil ōcaiyai eḻuppik kuḻal vācittāṉ. (pe. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 177-179). kuḻal vēyṅkuḻal, āmpaṟkuḻal eṉac cila vakaippaṭum. avaṟṟuḷ vēyṅkuḻalē uyarntatu. mullai nilattu āyar ataṉai ūtiṉar. piṉṉar atu piṟa nilaṅkaḷilum paraviyatu.
yāḻkaḷ oṟṟai narampuṭaiyatu, ēḻunarampukaḷai uṭaiyatu, ataṟkum mēṟpaṭṭa narampukaḷai uṭaiyavai eṉap pala vakaippaṭum. avai cīṟiyāḻ, pēriyāḻ, vil yāḻ eṉap pala peyarkaḷaip peṟum. kumiḻiṉatu uṭpoyyākiya kompiṭattē vaḷaittuk kaṭṭiṉa māṟ kayiṟākiya viralālē teṟittu vācikkum narampiṉaiyuṭaiyatu vilyāḻ eṉpatu (ku. pāṭṭu, aṭi, 180-182).
caṅku, muracu, toṇṭakappaṟai (tirumuruku. aṭi, 119-121, 197), taṭāri, taṇṇumai, kuḻal, yāḻ (pe. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 144, 179, 182), āmpaṟkuḻal, vayir (ūtu kompu), calli, karaṭi (ma. kā. aṭi, 612 urai), muḻavu, ākuḷi, kañcatāṉam, kompu, neṭuvaṅkiyam, kuṟuntūmpu, kuḻal, karaṭikai, ellari (calli), patalai (malaipaṭu. aṭi, 2-11) mutaliyaṉa pattup pāṭṭuḷ iṭam peṟṟuḷḷaṉa., muḻavu, ākuḷi, tāḷam, neṭuvaṅkiyam, kuṟuntūmpu, kuḻal, karaṭikai, ellari, patalai eṉpavaṟṟaik kūttar payaṉpaṭuttiṉar; ivaṟṟuḷ ovvoṉṟaiyum taṉittaṉi uṟaiyil iṭṭu eṭuttuc ceṉṟaṉar (malaipaṭu. aṭi, 2-12).
ivaṟṟuḷ taṭāri eṉpatu kiṇaippaṟai eṉappaṭum. taṇṇumai eṉpatu mattaḷam pōṉṟa karuvi. calli allatu ellari eṉpatu oruvakaippaṟai. karaṭi allatu karaṭikai eṉpatu karaṭi kattiṉāṟpōṉṟa ōcaiyuṭaiya paṟai vakai. muḻavu eṉpatu mattaḷam. ākuḷi eṉpatu ciṟupaṟai. neṭuvaṅkiyam eṉpatu, kaṇkaḷiṉ naṭuvē veḷiyāyt tiṟanta yāṉaiyiṉ kaipōṉṟa karuvi. kuṟuntūmpu eṉpatu `iḷi eṉṉum narampiṉ ōcaiyai olikkum karuvi. calliyum karaṭikaiyum aritteḻum ōcaiyaiyuṭaiyavai. patalai eṉpatu oru kaṇ mākkiṇai.
pālai yāḻ
yāḻiṉ uṟuppukaḷuḷ `pattal eṉpatu oṉṟu. atu, māṉiṉ kuḷampu aḻuntap peṟṟa iṭam pōla iru puṟamum tāḻntu naṭuppakuti uyarnta nilaiyil amaintiruppatu. anta yāḻukkut tōl pōrvai oṉṟu uṇṭu. appōrvai cuṭar niṟam vāyntatu; vayiṟṟiṉ mayir oḻuṅkupōla iru puṟamum cērttup kaṭṭappaṭṭatu. anta yāḻil, āṇikaḷai muṭukkutaṟku naṇṭiṉ kaṇ pōṉṟa tuḷaikaḷ amaintiruntaṉa; yāḻiṉ kariya taṇṭu, paṭameṭutta pāmpiṉaip pōṉṟatu; attaṇṭil amainta vārkkaṭṭuk kaiyil aṇiyappaṭṭa toṭi eṉṉum nakai pōlak kāṭciyaḷittatu; yāḻil oṉṟukkoṉṟu nerukkamāka narampukaḷ iḻuttuk kaṭṭappaṭṭiruntaṉa. curuṅkak kūṟiṉ, anta yāḻ maṇamāṉa peṇṇai oppaṉai ceytāṟpōṉṟa aḻaku peṟṟiruntatu eṉṟu kūṟalām. avyāḻ, yāḻiṟkuriya teyvam taṉṉiṭattē nilaipeṟattakka ilakkaṇattaip peṟṟiruntatu; vaḻiyiṟcelvōrait tuṉpuṟuttum kaḷvarum, taṉ ōcai kēṭpiṉ, tam kaippaṭaiyai naḻuva viṭṭut tam koṭuñceyalaiyum maṟakkac ceyyum iṉṉicaiyai veḷippaṭutta vallatu (po. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 4-22)
cīṟiyāḻ
ciṟupāṇaṉ payaṉpaṭuttiya cīṟiyāḻ, kariya kuraṅku pāmpiṉ talaiyaip piṭittapōtu appāmpu oru kāl iṟukavum orukāl nekiḻavum ataṉ kaiyaic cuṟṟuvatu pōla aḻakiṉai uṭaiya taṉatu taṇṭiṭattil ceṟiyac cuṟṟiṉa, nekiḻa vēṇṭum iṭattu nekiḻntum iṟukavēṇṭum iṭattu iṟukiyum narampu tuvakkum vārkkaṭṭiṉai uṭaiyatu; iraṇṭu viḷimpum cērattaittu muṭukkiṉa āṇikaḷālē maṇiyai niṟaittu vaittatu pōṉṟa aḻakaiyuṭaiyatu; vayiṟu cērntu oḻuṅkupaṭṭa toḻil vakai amainta pattar eṉṉum uṟuppiṉaiyuṭaiyatu; kumiḻamarattup paḻattiṉatu niṟattaip pōṉṟa tuvar ūṭṭiṉa polivu peṟṟa pōrvaiyai uṭaiyatu; tēṉ pōṉṟa iṉiya taṉmaiyaik koṇṭa muṟukkaṭaṅkiṉa narampiṉaiyuṭaiyatu; ellāttuṟaikaḷilum pāṭutaṟku ēṟṟa vāyppuṭaiyatu; icai nūl kūṟukiṉṟa muṟaimaippaṭi cempālaippaṇ pōṉṟa paṇkaḷai eḻuppattakkatu  (ci. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 221-230).
pēriyāḻ
pēriyāḻ, periyaṉavum ciṟiyaṉavumāka oṉpatu vārkkaṭṭukaḷaik koṇṭatu; vaṭittu muṟukkikkaṭṭiṉa iṉiya ōcaiyaittarum narampukaḷai uṭaiyatu; nērmaiyāṉa varakiṉ katirkaḷ iraṇṭu varicaiyāka oḻuṅkupaṭṭu amaintiruppatu pōlat taṉatu naṭu nīḷattil varicaiyākavum nerukka mākavum amainta ciṟiya tuḷaikaḷil cuḷḷāṇikaḷ taikkappeṟṟatu. yāṉaik kompiṉāl putitākac ceyyappaṭṭa aḻakiya āppu anta yāḻiṉ pattalil kuṟukkē cerukappaṭṭiruntatu. aḻakaṉaittum oruṅkē tiraṇṭu uruveṭuttāṟpōṉṟa maṭantai oruttiyiṉ aṭivayiṟṟi liruntu mēl nōkki vaḷarntu paṭinta mayiriṉ oḻuṅku cemmaiyāka amaintiruppatu pōla, anta yāḻiṉaip potinta tōlai iṇaittu aḻakākat taikkappeṟṟa taiyaliṉ oḻuṅku amaintiruntatu. yāḻiṉ unti eṉṉum uṟuppil amainta taiyaliṉ oḻuṅku maṭantaiyiṉ untiyiṉ mēl eḻunta mayiriṉ oḻuṅkai ottiruntatu. yāḻiṉ kōṭu nuṇṇiya arattiṉāl nuṭpamāka arāvi amaikkap paṭṭiruntu. atu vaḷaintu nimirntu kaḷam paḻattiṉ niṟattiṉai ottuk kaṭumaiyāyk kāṇappaṭṭatu. ittakaiya ciṟappiṉai yuṭaiya pēriyāḻ, irupattoru narampukaḷaiyuṭaiyatu. (malaipaṭu, aṭi, 21-37, aṭikkuṟippu).1
paṇkaḷ mutaliyaṉa
yāḻiṟkuriya teyvam yāḻil taṅkiyirukkum eṉpatu icaivāṇar nampikkai. yāḻiṟkuriya teyvam mātaṅki (po. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 20 kuṟippu). yāḻiṉ kōṭu koṉṟai marattiṉālum karuṅkāli marattiṉālum ceyyappaṭum; pattal ceytaṟkuriya maram kumiḻamaramum murukka maramum taṇakku maramumākum (aṭi, 21-22 urai). icaivāṇar yāḻ narampukaḷaik kūṭat taḻuvuvar; itu vārttal eṉappaṭum; yāḻ narampukaḷai uruvuvar; itu vaṭittal eṉappeyar peṟum; yāḻ narampukaḷait teṟippar; itu untutal eṉappaṭum; yāḻ narampukaḷuḷ oṉṟai viṭṭu oṉṟait teṟippar; .itu uṟaltal eṉappaṭum. porunar, pāṇar eṉpavar yāḻai eṭuttu ittoḻilkaḷaic ceytu tēvaraip pukaḻntu pāṭuvar. ippāṭal vakai `tēvapāṇi eṉappaṭum. teyvaṅkaḷaip paṟṟiya perumpāṭal, vakai `peruntēvapāṇi eṉap peyar peṟum (nakkiratēva nāyaṉār pāṭiya peruntēvapāṇiyaik kāṇka); teyvaṅkaḷaip paṟṟiya ciṟiya pāṭal vakai `ciṟu tēvapāṇi eṉappaṭum (cilampu, 6:35 urai). cīr mutaliyavai tāḷavicēṭaṅkaḷ. cīr, muṭiyuṅkārattait taṉṉiṭattē uṭaiyatu; pāṇi, eṭukkum kālattait taṉṉiṭattē uṭaiyatu; tūkku, nikaḻum kālattait taṉṉiṭattē uṭaiyatu (po. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 24 kuṟippu).
`naivaḷam eṉpatu, `naṭṭapāṭai eṉṉum paṇ; `kāmaram eṉpatu, `cīkāmaram eṉṉum paṇ; kuralkural eṉpatu, cempālaippaṇ (ci. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 36, 77, 229); ivaiyum, pālaippaṇ (pe. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 180) mutaliya cila paṇkaḷum pattuppāṭṭuḷ kuṟikkappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa. ippaṇkaḷuḷ pakaṟpaṇkaḷ cila; irāppaṇkaḷ cila. naṭṭapāṭai eṉṉum paṇ pakaṟpaṇkaḷuḷ oṉṟu (ku. pāṭṭu, aṭi, 146-148 uraiyum aṭikkuṟippum). āmpal eṉpatu oru vakaippaṇ eṉpar cilar. nacciṉārkkiṉiyar, `veṇkalattāl kumutavaṭivāka aṇaicu paṇṇic ceṟitta kuḻal eṉpatu (cīvaka. cey. 1662 urai). kōvalar āmpalantīṅkul payiṟṟiṉar (ku. pāṭṭu,aṭi, 221-222). valivu, melivu, camam eṉṉum  mūṉṟu tāṉattilum ovvoṉṟilum  ēḻutāṉam muṭittup pāṭum irupattoru pāṭal tuṟaikaḷ uṇṭu (puṟam. 152). pāṇar attuṟaikaḷ palavaṟṟaiyum vācittu aracarkaḷai makiḻvittaṉar (malaipaṭu. aṭi, 39-40). pāṭumakaḷir yāḻ oliyōṭu tammiṭaṟṟu oli poruntap pāṭic ciṟappuṟṟaṉar (ma. kā. aṭi, 217-218).
ilakkiya ilakkaṇaṅkaḷaik kaṟṟavar pulavar eṉappaṭṭaṉar; kūtta nūlkaḷaik kaṟṟa aṟiñar kūttar eṉappaṭṭaṉar. aṅṅaṉamē icaikkalaikkuriya nūlkaḷaik kaṟṟavarē porunar, pāṇar, pāṭiṉiyar eṉappaṭṭaṉar. caṅka kālattil icaikkalaikkariya nūlkaḷ iruntaṉa. (ci. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 2308; malaipaṭu. aṭi, 38 urai).
icaivāṇar
tolkāppiyattil icaivāṇaraip paṟṟiyum kūttaraippaṟṟiyum pēcappaṭṭaṭuḷḷatu. porunar eṉpavar ērkkaḷattēṉum pōrkaḷattēṉum ceṉṟu pāṭum kūttar; avarkaḷ icaikkaruvikaḷai icaittup pāṭiṉārkaḷ; viḻā naṭakkum ūrkaḷil taṅkaḷ icaittiṟaṉaik kāṭṭi, viḻā muṭintavuṭaṉ viḻā naṭaipeṟum vēṟu ūrkaḷukkuc celvatu porunar vaḻakkam (po. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 1-3). avarkaḷ vaikaṟaiyiṟceṉṟu vaḷḷalkaḷ araṇmaṇaiyai aṭaintu, taṅkaḷ kiṇaippaṟaiyaiyō piṟa icaikkaruviyaiyō olittu vaḷḷaliṉ pukaḻaippāṭutal vaḻakkam (aṭi, 70-76). pāṇar icaikkalaiyil vallunar; pala narampukaḷaiyuṭaiya periya yāḻai icaittup pāṭiṉar `perumpāṇar eṉappaṭṭaṉar; cila narampukaḷaiyuṭaiya ciṟiya yāḻai icaittuppāṭiyavar `ciṟupāṇar eṉappaṭṭaṉar. icaiyil valla makaḷir `pāṭiṉiyar eṉappaṭṭaṉar. .ippāṇarum vaḷḷalkaḷai nāṭic ceṉṟu pāṭip paricil peṟṟaṉar. porunarum pāṇarum kūttarum viṟaliyarum karikālaṉ pōṉṟa vaḷḷalkaḷiṭam peṟṟa ciṟappiṉai `maṉṉar upacarippu eṉṉum talaippiṟparakkak kāṇalām.
pala icaikkaruvivaḷai icaittuk kūttu (naṭaṉam) āṭiyavar kūttar eṉappaṭṭaṉar. avaruṭ peṇpālār `viṟaliyar eṉap peyar peṟṟaṉar. (tol. po. 91 urai). kuḻal, yāḻ, muḻavu mutaliya pala vakai icaikkaruvikaḷai icaippatilum vallunar iruntaṉar. ivarkaḷ vaḷḷalkaḷiṭam ceṉṟu paricil peṟṟu vāḻntārkaḷ; potu makkaḷiṭam taṅkaḷ kalaittiṟaṉaik kāṭṭip poruḷ peṟṟu vāḻntārkaḷ. vaṟumai vāṭṭumpoḻutu pāṇaṉ tāṉ kaṟṟa kalviyai ikaḻntu pēcutal vaḻakkam (pe. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 22).
vaḷḷalkaḷiṭam paricil peṟṟu mīṇṭa porunarum, pāṇarum, kūttarum tammaip pōṉṟa icaivāṇarai avvaḷḷalpōl āṟṟuppaṭuttutal marapu. aṅṅaṉam āṟṟuppaṭuttutal `āṟṟuppaṭai eṉappaṭum. atu porunar āṟṟuppaṭai, pāṇāṟṟupṭai, viṟaliyāṟṟuppaṭai, kūttarāṟṟuppaṭai eṉappeyar peṟum. tolkāppiyarē ivvāṟṟuppaṭaiyaip paṟṟik kūṟutalāl, avar kālattilum avarkku muṉṉum āṟṟuppaṭai nūlkaḷ iruntamai teḷivu. ākavē, tolkāppiyarkku muṉpē innāṭṭil icaikkalaiyum kūttukkalaiyum tōṉṟi vaḷarntiruntaṉa eṉpatai nām naṉku aṟiyalām.
pāṭiṉi
porunaṉuṭaṉ karikālaṉiṭam paricil peṟac ceṉṟa pāṭiṉi, āṟṟuk karumaṇal pōṉṟa kūntalaiyum, piṟai pōṉṟa aḻakiya  nutaliṉaiyum, vil pōṉṟa puruvattaiyum, kuḷirnta kaṇkaḷaiyum, ilaviṉatu itaḻaiyokkum civanta vāyiṉaiyum, iṉiya coṟkaḷaiyum, muttukaḷ pōṉṟa paṟkaḷaiyum, mayirai veṭṭukiṉṟa kattarikaiyiṉ kuḻaiccai yottatum, poliviṉaiyuṭaiya makarakkuḻaiyiṉ acaiviṉaip poṟuttalamaintatumāṉa kātiṉaiyumuṭaiyavaḷ; nāṇam varuttalāl piṟarai nōkkātu kaviḻnta kaḻuttiṉai yuṭaiyavaḷ; acaiyum mūṅkil pōlum parutta tōḷkaḷaip peṟṟavaḷ; melliya mayiriṉaiyuṭaiya muṉ kaiyai uṭaiyavaḷ; kāntaḷ pōlum melliya viralkaḷaiyuṭai yavaḷ; kiḷiyiṉatu alakōṭu oppiṉaiyuṭaiya oḷi viṭukiṉṟa perumaiyuṭaiya nakaṅkaḷai uṭaiyavaḷ; īrkku naṭuvē cella muṭiyāta eḻucciyaiyuṭaiya iḷamaiyum aḻakum poruntiya nakilkaḷaip peṟṟavaḷ; nīrccuḻi pōṉṟa uttama ilakkaṇaṅkaḷ niṟainta koppūḻiṉai uṭaiyavaḷ; `uṇṭu eṉṟu piṟarāl uṇarappaṭāta varuntum iṭaiyiṉaip peṟṟavaḷ; pala maṇikaḷ kōtta vaṅkaḷaiyuṭaiya mēkalai eṉṉum aṇiyai aṇintavaḷ; periya peṇyāṉaiyiṉ perumaiyaiyuṭaiya kaipōla oḻuka vantu melliyavāyt tammil neruṅki oṉṟit tiraṇṭa tuṭaikaḷaiyuṭaiyavar; mayir oḻuṅkupaṭṭa kaṇaikkālai uṭaiyavaḷ; ōṭi iḷaitta nāyiṉatu nāvaip pōṉṟa ciṟiya aṭiyiṉaiyuṭaiyavaḷ; mayil pōṉṟa cāyalai uṭaiyavaḷ; kalviyāl perumai peṟṟavaḷ (po. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 25-47).
pāṇar kuṭiyiruppukaḷ
maturaiyai aṭutta vaiyaiyāṟṟiṉ nīrttuṟaikaḷiṉ arukil pūntōṭṭaṅkaḷ amaintiruntaṉa. avaṟṟiṉiṭaiyē perumpāṇar kuṭiyiruppu iruntatu. (ma.kā.aṭi, 340-342). pāṇar kuṭiyiruppil pāṭal āṭalāl ōcai eḻuntatu (aṭi, 268-9).
iṉṟuḷḷa ceṅkaṟpaṭṭu māvaṭṭattil paṇṭaikkāla āmūrkkōṭṭam aṭaṅkiyiruntatu. ``āmūrk kōṭṭattu mōntūr nāṭṭup perumpāccēri eṉpatu kalveṭṭu vācakam.1 perumpāccēri eṉpatu `perumpāṇaccēri eṉpataṉ marūuvākum. itu tirukkaḻukkuṉṟattiṟku arukil iruntatu. tiruvaḷḷur vaṭṭattil `pāṇaṉ pākkam eṉṟa ciṟṟūr iruntateṉak kalveṭṭuk kūṟukiṟatu.1 ``perumpāṇ etirvāyil eṉpatu pōḷūrai aṭutta tirumalaiyil uḷḷa oru kalveṭṭu vācakam.2 kuṭantaiyil kāvirikkaraiyil irunta pāṇaṉ tuṟaiyē ikkālattil `pāṇātuṟai eṉṟu māṟi vaḻaṅkukiṟateṉak karutalām. vaiyaiyāṟṟiṉ nīrttuṟaiyil pāṇar cēri amaintiruntatu eṉṟu maturaikkāñci kūṟukiṟatu. avvāṟē kāviriyiṉ nīrttuṟaiyil pāṇar cēri oṉṟu iruntirukkalām. pāṇar cēri arukil irunta nīrttuṟai `pāṇar tuṟai eṉap peyar peṟṟirukkalām. atu kālappōkkil `pāṇā tuṟai eṉa māṟi vaḻaṅkalāyiṟṟeṉak karutalām.
ki.pi. 9ām nūṟṟāṇṭil vāḻnta pallava kampavarmaṉ kālattil kāñci vaṭṭattuk kīḻpputtūril perumpāṇaṉ cakkāṭi araiyaṉ eṉpavaṉ makaṉ oru kuḷam toṭap poṉ koṭuttāṉ.3
vantavāci vaṭṭattut toṇṭūraic cērnta perumpāṇaṉ atti māṭamaṉ eṉpavaṉ teḷḷāṟṟuc civa perumāṉukku oru cantiviḷakku erikkap poṉtantāṉ. avaṉ mūṉṟām kulōttuṅkaṉ kālattavaṉ (ki.pi. 1178-1218) eṉṟa teḷḷāṟṟuc civaṉ kōvil kalveṭṭuk kūṟukiṟatu.4
itukāṟum kūṟappaṭṭa cāṉṟukaḷāl caṅkakālattup pāṇar marapiṉar pallavar kālattilum piṟkālac cōḻar kālattilum toṭarntu iruntu vantaṉar eṉpatum, avarkaḷ taṉiyāy irunta iṭam pāṇar cēri eṉappaṭṭatu eṉpatum naṉkaṟiyak kiṭattal kāṇka. toṇṭai nāṭṭil perumpāṇar .iruntaṉar eṉpataṟkup `perumpāccēri eṉṟa ūrppeyarum mēlē kāṭṭappaṭṭa kalveṭṭukaḷum cāṉṟātal kāṇalām. eṉavē, toṇṭaimāṉmītu perumpāṇāṟṟuppaṭai pāṭappaṭṭaṭai poruttamē eṉpatai aṟintiṉpuṟalām.

icaivāṇar peyarālum icaikkaruvikaḷ peyarālum iṉṉum cila ūrppeyarkaḷ vaḻaṅkappaṭukiṉṟaṉa. avaṟṟaik kīḻē kāṇka:

4. naṭaṉakkalai
kūttiṉ tōṟṟam
iṟaivaṉatu aruṭpaṭaippilē kūttu nikaḻkiṉṟatu. evariṭamum payiṟci peṟāmalum, kūttukkalaiyiṉ paṇpaic ciṟitaḷavum kallāmalum, karumukilkaḷaik kāṇum mayilkaḷ ciṟakukaḷai virittu āṭukiṉṟaṉa. koṭiya aravaṅkaḷ makuṭi ōcaiyaik kēṭṭatum tam puṟṟukaḷiliruntu veḷippōntu icaiyil īṭupaṭṭu meymmaṟantu paṭameṭuttu āṭukiṉṟaṉa. kaṇṇaṉaip pōṉṟāratu vēyṅkuḻalil īṭupaṭṭup pacukkaḷ tammai maṟantu acaintāṭukiṉṟaṉa. ivaṟṟaik kūrntu nōkkiṉ, iyaṟkaip paṭaippilēyē kūttu iyalpāy amaintuḷḷa uṇmaiyai uṇaralākum.
paṇṭu malai muḻaikaḷil vāḻntavar mutaṟkaṇ palavāṟu ōcaiyeḻuppi oruvarukkoruvar tam eṇṇaṅkaḷai aṟivittukkoṇṭaṉar. piṉṉar am makkaḷ caikaikaḷ cērttut tam karuttukaḷai veḷippaṭuttiṉar; piṉṉarp paṭippaṭiyāyt tamakkeṉa moḻiyai amaittuk koṇṭaṉar. ivvāṟu ovvoru nāṭṭiṉarum tamakkeṉat taṉittaṉi moḻiyai amaittukkoṇṭaṉar. maṉitaṉ palavakai uṇarccikaḷ koṇṭavaṉ; aḷavu kaṭanta makiḻcci uṇṭākum poḻutu avaṉ taṉṉai maṟantu kūttāṭuvāṉ; kōpamāyirukkum poḻutu kaṇ civantu utaṭukaḷ tuṭikkap paraparappuṭaṉ pēcuvāṉ. iṅṅaṉam maṉitaṉ ovvōr uḷḷa nilaiyil ovvoṉṟai veḷippaṭaiyākak kāṭṭutal allatu ceytal iyalpu.
`maṉitaṉ makiḻcci nilaiyil taṉ viruppappaṭi pala vakai ōcaikaḷai eḻuppa, avvōcaikaḷ, cila camayaṅkaḷil avaṉaiyaṟiyātu avaṉukku iṉpattai aḷikka avaṉ mīṇṭum mīṇṭum avvōcaikaḷai eḻuppi aṉupavikka ivvāṟu eḻuppappaṭṭa olikaḷiṉ cērkkai kātukaḷukku iṉpamaḷitta nilaiyil, avaṉaip piṉ paṟṟip palar attuṟaiyil iṟaṅkiyirukkalām.
`maṉitaṉ taṉ kūttukkēṟpa olikaḷai eḻuppiyum, kaikaḷaik koṭṭiyumirukkalām. avaṉ iṅṅaṉam kutittatu kūttākavum olikaḷai eḻuppi ōcaiyiṭṭatu icaiyākavum, kaikaḷaik koṭṭiyatu tāḷamākavum māṟiyirukkalām, eṉṟu aṟiñar karutukiṉṟaṉar.
ivvāṟu piṟantirukkalām eṉṟu karutappaṭum icai, kūttu, tāḷam ākiya mūṉṟum cērnta tokuppē kūttu allatu `naṭaṉam eṉpatu.
intiyāvukku veḷiyē
mikappaḻaiya ekiptiya -camēriya- pāpilōṉiya nākarikac ciṉṉaṅkaḷil pala vakai naṭaṉaṅkaḷai uṇarttum ōviyaṅkaḷ kāṇappaṭukiṉṟaṉa. ataṉāl, appaṇṭai nākarikaṅkaḷil tiḷaittavar kūttukkalaiyil aṟivu peṟṟiruntaṉar eṉpatu terikiṟatu.
intiyāvil
intiyāvil vētakālattiṟku muṟpaṭṭa cintu veḷi nākarikattai uṇarttum putaiporuḷkaḷil veṇ kalattāṟceyyappaṭṭa kūttiyiṉ vaṭivam oṉṟu kiṭait tuḷḷatu. cila kaṟcilaikaḷ naṭaṉa muṟaiyil kāṇappaṭukiṉṟaṉa. tavilaik kaḻuttil māṭṭit toṅka viṭṭa maṉita uruvam (kaḷimaṇṇāṟceyyappaṭṭatu) kiṭaittuḷḷatu. mirutaṅkam, vīṇai, tāḷam eṉpavaṟṟaik kuṟikkum ōviyaṅkaḷ akappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa. ivaṟṟaic cērttu nōkkum poḻutu, cintu veḷi makkaḷ naṭaṉakkalaiyil aṟivuṭaiyavarkaḷāy iruntārkaḷ eṉpatu pulappaṭukiṟataṉṟō?
vaṭavintiyāvil naṭaṉattaippaṟṟi eḻunta mutal vaṭamoḻi nūl `paratam eṉpatu. itaṉaic ceytavar parata muṉivar. innūl ki.mu. mūṉṟām nūṟṟāṇṭiṉatu eṉṟu aṟiñar aṟaikiṉṟaṉar. iḵtu iṉṟaḷavum mikac ciṟanta nūlāy iruntu varukiṉṟatu. ittakaiya ciṟanta nūl ki.mu. 3ām nūṟṟāṇṭiṉatu eṉiṉ, ataṟku muṉṉarē vaṭavintiyāvil naṭaṉakkalai mika uyarnta nilaiyil iruntiruttal vēṇṭum eṉpatu peṟappaṭukiṟataṉṟō?
`naṭaṉakkalai , `aṟam, poruḷ, iṉpam, vīṭu eṉṉum nāṟpēṟukaḷaiyum nalka vallatu; maṉavuṟuti, uṭal vaḷam, iṉpa uṇarcci mutaliya naṟpaṇpukaḷai aḷikka vallatu. ikkalai tarum iṉpam tavattiṉar aṭaiyum iṉpattiṟku iṇaiyāṉatu, eṉpatu paratattiṟkūṟappaṭum ceytiyākum.
paratam tōṉṟiya piṉṉar eḻunta vaṭanāṭṭu ōviyaṅkaḷilum ciṟpaṅkaḷilum ilakkiyaṅkaḷilum naṭaṉakkalai naṉku viḷakkappaṭṭuḷtu. kuptarkaḷ āṭcikkālattil eḻunta ayalār paṭaiyeṭuppukaḷālum kuḻappaṅkaḷālum vaṭavintiyāvil ikkalai naṉku vaḷara iṭam peṟatāyiṟṟu. āyiṉum, vinta malaikkut teṉpāṟpaṭṭa nāṭukaḷil ikkalai naṉṉilaiyil vaḷarcci peṟalāyiṟṟu.
caṅka kālattiṟkūttukkalai
paḻaiya nūlākiya tolkāppiyattil paḻantamiḻ makkaḷiṭam irunta vanta kūttu vakaikaḷ cila kuṟikkap paṭṭuḷḷaṉa. avai, 1. vēlaṉ āṭum (kāntaḷ) veṟikkūttu. 2. veṉṟa vīrar tam aṭaiyāḷap pūccūṭi āṭum karuṅkūttu, 3. veṟṟiyaip pārāṭṭip peṇkaḷ āṭum vaḷḷikkūttu, 4. kaḷattai viṭṭu ōṭāta iḷaiya vīraṉukkuk kāliṟ kaḻalaikkaṭṭi iru pālārum āṭum kaḻaṉilaikkūttu mutaliyaṉavākum. ivai perumpālum pōrttoṭar puḷḷavai. ivaiyaṉṟi, āycciyar kuravai, vēṭṭuvavari mutaliya kūttu vakaikaḷum iruntaṉa.
`paṇṭaittamiḻakattiṟ kūttar iruntu vantaṉar; kūttukaḷ naṭaipeṟṟu vantaṉa, eṉpataic caṅka nūlkaḷāl nām aṟiyalām. kuṟiñci nilak kiḻavaṉākiya murukap perumāṉai vaḻipaṭṭu āṭum kūttu, `kuṉṟakkuravai eṉappaṭum. ituvē mullai nila makaḷirāl māyōṉait tutittu āṭappaṭumāyiṉ, `āycciyar kuravai eṉap peyar peṟum. `kuravai eṉpatu, `maṅkaiyar eḻuvar cennilai maṇṭalak kaṭakak kaikōttu annilaik koppa niṉṟu āṭum kūttākum. kuravaiyāṭutal irupālārukkum uriyatu. kuṟavartoṇṭakappaṟai koṭṭak kuravaiyāṭuvar. atu kāṇum makaḷirum mēṟcoṉṉa ilakkaṇappaṭi niṉṟu āṭuvar. aṅṅaṉamāṭum pōtu avarkaḷ pāṭikkoṇṭē āṭuvārkaḷ. itaṉ vivaraṅkaḷait tokai nūlkaḷilum cilappatikārattilum virivākak kāṇalām.
`tuṇaṅkai eṉpatu kūttu vakaikaḷuḷ oṉṟu. atu muṭaṅkiya iru kaikaḷaiyum vilāppuṭaikaḷil oṟṟi aṭittukkoṇṭu acaintāṭum oru vakaik kūttu. makaḷir viḻākkālaṅkaḷil tuṇaṅkaik kūttu āṭuvar. āṭavar ammakaḷirkku mutaṟkai koṭuttal vaḻakkam.
nāṉilaṅkaḷilum irunta vaḷḷalkaḷ pāṟceṉṟu uḷḷakkuṟippup puṟattu veḷippaṭa āṭiya naṭaṉamaṅkai paṇṭait tamiḻakattil viṟali eṉap peyar peṟṟāḷ. viṟaliyar pāṇaruṭaṉum kūttaruṭaṉum ceṉṟu tam kalait tiṟaṉaikkāṭṭi vaḷḷalkaḷiṭam paricu peṟṟu vantaṉar.
iṅṅaṉam meyppāṭukaḷ tōṉṟa naṭikkum viṟaliyar palar caṅkakālattil iruntaṉar eṉpatait tokai nūlkaḷāl aṟiyalām. paṇṭai aracarkaḷ viṟaliyar āṭal pāṭalkaḷaip pārāṭṭip poṉṉari mālaiyaip paricaḷittārkaḷ; toṭi mutaliya ciṟanta nakaikaḷaiyum vaḻaṅkiṉārkaḷ.1 viṟaliyar niṟamuṭaiya kalavai pūcappaṭṭa vaḷainta cantiṉaiyuṭaiya muṉkaikaḷaiyum vēṟ pōṉṟa tōḷiṉaiyum oḷi poruntiya neṟṟiyaiyum uṭaiyavar eṉṟu kōvūrkiḻār pārāṭṭi yuḷḷār. `viṟaliyar, yāḻ vācittāṟpōlap pāṭum nayappāṭu tōṉṟum pāṭṭiṉaiyuṭaiya viṟalpaṭa āṭutalaiyuṭaiyōr, eṉṟu māṅkuṭi marutaṉārum peruṅ kavucikaṉārum kūṟuvatu, viṟaliyaruṭaiya icaic ciṟappiṉaiyum naṭaṉap payiṟciyiṉ mēṉmaiyiṉaiyum naṉku uṇarttuvatākum.2 `cōḻaṉ nalaṅkiḷḷi (ittakaiya) viṟaliyarkku māṭa maturaiyaiyō vañcimā nakarattaiyō vēṇṭumāyiṉ,  tara vallavaṉ,eṉṟu kōvūr kiḻār kūṟiyuḷḷatiliruntu viṟaliyar paṇṭai aracarpāl peṟṟirunta peruñciṟappiṉaik kāṇalām.3 naṭaṉamakaḷ, `viṟali, kūtti, āṭumakaḷ, āṭukaḷamakaḷ eṉavum nūlkaḷilē kuṟikkappaṭṭāḷ. `aṅṅaṉamē, naṭaṉamāṭupavaṉ, `kūttaṉ, āṭumakaṉ, āṭukaḷamakaṉ eṉappaṭṭāṉ. ivarkaḷ caṅkakālattiṟ kūttukkalaiyai vaḷartta kalaivāṇarkaḷ. ivarkaḷ naṭaṉamāṭiṉa araṅkaṭ `āṭukaḷam eṉappaṭṭatu. viḻākkālaṅkaḷil ivarkaḷ pala vakaik kūttukaḷai āṭiṉārkaḷ; puṟa kālaṅkaḷil aracarkaḷ mutaliya vaḷḷiyōr pāṟ ceṉṟu, pāṭi āṭip paricil peṟṟu mīṇṭaṉar. ivarkaḷatu kalaiyai uṇarttum nūlē `kūtta nūl eṉpatu.
cilappatikārattil
cilappatikārattil kūttu eṉpatu nāṭakam eṉṉum peyaruṭaṉ vaḻaṅkappaṭṭuḷḷatu. `nāṭakamakaḷir eṉṉum toṭar, naṭaṉa makaḷir, kūtta makiḷar, viṟaliyar eṉṉum peyarkaḷiṉ poruḷaiyē kuṟippatākum. mātavi nāṭaka maṅkai (viṟali). avaḷ āṭiya kaḷam nāṭaka araṅku eṉap peyar peṟṟatu. ippeyarkaḷ vaṭavar nuḻaiviṉāl uṇṭāṉa peyar māṟṟaṅkaḷ eṉṉalām. cilappatikārattil naṭaṉakkalaiyaip paṟṟiya pala vivaraṅkaḷ araṅkēṟṟu kātaiyil viḷakkamākat tarappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa. naṭaṉamakaḷ ciṟappākak kūttu, pāṭṭu, aḻaku immūṉṟilum niṟaivu peṟṟavaḷāy iruttal vēṇṭum. avaḷ 7 vayatu mutal 12 vayatu varai (ēṟattatāḻa āṟāṇṭukaḷ) kūttakkalaiyilē payiṟci peṟutal vēṇṭum.
vīram, accam, iḻivu, viyappu, iṉpam, tuṉpam, nakai, naṭuvu nilai, vekuḷi eṉṉum oṉpatu cuvaikaḷ naṭippiṟkuriyavai.1 naṭippavar ivaṟṟai naṉku pulappaṭutti naṭikka vēṇṭum. cōmpalukku uriya naṭippu, veṭkattiṟkuriya naṭippu, perumaikkuriya naṭippu, maḻaiyil naṉaivataṟkuriya naṭippu, paṉiyil talaippaṭuvataṟku uriya naṭippu, veyilil celvataṟkuriya naṭippu mutaliya 24 vakaiyāka naṭippup pakuttuk kāṭṭappaṭṭuḷḷatu. ovvoru vakaikkum ilakkaṇam uṇṭu.2
kai naṭippukaḷil oru kaiyiṉāl naṭittuk kāṭṭutal, iru kaikaḷālum naṭittuk kāṭṭutal eṉṉum pirivukaḷ uṇṭu. oru kaiyiṉāl naṭittuk kāṭṭum naṭippukaḷ 33 vakaippaṭum.3 avai `patākai, iḷampiṟai, viṟpiṭi, kuṭaṅkai, valampuri mutaliya taṉittaṉi peyarkaḷ peṟṟuḷḷaṉa. inta naṭippukaḷil kai viralkaḷ muṭaṅkutal, nimirtal, kuṉital, virital, toṭutal, viṭutal muṟaikaḷil iyakkik kāṭṭappaṭum. iraṇṭu kaikaḷāl naṭittuk kāṭṭum naṭippukaḷ patiṉaintu vakaippaṭum. avai añcali, puṭpāñcali, apaya attam, makaram mutaliya pala peyarkaḷaip peṟṟuḷḷaṉa.4
naṭaṉamakaḷai akkalaiyiṟpayiṟṟum āṭal āciriyaṉ amaiti, icaiyāciriyaṉ amaiti, taṇṇumai āciriyaṉ amaiti, kuḻalōṉ amaiti, yāḻāciriyaṉ amaiti eṉpavai yāvai eṉpataic cilappatikāram, araṅkēṟṟu kātaiyil teḷivuṟak kāṇalām. iṉṉiṉṉavaṟṟil muḻuppayiṟci peṟṟavarē iṉṉiṉṉa āciriyar eṉa iḷaṅkōvaṭikaḷ kūṟutalaik kāṇa, avar kālattil tamiḻakattil icaiyum kūttum mikavuyariya nilaiyil cīrum ciṟappum peṟṟiruntaṉa eṉpatu veḷḷiṭai malaipōla viḷakkamākum. āṭaṟkuriya araṅku eṅṅaṉam amaikkappaṭal vēṇṭum eṉpatum, innūluḷ teḷivāka viḷakkappaṭṭuḷḷatu; araṅkiṟpukuntu āṭum iyalpum vivarikkappaṭṭuḷḷatu.
araṅkiṉiṟpukuntu mātavi pāṭiṉāḷ; āṭiṉāḷ. appoḻutu mēṟcoṉṉa pala vakai āciriyarkaḷ araṅkil iruntu tattam toḻilaic ceytārkaḷ. avvamayam,
``kuḻalvaḻi niṉṟatu yāḻē; yāḻvaḻit
taṇṇumai niṉṟatu takavē; taṇṇumaip
piṉvaḻi niṉṟatu muḻavē; muḻavoṭu
kūṭiniṉ ṟicaintatu āman tirikai;
āman tirikaiyo mantara miṉṟik
koṭṭiraṇṭu ṭuṭaiyatōr maṇṭila mākak
kaṭṭiya maṇṭilam patiṉoṉṟu pōkki
vanta muṟaiyiṉ vaḻimuṟai vaḻāmal.1
mātavi āṭiṉāḷ.
caṅka kālattil irunta kūtta nūlkaḷ
mēṟcollappaṭṭa palvakaik kūttu vakaikaḷaiyum, viṟaliyar kūttar mutaliyavar iruntamaiyaiyum nōkkac caṅkakālattil kūttanūlkaḷ iruntiruttal vēṇṭum eṉpatu veḷḷiṭai malai. āyiṉ, annūṟ peyarkaḷai uḷḷavāṟu aṟiyac cāṉṟillai. ki.pi. 14ām nūṟṟāṇṭirum cilappatikārattiṟku urai vakuttavarumāṉa aṭiyārkku nallār, tamakkup palanūṟṟāṇṭukaḷukku muṉpu pāṭappaṭṭa cilappatikārattiṟku urai kāṇkaiyil cila kūtta nūṟpeyarkaḷaik kuṟikkiṉṟār. avaṟṟuḷ pala cilappatikāra kālattil iruntaṉa eṉṟu koḷvataiviṭa, aṭiyārkku nallār kālattil  iruntaṉa eṉavum, avaravaṟṟai naṉku paṭittaṟintavar eṉavum kōṭalē poruttamuṭaiyatākum. avar kuṟikkum kūtta nūlkaḷāvaṉa:
1. paratam, 2. akattiyam, 3. muṟuval, 4. cayantam, 5.kuṇanūl, 6. ceyiṟṟiyam, 7. iṇainuṇukkam, 8. .intira kāḷiyam, 9. pañcamarapu, 10. parata cēṉāpatīyam, 11. mativāṇaṉār nāṭakat tamiḻ nūl, 12. kūttanūl.
ivaṟṟuḷ mutal iraṇṭu nūlkaḷ aṭiyārkku nallār kālattilēyē iṟantaṉa eṉpatu kuṟikkappaṭṭuḷḷatu. piṟa nūlkaḷiliruntu iraṇṭoru cūttiraṅkaḷ aṭiyārkku nallār, pērāciriyar mutaliyōrāl āḷappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa. innūlkaḷuḷ oṉṟēṉum ikkālattil kiṭaittilatu.1
iṉip pattuppāṭṭuḷ iṭam peṟṟuḷḷa kūttukaḷaip paṟṟiya ceytikaḷaik kāṇpōm:
viṟali
naṭaṉakkalaikkuriyavaḷ viṟali. avaḷ porunaruṭaṉum, pāṇaruṭaṉum, kūttaruṭaṉum ceṉṟu taṉ kalaittiṟaṉai vaḷḷalkaḷukkum potumakkaḷukkum kāṭṭip paricil peṟutal vaḻakkam. ikkāla naṭikaiyar kaṇ kavarum uṭaṟkaṭṭum pēraḻakum peṟṟiruttal pōlavē caṅkakāla viṟaliyarum peṟṟiruntaṉar eṉpatu pattuppāṭṭāl terikiṟatu.
ciṟupāṇaruṭaṉ ceṉṟa viṟali, ulakiṟku aruḷutalaic ceytu melliyatāy vīḻntu tāḻkiṉṟa maḻaiyiṉatu aḻakait taṉṉiṭattē koṇṭu eṇṇeyilē muṟṟup peṟṟu iruṇṭa kūntalaiyuṭaiyavaḷ; mayilkaḷ palavuṅkūṭi nīlamaṇipōlum kaṇṇiṉaiyuṭaiya tōkaikaḷai makaḷir kūntalai virittāṟpōla virittuppārttu, `ivarkaḷ cāyalukku ovvēm! eṉṟu pēṭṭiṟkuḷḷē ceṉṟu maṟaitaṟkuk kāraṇamāṉa cāyalai2 uṭaiyavaḷ; ōṭiiḷaittu varuntukiṉṟa nāyiṉatu nāviṉ nalla aḻakai varutti, vaṟumaiyāl cilampu mutaliyaṉa iṉṟip polivaḻinta aṭiyiṉaip peṟṟavaḷ; iḻukkappaṭṭu nilattuc ceṟiyum kariya piṭiyiṉatu periya kai pōlat tāmum aṭiyōṭē toṭarpuṇṭa muṟaiyāṟparuttu malaiyil oḻuṅkupaṭa vaḷarnta vāḻaiyeṉattiraṇṭu neruṅkiyuḷḷa iraṇṭu kuṟaṅkiṉai uṭaiyavaḷ; vāḻaippū eṉṉumpaṭi aḻaku peṟṟa paṉiccaiyaip peṟṟavaḷ; kōṅkiṉ mukaiyai ikaḻnta melliya maṇikaḷ iṭaiyil kiṭakkap peṟṟa nakilkaḷai uṭaiyavaḷ; nuṅkiṉ iṉiya nīrpōṉṟa nīraic curappikkum paṟkaḷaip peṟṟavaḷ; mullai cūṭutaṟkamainta kaṟpiṉaiyuṭaiyavaḷ; melliya iyalpiṉaiyum maṭappattaiyum uṭaiya māṉ pōlum pārvaiyaip peṟṟavaḷ; oḷi poruntiya neṟṟiyai uṭaiyavaḷ (ci. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 13-31).
kūttup paṟṟiya ceytikaḷ
tamiḻ nāṭṭu ūrkaḷil makaḷir tuṇaṅkaik kūttiṉaiyum aḻakiṉaiyuṭaiya tāḷa aṟutiyaiyuṭaiya kuravaik kūttiṉaiyum āṭutal vaḻakkam (ma. kā. aṭi, 159-160). malai nāṭṭil kuṟavarkaḷ kaḷḷiṉ teḷivaip paruki makiḻntu toṇṭakap paṟaiyiṉatu tāḷattiṟku ēṟpak kuravaiyāṭutal marapu. (tirumuruku. aṭi, 195-197). kuṟappeṇkaḷ taḻaiyuṭai uṭuttu murukaṉ ciṟappiṉaip pāṭikkoṇṭē oruvarōṭoruvar kaikōttukkoṇṭu kuravaiyāṭi acaivatu vaḻakkam (aṭi, 202-216). maturaiccērikaḷil peṇṭir kaṭampa malaraic cūṭiya murukaṉai niṉaintu tammuḷ taḻuvik kaikōttu maṉṟutōṟum kuravaik kūttāṭiṉar (ma. kā. aṭi,612-614).
naṉṉaṉatu malai nāṭṭil malaiyucciyil vāḻnta kuṟavar naṟavai aruntit tam peṇṭirōṭu kūṭi, māṉ tōl pōrtta ciṟupaṟai kalleṉṟu olikkak kuravaik kūttāṭiṉar (malaipaṭu. aṭi, 320-322). vaḷḷikkūttu eṉpatu iḻintōr kāṇum kūttu. ikkūttu irupālārkkum potuvāy varuvatu. ciṟṟūrkaḷil ikkūttu naṭaipeṟutal vaḻakkam (pe. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 370-371). nāṭakam eṉpatu katai taḻuvi varum kūttu. ataṉai āṭiya makaḷir nāṭakamakaḷir eṉappaṭṭaṉar (pe. ā. paṭai, 55). viṟaliyar tāḷa aṟutiyaiyuṭaiya kuḻalōcaiyiṉ tāḷattiṟku oppa naṭaṉam āṭiṉar (ci. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 162).


kūttarai ātarittavar
kūtta nūlkaḷai naṉku kaṟṟu akkalaiyil pulamai peṟṟa kūttarait tamiḻ neṭunila maṉṉarum kuṟunila maṉṉarum naṉku pōṟṟip pātukāttaṉar. kaṭaiyeḻu vaḷḷalkaḷuḷ oruvaṉāṉa ōri, kūttarkkup pala nāṭukaḷai vaḻaṅkip pukaḻ peṟṟāṉ. ōymāṉāṭṭai āṇṭa nalliyakkōṭaṉum pala vācciyaṅkaḷaiyuṭaiya kūttaraip purantu peyar peṟṟāṉ (ci. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 107-109, 125). vattarāṟṟuppaṭaiyaiyē taṉmītu pāṭappeṟṟa peruñciṟappuṭaiyavaṉ naṉṉaṉ eṉṟa ciṟṟaracaṉ. avaṉ kūttar talaivaṉukkup poṟṟāmarai malaraic cūṭṭiṉāṉ; viṟaliyarkkup pēraṇikalaṅkaḷai vaḻaṅkiṉāṉ; yāṉai, kutirai, pacukkaḷ, celvam mutaliyavaṟṟai maḻaipōla vaḻaṅkiṉāṉ )malaipaṭu. aṭi, 568-580).
kūttaṉ pākkam eṉṟa ōrūr ki.pi. 13 allatu 14ām nūṟṟāṇṭil iruntateṉṟu māmallapurattuk kalveṭṭu oṉṟu terivikkiṟatu.1 ``puliyūrk kōṭṭattu māṅkāṭu nāṭṭuk kūttaṉ pākkam2 eṉpatu oru kalveṭṭu vācakam. kūttāṭi paṭṭi eṉṟu ōrūr iruntatai maṟṟoru kalveṭṭuk kuṟikkiṟatu.3 irāmanātapura māvaṭṭattut tirupputtūr vaṭṭattil kūttakkuṭi eṉṟa aticaya pāṇṭiya nallūr iruntatu.4 tañcaimāvaṭṭattil kūttaṉūr eṉṟa peyaril ōrūr iruntatu eṉpatu kalveṭṭāl terikiṟatu.5 mutaṟ kulōttuṅkaṉ 18ām āṭciyāṇṭil kōvil viḻāvil tamiḻakkūttu nikaḻttiya vikkiramātittaṉ tirumutukuṉṟaṉ eṉṟa virutarācapayaṅkara ācāriyaṉukkuk kūttāṭṭuk kāṇiyāka nilam viṭappaṭṭatu.6

28. vāṉakkalai
caṅkakālat tamiḻar, aintu pūtaṅkaḷaip paṟṟiyum, maḻai uṇṭātal paṟṟiyum, āṟu paruvaṅkaḷ paṟṟiyum, apparuvaṅkaḷil nikaḻum iyaṟkai māṟutalkaḷ paṟṟiyum, nāḷ mīṉkaḷ kōḷ mīṉkaḷ eṉpavai paṟṟiyum ōraḷavu aṟintiruntaṉar eṉpata pattup pāṭṭāl  terikiṟatu.
aimpūtaṅkaḷ
nilam, nīr, tī, kāṟṟu, vāṉam eṉpaṉa aintu pūtaṅfḷ.ivaṟWŸ vāṉam, taṉṉai oḻinta nāṉku pūtaṅkaḷum taṉṉiṭattē akaṉṟu virivataṟkuk kāraṇamāyuḷḷatu eṉpataip paḻantamiḻar aṟintiruntaṉar (pe. ā. paṭai, aṭi; ma. kā. aṭi, 266-7).
maḻai uṇṭātal
mēkam kaṭal nīraik kuṭittu valamāy eḻuntu malaikaḷai iruppiṭamākak koḷkiṉṟatu; peyyuṅkālattil ulakattai vaḷaittu eḻuntu kaṭiya celaviṉai mēṟkoṇṭu maḻai peyyum (mu. pāṭṭu, aṭi, 4-5).
irācikaḷ
vāṉaviyal aṟiñarkaḷ, viṇṇil cūriyaṉ celvatākat tōṉṟum vītiyākiya irāci maṇṭalattai ovvoṉṟum 30s, aḷavuḷḷa paṉṉiraṇṭu camapākaṅkaḷākap pirittiruk kiṟārkaḷ. intappākaṅkaḷai `irācikaḷ eṉpar. ivaṟṟukku muṟaiyē mēṭam, (Aries), iṭapam (Taurus), mituṉam (Gemini), kaṭakam (Cancer), cimmam (Leo), kaṉṉi (Virigo), tulām (Libra), viruccikam (Scorpionis), taṉucu (sagittarius), makaram (Capricornis), kumpam (Aquarius), mīṉam (Pisces) eṉpaṉa peyar. ippeyarkaḷ, antanta irācikaḷil amaiyum naṭcattirat tokutikaḷ mēṭam (āṭu) mutaliya vaṭivuṭaiyaṉavākat tōṉṟuvatāl ēṟpaṭṭaṉa eṉpar. cūriyaṉ inta irācikaḷil irukkum kālaṅkaḷai muṟaiyē cittirai, vaikāci mutaliya mātaṅkaḷ eṉa vaḻaṅkukiṟōm.
naṭcattiraṅkaḷiṉiṭaiyē pūmiyaip poṟuttuc cūriyaṉ iyaṅkum pātaiyum, cantiraṉum piṟa kirakaṅkaḷum iyaṅkam pātaikaḷum vāṉamaṇṭalattil cūriyappātaikku irupuṟamum cumār 9s tūrattiṟkuḷ aṭaipaṭum oru maṇṭalattil amaiyum. itaiyē irāci maṇṭalam eṉpar. inta maṇṭalattilēyē acuvati, mutaliya 27 naṭcattiraṅkaḷum irukkiṉṟaṉa. āṉāl, inta vitikku vilakkāka aṉuṣam, kēṭṭai, mūlam eṉṉum naṭcattiraṅkaḷ immaṇṭalattiṟku mikavum teṟkē irukkiṉṟaṉa.1
tiṅkaḷ
vāṉa veḷiyil iyaṅkum pala kōḷaṅkaḷuḷ tiṅkaḷ (cantiraṉ) oṉṟu. iḵtu uḷḷattil iṉpak kiḷarcciyai ūṭṭum pēreḻil uṭaiyatu. ulakil pala moḻikaḷil uḷḷa ilakkiyaṅkaḷ tiṅkaḷaip pukaḻntu pēcukiṉṟaṉa. pūmikku mika irukil uḷḷa kōḷam tiṅkaḷē. .itu namakkuc cumār 238,000 kal tūrattil irukkiṟatu. itaṉ kuṟukkaḷavu 2,160kal. itu pūmiyiṉ kuṟukkaḷavil kāṟpaṅku. cantiraṉ parappu, pūmiyiṉ parappil 1/13 paṅku; parumaṉil 1/49 paṅku. tiṅkaḷiṉ eṭai pūmiyiṉ eṭaiyil 1/82 paṅku.
cūriyaṉaiviṭac cantiraṉ mikac ciṟiyatēyāyiṉum, pūmikkuc cūriyaṉaiviṭa mikavum camīpattil iruppatāl, nam kaṇkaḷakkuc cūriyaṉum cantiraṉum perumpālum orē aḷavuḷḷaṉavāyt tōṟṟukiṉṟaṉa.
pūmiyaip pōlac cantiraṉukkum iru vakaic cuḻaṟcikaḷ uṇṭu. oṉṟu, taṉṉil tāṉē cuḻaṉṟu koḷvatu; maṟṟoṉṟu, pūmiyaic cuṟṟi varuvatu. cantiraṉ maṇikku 2300 mail vītam pūmiyai nīḷvaṭṭap pātaiyil cuṟṟukiṟatu. iṅṅaṉam atu pūmiyai oru muṟai cuṟṟivara ēṟattāḻa 30 eḷkaḷMkiṉṟaṉa.mJ taṉṉil tāṉē orumuṟai cuḻala 271/2 nāḷkaḷ ākiṉṟaṉa. cantiraṉ taṉṉil tāṉē cuḻaṉṟukoḷḷum vēkamum ēṟattāḻac camamākum. ātalāl, cantiraṉiṉ oru pākattai maṭṭumē nām pārkka iyalkiṟatu. pūmiyaip pōlavē cantiraṉukkum pakal iravu uṇṭu. pūmiyiṉ pakal iravu cērnta oru nāḷukku 24 maṇi; cantiraṉilō, kiṭṭattaṭṭa oru mātam. atāvatu, cūriyaṉ tōṉṟiṉāl, maṟaiyac cumār 15 nāḷkaḷ ākum; maṟaintāl, mīṇṭum tōṉṟa 15 nāḷkaḷākum. cantiraṉil niṉṟu pārttāl, pūmiyum oru periya cantiraṉaip pōlat tōṉṟum.1
urōkiṇi
urōkiṇi (Alebaran) acuviṉi mutal eṇṇappaṭṭa naṭcattiraṅkaḷuḷ nāṉkāvatu; iṭaparāciyil mikavum pirakācamāy viḷaṅkuvatu. inta mīṉ caṟṟuc cenniṟamuṭaiyatu; vāṉattiṟkāṇappaṭum irupatu oḷi mikunta naṭcattiraṅkaḷuḷ oṉṟu; cūriyaṉatu viṭṭattaip pōla aimpatu maṭaṅku koṇṭatu; eṇpatu oḷiyāṇṭut tolaivil uḷḷatu.2
`cantiraṉ takkaṉuṭaiya putalviyar irupatteḻuvarai maṇantāṉ; avarkaḷuḷ urōkiṇiyiṭam mikunta aṉpu celuttiṉāṉ eṉpatu purāṇakkatai.
pāṇṭimātēviyiṉ kaṭṭiliṉ mēṟkūraiyil iracimaṇṭalam vairayappaṭṭiruntatu; cantiraṉ, unrākiṇi, uruvaṅkaḷum vairayappaṭṭiruntaṉa. ākāyattiṭattē tiṇṇiya nilaiyiṉaiyuṭaiya kompiṉaiyuṭaiya mēṭarāci mutalāka ēṉai irācikaḷiṟ ceṉṟu tiriyum mikka celaviṉaiyuṭaiya ñāyiṟṟōṭē māṟupāṭu mikunta talaimaiyiṉai yuṭaiya tiṅkaḷōṭu tiriyāmal niṉṟa urōkiṇi eḻutappaṭṭiruntatu (neṭunal. aṭi, 159-163).
cūriya maṇṭalam
vāṉavītiyil oḷi vīcum cūriyaṉum, ataic cuṟṟi varum oṉpatu kirakaṅkaḷum, avaṟṟiṉ 28 upakirakaṅkaḷum pala ciṟu kirakaṅkaḷum vāl naṭcattiraṅkaḷum eri naṭcattiraṅkaḷum cūriya maṇṭalattil aṭaṅkum.
putaṉ, veḷḷi, pūmi, cevvāy, viyāḻaṉ, caṉi, yurēṉa, nepṭiyūṉ, puḷūṭṭō eṉpaṉa oṉpatu kirakaṅkaḷākum.
cūriyaṉukku miku aṇmaiyil uḷḷa kirakam putaṉ; miku tolaivil uḷḷatu puḷūṭṭō. peruṅkirakaṅkaḷ oṉpatuḷ mutal āṟu kirakaṅkaḷaic cātāraṇamākak kaṇṇiṉāl kāṇa iyalum. avaṟṟaip paṇṭaikkāla mutalē aṟintiruntaṉar. ivai yāvum tāmākavē oḷirāp poruḷkaḷ; tāṉē oḷirum naṭcattiramāṉa cūriyaṉiṭamiruntu oḷiyaip peṟṟup piratipalikkiṉṟaṉa. kirakaṅkaḷ yāvum nīḷvaṭṭamāyuḷḷa vevvēṟu pātaikaḷil orē ticaiyil cūriyaṉaic cuṟṟi varukiṉṟaṉa; pūmi ettaḷattil cūriyaṉaic cuṟṟi varukiṟatō, kiṭṭattaṭṭa atē taḷattil, atāvatu, caṟṟu māṟupaṭṭa taḷattil cūriyaṉaic cuṟṟukiṉṟaṉa.1
veḷḷi
cūriyaṉaic cuṟṟivarum oṉpatu kirakaṅkaḷil veḷḷi eṉṟa cukkiraṉum oṉṟu. cūriya maṇṭalattilē oḷi mikka kirakam cukkiraṉē. ataṉāl, mēṉāṭṭār aḻakut tēvataikkuriya vīṉa (Venus) eṉṉum peyarai itaṟku iṭṭuḷḷaṉar. itu cila mātaṅkaḷil piṉṉiravil kiḻakkilum, cila mātaṅkaḷil muṉṉiravil mēṟkilum tōṉṟum. itu paṟṟiyē itaṉaik kālai naṭcattiram eṉṟum, mālai naṭcattiram eṉṟum kūṟuvar.
cūriyaṉai aṭuttuc cuṟṟuvatu putaṉ; atai aṭuttuc cuṟṟuvatu cukkiraṉ. itu uruvam, parimāṇam, aṭartti ivaṟṟil ellām pūmiyai ottuḷḷatu. itu putaṉaippōla āṟu maṭaṅku oḷiyuṭaiyatu; cantiraṉaip pōla eṭṭu maṭaṅku piratipalikkum tiṟamaiyuṭaiyatu. ivvāṟu piratipalikkum taṉmai mikkatāyiruppatālē tāṉ cukkiraṉ oḷi mikka kirakamāy miḷirkiṉṟatu.2
porunaṉ, virikiṉṟa kiraṇaṅkaḷaiyuṭaiya veḷḷi eḻunta ceṟinta iruḷaiyuṭaiya viṭiyaṟkālattil karikālaṉ araṇmaṉaiyiṟpukuntu, taṉ taṭāriyil ōcaiyaip piṟappittup pāṭiṉāṉ (po. ā. paṭai, aṭi, 69-72).
veḷḷi teṉticaiyil vGjltīya nimi¤tam.aḵJ aṅṅaṉam eḻiṉum, pāṇṭi nāṭṭu yāṟukaḷ veḷḷam māṟāmal vantu viḷaivaip perukkiṉa (ma. kā. aṭi, 108-9).
`veḷḷiyākiya mīṉ tāṉ niṟṟaṟkuriya vaṭaticaiyil nillāmal teṉticaikkaṇṇē celliṉ, peyyum paruvattu maḻai peyyātu, eṉṟu nam muṉṉōr nampiṉar (pa. pālai,  aṭi, 1-2).
viṇmīṉkaḷ
viṇmīṉkaḷ eṉappaṭum naṭcattiraṅkaḷ cūriyaṉaip pōṉṟa kōḷaṅkaḷēyākum. cila, mikunta oḷiyuṭaiyaṉa; cila, kuṟainta oḷiyuṭaiyaṉa. mikavum aṇmaiyil uḷḷatu, nāṉku oḷiyāṇṭut tolaivil uḷḷatu. oḷiyāṇṭu eṉpatu, oḷiyāṉatu oru vināṭikku oru laṭcattu eṇpattu āṟāyiram mail tūram vītam ōrāṇṭu kālattil cellum tūramākum. cila naṭcattiraṅkaḷ pattāyiram oḷiyāṇṭut tolaivil uḷḷaṉa. vāṉattil kōṭikkaṇakkāṉa naṭcattiraṅkaḷ uḷḷaṉa. āyiṉum, nām veṟuṅkaṇṇōṭu orē camayattil teḷivāṉa iravil kāṇakkūṭiyaṉa ēṟakkuṟaiya mūvāyiramēyākum.
paṇṭaikkālattil vāḻnta makkaḷ naṭcattiraṅkaḷaik kūṭṭam kūṭṭamāka vakuttu, avai iṉṉa uruvam uṭaiyaṉa eṉṟu kūṟiṉārkaḷ; naṭcattirak kūṭṭattiṉuruvattai vaittu riṣapam (erutu), viruccikam (tēḷ), tulām (tarācu), eṉṟu palavāṟu peyariṭṭārkaḷ.
cila naṭcattiraṅkaḷ, cūriyaṉaip pōla nūṟu maṭaṅku kaṉa aḷavuuṭaiyavai. cūriyaṉ pūmiyaip pōla 330 āyiram maṭaṅku kaṉa aḷavuṭaiyatu. naṭcattiraṅkaḷ iṭam peyarkiṉṟaṉa. naṭcattiraṅkaḷ vēṟu vēṟu niṟaṅkaḷ uṭaiyaṉa. potuvākac civappu, ārañcu, mañcaḷ, nīlam eṉa nāṉku niṟaṅkaḷ kāṇappaṭum. niṟam vēṟupaṭuvataṟkuk kāraṇam, veppanilai vēṟupāṭēyākum.
naṭcattiraṅkaḷiliruntu varum oḷikkiraṇaṅkaḷil naṭuvil uḷḷavaiyum viḷimpil uḷḷavaiyum orē camayattil nammuṭaiya kaṇṇukku vantu cēruvatillai. ataṉālētāṉ naṭcattiraṅkaḷ imai koṭṭuvatu pōlat tōṉṟukiṉṟaṉa.1
nāḷ mīṉkaḷ
nīla niṟattaiyuṭaiya ākāyattē valamāka eḻuntu tiriyum nāḷkaḷākiya mīṉkaḷōṭē kalanta kōḷkaḷākiya mīṉkaḷ pōla-akaṉṟa iṭattaiyuṭaiya maṉṟilē āṭṭukkiṭāyuṭaṉ cival eṉṉum paṟavaiyaip paratavar poruvittaṉar (pa. pālai, aṭi, 67-69).
nāḷkaḷākiya mīṉkaḷ- irupattēḻu naṭcattiraṅkaḷ; kōḷkaḷākiya mīṉkaḷ- navakkirakaṅkaḷ eṉpavai. navakkirakaṅkaḷ ivai eṉpatu muṉpē kūṟappaṭṭatu. iṅku irupattēḻu naṭcattiraṅkaḷiṉ peyarkaḷaik kāṇpōm:

ivaṟṟuḷ acuviṉi (acuvati) eṉpatu, kutiraiyiṉ talai pōla uḷḷa āṟu naṭcattiraṅkaḷ koṇṭatu. (acuvam-kutirai).2 paraṇi eṉpatu mūṉṟu naṭcattiraṅkaḷ uḷḷatu. aḵtu aṭuppuppōla iruppateṉak kūṟuvar. (paraṇi-aṭuppu)1. ivvāṟu irupattēḻu naṭcattiraṅkaḷuḷ ovvoṉṟum, cila naṭcattiraṅkaḷiṉ cērkkaiyēyākum. accērkkai tarum uruvattaik koṇṭē ovvoru cērkkaiyum acuviṉi, paraṇi mutaliya kāraṇap peyarkaḷaip peṟṟatu.
kāvirippūmpaṭṭiṉattuk kaṭaṟkaraiyil irunta periya poykai, maḻai mācu nīṅkiṉa periya ākāyattiṭattu matiyaic cērnta makamākiya veḷḷiya mīṉiṉatu vaṭivu poruntiya valiya uyarnta karaiyaip peṟṟiruntatu. (pa. pālai,  aṭi, 34-38). iṅku, mati-poykaikkum, makamīṉ-karaikkum uvamikkum poruḷākum.
makam eṉṉum peyaruṭaiya naṭcattirak kūṭṭattil aintu pirakācamāṉa naṭcattiraṅkaḷ uḷḷaṉa. avai veṭṭarivāḷ pōla iruppatākat tamiḻarum, pallakkup pōṉṟu iruppatāka maṟṟavarum kūṟuvar. inta arivāḷiṉ kaippiṭiyil pēroḷi poruntiya oru naṭcattiram uḷḷatu. ataṟku rekula (Regulus) eṉpatu peyar. makanamcattirakkūṭṭam cimmarāciyil uḷḷatu.2
inta ilakkaṇam koṇṭu kāṇiṉ, mēlē kūṟappaṭṭa poykaiyiṉ karai veṭṭarivāḷ pōla iruntateṉpatu teḷivākiṉṟatu. poykaiyiṉ karaikku makamīṉai uvamai kūṟiya pulavaratu vāṉakkalai aṟivu viyakkaṟpālataṉṟō?
koḻuviya koṭiyaiyuṭaiya mucuṇṭai (mucuṭṭai) kārttikaiyākiya mīṉ pōla veḷḷitāy malarntatu eṉṟu malaipaṭukaṭām kūṟukiṉṟatu (aṭi, 100-101). mucuṇṭai koṭṭam pōṉṟa pūvait taṉṉiṭattē peṟṟatu eṉṟu ciṟupāṇāṟṟuppaṭai ceppukiṟatu (aṭi, 166). paṉaṅkurut tāṟceyyappaṭum oru vakaic ciṟiya peṭṭikkuk koṭṭam3 eṉpatu peyar.4 tīccuṭariṉ nuṉipōṉṟa amaippil āṟuviṇmīṉkaḷaik koṇṭa kūṭṭam kārttikai eṉappaṭum. aḵtu uṭaivāḷiṉ vaṭivam koṇṭatu. erittal ataṉ iyalpu. atu cemmai kalanta veṇmai niṟamuṭaiyatu. aḵtu aṅki, aḻal, āṟumīṉ, āral, ēri, taḻal eṉap pala peyarkaḷaip peṟum.

poḻutukaḷ
taṭpaveppanilai, iravu pakal nēra aḷavu ivai āṇṭu muṟṟum orē mātiri iruppatillai; kālattukkuk kālam vēṟupaṭum. inta vēṟupāṭṭaiyoṭṭi āṇṭaic cila iyaṟkaik kālap pakutikaḷākap pirikkalām. avvāṟu pirikkappaṭum pakutikaḷ, `paruvaṅkaḷeṉappaṭu kiṉṟaṉa.
caṅkakālat tamiḻar, yāṇṭai āṟu pirivukaḷākap pirittaṉar. avai kār, kūtir, muṉpaṉi, piṉpaṉi, iḷavēṉil, mutuvēṉil eṉpavai. ivai perum poḻutukaḷ eṉap peyar peṟṟaṉa.
1. āvaṇiyum puraṭṭāciyum - kār kālam
2. aippaciyum kārttikaiyum-kūtirkkālam
3. mārkaḻiyum taiyum-muṉ paṉikkālam
4. māciyum paṅkuṉiyum-piṉ paṉikkālam
5. cittiraiyum vaikāciyum-iḷavēṉiṟkālam

ivvāṟu paruvaṅkaḷ māṟi māṟi varuvataṟkuk kāraṇam, pūmi nīḷvaṭṭap pātaiyil cūriyaṉaic cuṟṟi varuvatē.1 ipparuvaṅkaḷ tolkāppiyar kālattukku (ēṟattāḻak ki.mu. 300kku) muṉpē nam muṉṉōrāṟ kaṇṭaṟiyappaṭṭavaiyākum. apperumakkaḷ ovvoru paruvattiṟkum uriya ciṟupoḻutukaḷaiyum kūṟiyuḷḷārkaḷ.
paṇṭaittamiḻar yāṇṭiṉai āṟu perumpoḻutu kaḷākap pirittāṟpōlavē oru nāḷaiyum āṟu pirivukaḷākap pirittaṉar. avai vaikaṟai, kālai, naṇpakal, eṟpāṭu, mālai, yāmam eṉpavai. ivai `ciṟu poḻutukaḷ eṉap peyar peṟṟaṉa.

iṅṅaṉam nam muṉṉōr ēṟattāḻa nāṉku maṇi nēram koṇṭatai oru ciṟu poḻutākak koṇṭaṉar.
tolkāppiyal kuṟiñci, mullai, marutam, neytal, pālai eṉṉum aintu ōḻukkaṅkaṭkum uriya perum poḻutukaḷaiyum ciṟu poḻutukaḷaiyum kīḻ varumāṟu kūṟiyuḷḷār.
1. mullai oḻukkattiṟkuk kār kālamum mālaip poḻutum uriyavai.
2. kuṟiñci oḻukkattiṟkuk kūtirkkālamum muṉ paṉikkālamum yāmamum uriyavai.
3. maruta oḻukkattiṟku āṟuparuvaṅkaḷum vaikaṟaiyum uriyavai.
4. neytal oḻukkattiṟku āṟu paruvaṅkaḷum eṟpāṭum uriyavai.
5. pālai oḻukkattiṟkup piṉpaṉiyum iḷavēṉilum mutuvēṉilum naṇpakalum uriyavai.1
pattuppāṭṭuḷ mullaipāṭṭum kuṟiñcippāṭṭum neṭunalvāṭaiyum akapporuḷ paṟṟiyavai. mullaippāṭṭil kārkālac ciṟappum ataṟkuriya mālaippoḻutu nikaḻccikaḷum talaivaṉaip pirinta talaivi āṟṟiyiruttalum ciṟappuṟak kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa. kuṟiñcip pāṭṭil yāma nikaḻccikaḷum puṇartalum puṇartal nimittamum naṉku kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa. neṭunalvāṭaiyum mullai oḻukkattiṟ uriyatu ātaliṉ, ataṉkaṇ kārkālamum kūtirkkāla nikaḻccikaḷum talaivaṉaip pirinta talaivi āṟṟiyiruttalum virivākak kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.

perumpoḻutukaḷ
kār
